(89)be/:rethos :rdo stuno sheṇ+ḍi /)krung da ga pa ba 'jug gnas bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe bsdur zhus/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang /

rgyud 'bum/ 'omi (89)0572 dpa' bo gcig pu grub pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po/ 3le'u dang po/ 3le'u gnyis pa/ 14le'u gsum pa/ 21le'u bzhi pa/ 28rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po dri paṃ ka ra shrī tsā na dang /lots+tsha ba dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur/dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(32) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(44)0573 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi zhal nas gsungs pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 451

rgya gar gyi mkhan po tsā na ga dang / lots+tsha ba ban+de klu'i dbang pos bsgyur/rgya gar gyi mkhan po bai shu so ha dang / zhu rdo/ gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de de ba tsan+d+ras gtan la bsdur mchan/(46) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(47)0574 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis dmod btsugs pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 48bsdur mchan/(50) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(51)0575 'jam dpal gyis dam bcas pa'i gzungs/ 52bsdur mchan/(53) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(53)0576 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan/ 54bsdur mchan/(55) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(55)0577 rje btsun 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi shes rab dang blo 'phel ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 56bsdur mchan/(57) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(58)0578 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sngags yi ge 'bru gcig pa'i cho ga 592

bsdur mchan/(60) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(60)0579 bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jam dpal rnon po la bstod pa/ 61bsdur mchan/(63) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(63)0580 'jam dpal ngag gi dbang phyug la bu mo brgyad kyis bstod pa/64bsdur mchan/(65) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(66)0581 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/ 67bsdur mchan/(72) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(73)0582 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa kau shi ka zhes bya ba/ 74bsdur mchan/(78) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(79)058 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba'i mdo sde'i rgyal po theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 80dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 80gnyis pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku che'i tshad bstan pa'i le'u/ 90gsum pa/ sku gsum rnam par 'byed pa'i le'u/ 114bzhi pa/ rmi lam na 'gyod tshangs byed pa mthong ba'i le'u/ 1343

lnga pa/ las kyi sgrib pa rnam par sbyong ba'i le'u/ 147drug pa/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i gzungs kyi le'u/ 176bdun pa/ pad+ma lta bu'i dpes bsngags pa brjod pa'i le'u/ 20 brgyad pa/ gser rgyal gyi gzungs kyi le'u/ 208dgu pa/ stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin bstan pa'i le'u/ 211bcu pa/ stong pa nyid la brten nas smon lam yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba'i le'u/ 216bcu gcig pa/ rgyal po chen po bzhis lha dang mi rnams la blta zhing brtag pa'i le'u/ 229bcu gnyis pa/ rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag gis yul bsrung ba'i le'u/ 23nabacu gsum pa/ mngon par zhen pa med pa'i gzungs kyi le'u/ 261bcu bzhi pa/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i gzungs kyi le'u/ 269bcu lnga pa/ lha mo spobs pa chen mo'i le'u/ 275bcu drug pa/ dpal gyi lha mo chen mo'i le'u/ 293bcu bdun pa/ dpal gyi lha mo chen mos nor 'phel bar byed pa'i le'u/ 296bco brgyad pa/ sa'i lha mo brtan ma'i le'u/ 301bcu dgu pa/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po yang dag shes kyi le'u/ 308nyi shu pa/ rgyal po'i chos lugs yang dag pa'i bstan bcos bstan pa'i le'u/ 312nyer gcig pa/ rgyal po legs skyes kyi le'u/ 321nyer gnyis pa/ lha dang gnod sbyin rnams kyis yongs su bsrung zhing 'dzin par byed pa'i le'u/ 325nyer gsum pa/ lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 333nyer bzhi pa/ nad rab tu zhi bar byas pa'i le'u/ 337nyer lnga pa/ tshong dpon gyi bu chu 'bebs kyi le'u/ 343

nyer drug pa/ lus yongs su gtang ba'i le'u/ 355nyer bdun pa/ phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bsngags pa brjod pa'i le'u/ 374nyer brgyad pa/ byang chub sems dpa' mdzes pa'i tog gis bsngags pa brjod pa'i le'u/ 376nyer dgu pa/ byang chub kyi shing gi lha mos bsngags pa brjod pa'i le'u/ 378sum cu pa/ lha mo spobs pa chen mos bsngags pa brjod pa'i le'u/ 380so gcig pa/ yongs su gtad pa'i le'u/ 382zhu chen gyi mkhan po dang lots+tsha ba bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs pa ban+de chos grub kyis rgya'i dpe las bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(388) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(459)0584 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 460dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 460gnyis pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku che'i tshad bstan pa'i le'u/ 469gsum pa/ sku gsum rnam par dbye ba'i le'u/ gosabazhi pa/ rmi lam na bshags pa'i le'u/ 507lnga pa/ las kyi sgrub pa rgyun gcod pa'i le'u/ 520drug pa/ sa rnam par sbyong ba'i le'u/ 548bdun pa/ 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad la bstod pa'i le'u/ 573brgyad pa/ gser can zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi le'u/ 578dgu pa/ stong pa nyid kyi le'u/ 5825

bcu pa/ stong pa nyid la brten nas bsam pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i le'u/ 586bcu gcig pa/ rgyal po chen po bzhis lha dang mi la rnam par lta ba'i le'u/ 598bcu gnyis pa/ rgyal po chen po bzhis yul 'khor yongs su skyong ba'i le'u/ 602bcu gsum pa/ chags pa med pa'i gzungs zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 638bcu bzhi pa/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i gzungs kyi le'u/ 641bco lnga pa/ lha mo dbyangs can gyi le'u/ 646bcu drug pa/ lha mo dpal gyi le'u/ 661bcu bdun pa/ lha mo chen mo dpal gyis nor yongs su spel ba'i le'u/ 664bco brgyad pa/ sa'i lha mo brtan ma'i le'u/ 667bcu dgu pa/ gnod sbyin gyi dbang po yang dag shes kyi le'u/ 675nyi shu pa/ rgyal po'i bstan bcos lha'i dbang po'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i le'u/ 680nyer gcig pa/ legs par byung ba'i le'u/ 688nyer gnyis pa/ gnod sbyin gyi gnas zhes bya ba kun tu srung ba'i le'u/ 692nyer gsum pa/ lha'i bu stong phrag bcu lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 699nyer bzhi pa/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byas pa'i le'u/ 704nyer lnga pa/ chu 'bebs kyis gdul ba'i nya'i sngon byung ba'i le'u/ 710nyer drug pa/ stag mo la lus yongs su btang ba'i le'u/ 720nyer bdun pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bstod pa'i le'u/ 738nyer brgyad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bstod pa'i le'u/ 739nyer dgu pa/ 'jug sdud kyi le'u/ 741paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi dra dang /shrī len+d+ra bo snyi dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes ldes bsgyur /dri sdos te skad gsar chad kyis gtad bsdur mchan/(743) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(798)

༄ga /dpa' bo gcig pu grub pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po/①sa gi /rgya gar skad du/ sid+dha ②ye ka bī ra ①ma hā tan+t+ra rā dza dunā ma/bod skad du/ dpa' bo gcig pu grub pa zhes bya ba'i ⑤rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po/ bcom ldan 'das du'ajam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo gcig grub dpa' bo'i gtso/ /rab mchog smra ba rnams kyi mchog /'gro ba'i bla ma 'jam rdo rjes/ /'jig rten don du rgyud rab gsungs/ /lha nyid gsang sngags tshul gyis ni/ /dngos grub thams cad stsol mdzad pa/ /sngags pas de nyid bsgoms nas ⑦ni/ /de nigrub na ni 'grub 'gyur te⑨/ /sngags pa lus ni rnam dag dang / /gang tshe dngos grub phra mo 'grub⑩/ /snod du gyur pa'i lus la yini/ /dngos grub chen po rab tu skye/ /rim 8pa 'di yis 'di la ni/ /sa la sogs pa 'thob 8pa skye/ /sngags pas ④yid bzhin nor bu ltar/ /rtag 8tu sems can don byed do/ /de ltar mkhyen nas thugs brtses 0non/ /rdo rje tso83—3

'chang sogs kyis zhus tshe/ /grub pa'i gsang sngags bsdus ①pa ni/ /'gro ba'i don du gsungs pa yin/ /oṃ kā lu me ②yu kā lu me nistam+bha ya sbri 0lā ba tuṣā rañca ④luts+tsha i luts+tsha i swā hā/ gsang sngags kyi rgyal po 'di ni dulegs par bzlas na ser ⑦ba gcod par byed do/ /dran pa nyid dang thal ba la mngon par bzlas pas duser ba 'bab pa'am kha ba 'bab ⑨pa gcod par 'gyur zhing gang du 'dod pa der 'gro'o/ /de bzhin du glog ⑩dang rlung dang rdo rje dang thog 'bab pa la sogs pa med par byed do/ /oṃ ga ru ḍa ⑩lha sa ho8/ tsa la tsa la ṭ+wā hā/sngags kyi rgyal po 'di dran pa nyid ni tsoser ba 'bab pa zlog ④par byed do/ /rdo rgyus kyis rnga pa ṭa 8ha la bris shing / rnga lcag ⑩la mngon par bzlas pa'i rnga pa ṭa biha'i sgras ser ba 'bab pa zlog 8par byed do/ /de bzhin du dung la sogs pa'i sgras kyang bya'o/ /oṃ he he/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ brnya brnya/ dhā ra ya ⑩dhā ra ya/ ni rud+dha ni rurta0 / che ge mo u 0ma ṇi ṭ+wā hā/ gsang sngags kyi rgyal po 6)'di sngon du bsnyen pa'i tshogs 'bum phrag gcig yongs su bzlas na 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /glog dang rlung dang rdo rje dang thog 'bab pa'am kha ba ⑥la sogs pa dran pa tsam nyid kyis zlog ④par byed do/ / ⑤thal ba dang yungs kur la tsomangon par bzlas na/ char ches pa gcod pa dang byi ba dang sbrang ma la sogs pa'i mchu 'ching bar byed do/ /skyed dumos tshal dang 3zhing la bya dang 'bu 0srin dang byi ba rnams kyis nye bar 'tshe ba zlog du )par byed do/ /dur khrod kyi (lharas la ming dang bcas pa'i sngags bris la spra tshil gyis gtums 9te/ dur khrod kyi bum par bcug rdunyanas kha bcad de/ de nyid du sbas pas mngal rengs par 'gyur rosaste/ /phyung nas 'o ma dang duchus bkrus te chu la tsobor bas zhi bar 89—4

'gyur ro/ /yung ba'am/ ba ༅blas gro ga'am ②gos sam lo ma la mngon par bris te/ spra tshil gyi nang du gtums ②pa'i sngags 'di grog mkhar gyi sa las 'jigs byed kyi dugazugs su byas pa de'i snying gar bcug ⑤ste de'i kha ⑥thal bas bkang nas sbas na/ rgol ba dang phyir 0rgol ba'i kha nirengs par byed do/ /rtsod sbyong ⑨byed pa na gzugs de nyid kyi lce la lan bdun mngon par bsngags ⑨ pa'i tsher ma bdun gyis btsugs yin kha 'ching bar byed ⑩par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rgyus kyis kham phor tshul bris te thal bas bkang la④/ kha sbyar 8te sbas na ⑩mi snyan pa brjod pa ⑩kha rengs par byed do/ /rdza mkhan gyi lag pa phyis pa'i ⑫'jim pa las/ lug gi gzugs su yibyas pa'i snying gar duspra tshil gyis gtums byapa'i sngags bcug na khros pa'i kha rengs par byed do/ /ske'am dudapung pa la sngags btags dun g.yul ngogs kyi mtshon cha'i chadabal zhi bar byed do/ /grog mkhar gyi 'jim dupa las byas pa'i tshogs kyi bdag po'i rkang pa'i mthil du sngags kyi rgyal po 'di 0bcug ste/ bzhi mdor sbas na 'gro ba dang 'ong ba thams cad rengs par byed cing rtag par dubyed pa thams cad rengs par byed do/ /gro ga'am tsogos la sngags kyi rgyal po 'di bris la spra tshil gyis gtums 0te de nyid kyi khong par bcug la/ bum pa sar zhu pa chus bkang ba'i nang du bcug na yongs su brtag pa ⑥rongs par byed do/ /bla gos kyi mtha' ma la sngags rjes su dran zhing mdud (nyepa bcings pas lam du rkun po la sogs pa rengs par byed cing /nags kyi ba men la sogs pa rwa can dudang mche ba can rnams rengs par byed do// bong ba la ④lan bdun sngags nunyete chur bcug na/ chu na rgyu ba'i kha 'ching bar 49byed do/ /dur khrod kyi ras la pha rol gyi dpung gi tshogs kyi skyes bu'i dugatso bo'i 83—5

ming smos pa'i sngags sna tshogs rdo rje'i dbus su bris la①/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i phyi rol du yi ge lo brgyad bris shing phyi rol dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor dang ldan par ②bris te/ phyogs rdo rjes brgyan ③pa'i spra tshil las byas pa'i dutshogs kyi bdag po'i khong par bcug pa'i sngags/ pha rol gyi dpung gi tshogs kyi sa mtshams kyi bar du ⑤bcug na dpung gi tshogs rengs par byed do/ /sngags oṃ duganyis kyi kha sbyor du bcug la yi ge ṭha ⑦zung gis yongs su bskor bdu/ phyi rol du yi ge lo brgyad kyis bskor ba dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor gyis khyanon ⑩pa sna tshogs rdo rjes nye bar mdzes par byas pa/ grog mkhar gyi 'jim tunyepa las byas pa'i tshogs kyi bdag po'i khong par bcug la0/ dur khrod kyi bum pa'i nang du bcug nas ⑫dur khrod du sbas pa'am/ phub ma'i sbyin sreg 8gis pha rol gyi dpung gi tshogs rengs par byed do/ / grong khyer tshig pa'i 0me la mngon du phyogs shing sngags 'dis mngon par bsngags ⑩pa'i chu snyim pa bdun rab tu gtor na khyim gang bsrung 0bar 'dod pa'i khyim de srung bar byed do/ /thal bas mgul pa ⑫bcings pas skyugs pa zlog 7par byed do/ /mthe'u chung gi rtse 0dam du btsir ⑥la sngags brjod pas skyigs bu med par byed do/ /thal ba la ⑤mngon par bsngags pas mig rengs pa sos 0par byed do/ /'brum bu la sogs pa rnam par 'tshe ba la ras kyi dum ri stebu la bris te/ khyim gang gi sgor btags ⑤pa'i khyim der 'brum bu la sogs pa tsornam par 'tshe ba zlog du )par byed do/ /nya dang sha dang chang dang 'bras chan (nyal sogs pa sbyin par 'gyur ba las grong gi phyi rol gyi char gtor ma chen po gtang 4)bar bya ba dang yam 0shing lnga dang 'bru lnga'i bye brag mar la btags 5)pas grong gi dbus su zhi ba'i thab khung dubyas la sbyin sreg 83—6

byas na bdud dang rnam par 'tshe ba thams cad rengs par byed do/ /gang 'ga' zhig la grong la sogs pa 'byin ①par 'gyur ba la bzlas pa tsam gyis zlog ②par byed do/ /rtag tu bzlas na lha dang lha ma yin dang lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mi mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /dpal rje btsun sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mngon par byang chub pa'i dus su/ bdud bzhi las rgyal bar bya ba'i don du ⑧sngags kyi rgyal po 'di mdzod spu las rnam par 0phyung ba'i phyir ⑤mdzod spu'i nor bu zhes bya bar 0grags pa yin no/ /gseg stim la mngon par bsngags te gtor bas dusbrul dag 'byer bar byed do/ / khyim gyi ⑨rig ngos tshul rdo rgyus la mngon par bsngags ⑩pas bris na sbrul gyis 'azil gyis non par mi 'gyur ro/ /yang na 8rdo leb la sngags tsogazong bus bskos 8te bris pa sbas na ri dgas ⑩dang sbrul gdug pa rnams khyim mam ⑩grong ngam grong khyer du sbas na 8ci ⑥srid 'dod pa'i du bar du mche ba 'ching bar byed do/ /phyung bas grol bar 'gyur ro/tse /sngags 'di ma bsgrubs su zin kyang sgrolas thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /gsog dum la sogs pa la yongs su bzlas te gtor na mche ba can thams cad kyi mche ba 'ching bar byed do/ /tsodabang chen gyi dkyil 'khor gyis khyab pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i dbus su bsgrub par ④bya ba'i ming dang bcas pa'i sngags thams cad bri bar bya'o/ /dur dukhrod kyi ro bsregs 0pa'i shing gi phur bu la lan bdun mngon par bsngags pa 0sgo'i steng du sbas na/ skyed kyis 'tsho ba thams cad kyi skyed med par byed do/ /phyung bas grol bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ ni hi nits+tsha dule a bha ya bha yaṃ ka ri/ e lu be lu 0tsu le lu/ shi lā ya ḍa du )yi dza ha ye/ pas i dzasta/ e pe lu ā ga sa pa the 0ke ra te/ i a tu mu ri ma dha ⑥ri khi 83—7

n+ni khi lawa mo ha ni thi bhi ②dza kā raṃ dza nyi thā kā ro niṇi nyi ṭhaḥṭhaḥswā hā/ sngags kyi rgyal po 'di sngar ma dusmos pa'i las thams cad ma bsgrubs ⑤su zin kyang byed par 'gyur ro/ /de las gzhan yang dumangon par 'dod pa'i las de dag ⑦thams cad byed par duthe tshom med do0/ /lan tshwa ⑩dang ske tshe mnyam pa'i ⑪sbyin sreg gam phub ma'i sbyin sreg gis pha rol gyi dpung gi tshogs rnams 'byer bar byed do/ / oṃ asna sista ka sgyu su dzo me phe ḍa e du sgyu su swā hā/ zhes byung ngo / /8ma am bā shim bhā 8kalpa su dzo me yi ④dus su/ sngags kyi rgyal po 'di ma bsgrubs 8su zin kyang rtag tu bzlas na 'jigs pa thams cad zlog ⑩par byed do / /rdo rje'i mchu'i thig les dgra bo thams cad rmongs par byed cing khros pas ⑫rab tu dang bar byed do/ /bcings pa la bzlas na bcings pa grol bar byed do//phongs par gyur pas ⑩bzlas na rnyed pa 0'grub par 'gyur ro/ /e khon duthi to/hu lu hu dzā lā dzi gte/ oṃ skoḥ to hu lu hu lu/ dzā lā dzi hwa twe 0hu lu ru tre+e ba pra ti rāts+tsha tu hu lu swā hā/ hu lu hu lu ya tre+e boḥ to hu lu ta tre+e ba pra ti gats+tshan+tu hu lu hu lu swā hā/④ sngags kyi rgyal po 'dis 'thab pa dang 'thab mo dang rnam par rtsod pa 'thams cad la bzlas pa byas pas ⑩zhi bar byed do ⑦/ /phub ma'i sbyin sreg 9gis kyang thams cad du zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar rnyed pa'i me tog la sngags rjod de / chu la bskur na thams cad du zhi bar 'gyur zhing rnam par rgyal ba thob par the tshom do)med do/ /grong khyer tshig pa'i me la mngon du phyogs pas 'dug ste(nye/ mngon par bsngags pa'i chu snyim pa bdun gtor na(nya/khyim gang bsrung sa bar 'dod pa'i khyim de srung chabar byed cing mes tshig pa'i me'i ri snyekha las thar bar byed do/ /rkang gnyis dang rkang bzhi'i mche ba la phub ma'i sbyin 83—8

sreg ①gis zhi bar byed do/ /oṃ pad+me pad+mā k+ṣi ②pad+ma su bha ge phuḥl/ pad+me pad+ma/ak+ṣe pad+ma/ su bha ge phuḥswā hā/du sngags ⑤'di thal ba la bzlas te bskus pas mig rgya btab pa rengs pa sos par byed do⑤/ /byabs ⑦pas mig rengs pa sos ⑧par byed do/ /lan bdun mngon par bsngags pas 0mig gis khros pa mthong ma thag tu rab tu dad par 0byed do/ /lan bdun mngon par bsngags pa'i chus gdong bkrus na skye bo thams cad dga' bar byed do/ /rtsig pa la ming smos pa'i sngags rdo rgyus kyis bris na mig yind thams cad 'joms par byed do/ /dben par 'dug ste sems rtse gcig pas skyes bu'i mig gnyis la mngon par bsngags pa byas na/ gang gi tshe g.yon pa 'gul 'bar gyur pa de'i tshe/ bsams pa'i dgos pa 0'grub par ston pa yin no/ /g.yas pa 'gul bar byed na mi dge ba'i dgos pa ston par byed do/ /oṃ mo tsa ni mo tsa ④ya mo k+ṣa ni mo k+ṣa ya/ dzī baṃ 8ba ra de swā hā/ 'dis tsomangon par bsngags pa'i til mar gyis ⑩skye ba'i sgo 8la bskus na/ sbrum ma bde bar btsa' bar byed do/ /bcings pa la mngon du 0phyogs par byed pas/ lan bdun mngon par bsngags 0 pa'i chu snyim pa bdun mngon par gtor ba dus gsum du byas pas bcings pa rnams grol bar byed do/ /gur gum mam 0gi wang gis gro ga tsol mngon par bris te/ bcings pa'i mgo bo la 0btags na bcings pa las tsogrol bar byed do/ / rtag tu bzlas na bcings pa grol bar byed do/ / ༷o ha ri marka ṭa tson ma/ sa hā sra bā huḥphya/ de ba da ta haṃ/ ban tsodha nān mok+ṣu ya swā hā/ rdo rgyus la mngon par bsngags pas sa'i steng du yang dang yang du bris te/lugs las bzlog ⑥pas phyis na bcings pa las grol bar byed do/ /lo ma la 89wa 9

ming dang sngags su bcas pa ①mngon par bris te/ mgo bo la btags na bcings pa thams cad grol bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ tā ri ṇi tā ra ya/ mo tsa ni mo tsa ya/ mo k+ṣa ni mo k+ṣa ya/ gli ② ba ra de swā hā/ sngags kyi rgyal po 'di legs par bzlas na las thams cad byed par 'gyur zhing / lan bdun mngon par bsngags pa'i til mar gyis ③skye ba'i sgo la bskus na sbrum ma bde bar btsa' bar 'gyur ro/ /lan bdun mngon par bsngags pa'i chu 'thungs na/ mngal 'khyim ④pa bde bar btsa' bar byed do/ /rtag tu bzlas pas ⑤bdag dang gzhan 'ching ba las thar bar 'gyur roX/ /ske'am ⑦dpung pa la bsrung nib btags pas 'jigs ⑨pa thams cad las srung bar byed do/ /oṃ tā re 0tu'i re tu re mok+ṣa ya dzī ⑩bo swā hā/ sngags kyi rgyal po 'di 8sngar smos pa'i bya ba 0byed par 'gyur ro/ /gur gum gyis gro ga 8la gang gi 8ming smos pa'i sngags mngon par bris la spra tshil du gtums 0te/ dri zhim po'i 7chus bkang ba'i bum pa gsar 8pa'i nang du bcug ste/ me tog dri zhim po la sogs pas dus gsum du mchod pa byas na 'thab pa dang 'thab mo dang rtsod pa thams cad las rnam par rgyal bar 'gyur ro//gur gum gyi gro ga ⑩la gang gis 0ming smos pa/ oṃ 0ye raṇ+ḍa su zho )ba ne kā ko/rang gā tī ra mu ya asbi taḥyi ba tu dru ta/ yā nī yam+bi phyoshalnga bha ba tu gu'i tsā.i/ oṃ e raṇ+ḍa ba ne kā gaḥgaṅgā tī ra mu ba sbri taḥpi ba tu dru taḥsā nī yam+bi shasgyu bha ba tu kugri swā hā/(nya lan bdun mngon par bsngags pa'i chu khyor ba gsum pho nyar 'ongs pas 'thungs na stan/ sbrum ma bde bar btsa' bar byed do/ /oṃ a phyem ra ṇi ṭī phyuban ti ye 4)swā hā/ sngags kyi rgyal po 'di legs par bzlas na las (1thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /mngon par bsngags pa'i chu 'thungs na 'brum 89—10

bu bya'ong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /lus las skyes pa'i dug mi bzad pa dang spre'u dug dang sbrul dug ②la sogs pa'i rma la yung ba sridang a ru ra dang ru rta la sogs pa la yongs su bzlas te bskus na rang bzhin du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /nad dang rnam par 'tshe ba thams cad la sngags mdud bcings na 0zhi bar byed do/ /rtag tu bzlas na tshe zad pa yang tshe ⑧lo brgya thub 0par 'gyur ro/ /mar dang til ⑦gyi sbyin sreg nigis thams cad zhi bar byed do/ /mngon par bsngags pa'i sman gyi btungs pas nad ⑨thams cad las yongs su 0thar bar byed do/ /lan brgya 0bkrus pa'i mar la mngon par bsngags pas tson ba'i yan lag la bskus na rang bzhin du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /mgo'i tsond la til mar la bsngags te bskus pas rang bzhin du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /gdug pa'i rma la chu la bsngags nas gtor bas sos par 'gyur ro/ / spri ha'i ④nad la be tsodang la sogs pa'i tsomatshon gyis gtubs na spri ha ⑩bcad par 'gyur ro/ / ni rgyan dhi ⑫dang nim pa'i rtsa ba rma bya'i mjug 7sgro dang bcas pa dugacig tu sbyar la/ brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bsngags pa'i bdug pas ⑥bdugs na/ rims nyin gcig pa dang / ⑤nyin gnyis pa dang / nyin gsum pa dang / nyin bzhi pa la sogs pa sel bar byed cing / 'byung po dang du/ sha za dang / tshangs pa dang ④/srin po la sogs pa sel bar 'gyur ros/ /bud med bu shi bas lan khyabargya rtsa brgyad mngon par bsngags pa'i bum pas khrus byas na bu 0gson po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /gro ga dul bris pa'i sngags rked pa'am 0dpung pa la btags pas zhu mngal srung bar 'gyur ro0/ /sngags rjes su dran pas g.yul ngogs su 'jug na rgyal ba rnyed sapar 'gyur zhing byabs pas nad thams cad sel bar byed 83—11

do / /oṃ pā da tsā ①la ne swā hā/ sngags kyi rgyal po 'di sngon du bsnyen ②pa'i cho gas legs par bsgrubs na dulas thams cad byed doX/ /phol mig gi ⑤'jigs pa la mngon par bsngags pa'i chu 'thungs na phol mig med par 'gyur ro/ / gro ga'am shog gu dul bris te sgo la btags pas phol mig med par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni 'tshe ba thams cad la mar la btags pa'i til gyi ⑦phyin sreg gis byasung ba chen po yin no/ /khu'i sgro lag pas bzung ⑨ste bzlas pa khri byas la gang gi ⑩khang pa'i steng gi logs 7su sbas pas de 'byer bar byed do/ /oṃ pi shā tsi paṇ+ḍi ⑫sha wa ri sarbo 7pa dra ba nā sha ni 8swā hā/ rig pa chen mo 'di ma bsgrubs su zin kyang rkang gnyis pa 7dang rkang bzhi pa thams cad kyi rnam par 'tshe ba sel bar byed cing / las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro⑩/ /sbyin sreg gam ⑩bzlas pa'am khrus sam sngags mdud dam mngon par bsngags pa'i chu 'thungs 8pa'am byabs pas 37nad thams cad sel bar byed do/ /gro ga du la gur gum gyis bris pa'i sngags ske'am cadapung pa la btags na rtsod sbyong la 3rgyal ba thob par 'gyur zhing / —rte rims nyin bzhi pa la sogs pa mi bzad pa las rnam par grol ④bar 'gyur ro/ /srin po la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa sel bar byed cing / 'thab pa dang 'khrug pa dang rtsod pa dag las rgyal ba sgrub 9 nyapar byed do/ /stag dang chu srin dang lto 'phye chen po dang rkun 3nyepo la sogs pas 8)mi mthong zhing rtag tu bzlas na skye bo thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ ār+ya tre tī ā( nye/ a mu ka su tsak+ṣa stam+bha ya ti 36ṭhaḥṭhaḥswā hās )/ tshes 8lhagang la du mig na bar gyur pa de la rtsig so pa'am spang leb la rdo rgyus kyis tshes bris gigel yi ge e zhinakha sbyar gsum du 69bya'o/ /oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags kyi rgyal po 'di lan cig so bzlas pas sdig 89—12

pa thams cad nges par sreg par ①byed do/ /'byung po la sogs pa'i gdon ②gyis zin ①pa la yungs kur la sogs pas ④brdegs pas gdon thams cad 'byer bar byed do/ /kham phor la rdo rgyus kyis bris ⑤te sgo la btags pas gsar du btsas pa'i byis pa srung bar byed do/ /spra tshil gyis gzugs 0sor bzhi pa byas pa de'i snying gar ⑦bsgrub bya'i ming dang bcas ⑧pa'i sngags mngon par bris te bcug la de'i kha la tsher ma btsugs spun phyir rgol ba'i kha phur bus btab par 'gyur ro/ /rkang pa la btsugs ⑩na 'gro ba dang 'ong ba 7rengs par byed do/ /snying ga tsol btsugs na khro ba 0'joms par byed do④/ /mi'i rje ngar gyi tsorus pa'i phur bu'am/ lcags kyi phur 0bus gdab par bya'o/ /ming nas bzung zhing yan lag gang dang gang la phur bus gdab ⑩pa de dang de 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /dgra bo'i sgo'i 'og tu 7sbas na 'byer bar byed do/ /dur khrod kyi thal ba la mngon par bsngags pas sgo'i ⑩ya them la gtor na 'byer ro( )ske/ /ral gri la mngon par bsngags la rgu nyegayul du 'jug na rgyal ba sgrub ④par byed do/ /bya ba gang la 'jug pa na gtor ma nye bar bstabs 3na de dang de 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /sngags pa dge ba'am lustemi dge ba'i las gang 'dod pa ebazlas pa tsam gyis byed do/ /oṃ 39ka phye span+da span+da two/ sru n+ya be bla ( rteni ma ma twa byathā span+da ya sba/ span+da si ba dza ṇi ( leg hā/ oṃ kā shi span+da ka she span+da ā+oṃ d+me shu n+ya be thra ni a sma kuṇ+ḍa ta thā span+da ya thā span+da si ba dza ṇa swā hā/du ) mig 'gul bar gyur nunyen byabs pas zhi bar byed donu / /oṃ rdza sgye mo hi hri da ya mā brta suni hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ sngags kyi rgyal po 'di tho rangs shustebya rog sgra mi nunyegrag pa'i dus su/lan bdun mngon par bsngags pa'i chus gdong bkrus na skye bo thams cad dga' 89—13

bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal la ①ba mar dang ②pad+ma dkar po'i skud pa'i sdong pos ⑤du ba blangs la/ brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bsngags pa byas pa 0des mig la bskus pas ④bud med thams cad yid 'phrog 0par byed do/ /rgyal la rgyas thur du bltas ⑧pa'i me tog gi rtsa ba dang shi ri khaṇ+ḍa ⑨dag sbyar la/ brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bsngags pa des ⑩jig ler byas na rje bo khros pa de ⑩rab tu sad par ⑫byed do/ /ku co dang 'thab pa dang rtsod pa dag las rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /cho ga bzhin 0rtag tu bzlas pas grong khyer bskyod pa skyed par byed do/ /oṃ ste bha ni/s+t+waṃ 0bha ya/ rdza bha ni/ rdza bha ya/ mo ha ni/8 mo ha ya/ rak+ṣa ni 'i8/rak+ṣa ya rmā0/ ba ra di rtsonyasid+dha lo tsa ni ⑦/swā hā/ sangs rgyas spyan gyi snying po 'dis 'jigs pa thams cad sel bar byed do/ /dpa' bo gcig pu grub pa ⑥rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las le'u dang po rdzogs so0// //rab sad legs par sangs rgyas pa'i/ /slob ma yon tan gzhi ⑤yin padu/ /bla ma la gus mkhas pa la/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po bshad par byabu/ /oṃ na mo bi ma (nyal tsan+d+ra ya/ de ba pu ⑩tā ya/ sa h+ye na sgri ya ti lo maḥs h+ye na pa ri gro h+ya te sa h+ye na dharmaḥn 3sbi to lo kuḥ sa h+ye bras sa tān rna/ sa traṃ bu rtso dhan: saṃ gha: tsog ṇa sā 9 )ga raḥ.a ne na sa traṃ du)bā kye na k+ṣi pra mā bi sha dar+sha khebya/ tabya thā/ oṃ sa ra sa ra snye/ si ri si ris / su ru su ru/ me ru man+da bur pra ti kā sa ā bi sa ā bi sha /kai lā gyes ku ṭa pu gi5tā ya na maḥ swā hāzhun/ yan ma yā tsin ti haṃ kāru ta ta sarba bru hi ta tā ta/ āt+na bā pa rā bā so)shu bha ya/ di bā 0shu lha/ nang par gtsang ba'i ( snas phyogs su dkyil 'khor byas shing bum pa bzhag (nya89wa 14

la/ lha'i bu dri ma med pa'i zla ①ba la mchod pa rgya che ba ②byas nas me mo nga nil mngon par bsngags te/ khye'u 'am bu mo legs par khrus byas la dugos legs par bkrus pa dubaskon cing du/ tsan+dan dkar po'i lde gagus yan lag byugs ⑧la me tog dri zhim po'i phreng ba stimagul du btags pa/ grong ba'i 0chos kyis rab tu ma nyams (nyepa la bstan na ji ltar bsams pa'i dgos pa phyin ci ma log par ⑫ston par 'gyur ro/ /dgongs 8sngas drung du dkyil 'khor nye bar byugs ④la/bcom ldan 'das dang lha'i bu dri ma med pa'i zla ba la mchod pa rgya 8chen po byas la/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas cang mi smra bar nyal na dge ba dang mi dge ba ji ltar bsams ⑩pa bzhin 0ston par 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu bzlas na 'jig rten gsum 8gyi spyod pa ston par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ shra ba ṇa 7pi shā tsi ni muṇ+ḍi du swā hā/ba ru ra'i shing ngam n+ya gro dha'i shing gi rtsa bar 'dug la/ cang mi smra bar 'bum phrag gcig bzlas na grub 0par 'gyur te 'jig rten gsum gyi spyod pa ru yang ston par 'gyur rodu/ /yang na legs par khrus byas la gos gtsang ma bgos te dben par 'dug la khri bzlas pas grub ④par 'gyur ro/ /dgongs dunyal kur ru rta la brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bzlas nas gdong dang (nyarkang pa gnyis bkrus na/ mi lam du 0dge ba dang mi dge ba rnam par ston par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ na maḥ sabhā ṭ+wāṃ/ samyakle ( shebu / ko ṭī shu)dzā/ tabya thā/ oṃ tsa le tsu le/ tsun+da du byeswā hā/ bīr+ya dus t+ya pā di sonyeni ba ra de ka thā nunyeya swā hā/ gong du bshad pa'i cho gas ④me long ngam ral gri'am mar me'am chu snod la ston par byed do/ /lan brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bsngags pa'i chus gdong bkrus la so mi smra bar du nyal na mi lam du dge ba dang mi dge ba sgo 7ston par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ mu tsi li swā hā/89—15

mo ha ni swā hā/ dan ti ①mi swā hā/ gsang ②sngags 'di khri bzlas na 'grub ①par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la mchod pa rgya chen po byas nas lan brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bsngags pa'i chus gdong bkrus te/ dgos pa yid la byed pa'i bzlas pas mi smra bar nyal na bcom ldan 'das rang gi gzugs su mthong bar 'gyur zhing dge ba dang mi dge ba rmi lam du dmigs ④par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ pra dzā ⑤la hūṃ phaṭa/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten mgon po'i snying po 'di lan yi'abum phrag bcu bzlas na 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gong du smos ⑦pa'i cho gas dge ba dang mi dge ba mi lam du ston par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā 〉du/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā ṭ+wāṃ/tabya thā/ ku mā ra rū pi ṇi medar+sha ya/ āḥ 47/ bi bhū ṣi ta me da pa ra be khyu ti (lha'i ta sa mud bhā ba yadhi/ swa pa ṭ+wāṃ 0ni be da ya/ ya thā bhū ④rta hūṃ rdu phaṭa 'phaṭa swā hā/ rje btsun ⑩'jam dpal gzhon nu'i bris 7sku'am lugs ma'i ⑫mdun nam sku gdung dang bcas pa'i mchod rten la ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa byas te/ brgya phrag bdun bzlas pa byas na rmi lam du bdag nyid dmigs shing gzhan dag gis 37kyang mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ kuṇ+ḍi pi shā tsi kuṇ+ḍi me ka thā ri du )ya hūṃ phaṭa / sha za'i shing gi drung gi tsho 1tsa bar khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas shing / de nyid du mi smra bar 'dug ste/ sha dang nya sha dang mi nunyesha dang 'dzam bu ti ka la mngon par bsngags pa'i gtor ma nye bar bstabs la dus gsum du sngags ṇa snyebazlas na/ zhag dang po la mtshan ma nye bar ston par byed cing phyis 'ong ba 'grub par 'gyur zhing soste/ de la sogs pa 69srid pa gsum gyi spyod pa rnam par ston par byed do/ /zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogatshangs pa gsod 89—16

pa yang ①'grub par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ tsa tusku dza tsa turmu kha niṣaṭa mu kha/ bi kṛ tā dunan kuṇ+ḍi pi shā 0tsi ma ā kun+ta ya hūṃ phaṭa/ dur khrod du gshin rje mthar byed kyi bris sku'i mdun du bzlas pa byas na zhag bdun nas sha za rna sgrogs ⑤'grub par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ bud+dha 0tsu ru mā ⑦〈 ru ke swā hā/ sku gdung dang bcas pa'i mchod rten nam rje btsun dusangs rgyas kyi 0spyan sngar bsnyen pa 0cho ga khri bzlas la/de'i 'og tu ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa byas nas nyal ba'i dus su brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ bdag gang nas skyes par gyur gang du ⑩skye bar 'gyur zhes yid la bsams shing nyal na 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa'i skye ba dmigs par 'gyur bar 8the tshom med do/ /gal te zla ba drug gi nang rol tu 'chi bar 'gyur na de'i tshe rmi lam du bdag gam gzhan gyi mgo bo 0mi mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du mngon par bsngags pa'i me long bltas pa tson khye'u 'am bu mo gang gi tsamago bo mthong bar ma gyur pa de'i ⑩zla ba drug gi nang du 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /rdo mig bu mig dang shing a gas ti chadakar po'i rtsa ba reng bur byas te/ brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bsngags pas mig la byugs 8na/ gang dag zla ba drug gi nang du 'chi bar 'gyur ba'i rkang ༅gnyis dang rkang du bzhi 0de dag thams cad kyi mgo bo du dz+wamed pa mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ swasna 'bi lo ki ni sid dha lo tsa ni swasna/ me ka thā ④ya swā hā/ sngags kyi rgyal po 'di gong nas smos pa'i cho gas ⑤las thams cad byed phyepar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ a di ti de ba data haṃ/ me zhu de nyi da dā ba ya swā 'ahā/ chu'i nang du zhugs te bu mo gang gang 0gi ched du bzlas pa byed pa de de nyid la ster bar byed do/ /yi ge 'bum bzlas pa byas pa so ripri yang ku'i me tog gam pa la sha'i me tog gi sbyin sreg 'bum gyis dpal chen po 83—17

grub ①par byed do/ /mtshan mo 'o ma can gyi ②yam shing gis sbyin sreg byas nas③/grong gang gi ched du sbyin sreg bzlas pa byed 0pa de rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /pad+ma rnams sam bil pa ⑤rnams kyi 'bras bu'i zhusbyin sreg 'bum gyis rgyal rigs su skyes pa rgyal srid ⑨rnyed par 'gyur zhing gzhan dag gis dudapal chen po thob par byed do/ /ji lta ba bzhin du rnyed pa'i me tog rnams kyi 0sbyin sreg 'bum phrag bdun gyis 'byor pa mi zad par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ dza ye/ bi dza ye/ a dzi te/a 7pa rā dzi te swā hā/ sring mo bzhi'i snying po'i 7sngags kyi rgyal po 'di gong du bshad pa'i cho gas 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas na/ gong du bshad pa'i cho gas 8las thams cad 0byed par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ me ④sgo'i ya swā hā/ pa la sha'i me tog gam yam shing gis sbyin sreg tso'abum phrag gcig byas na gser srang 'bum rnyed par 'gyur zhing bu mo don du gnyer bas kyang gang mngon par ⑩'dod pa'i bu mo rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ ka ma la bā si ni/ ka ma le ma hā lasmri ra rdzu me de ⑩hi ba ra de swā hā/ gsang 8sngags 'di ni dpal chen po'i 7snying po'o/ /rtag tu bzlas pa byas na phun sum tshogs pa'i mchog ster bar 'gyur ro/ /ji lta ba bzhin du rnyed pa'i me tog gi sbyin sreg ze gis dpal chen por 'gyur zhing mngon par 'dod pa'i bu mo 'grub rka nyepar 'gyur ro/ /ras bal gyi sa bon gyi tshad tsam dugu gul gyi ri lu 2nyemangar gsum la 9 ste btags pa'i sbyin sreg ( —nye'abum mam 0pad+ma'i sbyin sreg 2 'bum gyis rgyal srid sgrub par byed do/ /oṃ nan tu nar ni ba ra ded ni ba ra de/ gi ni 3kyi ṇi khi ṇi/ la la khi ṇi la khi ṇi/9 shri yaṃ durtege da da bo (nyeṣa ṭa swā hā ge/ dga' byed gi ma'i sngags kyi rgyal po tsuge'adi ni gong du bshad pa'i las thams cad do 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ dzam ste mo te tsos hā/ rje btsun 89—18

ma sgrol ma la ka ra bī ①ra'i me tog gis mngon par mchod de/ sngags kyi rgyal po ②yi ge 'bum bzlas na yid la re ba thams cad nirdzogs par byed do/ /oṃ ba su dhā ri ṇi dhiswā hā/ oṃ rgyashrī ba su swā hā/ oṃ ba su shrī ye swā hā/ oṃ shrī ba su mu khri duswā hā/ oṃ shrī ⑦ba su ma ti shrī ye duswā hā/ bdag nyid dzam+bha ⑨la'i gzugs su bsgom tshul/ rang gi snying ga'i ⑩zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su ba su dhā hunyer gser gyi mdog can phyag gnyis pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ shar phyogs ⑫la sogs pa'i phyogs na hunyelha mo bzhis bskor ba g.yas kyis mchog sbyin pa/g.yon gyis 8'bras kyi snye ma bsnams pa bsgoms la 0yid la re ba rdzogs par byed do/ /ba'i lci bas dkyil 'khor gru bzhi khru do ba'i 7tshad du byas la/ dus gsum du me tog dri zhim pos mchod de stong phrag bzhi bzlas pa byas na zla ba drug gis 0yid la re ba thams cad rdzogs par byed do/ /ji lta ba bzhin du yirnyed pa'i me tog gi zhu )sbyin sreg 'bum phrag bzhi byas na dpal chen por 'gyur zhing /yi ge 'bum bzlas na dpal chen po 'grub par byed dozhunye/ /gu gul gyi ri lu'i sbyin sreg me'abum byas na/ yid la re ba yongs su rdzogs par byed dozhuge/ /oṃ ba su dhā ④ri ṇi a mu ke ka ṭ+wāṃ me de hi/( —nye rā pa ya swā hā/ sngags 'di chu'i nang du ( nyezhugs nas khrus byas te 'bum phrag bzhi nges par bzlas pa du byas na/mngon par 'dod pa'i bu mo thob du par 'gyur ro/ /mtshan mo 'o ma can gyi ri rtseyam shing gis grong gi ming nas smos nas sbyin sreg zhu )'bum byas na grong rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ ba su dhā ni ri ṇi swā hā/ oṃ tsan+d+ra kān s+t+ya saswā hā/ oṃ dat+ta yi susnyeg hā / oṃ ba su das sanayi swā hā/ oṃ ār+sā yi dunaswā hā/ oṃ su bha drwa yi swā hā/ oṃ gus yi (9swā hā/ oṃ de byi su swā hā/ oṃ swa ra swa s+t+ya du:swā hā/ gser gyi byang 89wa 19

bu'am dngul gyi byang bu'am zangs ma'i ①byang bu'i me tog la 'dab ②ma brgyad pa'i dbus su bub su dhā ra/ shar la sogs pa'i 'dab ma la tsan+d+ra kā dul sogs pa gnod sbyin mo rnams mngon par bris pa'i byang bu gnyis kha sbyar du byas pa'i nang du mar dang sbrang rtsi dang ka ra bcug ste/ gong du bshad pa'i cho gas sngar smos pa'i las rnams byed par 'gyur ro/ /dbus su ni oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ya ⑤su hā/ phyogs su ni oṃ ma ṇi 0bha drwa ya swā hā/ oṃ puṇ+ḍi gabha drwa ya swā hā/ oṃ dha na dā ⑧ya swā hā/ oṃ bai shra ba ḍā ya 〈peswā hā/ mtshams su ni oṃ ki ⑩li mā li swā hā / oṃ tsi bi kuṇ+ḍa ⑩li ni swā hā0/ oṃ mu khen+d+ra 8ya swā hā/ oṃ tsa ran+da ya 8swā hā / gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'o⑩/ /bcom ldan 'das ni ba su dhā ri ⑩dang bcas pa gser gyi mdog can/ ne'u ⑩le dang bī dza pu ra hunyes bon gyis bkang ba phyag na bsnams pa/ gsus pa 'phyang yib/rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gong du bshad pa'i gnod sbyin mo dang /gnod sbyin gyi dbang po dang bcas pa la/ dus gsum du mchod pa byas nas/bsgoms 9 rteshing bzlas pa byas na bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jig rten gsum gyi rgyal srid stsol bar mdzad do/ /tho rangs chu khyor ba brgya rtsa brgyad sbyin pa dang bya rog gi skad 31mi grag par chu'i nang du zhugs te/ bzlas pa byas zhu nyapa de'i gter mi zad cing 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na gser la sogs du nyapa'i byang bu la ba su dhā ra snyeganod sbyin mo dang bcas pa dang / byang bu gnyis pa la bcom ldan 'das dzam+bha ( nyal gnod sbyin gyis bskor ba yang dag par bris la/ kha sbyar du byas te mnyes par byas na dngos grub chen po brgyad kyang ster bar mdzad na/grub pa gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ dpa' bo gcig pu grub pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal 89—20

po chen po ①las le'u gnyis pa rdzogs sol// //oṃ badz+ra tīk+ṣa②/ duḥkha: da pra dz+nyā dz+nyā na myurta duye/ dz+nyā na kā ya bā gli shwa ra a ra pa tsa nā ya te na maḥ/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje dpa' bo gcig pu ⑤grub pa/ ston ma'i zla ba'i du'od ltar dkar ba/ phyag g.yon na ut+pa la sngon po bsnams pa/ g.yas kyis memachog sbyin par bdag nyid bsams la i ā bya nud ⑧pan na pra kṛ te⑨/ pra bhā swa ro⑩/ su bi shud+dha/ dharma dhā tu/ tri sabhā hā ta swa yir swa ti pā ṇi mu pa la bha te/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gis dbyangs can gyi ngag thob par 'gyur zhing ⑫/ zla ba drug gis ngag gi dbang phyug 'grub ⑫par byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das ngag gi dbang phyug mngon sum du mthong zhing thos pa 'dzin pa yang thob par 'gyur ro/ /shu dag zho 0phyed kyi tshad 0la lan brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bsngags pa/ tho rangs 'o ma'am mar ram til mar dang lhan cig ⑩zla ba gcig ⑩'thungs snyin glen pa dang dig pa med par byed doyi / /khu byug dar ma'i zhu skad dang 'dra bar dbyangs 0snyan cing tshig gsal bar 'gyur ro/ /zla ba drug goms par byas na ma thos pa'i bstan bcos mngon du 'gyur zhing / thos pa nam yang brjed ④par mi 'gyur te tsothos pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ bā kye rda ( sten maḥ/ rje btsun gsung gi dbang phyug gi snying po 'di gong ( sem bzhin ⑩ting nge 'dzin la gnas pas goms par byas na gong du bshad pa'i las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /rgya mtshor 'gro ba'i chu bo la ske ba 0tsam gyis chu la rgal la dzā shunyeti'i me tog gi 0phun pa 'bum phrag gcig blangs nas sngags brjod cing / phug pa re re rgyun phyogs su 'bab par 'gyur ba las/89—21

phun pa gcig rgyun las bzlog par 'ong ba ①de so la ma reg par mid na thos pa 'dzin pa la sogs stsol bar semadzad do/ /ji lta ba bzhin rnyed pa ①me tog gi ④sbyin sreg ⑤'bum phrag bzhi byas na ngag gi dbang phyug dang mtshungs dupar 'gyur rol/ /sman bh+ra ma'i ⑦bye ma zho bzhi 2tsam la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la tho rangs dkyil 'khor byas te/ ci 'byor pas bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje la yang ⑨dag par mchod de/ mar ram rang boskyur dang sbyar nas yi'athungs na zla ba drug gis thos pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /tshig gi ⑩bdag po'i dbyangs snyan par 8yang skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sngon du bsnyen pa'i cho gas yi ge 'bum bzlas na sngags kyi rgyal po 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /phyis zla ba gzas zin pa dang ④nyi ma gzas zin pa na lcags las byas pa'i ral gri rang gi lag pas blangs te/ zla ba mi snang ba ji 0srid grol bar gyur pa ⑩de srid bzlas pa byas na ral gri'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du 'khor lo dang / rdo rje dang ⑩/ rtse gsum pa dang / mda' dang / tho ba dang / zhags 8pa la sogs pa bsgrub par bya zhing ske/ rig 37pa la sogs pa dang bcud kyis len la sogs pa 'dus byas sgo )pa bsgrub par bya'o/ /yang na mig sman nam thig le'am rkang pa bsku ba'am dudabang du byas pa'i rdzas bsdus 3)te bsgrub par bya'o/ /'o thug gam zho dang zan nam 8stemar dang bcas pa khar dang bcas pas snod bkang ste/ lag pas bkab nas bzlas pa byas te 'thungs na lo lnga brgyar rdzo ste'atsho bar 'gyur ro/ /du mā shā ⑩khar bcug nas bzlas pa byas te mid na sdeb sbyor dang thos pa 'dzin pa dang smra mkhas pa dang yid gzhungs par 'gyur ro/ /pad+ma'i sbyin sreg 3)'bum gyis bcom ldan 'das mngon sum du 'gyur ro/ /bil ba'i nyin sreg 'bum gyis 'jig rten 83—22

gsum gyi ①rgyal srid 'grub par byed do②/ /ji lta ba bzhin du ③rnyed pa'i me tog gi sbyin sreg dugis ngag gi ⑤dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro0/ /mar la btags pa'i 'bru lnga'i sbyin sreg ⑦'bum phrag bzhi byas pa tsam gyis gnod sbyin mo dang klu'i bu ⑧me la sogs pa 'gugs par byed do/ /de bzhin du yam shing ⑨lngas kyang bya'o/ /rtag tu goms par byas na tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas nyid kyang bsgrub ⑩par byed par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ hrīḥyi / sngags kyi rgyal po 'di 'bras bu mnyam por ster bar byed do/ /oṃ hrīḥm hā mā snang ge ma hā sā ra swa 83 na maḥ/rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i snying po 'dis las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro//oṃ pra kṛ 8ti pa ri shu ཿ/ sarba dharmāḥ8pra kṛ 87/ pa ri shurnyo3rta/ sa bā t+yā bh+yan ta ⑩ra na ma 0yi 8ti/ zhes bya bas phyi dang nang du yirgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba dang bcas pa'i sna tshogs pa dudang bdag nyid rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag par bsam dul/ pad+ma dkar po khru bdun pa'i tshad dang de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du duphyag gnyis pa pad+ma dang mchog sbyin gyis rnam par mdzes tsopa/ bcom ldan 'das ma cithugs rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyi sku can/ gcig tu gzhan la phan 'dogs pas bzhugs pas/ sgrub pa po rnams la tsomangon par 'dod pa'i dngos grub stsol ba la dgyes pa/ ston ku'i zla ba ltar dkar ba tsan+dan dkar po'i lde phyugs byugs 9shing me tog gis mdzes par brgyan ⑦pa/ na bza' dkar po dang mu tig gi ⑥ phreng bas thugs ka ⑥mdzes par dubyas pa/ sku rin po che sna tshogs kyis dubargyan pa'i sku las yongs su spros pa'i 'od zer stong gis mtha' yas shing dpag tu med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams snang bar byed pa/lo bcu gnyis kyi na tshod du 'khrungs pa'i sku can/ ngag gi dbang phyug ma mchen 89—23

mor ①bdag nyid rnam par bsam mol/ /mdun du shes rab ma dang g.yas su yid gzhungs ma dang / rgyab tu blo ③ma dang / g.yon du dran pa ma gong du smos pa'i yon tan thams cad kyis mdzes par lha mo rnam par bsam ①par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu lte ba'i phyogs su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi ⑤dbus su yi ge oṃ mdog dkar po rnam ⑥par bsams la de las byung ba'i ngag gi dbang phyug gi ⑦rang bzhin ma lus pa'i phreng ba rgyun mi 'chad pa'i (8)'byung bar rnam par bsam zhing ⑨/ gcig pu der phyogs pa'i yid can gyi sngags pas nges par ⑩bdag nyid kyi (/)lte ba'i dbus na gnas pa ⑩mi smra bas bzlas pa byas na/ zla ba gcig gis dbyangs can gyi ngag rab tu 'thob hunyepar 'gyur zhing zla ba gsum gyis tshangs pa gsod pa yang 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zla ba drug gis tsodabyangs can dang ngag mnyam bopar 'gyur ro/ /ra yi 'o ma a ru 35tsha 7ba gsum/ /pa tha nyunyeshu dag se gru sen dha pa rte/ /lan bdun sngags pa'i du ) mar dag ni/ /'thungs na dbyangs can 'grub par 'gyur 5nya/ /ra yi 'o ma bre bzhi dang / /sman rnams srang gcig tsam gyi tshad/ /mar bre gang dang mkhas pa yis/ /rim gyis me chung (nyal bskol bya/ /zla gcig tsam zhig rab sbyar sanyan/ /bla med tshig ni thob 'gyur zhing rka/ /zla drug nye bar longs spyod ( stepas/ /ngag gi dbang phyug mngon sum 'gyur / /shu dag shing mngar tsunyesen dha pa nya/ /a ru bca' lga la la phud/ /ru rta pi pi zi rar bcas/ /rnam btags ngag ni dag par byed/ /lha la me tog dri bzangs 2 sogs/ /nang par yang dag mchod nas ni/ /lan bdun sngags tsobyas zos nas ( 6ni/ /zla ba drug gis thos 'dzin byed/ /zla ba gsum gyis tshig bdag 'gyur/ /zla ba gcig gis blo ldan zhing / /khu byug gzhon nu'i skad 89wa 24

bzhin du/ /dbyangs snyan pa ni skye bar 'gyur/ /gangs can skyes pa'i a ru'am / /gangs ①can skyes pa'i shu dag la/ /tho rangs lan bdun mngon bsngags nas/ /zla gcig zos nas ⑤zla de la/ / tshig bdag po sridang yid gzhungs dang / /dbyangs snyan dushes rab ldan pa yang / /skye bar 'gyur zhing zla drug gis/ /thos pa 'dzin par yang 'gyur ro/ /oṃ bsdu rjodi ni/ bā tsarma ni yats+tsha sa ra swa tī dum hā shwe ⑦te swā hā/ pad+ma las ②skyes pa'i dkar mo chen mo'i snying po 'di ni/ gong du bshad pa'i las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ arka mā li 7ni/ ki ṇi ki ṇi khi ṇi khi ṇi 0swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das dpa' bo gcig pu grub pa gsung gi rang bzhin ma lus pa'i po ti bsnams pa/ phyag g.yas kyis 7shes rab kyi ral gri phyar 0ba/ gzhon nu'i gzugs can 'jam pa'i rdo rjer bdag nyid bsams la/ mdun du nyi ma'i phreng ba dbyangs can chen po 8dang rgyab tu dpal chen mo dang g.yas su skra can ④ma dang g.yon du nye ba'i skra can 8ma rnam par bsam par bya ste/ ston ku'i zla ba ltar dkar ba ⑩bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar bsgoms ⑩pa la gnas shing nges par gnas pas ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa byas te/ sngon du bstan hunyepa'i cho gas sngags 'di gong du smos pa'i rim pas/ 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas la/ de nas hunyedabyangs can gyi du)mar ram/ brad+ma'i mar srang gcig tsam la yongs su bzlas te/ bdag nyid la dbyangs can gyi phyag gis rab tu stsol rdu tshebar yongs su rtog cing / ting nge ru 'dzin la gnas pas 0btung bar bya'o/ /de la brad+ma'i mar 'di ni/ /bras yi zhustekhu ba 'o ma dang / /mar srang sum cu ( cigertsa gnyis dang / /yung ba dang ni ma la ti/ /dur byid a ru rar rdu thobacas pang zhe/ /de dag cha ni srang re dang / /pi 83—25

yi ge 'bya gcig pa'i cho ga①༄7gi /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sngags yi ge 'bru gcig pa'i cho ga② /tabya thā/ oṃ 5①/ gsang sngags yi ge 'bru gcig pa 'di durab tu gsang ba ste/ don thams cad sgrub par byed pa⑤/ las thams cad byed pa/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po/ re ba thams cad yongs su skong bar mdzad pa ste/ so shing la bsngags yinas bcangs na so na ba 'byang ④ngo / /mig na ba la rgyam tshwa btags ⑧pa la lan bdun bsngags 0te mig bkang na mig nad sel to/ /mi'i khong du mtshon gyi dum bu lus pa la zhun mar rnying ⑩pa la lan bdun nam/ brgya rtsa brgyad bsngags 7te blud pa'am/ rma khar bskus na mtshon gyi 8dum bu 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zas ma zhu ba dang / sbos te gsud pa dang / tshad pas 'khru ba la mu rang tshwa'am/ rgyam tshwa'am8/ yang na lan tshwa gzhan gang yang rung ba la lan bdun bsngags ④te zos na nad de las grol te 83—59

snan po la bstod pa/①༄tshon / thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /②bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jam dpal rnon po la bstod pa/ mthing senag mdzes pas 'jam par 'tsher ba'i dbu/ / lcang lo rdzings ④bskyod mthing ⑤gi mtsho ltar g.yo/ /dge ba'i spyi gtsug mtshan mchog g.yas su 'khyil/ /gtsug tor 'phags pas skye bos bltar mi mthong / /srid pa'i sdug bsngal ma lus gzhom pa dang / /mthu chen byin gyis rgol (6)ba gzhom pa'i phyir/ /dbu rgyan cod (7pan rgyal ba'i mchog gsang zhing / /chos kyi rgyal thabs dbang gi pha rol phyin/ /rin chen spug dang ut+pal 'dra ba yi/ /shin tu dngas (2)par dkar nag phyed pa'i spyan/ /smin tshugs mdzes pas zla ba tshes ltar 'khyugatsan /mig 'dzums tsobur gyis lta bas byams pa'i rtags/ /sil snyan rnam dag mtshan rab 'bru chags pa/ /rin chen ma lus rnam pa du mas spras/ /rgyal bas /7zhing mang rnam pa sna tshogs su/ /83—61

rnam thar dpag yas chos sgo grangs med gnas/ /shangs kyi dbyibs legs skye bo yongs las 'phags/ /mtho la yid tsam zur la legs pa'i mtshan/ /drang la chu phran 'dra bar mdzes pa'i tshul/ /bzang ①legs bskal pa brgyar yang bltar mi ngoms/ /pad+ma le brgan tshon ②ltar dmar ba'i sgros/ /yid gzhungs sel ②ba 'khyil ba bzang legs sku/ /mdog sdug chu skyes snang ba mtsho lo bzhin/ /shin tu dang ba'i yid kyis 'dzum pa mdzad/ /zhal ras zla 'dra gser gyi mdog gis rgyas/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor gser phreng du mas spras/ /gsal ba'i 'od phung nyi ma brgya bas lhag /'od zer sna tshogs sprin phung bzhin du 'phro/ /chos dbyings 'jam ④pa'i dbyangs kyis ⑤sgra sgrogs dupa/ /ka la ping ka lta bur yid 'phrog mdzad/ /sang sang dbyangs rab gsung dbyangs rab bsgrags ⑦pa/ /seng ge'i nga ro gser gyi dril ltar 'khrol/ /skyes mchog mdzad pa rgam ⑧par mdzad pa'i sku/ /cha lugs bzhin 'chang gzi brjid 'phags pa'i sku/ /gzhon nu'i tshul chags shin tu gzhon par gda'/ /gdul bya'i skye bo gzhon nu'i ⑨gzugs kyis gdul/ /dbu rgyan rin chen rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /mu tig do shal gser gyi rgyan du bkod/ /pad+ma lha yi na bza' sil ma bsnams/ /g.yas na mtshon mchog bsnams pa thabs kyis 'dul/ /dpe med rno ba shes rab nyid du nges/ /chos dbyings tshul nyid yang dag brjod pa dang / /mi shigs rdo rje gtan nas 'bigs pa'i tshul/ /g.yon pa shes rab pha rol phyin pa dang / /blang dor gnyis med bsam gyis mi khyab dbyings/ /zab mo'i chos nyid 7thugs su chud pa'i don/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jam dpal rnon po la bstod pa rdzogs sonalha// //89—62

bsdur ma na/61 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mjug byang las blangs te bkod/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉 thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'thing / du〈〈mi 〉〉lcangs lo rings/ 〈〈co 〉〉lcang lo jing /⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'a 'a/ rjo〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈bla 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉rgal/ ⑦〈〈li 〉〉gcod/⑧〈〈zhol 〉〉dwangs/ ⑨〈〈co 〉〉'khrug tho)〈〈co 〉〉'dzum/ 4)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉ba'i/62 ①〈〈li 〉〉bzangs/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉leb rgan tshon/ 〈〈co 〉〉leb rgan chon/ ③〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉'phel ④〈〈li 〉〉'jams/ ⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉kyi/()〈〈zhol 〉〉sgrags/ 9)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉sgrags/ 9)〈〈khu 〉〉gom/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉sgom/⑨〈〈g.yung 〉〉nu'/ 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉nu/ ⑩〈〈khu 〉〉nyis/ ⑪〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉sgo/bsdur 'azas re'u mig da 'asgem/ (195)89wa 63

0580༄ga /'jam dpal ngag gi dbang phyug la bu mo brgyad kyis bstod pa/①༄7gi /'jam dpal ngag gi dbang phyug la bu mo brgyad kyis bstod pa/gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po/ /ye shes sgron mes rab brgyan zhing / /'jig rten gti mug mun sel ba/ /'jam ②pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ ci / nyid kyi mdangs bzang tshogs kyis ni/ /0zla ba rgyas pa zil gnon zhing / /ma rig rnam par bsal gyur pa/ /'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma bgyis zur phud gsal ba la/ /nor bu 'bar ba'i sku mnga' zhing / /nyid ni kun du dga' ba'i sku/ /'jam dpal khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdud rtsi 'dra zhing 'jam la zab/ /yid 'ong gsung gi sgra sgrogs pa/ /dam pa tshamachos kyi rin chen mdzod / /'jam dpal khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gang (5)bā'i chu thigs ltar grangs med/ /'jig rten khams kun ma lus par/ /nyon mongs dri ma rab spangs pa'i tsho/ /'jam dpal khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mche ba gtsigs 89wa 64

shing bsgyings ①pa yi/ /'jigs pa'i sku yi tshul gyis ni/ /gshin rje'i dregs pa 'joms mdzad pa/ /'jam dpal khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod②/ /rang gi spyan dang mdangs ①'dra ba'i/ /ut+pal sngon pos rab mdzes pa/ /lhung bzed phyag na bsnams pa yi/ /'jam dpal khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /rgya cher mchod dang bstod pa yis/ /grol ba'i lam ni ston pa po/ /'jam dpal khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bu mo brgyad kyis bstod ④pa rdzogs sorgya// //'ubasdur mchan/64 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i dbu'i mtshan smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉'jams/ ③〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉 nyid kyi mdangs bzang tshogs kyis ni// ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉pa'i/⑤〈〈li 〉〉gi/ ⑥〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉ma lus pa/65 6)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zhing bsgrims/ 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉shing bsgrims/ 4kye〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stod/①〈〈khu 〉〉gdangs/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉kyi stod/ 〈〈snar 〉〉kyi bstod/ ⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉sgo/0〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉 lan cig zhus te dag go/ /skar zhus/89wa 65

0581༄ga /'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/①༄tshogi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya pradz+nyā pā ②ra mi tā nā māṣ+ṭa sha ta rkani/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa zhes bya bdu/ bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma rgyal phyag 'tshal lo/ /'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi/ /rgyal ba gang lags de kun gyi/ /yum ni dge ma khyod lags te/ /khyod ni lha mo rgyal ba'i sras/ /rang bzhin med pa'i rang bzhin can/ /sangs rgyas yum gyur de yi mtshan/ /dge ma ⑥bdag gis brjod par bgyig/ /'byor par 'dod pas mnyan par gyisabya/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang / lam gyi rnam pa ⑨mkhyen pa nyid dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / bden pa dang / de kho na dang / yang dag pa 89wa 67

dang ske/ phyin ci ma log pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa nyid dang / smon pa med pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid ①dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos gnas pa nyid dang / chos mi 'gyur ba nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang / chos kyi mtshan nyid dang / chos bdag med pa nyid dang ske/ ngo bo nyid med pa nyid dang / sems can med pa nyid dang / srog med pa nyid dang / gso ba ②med pa nyid dang / skyes bu med pa nyid dang /nigang zag med pa nyid dang / brjod par bya ba ④dang / brjod par bya ba ma yin pa dang / sems dang yid dang rnam par shes pa dang bral ba dang /mnyam pa med pa dang / mi mnyam pa dang ⑧/ mnyam pa dang bdag gi ba ⑥med pa dang / rgyags pa med pa dang / spros pa med pa dang / spros pa dang bral ba dang / spros pa thams cad dang bral ba dang /② spros pa thams cad las shin tu 'das pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad skyed (8)pa dang / nyan thos thams cad 'dzin pa dang /rang sangs rgyas thams cad skrun pa dang / 'jig rten thams cad 'dzin pa dang ske/ bsod nams kyi rdo9)tshogs zad mi shes pa bsags pa dang / ye shes 'bab pa dang / rdzu 'phrul mdzad pa dang / lha'i mig rnam par sbyong bar mdzad pa dang / lha'i rna ba rab tu dang bar mdzad pa dang / pha rol gyi sems shes par mdzad pa dang / sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran par mdzad pa dang /'chi 'pho ba dang / skye ba shes par mdzad pa dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad zad par khamadzad pa dang / 'phags pa dang / gtsang ba dang /89—68

bsangs ①pa dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa la gnas pa dang / yang dag par rgyaspong ba'i shugs dang ldan pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi'i zhabs dang ldan pa dang / dbang po sbyong bar mdzad pa dang / stobs mdzad pa dang /kha na ma tho ba med pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyi rin po ches mdzes par byas pa dang / nor bdun sbyin par mdzad pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ston pa dang / mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ston par mdzad pa dang / dbang bcu sgrub pa dang / sa bcu la ①gnas par mdzad pa dang / stobs bcu yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa dang / zad par gyi skye mched bcus mdzes par byas pa dang / shes pa bcu sgrub ④pa dang /bag la nyal ⑤bcu'i dgra 'jig par mdzad pa dang / bsam gtan rnams sgrub dupar mdzad pa dang / gzugs med pa'i khams las yang dag par 'da' bar mdzad pa dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bstod pa dang / shes pa thams cad mdzad pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad rdzogs par mdzad pa dang /⑦ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang /phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang /thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang /rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i 83—69

ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / ma byung ba dang / ma skyes pa dang / ma 'gags pa dang / chad pa med pa dang / rtag pa med pa dang / don gcig pa ma yin pa dang / don ①tha dad pa ma yin pa dang / 'ong ba med pa dang / 'gro ba med pa dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba rnam par bsgom ②pa dang / rab tu brtag par bya ba ma yin pa dang / rnam par shes par bya ba ma yin pa dang /gzhi med pa dang / mtshan nyid med pa dang / brtag par bya ba ma yin pa dang ske/ rig par bya ba ma yin pa ①dang / thog ma dang tha ma 'jig pa med par mdzad pa dang / g.yo ba med par mdzad ༷pa dang / gnyis su ⑤med pa dang /gnyis su ⑥med pa ma yin pa dang / zhi ba dang / blo 'jug pa rnam par spangs pa dang / gnyen po med pa dang / ma gos pa dang / nam mkha'i lam dang 'dra ba dang / yod pa dang med par brjod pa ma yin pa dang / ⑦mi lam gyi ngo bo nyid dang / sgyu ma lta bu'i chos nyid dang / mgal me bskor ba dang 'dra bar ⑧chos thams cad ro gcig pa nyid do/ /su zhig shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa 'di ⑨'don pa de ngan song thams cad las rab tu thar bar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang ⑩dgongs par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis kyang rtag par rgyun du srung 47ba dang /skyob pa dang / sbed pa 8byed par 'gyur ro/ /de'i gsang 8sngags kyi tshig 'di dag kyang rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par dran par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma8/ mos pa la byams ma/ yon tan dpag tu med pa dang ldan mas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyis rnam par ⑩mkhyen pa nyid/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' 89—70

thams cad kyi phyag bzhes ①pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di lta ste/ oṃ pralha pralha ma hā pralha/ pradz+nyā a ba bhā se/ pradz+nyā ā ②lo ka ka re / a budz+nyā na bi bya ma nergya/sid dhirdzi/ su sid dhi/ sid dha ma nel/ bha ga ba ti sasde dug sun dā ⑨ri/bha ga ba ti/ brta sa ⑩li/ pra sā ⑨ri ta haste7/ sa mā shā tsos ka ri/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ kum pa kum pa/ tsa la tsa la/ rā ba rā ④ba/ gadzā gadzā/ ā gats+tsha/ā gats+tshan+tu/ bha ga ba ti mā bi las tsos hā/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'bum bzung ⑩bar 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu bzlas brjod byas na de'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad byang 8bar 'gyur ro/ /'di yinas shi 'phos nas kyang skye ba dran pa dang / yid gzhungs du shing shes rab mtshungs pa med par 'gyur ro/ /dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa ⑥thams cad kyi chos ma lus par bzung dubar 'gyur ro/ /gsang sngags dang / rig dusngags thams cad kyang yongs su bzung dustebar 'gyur ro/ /'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang skye ba dran pa dang / yid gzhungs shing shes rab chen por 'gyur rol/ /'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tsomatshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa rdzogs ldetho ⑦ // //89wa 71

༄ga /'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa kau shi ka zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya kau ②shi ka pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā nā mdu/bod skad du/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa kau ④shi ka zhes bya ba⑤/sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'bum phrag du ma thams cad kyang gzhon nur gyur pa sha stag dang thabs cig 6)tu bzhugs te⑦/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i dbang po brgya byin la bka' stsal pa/ kau snyishi ka de la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don ni 'di yin te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni (9)gnyis su blta bar mi bya/ gnyis ma yin par yang ma yin/ mtshan mar ma yin/ mtshan ma ma yin par yang ma yin / blang tshabar yang 37ma yin/ dor bar yang 3nyam yin/ bsnan par ma 89—74

yin/ bsnan pa med par yang ①ma yin/ kun nas nyon mongs par ma yin/kun nas nyon mongs pa ma yin par yang ma yin/ rnam par byang bar ②ma yin/rnam par byang ba ③ma yin par yang ma yin/ spang bar ma yin/ spang ba dum yin par yang ma yin/ gnas su ma yin/ gnas su ⑤ma yin par yang ma yin/sbyor bar ma yin/ sbyor ba dum yin par yang ma yin/ 'brel bar ma yin/'brel bar ⑦ma yin par yang ma yin/ rkyen du ma yin/ rkyen nim yin par yang ma yin/ chos su ma yin/ chos ma yin par yang ma yin/ de bzhin nyid ⑨ma yin/ de bzhin nyid ma yin par yang ma yin/ yang dag pa'i mthar ⑩ma yin/ yang dag pa'i mthar 0ma yin par yang ma yin no0/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don ni 'di lta ste/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid mnyam mo/ /chos thams cad zab pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab bo/ /chos thams cad dben pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dben no/ /chos thams cad g.yo ba med pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa g.yo ba med do8/ /chos thams cad rlom sems 8med pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rlom sems med do/ /chos thams cad 'jigs pa med pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jigs pa med do/ /chos thams cad bag tsha ba med pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bag tsha ba med do/ /chos thams cad ro gcig pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ro gcig go/ /chos thams cad skye ba med pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa skye ba med do/ /chos thams cad 'gags 8pa med pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'gags tshepa med do/ /chos thams cad nam mkha' tso 83—75

lta bu'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /gzugs mu med pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mu med do/ /de bzhin du tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa mu med pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mu med do/ /sa'i khams mu med pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mu med do/ /de bzhin du chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams dang / nam mkha'i khams dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams mu med pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mu med do/ / ri rab mu med pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mu med do/ /hu)rgya mtsho mu med pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mu med do/ /rdo rje mnyam pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam mo/ /chos thams cad dbyer med pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dbyer med do/ /chos thams cad kyi ②ngo bo nyid dmigs su med pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ngo bo nyid chadamigs su med do/ /chos thams cad bsal 94)ba med par mnyam pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsal tshanab med par mnyam mo/ /chos thams cad byed pa med pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa byed pa med do/ /chos thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /de bzhin du sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ske/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ske/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ske/ stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / ye shes (5)kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 83—76

'khor gsum yongs su dag pas ①su med pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mu med do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba ni 'di ltar ②stong pa nyid bcwa ④brgyad del/ 'di lta ste/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang /phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang /thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang /rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid de/ mdor na stong pa nyid 'di ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya'o/ /skar ma rab rib mar me dang / /sgyu ma zil pa chu bur dang ske/ /rmi lam glog dang sprin lta bu de/ /'dus byas de ltar blta bar bya/ /na mo bha ga ba s+t+ya ār+ya tshorme pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā yi/ oṃ dhīḥhrīḥ(peshrī shu ti smṛ (kyete ma ti ga ti bi 99)dza ye swā hā/ 'gag pa med cing skye med la/ /chad pa med cing rtag pa med / /tha dad don min mdon gcig min/ /'ong ba med cing 'gro med la/ /spros pa zhi bas zhi ba yi/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ston pa/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang yin pa/ /smra mchog de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i nyunyebu dang /lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / dge slong de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas 83—77

༄ga /'phags pa gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba'i mdo rje'i rgyal po theg pa chen po'i mdo/0)༄7gi /rgya yi 3skad du/ tā shin kyin kwang mya'u tsa'i shin wang kyin(kye/bod skad du/ 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba'i byamado sde'i rgyal po tshogatheg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po dang po/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab bya rgod spungs pa'i ri shin 96nitu rnam par dag pa 97chos kyi dbyings 'tshozab mo 997sangs rgyas thams cad 7kyi spyod yul de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas 11na dge slong chen po'i dge 'dun khri phrag 32dgu khri brgyad stong dang thabs cig nya tu bzhugs te/ thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa sha stags /glang po che'i rgyal po ltar shin tu rnam par byang ba sha stag /zag pa zad pa sha stags /nyon mongs pa med pa sha stagatshe /sems shin tu rnam par grol ba sha stag1 /shes rab shin tu rnam par grol ba sha stag18 /bya ba 89wa 80

byas pa sha stag /khur bor ba sha stag /bdag gi don rab tu rnyed pa sha stag /srid pa'i sbyor ba yongs su zad pa sha stag /dam pa'i dbang mchog thob pa sha stag /tshul khrims rnam par dag pa la gnas pa sha stag /thabs dang shes rab tu ldan par mkhas pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa sha stag /rnam par thar pa brgyad dang ldan pa sha stag /pha rol du yongs su phyin pa sha stag ste/ de dag gi ming ①la 'di lta ste/ tshe dang ldan pa kun shes kauṇ+ḍi n+ya ②dang / tshe dang ldan pa rta thul dang / tshe dang ldan pa rlangs pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa ming chen dang /tshe dang ldan pa bzang po dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung ①chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa lteng ④rgyas 'od srung dang / tshe dang ldan pa ga yā ⑤'od srung dang /tshe dang ldan pa chu bo 'od srung (6)dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang / tshe dang ldan pa med gal (7gyi bu chen po dang / bode la gcig ma gtogs pa de ni tshe dang ldan pa kun dudaga' bo ste/ de la sogs te nyan thos kyi dge 'dun chen po rnams phyi dro'i dus na so so'i ting nge 'dzin las langs nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der lhags te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la spyi bos phyag byas nas/ g.yas phyogs nas lan gsum bskor ba byas te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong snyed kyang de na (7)'dus par gyur te/ thams cad kyang klu'i rgyal po chen po ltar gzi brjid kyi byin gyi mthu che ba/ shin du grags pa dang ldan pa/ cang shes dang ldan pa/ sbyin pa dang tshul khrims yongs su dag pa mchod pa dang / rim gro byed pa dang /dzo yongs su dag pa/ bskal pa grangs med pa nas bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus su ldan pa/ bsam gtan 83—81

thams cad las yongs su 'das pa/ dran pa mngon par gzhag ①pa/ shes rab kyi sgo yongs su 'byed pa/ rnal 'byor dang thabs dang dbang gis rnam par rol pa/ mngon par shes pa dang / gzungs dang ldan pa/ spobs pa yongs su mi zad pa nyon mongs pa thams cad yongs su spangs pa/ nyon mongs pa'i bshal thag yongs su gcod pa/ ring po mi thogs par thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang ldan par 'gyur ba/ bdud dang / bdud kyi dmag yongs su 'joms ②pa/ chos kyi rnga rab tu sgrogs pa/ mu stegs thams cad yongs su zlog pas bsam pa rnam par dag par sbyor ba/ dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba/ ②lha dang mi thams cad yongs su sgrol ba/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rgyan yongs su sgrub pa/ rgyud drug gi skye bo yongs la phan 'dogs pa / ye shes chen po phun sum tshogs pa/ bzod pa chen po dang yongs su ldan pa / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i sems la gnas pa/gzhan gyis stimi thub pa'i stobs chen po dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du rgyu zhing mchod pa byed pa/ yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar mi 'jug pa/ma 'ongs pa'i bskal pa'i mthar yongs su mi zad pa'i yi ci)dam gyi smon lam chen po bskyed pa/ sangs rgyas mang po las shin du zab mo'i rgyu rnam par dag pa bskyed ༷7pa/ dus gsum gyi chos ma skyes pa'i bzod pa thob ⑦pa/ nyan thos dang ske/ rang sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul las yongs su 'das pa/ 'jig rten gyi don sbyor ba la mkhas pa/ ston pa chen pos dgongs te gsungs pa'i chos shin du bkod pa rgya cher ston pa/ stong pa'i mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa'i (nyezab mo la mkhas pa/ the tshom 9(7yongs su spangs pa sha stag ste/ de dag gi ming la 'di 89—82

lta ste/ bsgribs pa med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / chos kyi 'khor lo yongs su bskor bar sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / brtson 'grus yongs su ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang /yongs su mi skyo ba'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / byams pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' dang / spyan ras gzigs byang chub sems dpa' dang / gzungs kyi dbang po'i rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' dang / spobs pa chen po'i rgyan gyi ①rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' dang /ri rab mchog gi rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' dang / rgya mtsho chen po zab mo'i rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' dang / rin po che'i rgyal mtshan byang chub sems dpa' dang / rin po che'i rgyal mtshan chen po'i byang chub sems dpa' dang /sa'i snying po'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / nam mkha' ②snying po'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / rin po che'i phyag dbang byang chub sems dpa' dang / rdo rje'i thal mo byang chub sems dpa' dang / dga' ba'i stobs byang chub sems dpa' dang / chos kyi stobs byang chub sems dpa' dang / 'od rgyan chen po byang chub sems dpa' dang / gser gyi 'od rgyan chen po byang chub sems dpa' dang / tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / rtag tu ting nge 'dzin byang chub sems dpa' dang / shes rab rnam par dag pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / brtson 'grus dka' thub byang chub sems dpa' dang /bsam pa nam mkha' ci bzhin byang chub sems dpa' dang / smon lam chen po yongs su mi gcod (kyepa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / sman gtong byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyon mongs pa'i nad rnam par sel ba'i byang chub sems 83—83

dpa' dang / sman gyi rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' dang / 'phags par dga' ba'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / gong du lung bstan pa thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / sprin chen 'od gtsang byang chub sems dpa' dang /sprin chen chos skyong byang chub sems dpa' dang / sprin chen grags can dga' byang chub sems dpa' dang / sprin chen mtha' yas grags byang chub sems dpa' dang / sprin chen seng ge sgra byang chub sems dpa' dang / sprin chen glang po che'i rgyal po'i sgra byang chub sems dpa' dang / sprin chen bkra shis byang chub sems dpa' dang / sprin chen rin chen yon tan byang chub sems dpa' dang / sprin chen nyi ma'i snying po byang chub sems dpa' dang / sprin chen zla ba'i snying po byang chub sems dpa' dang / sprin chen skar ma'i 'od byang chub sems dpa' dang / sprin chen me 'od byang chub sems dpa' dang / sprin chen glog 'od byang chub sems dpa' dang / sprin chen 'brug sgra byang chub sems dpa' dang / sprin chen shes rab char yongs su snyoms pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / sprin chen char gyi rgyal po yongs su dag pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / sprin chen me tog sdong po'i rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' dang /sprin chen pad+ma (17sngon po'i bsung byang chub sems dpa' dang / sprin (5)rin po che'i tsan+dan sku rnam par bsil ba )byang chub sems dpa' dang / sprin chen mun pa rnam par tsho47sel ba'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / sprin chen lta ba'i rab rib rnam par sel ba'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 'khor de dag phyi dro'i dus na so so'i ting nge 'dzin las langs nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der lhags te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 89—84

zhabs gnyis la spyi bos phyag byas nas g.yas phyogs nas lan gsum du bskor ba byas te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang 'di lta ste/ lits+tsha bī ①gzhon nu 'bum phrag 'bum brgyad stong yang der 'dus par gyur te/ de dag gi ming la gzhon nu seng ge'i 'od dang / gzhon nu seng ge'i blo gros dang / gzhon nu chos byin dang / gzhon nu dbang po sbyin dang / gzhon nu 'od chen dang /gzhon nu dpal chen dang / gzhon nu sangs rgyas skyabs ②dang / gzhon nu chos skyabs ②dang / gzhon nu dge 'dun skyabs dang / gzhon nu rdo rje ④skyabs dang / gzhon nu nam mkha' skyabs ⑤dang / gzhon nu nam mkha' sgra sgrogs (5)dang / gzhon nu rin po che'i snying po dang / gzhon nu bkra shis mchog gi snying po dang / de dag gzhon nu thams cad kyi gtso bor gyur nas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub tu gnas te theg pa chen po'i dad pa so sor rnyed nas/ phyi dro'i dus na bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der lhags teg/ bcom ldan 'das kyi /de zhabs gnyis la spyi bos phyag byas nas/ g.yas phyogs su lan gsum ⑨bskor ba byas nas/ phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang 'di lta ste/ lha'i sras po bzhi khri nyis stong yang der 'dus par gyur te/ de dag gi ming la 'di lta ste/lha'i sras po mthong na dga' ba dang / lha'i sras po yid dga' ba dang / lha'i sras po nyi ma'i 'od dang / lha'i sras po zla ba'i gtsug tor dang / lha'i sras po nam mkha'i blo gros rnam par dag pa dang / lha'i sras po nyon mongs pa yongs su spangs pa dang / lha'i sras po rnam par bkra shis dang / de dag thams cad kyang lha'i sras po rnams kyi gtso bor gyur pa/ theg pa chen po'i chos yongs su skyong ba'i yi dam chen po'i smon lam 'debs pa/ dam pa'i chos yongs su mi 83—85

nub par gdung 'tshob pa de dag thams cad phyi dro'i dus na bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der lhags nas bcom ldan 'das kyi ①zhabs gnyis la spyi bos phyag byas nas g.yas phyogs su lan gsum du bskor ba byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang 'di lta ste/ klu'i rgyal po nyi khri brgyad stong yang der 'dus par gyur te/ de dag gi ming la pad+ma'i ②klu'i rgyal po dang / e la'i lo ma klu'i rgyal po dang / stobs po che klu'i rgyal po dang / sgra bo che klu'i rgyal po dang ske/ dba' brlabs chung ngu'i klu'i rgyal po dang / chu'i rgyu du'adzin klu'i rgyal po dang / gser gyi bzhin klu'i rgyal po dang / yid bzhin klu'i rgyal po dang / de dag thams cad kyang klu'i rgyal po'i gtso bor gyur pa/ theg pa chen po'i chos yongs su skyong bar yongs su dga' ba dang / yongs su 'dzin pa dang /lung nod pa dang / shin tu zab mo'i bsam pa la mos pa dang / rjes su yi rangs pa snyidang / rnam par skyong zhing 'tsho bar byed de/ phyi dro'i dus na bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der lhags te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la spyi bos phyag byas nas g.yas phyogs nas lan gsum du bskor ba byas te/phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang 'di lta ste/ gnod sbyin gyi 'khor sum khri drug stong yang der 'dus par gyur to/ /de dag gi yigatso bo thog mar lha'i rgyal po mig mi bzang gis drangs nas a mra'i gnod sbyin dang / a mra thogs pa'i gnod sbyin dang / pad+ma ⑦'od kyi snying po'i gnod sbyin dang / pad+ma'i ⑧bzhin gnod sbyin dang / khro gnyer gnod sbyin dang / 'jigs pa mngon cidu ston pa'i gnod sbyin dang / sa kun g.yo ba'i gnod sbyin dang / zas kyi ril ming gnod sbyin dang / de dag thams cad kyang gnod sbyin gyi gtso bor gyur pa 89—86

sha stag ste༅/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam pa'i chos la shin tu dad pa'i ②sems bskyed pa/ dam pa'i chos yongs su skyong zhing srung ①ba'i sems bskyed pa dumi skyo ba/ phyi dro'i dus na bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der lhags te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la spyi bos phyag byas te g.yas phyogs nas lan gsum du bskor ba byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang 'di lta ste/ nam mkha' lding gi 'khor bzhi khri dgu stong yang der 'dus par gyur ⑤te/ nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po spos kyi glang po che'i yibyin gyi mthu dang ldan pas gtso bor gyur pa dang / gzhan yang 'di lta ste/ dri za'i ⑦'khor dang / lha ma yin gyi 'khor dang / mi'am ci'i 'khor dang / grul bum dang / lto 'phye chen po'i 'khor dang / ri dang / nags tshal dang / chu bo dang / rgya mtsho rnams kyi lha dang / drang srong dang / yul khams chen po thams cad kyi rgyal po dang /pho brang 'khor dang / btsun mo dang / slas dudang / dad pa rnam par bskyed pa'i bu pho dang / bu mo dang / lha dang / mi la sogs pa yongs su 'dus shing lhags nas thams cad kyang bla na med pa theg pa chen po'i chos 'di yongs su klog pa dang / 'don pa dang / 'chang ba dang / 'dzin pa dang / yi ger 'dri ⑨ba dang / kun du spel zhing bskyed ⑩pa dang / yongs su 'tsho ba dang / skyong ba'i dam tshig bcas te/ phyi dro'i dus na bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der lhags te bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la spyi bos phyag byas nas g.yas phyogs nas lan gsum bskor ba byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de ltar nyan thos dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / lha dang / mi dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin la sogs pa thams cad 'dus par gyur nas so so nas bste tunye83—87

stang dang / rim gro'i hu)sems bskyed de/ thal mo sbyar nas rab tu 'dzum pa'i mig gis ②bcom ldan 'das la blta ②zhing cung zad kyang mi yengs ④par dam pa'i chos shin tu thos par smon to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyi dro'i dus kyi tshe ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs nas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la gzigs te tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs so/ /'phags pa gser 'od dam pa'i chos mdo sde kun gyi rgyal po 'di/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi spyod yul te/ /shin tu mnyan cing thos par dka'/ /ngas deng dkyil 'khor (nyekhyed rnams la/ /dam pa'i mdo sde 'di bstan pas/ /phyogs bzhi sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang / /byin gyi 6)rlabs kyis brlabs 97par 'gyur/ /shar phyogs sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs dang / /lho phyogs sangs rgyas dkon mchog dpal/ /nub phyogs sangs rgyas snang mtha' yas / /byang phyogs sangs rgyas rnga sgra skyabs/ /ngas deng (8)chos mchog 'di bstan pas/ /bkra shis 'chags pa'i dam pa ste/ /sdig pa thams cad gzhom pa'i phyir/ /sdig pa'i las kun zad par 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'joms par byed/ /bde ba thams cad sbyin byed cing / /ye shes rtsa ba kun yi)mkhyen dang / /dpal kun gyis kyang brgyan par 'gyur/ /sems can gang dag dbang po nyams/ /dpal med pas ni gang zin cing / /lha rnams kyang ni 'phang bar 'gyur/ /gnyen sdug kun kyang snang ba dang / /bu smad 'khor dang bral ba dang / /phan tshun du ni mi 'phrod cing / /nor stor bas ni rab gtses te / /gza' dang skar mas gnod byas shing / /byad stems 7mi bzad zin ṅge dang ske/ /mya ngan nyon mongs las rnams kyis/ /shin tu mi bzad gzir ba dang ske/ /rmi lam ltas sdig mthong ba las/ /mya ngan rab tu 'khrug pa 0/rnams/ /89wa 88

gtsang mar lus kyis khrus gyis la/ /gos gtsang sar pa de bgos ①nas/ /mdo sde dam pa'i rgyal po 'di/ /sangs rgyas zab mo'i spyod yul te/ /klog ②'don rab tu 'dzin pa la/ /gus pa'i sems kyis nyon cig dang / /mdo sde 'di yi byin brlabs ③kyis/ /rmi ngan ltas sdig 'joms ④pa dang / /sdug bsngal thams cad bzlog pas ⑤ni/ /yongs su ma lus zad par 'gyur/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i rgyal po bzhi/ /blon po dang ni 'khor bcas dang / /gnod sbyin bye ba mang po rnams/ /shin tu gus pas rim gro bskyed/ /76)spobs pa'i lha mo chen ⑦mo dang / / nai rardzo nar ⑧gnas pa'i lha/ / de bzhin ⑨'phrog ma 'byung po'i ⑩ma / / sra ba 0sa yi lha mo dang / /tshangs pa'i 8dbang po brgya byin dang / / klu yi 0rgyal po mi 'am ci/ / nam mkha' lding gi ④rgyal po dang / /lha ma yin gyi 'khor rnams bcas/ /de ltar mthu chen de dag kunasko/ /rang gi 'khor rnams khrid yinas ni/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu mi 'bral chabar/ /gang zag de la srung bar byed / /zab mo sangs rgyas spyod yul dang / /sangs rgyas dgongs te gsungs pa'i nyunyebaka' / /mdo sde gang yin ngas bshad pa/ /bskal pa bye bar phrad dka' bas/ /gang gis mdo sde 'di thos nas/ /gzhan la rgya cher ston pa dang / /gal te sems kyis yi rangs nyurtedang / /mchod pa bshams nas mchod byed na/ /de 'dra'i gang zag de dag ni/ /bskal pa tshad med snyed du yang / /rtag par lha dang mi rnams dang / /klu la sogs pas mchod bkur 'gyur/ / 'di yi bsod ri )nams tshad med pas/ /gang gā'i bye snyed grangs las 'das/ /mdo sde 'di ni gang klog pa/ /yon tan 'di dag thob par 'gyur/ /phyogs bcu'i bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / /spyod zab byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /mdo sde 'dzin 83—89

la yongs bsrungs nas/ /sdug bsngal bgegs dang bral ①bar mdzad/ /mdo sde 'di ni gang mchod pas/ /snga ma bzhin du lus bkrus nas/ /zas dang me tog spos mchod cing / /byams dang snying rje'i sems bskyed de②/ /mdo sde 'di ni nyan 'dod pas/ /sems gtsang dri ma med byas te/ /rtag par dga' ba'i sems bskyed (kyen/ /yon tan mang po skye bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig gus pa'i sems dag gis/ /mdo sde 'di ni nyan byed na/ /legs par mi yi ④'gror skye zhing ske/ /sdug bsngal bgegs dang 'bral bar 'gyur/ /de ni dge ⑤tsa smin pas na⑥ / /sangs rgyas rnams kyis ⑦bsngags pa yi/ /mdo sde 'di ni thos pa dang / /'gyod tshangs chos ni thos pa yin/ /gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba byamado sde'i rgyal po las gleng gzhi'i ①le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas de'i tshe rgyal po'i khab ⑩kyi grong khyer chen po na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mdzes pa'i tog ces bya ba 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bye ba phrag nanyabargya stong tshad med pa rnams la bsnyen bkur chadang rim gro byas nas dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa zhig yod de/ de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' mdzes pa'i tog ces bya ba (snyegacig pu 6stedaben par gnas pa de 'di snyam du rgyu gang hunyedang rkyen gang gi phyir de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa sku tshe thung ste lo brgyad cur gyur snyam mo/ /gzhan yang 'di snyam du bcom ldan 'das kyis ji skad gsungs pa ltar na rgyu dang rkyen rnam pa gnyis kyis tshe ring por 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs te/ gnyis gang zhe na sems can gyi srog mi gcod pa dang / gzhan dag la yang bza' ba dang btung ba yongs su btang ba'o/ /de bzhin gshegs 89wa 90
