rnams kyang rtag tu bde ba'i longs spyod myong ba la 'god par byed na/ bsod nams bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par 'gyur/ yul de dag na gnas pa'i mi rnams kyang 'dod pa lnga'i bde ba rnam pa sna tshogs myong bar 'gyur/ dngos po ngan pa thams cad kyang rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das slad ma'i dus kyi tshe mi'i rgyal po gang la la zhig 'di ltar gser 'od dam pa'i mdo sde 'di nyan ①par mos pa dang / bdag nyid dang / btsun mo dang /rgyal bu nas pho brang nang gi ②slas la sogs pa'i bar dag dang / grong khyer dang /grong rdal dang / pho brang yongs su srung ①zhing skyob pa dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dga' ba mchog dam pa dang / rab tu dben pa'i bde ba 'thob par 'tshal ba dang / tshe 'di nyid la rgyal thabs btsun zhing mtho ba dang / dbang phyug dang ldan zhing dar ba dang / rtag tu 'phel bar 'tshal ba dang / gzhan yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po tshad ma mchis shing mtha' ma mchis pa yongs su sdud pa dang / rang gi yul du phyir rgol ba'i dgra dang / mya ngan dang / 'khrug pa dang / gdon bgegs kyi dngos po rnams ma mchis par 'tshal na④/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar mi'i rgyal po des bag ma mchis pas sems g.yeng bar mi bgyi zhing shin tu gus pa bskyed (snyede bsam pa thag pa nas mdo sde'i rgyal po mchog dam pa 'di mnyan cing yongs su gzung (bebar bgyi'o/ /chos nyan par 'tshal geba'i tshe/ sngar rgyal po la gces pa'i pho brang mchog dam pa rab tu brgyan te gsal ba'i phyogs su spos chab kyis nichag chag btab stel/me tog mchog tshudam pa sna tshogs mngon par gtor nas seng ge'i khri chos kyi 83—239

gdan khyad par du 'phags pa btsugs te/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis rab tu brgyan ①nas rin po che sna tshogs kyi ②gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan bsgreng ①ste/ rin thang ma mchis pa'i spos bsregs nas rol mo rnams bgyi'o / /rgyal po des rjode'i tshe yongs su dag par khrus bgyis te/ spos kyi byug ⑤pas lus bskus dunas gos sar ⑦pa gtsang ma bgos te/ rgyan phreng rnams kyis brgyan nas stan dma' ba la mchis te/ mtho ba'i bsam pa mi bskyed ⑧par dbang phyug gi thabs yongs su spang bar bgyi'o/ /nga rgyal rnams spangs te sems rtse gcig tu 0dran pa nye bar gzhag nas mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di mnyan par bgyi'o//chos smra ba'i mkhan po la ston pa chen po'i 'du shes bskyed ⑩par bgyi'o/ /pho ⑩brang nang gi 8btsun mo dang / rgyal bu dang / slas 0dang / 'khor rnams la byams pa dang / brtse ba'i sems bskyed nas rab tu dga' bas phan tshun ④blta bar bgyi'o/ /shin tu mthun pa'i mdangs 8kyis tshig 'jam por smra bar bgyi'o/ /bdag nyid kyi lus dang sems la dga' ba chen pos kun du khyab par bgyi'o / /deng bdag ni shin tu bsam par dka' ⑩zhing khyad par du ⑩'phags pa'i phan yon chen po yangs shing 8rgya che ba 'di lta bu 'thob 7par 'gyur ro snyam du bsams nas mdo sde'i rgyal po de la rab tu mchod par bgyi'o/ /de ltar bsams nartelags nas chos smra ba'i mkhan po der mchis pa mthong bar gyur tshun shin tu gus pas 2rtedakon pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po snyibazhi po stodag la bka' stsal pa/ 'di ltar chos smra ba'i mkhan po de mi bsu bar mi bya'i / de'i tshe mi'i rgyal po des gos sar ⑩pa gtsang ma 2 bgos nas rgyan dang / phreng ba rnam pa sna tshogs kyis rab tu brgyan 89—240

te/ bdag nyid gdugs dkar po dang / spos dang / me tog thogs nas dmag gi dpung bshams te/ rol mo rgyas par byas nas rkang gis grong khyer nas phyir byung ①ste/ bkra shis kyi dngos po thob ②par bya ba'i phyir gus pa'i 'du shes bskyed nas chos smra ba'i mkhan po de bsu bar bya'o/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag rgyu dang rkyen gang gi phyir mi'i rgyal po des bdag nyid kyis bkur sti dang /mchod pa de lta bu bya dgos she ②na/ mi'i rgyal po de rkang pa bteg cing rkang pa bzhag pa na dugom pa re re zhing sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong ①po rnams la bkur sti dang / mchod pa dang / rim gro dang / bla mar byed par 'gyur zhing / gzhan yang bskal pa'i grangs de snyed kyi 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las yang dag par 'da' bar 'gyur bas so༅/ /gzhan yang ma 'ongs pa'i dus na bskal pa'i grangs de snyed du 'khor los sgyur ⑦ba'i rgyal po'i longs spyod mchog khyad par du 'phags pa dag la longs spyod par 'gyur/ gom pa re re bor ba'i dbang gis tshe 'di nyid la yang bsod nams 'phel bas rang dbang du ⑧rgyal po byed cing bsam gyis 0mi khyab pa'i rnam par smin pa dang ldan pa dang / mang po kun gyis bkur ⑩bar 'gyur/ bskal pa 'bum phrag brgya stong tshad med pa snyed du lha dang mis yongs su spyad pa'i rin po che sna bdun gyi gzhal med khang dag la longs spyod par 'gyur/ skye ba thams cad du rgyal po byed par 'gyur/ tshe ring bar 'gyur/ tshig gi spobs pa dang ldan pas lha dang mi kun gyis mngon par yid ches par 'gyur/ 'jigs shing skrag pa med par 'gyur/ grags pa chen po dang ldan zhing mang po kun gyis yongs su blta hubar 'gyur/ lha dang mi'i nang du khyad par du 'phags pa'i bde ba dag la longs 83—241

spyod par 'gyur/ mthu stobs chen po thob ①par 'gyur/ gzi byin chen po'i yon tan dang ldan par 'gyur/ lus kyi mtshan ma ②gya rnam zhing shin tu mdzes pas dpe zla med par 'gyur/ lha dang mi'i ston ①pa mthong bar 'gyur0/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang phrad par 'gyur/ bsod nams kyi phung po tshad med pa mngon par grub 0cing phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po dag 'di ltar shes par bya ste/ mi'i rgyal po de dag gis yon tan gyi phan yon rnam pa sna tshogs tshad med pa de lta bu mthong ba'i phyir bdag nyid dpag tshad gcig nas dpag tshad brgya stong du ma'i bar du chos smra ba'i mkhan po bsu bar bya zhing du/chos smra ba'i ⑦mkhan po la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /slar grong dang ske/ grong khyer du phyin nas kyang deng ⑧de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya yo)thub pa bdag gi pho brang du gshegs nas bdag gi mchod pa bzhes te bdag la 7chos ston par mdzad do/ /bdag kyang chos ⑩thos pa'i dbang gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i 8byang chub las phyir maldog par mi 8'gyur bas 'di nyid sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma dang phrad par gyur pa yin no(nya/ /deng bdag gis ni 1)shin tu yangs shing ⑩rgya che ba mchog tu khyad par du 'phags pa'i 8bde ba'i yo byad rnam pa sna tshogs kyis 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la mchod cing 0rim gro byas so/ /deng bdag gis ni 5)gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang / sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dgas rdzidang ske/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas kyi sdug bsngal thams cad rtsa ba sornyenas bton to/ /deng 'khor los sgyur 5snyeba'i rgyal po dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa bye ba khrag 89—242

khrig brgya stong tshad med pa snyed kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rab tu bskyed do/ /deng sems can bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong tshad med pa snyed 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bton nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba la bkod do①/ /deng tshad med mtha' med cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bsod nams ②kyi phung po rab tu bsags so/ /pho brang nang gi slas dang skye bo mang po bde ba la bkod nas yul rnams rab tu zhi bar byas pas/ gnod pa dang / dug gdug pa dang / mi ma rungs pa med cing phyogs gzhan nas 'ong ba'i nidagra rnams nye bar 'ongs nas gnod pa mi byed pa dang / mya ngan dang nad rnams med par 'gyur ro snyam du bsam 0par bya'o/ /rgyal po chen po dag 'di ltar rig par bya ste/ de'i tshe mi'i rgyal po de dag gis de ltar yang dag pa'i ⑤chos la btsun par byas shing bla mar byas pa dang / mdo sde dam pa 'di yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang rka/ dge bsnyen dang /yi dge bsnyen ma dag la mchod pa dang / bkur ste dang / bla mar byas shing bsngags pa brjod pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang yin pa de dag dang / bsod nams mchog gang yin pa de ⑦dag thog ma kho nar khyed ⑧'khor dang bcas pa las ⑨yongs su sngo 0bar byed na mi'i rgyal po de dag bsod nams chen po'i dge ba'i las kyi rgyu dang / rkyen dang ldan par 'gyur bas tshe 'di nyid la dbang chen po thob nas gzi byin chen po nyunyerab tu 'phel bar 'gyuratso/ dpal dang mtshan mchog rnams 8kyis rab tu brgyan ⑫par 'gyur/ phyir rgol ba thams cad yang dag pa'i chos kyis tshar gcod par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po chen po bzhi po chadag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das mi'i rgyal po gang la la zhig de ltar yang 89—243

dag pa'i chos ①la gus pas bkur ste bgyis nas mdo sde 'di mnyan par bgyid pa dang / mdo sde 'di ②'dzin pa'i 'khor bzhi po dag la bkur ste dang /mchod pa dang / bla mar bgyis nas bsngags pa brjod par bgyid pa dun/de'i tshe mi'i rgyal po des bdag cag rnams dga' dubar bgyi ba'i slad du chos kyi gdan dang nye ba'i phyogs gcig tu spos chab kyis chag chag btab ste/ me tog mchog dam pa mang po mngon par gtor nas rgyal po chen po bzhi dumachis pa'i stan yang bshams te bting bar gyur na/ bdag cag kyang rgyal po de dag dudang lhan cig yang dag pa'i chos nyan par bgyid dog/ /rgyal po des kyang bdag cag la phan 'dogs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ci mchis pa'i bsod nams kyi skal ba gang lags pa bdag cag la yang yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ⑧de'i tshe mi'i rgyal po des chos smra ba la chos bshad par gsol ba btab nas stan la mchis pa'i tshe bdag cag gi slad du spos mchog dam pa sna tshogs bsregs nas mdo sde 'di la mchod par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de'i tshe spos kyi bdug ⑨pa de dag skad cig ma gcig la 7nam mkha' la mngon par 'phags nas bdag cag 7rnams kyi gzhal med khang du mchis 7te/ spos kyi gdugs 0su 'gyur bas bdag cag lha'i 'khor rnams kyis ④kyang spos kyi dri mchog de tshor bar 'gyur/spos kyi du ba de yang gser gyi 8'od dang ldan pas bdag cag gnas pa'i khang khyim nas tshangs pa'i gnas dang / brgya byin lha'i dbang po ⑩dang / lha mo spobs pa chen mo r+sha 7dang / lha mo dpal chen mo dang / sa'i lha mo brtan (nyam dang / sde dpon chen po yang dag shes dang lho)/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / lha'i rgyal po so )dbang phyug chen po dang / lag na rdo 89—244

rje gsang ba'i bdag po dang / sde dpon chen po rin chen bzang dang /'phrog ma'i bu 'khor lnga brgya pa ①dang / klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa dang / klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho'i gnas kyi bar ②thams cad kyang rab tu gsal bar bgyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta bu la sogs pa'i 'khor rnams kyis rang rang gi gzhal ①med khang du spos kyi bdug pa des skad cig yud tsam cig dul spos kyi gdugs su gyur par yang ⑤mthong la spos kyi dri yang tshor bar 'gyur/ 'od zer gyi kha dog gis lha'i gzhal med khang thams cad gsal bar bgyid pa yang mthong bar 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po bzhi po rjodag la bka' stsal pa/ spos kyi 'od zer des tsogazhal med khang de dag 'ba' zhig ⑧gsal bar byas nas spos kyi ⑨gdugs su gyur te 'od zer chen po ⑩'gyed pa ma yin te/ mi'i rgyal po de dag lag pas 7pog phor 8bzung ste/ spos mchog dam pa bsregs nas mdo sde 'di la mchod pa byed pa'i tshe spos kyi du 'ab de thang cig yud tsam gcig la 8stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na yod pa'i nyi ma dang / zla ba bye ba phrag brgya dang / ri'i rgyal po ri rab bye ba phrag brgya dang / gling bzhi pa bye ba phrag brgya dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po'i 8khang khyim thams cad gsal bar byas nas nam mkha' 0kun du gang zhing rgyas pa dang / spos kyi bdug pa rnam pa 8sna tshogs gang yin pa de dag sprin gyi gdugs su gyur /nyate/ gdugs de yang gser gyi kha dog dang ldan pas lha'i khang khyim thams cad gsal bar byed de/ 'di ltar stong gsum gyi stong chen 89—245

po'i ①'jig rten gyi khams na zhuspos kyi sprin dang / spos kyi gdugs rnam pa sna tshogs ji snyed yod ②pa thams cad ni ④gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba mdo sde'i rgyal po'i gzi byin gyi mthu las gyur pa yin no/ /mi'i rgyal po de dag lag tu pog phor ⑧thogs nas mdo sde 'di la mchod par byed pa'i tshe spos kyi bdug pa 0rnam pa sna tshogs gang yin pa de dag stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di 'ba' zhig ⑦tu khyab par 'gyur ba nim yin gyi/ skad cig yud tsam gcig gis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i ⑨klung gi bye ma dang mnyam pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong tshad med mtha' med pa kun du khyab cing ske/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams kyi nam mkha' kun du 0spos kyi gdugs su gyur nas kun du 0gsal bar byed pa yang de bzhin te/ de'i tshe sangs rgyas mang po de dag spos gya rnam pa'i dri gang yin pa de dag kyang rig cing mkhyen/ spos kyi lhonyebla re dang / gser gyi kha dog de dag kyang gzigs nas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i 7klung gi bye ma dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 7kyis cho 'phrul bstan nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mang po de dag gis mthun par gzigs shing so sor brtags te/ gsung mthun par chos smra ba'i mkhan po de la skyes bu chen po khyod kyis shin tu zab pa'i mdo sde gya nom pa 'di rgya cher yongs su spel nas/ bsod nams kyi phung po tshad med mtha' med 3nyecing bsam gyis mi khyab pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa tsolegs so legs so/ /zhes bsngags pa brjod par 'gyur ro/ /gang la la zhig mdo sde 'di lta bu mnyan nas thos pa'i bsod nams gang yin pa de'i tshad kyang shin tu mang ba yin na/ yi ger 'dri ba dang / len pa dang / 'dzin pa dang /89—246

klog pa dang / gzhan dag la yang dag par ston pa dang / ji skad bstan pa bzhin du mngon par sgrub pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/rigs kyi bu dag sems can gang la la zhig gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di thos par gyur pa ①gang yin pa de dag ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir ldog par mi 'gyur bas so/ /de'i tshe phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong tshad med grangs med pa ②gang gā'i ②klung gi bye ma dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams gsung gcig tu chos kyi stan la 'dug pa'i chos smra ba'i mkhan po de la legs so legs so/ /zhes bsngags pa 'di 0brjod nas rigs kyi bu khyod ⑤ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ brtson 'grus kyi stobs kyis dka' dub brgya stong tshad med pa snyed mngon par bsgrubs te/tshogs yongs su rdzogs par byas nas 'phags pa mang po las yang dag par 'das te/ khams gsum las nges par byung nas gtso bo ⑦mchog tu gyur te byang chub kyi shing gi rgyal po'i drung du 'dug nas/ khyad par du 'phags pa rnams kyis duyongs su brgyan ⑨par 'gyur/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na rkyen dang ldan pa'i sems can rnams yongs su skyob par 'gyur/shin tu 'jigs su rung ba'i bdud kyi dmag tshogs rnams tshar gcod par 'gyur/shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos rnams dang / shin tu zab pa'i bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rab tu rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu khyod rdo rje'i stan la 'dug nas sangs rgyas rnams kyis rab tu bsngags pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med pa/ shin tu zab pa gya rnam pa rnam pa bcu gnyis yongs su 89—247

bskor bar 'gyur/ bla na med pa'i chos kyi rnga chen po mchog tu gyur pa rab tu rdung bar 'gyur/ bla na med pa'i chos kyi dung shin tu gya rnam pa 'bud par 'gyur/ bla na med pa'i chos kyi rgyal mtshan khyad par du 'phags pa sgreng ①bar 'gyur / bla na med pa'i chos kyi sgron ma shin tu gsal bar spar bar ②'gyur/bla na med pa'i bdud rtsi'i chos kyi char rab tu 'bebs par 'gyur/ nyon mongs pa'i dgra'i 'ching ba tshad med pa yongs su gcod par 'gyur/ sems can bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong tshad med pa snyed mtha' med cing 'jigs su rung ba'i rgya mtsho las yongs su bzlas par 'gyur/ mu med pa'i skye shi'i 'khor ba las thar bar 'gyural/ sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong tshad med pa snyed dudang phrad par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsung bar ④'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag gis yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di ni slad ma dang / da ltar gyi tshe ⑤yon tan tshad ma mchis pa 'di lta bu yongs su rdzogs par bgyid pas de'i slad du mi'i rgyal po gang gis mdo sde shin tu gya nom pa 'di thos par gyur pa de ④ni sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong tshad ma mchis pa snyed las dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa lags pas mi'i rgyal po de dag la bdag cag rnams yongs su bsrung ༅zhing rjes su dran par bgyid do/ /gzhan yang bsod nams kyi phan yon tshad ma mchis pa snyed mthong ba'i slad du bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / 'khor gzhan rnams dang / yi dgas (kye'abum phrag brgya stong tshad ma mchis pa snyed rang rang gi gzhal med khang rnams su spos kyi ⑨bdug pa'i sprin gyi gdugs dang / cho 'phrul rnam pa sna tshogs pa 7de dag mthong ba/ de'i 7tshe 83—248

bdag cag rang gi lus ①mi snang bar bgyis nas chos nyan pa'i slad du rgyal po de'i pho brang yongs su gtsang zhing mdzes par brgyan ②pa chos 'chad ③pa'i gnas su mchi bar 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin du tshangs pa dang / brgya byin dang / lha mo spobs pa chen mo dudang / dpal gyi lha mo chen mo dang / sa'i lha mo brtan ma dang / sde dpon chen po yang dag shes dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / lha'i bu dbang phyug chen po dang / lag na rdo rje gsang ba'i bdag po dang / sde dpon chen po rin chen bzang dang / 'phrog ma'i bu 'khor lnga brgya pa dang / klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa dang / klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho dang ⑤/ lha dang gnod sbyin la sogs pa'i 'khor bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong tshad ma mchis pa snyed kyang chos nyan tshupa'i slad du so so nas rang rang ⑦gi lus mi snang bar bgyis te/ mi'i rgyal po de'i pho brang shin tu nikhyad par du 'phags pa chos kyi gdan shin tu mdzes par bgyis pa chos bshad pa'i gnas su mchi bar ⑨'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / 'khor gzhan rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams thams cad sems 0rtse gcig tu mi'i rgyal po de dag dang 0lhan cig tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen bgyis nas bla na ma mchis pa'i chos kyi sbyin bdag chen por 'gyur ba'i 8rgyus bdud rtsi'i ros bdag cag tshim par gyur pas/ de'i slad du bdag cag hunyergyal po de la yongs su bsrungs nas gnod pa rnams yongs su ④bsal te bde ba thob par bgyid do/ /de'i pho brang dang / grong dang / grong khyer dang / yul rnams su yang sdig pa dang ltas ngan pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyid do/ /de nas rgyal po chen po bzhi cig 8car thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /83—249

bcom ldan 'das mi'i rgyal po gang la la zhig rang gi yul du mdo sde 'di bzhugs par gyur kyang yongs su spel bar yang mi bgyid la sems kyis kyang spong bar bgyid cing nyan par yang mi mos/ ①mchod par yang mi bgyid/ bla mar yang mi bgyid/ bsngags pa brjod par yang ②mi bgyid la/ 'khor bzhi po dag mdo sde 'dzin pa mthong bar gyur na yang / bla mar mi bgyid cing mchod pa dang /rim gro yang mi bgyid na bdag cag dang / 'khor gzhan rnams dang / lha tshad ma mchis pa rnams kyang shin tu zab cing gya nom pa'i chos 'di ①thos par mi 'gyur bas bdud rtsi'i ro la rgyab kyis phyogs shing yang dag ༷pa'i chos kyi rgyud kyang dustor bar 'gyur/ gzi byin dang mthu stobs kyang ma mchis par 'gyur/ngan 'gro 'phel bar bgyid cing lha dang mi rnams yongs su nyams par 'gyur/'khor ba'i chu bor bying bar 'gyur zhing / mya ngan las 'das pa'i shul dang gol bar 'gyur bas bcom ldan 'das bdag cag 0rgyal po chen po bzhi dang /'khor gzhan rnams dang / gnod sbyin la sogs pa de lta bu'i dngos po mthong bar gyur na ⑦yul de yongs su spong bar bgyid ladu/ yongs su skyob cing yongs su bsrung ba'i ⑨sems kyang ⑩ma mchis par 'gyur ba tshulags so/ /bdag cag 'ba' zhig 8rgyal po de spong bar bgyid pa ma lags kyi yul skyong ba'i lha dge ba chen po tshad ma mchis pa rnams kyang yal bar bor nas mchi bar 'gyur lags so/ /de ltar yal bar bor ba'i dbang gis yul der gnod pa rnam pa sna tshogs 'byung bar 'gyur zhing rgyal thabs kyang stor bar 'gyur/ mi'i tshogs thams cad kyang 'o)dge ba'i sems ni ma mchis kyi gcig la gcig 8'ching ba dang / gsod pa dang / gshe ba dang / rtsod pa dang / phan tshun phra ma 89—250

dang / gya gyu bgyid cing nongs pa ma mchis pa la chad ①pa gcod pa 'ba' zhig ②sems pas/ nad dang / rims nad rnams ③'byung bar 'gyur/ gza' mjug 0rings yang nas yang du 'byung bar 'gyur/ gdugs gnyis cig car ⑤'char bar 'gyur/ gza' 'jug ①pa la rgyun chad pa ma mchis par 'gyur/ gzha' dkar ⑦nag gis bkra shis pa ma lags pa'i mtshan ma ston par 'gyur/skar mda' ltung zhing sa g.yo bar 'gyur/ khron pa'i nang nas sgra 'byung bar 'gyur/ char dang rlung drag po dus ma lags par 'bab cing ldang bar 'gyur/rtag par mu ge'i gnod pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ 'bru rnams yongs su smin par mi 'gyur/ phas kyi ⑤rgol ba'i dgra mang pos gtses pas yul gyi ①mi rnams sdug bsngal gyi gnod pa mang po myong bar 'gyur/ yul gyi sa phyogs kyang yid du mi mchi zhing mngon par dga' ba ci yang ma mchis par 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / lha brgya stong tshad ma mchis pa dang / sngon yul skyong ba'i lha dge ba chen po rnams kyis yongs su spangs nas/mchi ba'i tshe ltas ngan pa'i dngos po brgya stong tshad ma mchis pa de lta bu dag tunye'abyung bar 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das mi'i rgyal po gang la la zhig yul skyong zhing rtag par bde ba'i longs spyod myong bar 'tshal ba dang / skye bo mang po rnams bde ba la 'god par 'tshal ba dang / phas kyi rgol ba thams cad tshar bkum nas rang gi yul khams 7gtan du rgyas shing dar bar 'tshal ba dang /yang dag pa'i bstan pa 'jig rten du gnas nas sdug bsngal gyi 8gnod pa dang /sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos rnams nye bar zhi bar 'gyur bar 'tshal na/ bcom ldan 'das yul gyi bdag po de dag gis tsogadon mi 'tshal bar mdo sde'i rgyal po 89—251

dam pa 'di mnyan nas yongs su gzung bar bgyi zhing mdo sde 'di klog pa dang /'don pa dang / len pa dang / 'dzin pa dag la yang bsnyen bkur ba dang /rim gro dang / mchod par bgyid na/ bdag cag dang ①/ tshad ma mchis pa'i lha'i 'khor gzhan rnams chos mnyan ②pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba'i byin gyis brlabs kyi nimathus bla na ma mchis 0pa'i bdud rtsi'i chos kyi ro myong bar 'gyur bas dubadag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la sman par 'gyur zhing lha gzhan rnams kyang sman yon mchog thob par 'gyur lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar mi'i rgyal po des sems rtse gcig tu mdo sde 'di mnyan nas yongs su bzung ⑥ba'i slad du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar tshangs pa chen pos kyang sems can rnams la rtag par 'jig rten dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bstan bcos 5/nga dag par bstan/ brgya byin lha'i dbang pos ༅kyang bstan bcos rnam pa sna tshogs yang dag par bstan/ mngon par shes pa ⑧lnga dang ldan pa'i drang srong rnams kyis kyang khyabastan bcos mang po bstan te⑩/ bcom ldan 'das tshangs pa dang / brgya byin dang / mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa'i drang srong gis bstan bcos bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong tshad ma mchis pa snyed bstan mod kyi/'on kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis byams pa dang thugs rjes thugs brtse bar dgongs nas lha dang mi'i tshogs rnams kyi ched du gser 'od dam pa'i mdo sde shin tu gya nom pa bkas lhonyabashad pa gang lags pa sngar 8bstan pa de tsodag dang bsgrun nang/ bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong 'gyur 8snyed kyis ches khyad ⑩par du 'phags pas dper bgyir yang ⑩ma mchis lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/'di'i dbang gis 'dzam bu'i gling na rgyal po ji snyed mchis pa de dag yang dag 89—252

pa'i chos kyis 'jig rten btul ①nas sems can la bde ba'i dngos po stsal ba dang / bdag dang 'khor rnams yongs su ②bsrungs nas sdug bsngal gyi gnod pa ma mchis par bgyid pa dang / gzhan yang phas kyi rgol bas gnod pa ②bgyid pa ma mchis pa dang / sdig pa mi dge ba ci ༷snyed pa thams cad thag ring du spong ba dang / yul gyi godon ⑤bgegs rnams yongs su bsal nas yang dag pa'i chos kyis 'dul zhing rtsod pa ma mchis par bgyid pa'i slad du'o/ /de'i slad du mi'i rgyal po rnams so so nas rang gi yul du chos kyi sgron ma sbar te mtha' yas pa rnams gsal dubar bgyis nas lha'i tshogs dang rang rang ⑦gi 'khor rnams la sman par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / lha dang / gnod sbyin gyi 'khor tshad ma mchis pa dang / 'dzam bu'i gling na lha dang / yi dgas nici mchis pa ⑨thams cad rgyu dang rkyen 'di'i dbang gis bla na ma mchis pa'i bdud rtsi'i chos kyi ro myong bar 'gyur zhing ⑩gzi byin chen po'i mthu stobs dang ldan payi/ 'od kyi snang ba phun sum tshogs pa chadang /sems can thams cad bde bar 'gyur ba dang / gzhan yang slad ma'i dus kyi tshe bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong tshad ma mchis shing bsam gyis mi khyab pa snyed du rtag par 8shin tu bde ba'i longs spyod myong 8ba dang / gzhan yang tsosangs rgyas tshad ma mchis pa snyed mnyes par bgyis nas dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed de/de nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur bas/ 'di lta bu'i sman yon tshad ma mchis shing mtha' ma mchis pa thams cad kyang thugs rje chen po tshangs pa'i 'khor las yang dag par 'das pa mkhyen pa chen po brgya byin pas lhag pa'i/ dka' ba rnam pa sna tshogs 89—253

yongs su spyad ①pa mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa'i drang srong las khyad par du 'phags par gyur pas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong 'gyur ②sted kyis ③ches lhag dhipar gyur te brjod du ma mchis pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ⑤kyis sems can rnams kyi 0ched du 'di lta bu'i mdo sde shin tu gya nom pa yang dag par bkas ⑦bshad nas 'dzam bu'i gling gi yul gyi bdag po thams cad dang / mi'i tshogs dumang po rnams 'jig rten na chos kyi cho ga dang yul yongs su skyong zhing mi rnams gdul ba dang bskul bar bya ⑨ba'i dngos po ji snyed pa de dag gsal bar khong 4)du chud pa las gyur pa lags te/mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di'i byin gyis brlabs kyi ⑩mthus thams cad bde ba thob pa'i bsod nams kyi phan yon 'di dag thams cad kyang ston pa chen po shākya thub pas byams pa dang / thugs rje'i mthus mdo sde 'di rgya cher yang dag par spel ba las gyur pa lags pas/ bcom ldan 'das rgyu dang rkyen de'i 8slad du mi'i rgyal po rnams kyis mdo sde dam pa 'di yongs su bzung ste/ mchod pa dang /bkur sti dang / bla mar bgyis nas bsngags pa brjod par bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di lta bu la sogs pa'i yon tan khyad par du 'phags pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag gis thams cad la sman par bgyis 8pas de'i slad du mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba mdo sde'i rgyal po zhes bgyi ba lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po ④bzhi po dag la yang 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /khyed cag rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / 'khor gzhan rnams dang lha'i 'khor bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong tshad med pa rnams 0mi'i rgyal po de dag gal te sems rtse gcig tu mdo sde 'di mnyan nas mchod pa dang / bkur ste dang / bla mar 83—254

byas te/ bsngags pa brjod pa mthong nas yongs su bsrungs te/ gnod pa rnams yongs su sel bar byed na/ khyed cag rab tu bde ba myong bar 'gyur bar byed do/ /gal te 'khor bzhi po dag gis mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di rgya cher yang dag par spel bar byed na des ①ni lha dang mi'i nang na dusangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa rgya cher duyang dag par byas pa yin pas sems can tshad med pa snyed la ༷phan btags pa yin te/ 'di lta bu'i gang zag gang yin pa de la khyed kyis rtag par bsrung ⑤zhing yongs su bskyab par bya'o/ /'di lta bu'i 'khor bzhi po dag rkyen gzhan gyis phan tshun gnod pa byed pa med ⑥par byos la/ de dag lus dang sems rab tu dben zhing bde bas mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di yang dag par spel nas ⑦phyi ma'i mtha' ji srid pa'i bar du sems can duphan 'dogs pa la rgyun chad pa med par byos shig /de nas lha'i rgyal po rnam thos stan las langs te bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i gzungs kyi cho ga mchis te/ sems can gang la la zhig yongs su 'dzin par mos na yon tan tshad ma mchis pa dang ldan par 'gyur zhing bdag gis rtag par bsrungs pas ⑨sems can de sdug bsngal spangs ⑩nas bde ba thob ⑩par 'gyur/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rnam pa gnyis yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur lags so/ /gang zhig yongs su 'dzin par 'tshal bas sngar lus bsrung 8ba'i sngags 'di gdon 8par bgyi'o/ /sngags ni 'di lta ste/ na mo bai shra ba 87 ya/ ma hā rā 8cho ya/ tabya thā/ ra ra ra ra/ ku no ku no/khu no khu no/ ru r+ṇa ru kho / sa ba sa ba/ ka ra ka ra/ ma hā 'bi ka rang/nye/ma hā bi ka ro⑩/ ma hā kā la/ ma hā rā dza/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa tu( )/ bdag nyid kyi 89—255

ming brjod par bya/ māṃ sarba satā nāñca ①gu hā/ bcom ldan 'das sngags ②'di 'don pas skud pa dkar po la lan bdun sngags kyis btab ste lan re mdud ①pa re re bor nas dpung pa la bcings nadu/ de'i don gdon mi 'tshal bar 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /spos ⑤mang po 'di lta ste/ gu gul dang /tsan+dan dang / du ruska rjodang / ta ka ra'i pog ⑦'di rnams cha mnyam par gcig tu bsres te sug par pog phor thogs nas pog ⑧bsregs te mchod par bgyi'o / /khrus yongs su dag par bgyis te/ gos sar ⑨pa gtsang ma bgos nas ⑩khang pa dben par sngags ⑩bzlas te lha'i rgyal po rnam thos bdag g.yar drang bar bgyi lags so/ /sngags ni 'di lta ste/ na mo be+e shra ba 87 ya/ ma hā dha tson dā ya/ tsaṇ+ḍi 0shwa rā ya/ ā kun+ta/ a pa ra dzi ta/ tsaṇ+ḍi shwa ra/pa byar ma kā ru ṇi ka /sarba satwa nyi ta tsi(8/ bdag gi ming brjod/ ma ma dha na bsgo/ pa ra ye shwa ra/ swa yaṃ ā kun+ta ya 0swā hā/ sngags 'di lan bdun tshang bar lho bzlas na 6)de'i rjes la sngags kyi snying po gdon bu par bgyi'o/ /sngags 'don pa'i tshe sngar dkon mchog gsum la gus par phyag bgyis nas lha'i dbang po rnam thos kyi ming nas 'don par bgyid na/ nor rdzas rnams stsol cing 0sems can rnams ci dang ci smon pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyis nas bde ba 8stestsol bar bgyid do/ /de ltar phyag bgyis nas de'i rjes la rgyal po rnam thos kyi gi yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i sngags ( nyekyi snying po 'don ⑤par bgyid na/ yid bzhin gyi bde ba stsol bar bgyid do/ /de nas lha'i rgyal po rnam thos kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i sngags kyi snying po smras pa/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/2lha na mo be+e shra ba ( nye'o ya/ ma 89wa 256

hā rā dzā ya/ tabya thā/ si mi si mi/ su mu su mu/ tsaṇ+ḍa tsaṇ+ḍal/ tsa ra tsa ra/sa ra sa ra/ ka ra ka ra/ ki li ki liphyi/ ku ru ku ru/ mu ru mu ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ sa ya/ ād+ma ṭ+wāṃ ni ta tan an+tajo tu ②swā hā/ na mo be+e shra ba ④'o ya swā hā/ dha na dā ya dus hā/ ma no ra tha pa ri pu ra ya 0swā hā/ sngags 'don pa'i tshe sngar rgyalan stong tshang bar bzlas nas/ de'i rjes la khang pa gtsang dum dag tu ba lang gi lci bas dog sa la zhal zhal bgyis te dkyil 'khor chung ngu zhig ⑨bgyis nas zas ci 'byor pas sems rtse gcig tu mchod par bgyi'o/ /rtag par pog spos kyidam pa bsregs nas dud pa rgyun mi 'chad par bgyi'o/ /sngags kyi snying po snga ma gdugs mtshan du sems dran pa nye bar gzhag tunyenas/bdag nyid kyis thos pa tsam du zlos shing gzhan gyis rig par mi bgyid na/de'i tshe rnam thos kyi bu sha ni 8shi zhes bgyi ba gzhon nu'i gzugs nye bar bstan te/ drung du mchis nas 'di skad du ci'i phyir bdag gi pha 'bod 8ces 'dri bar 'gyur bas ④lan du 'di skad ces bdag dkon mchog gsum mchod pa'i don du nor 'tshal na/ de bzhin du stsal bar gsol zhes smra bar bgyi'o/ /de'i tshe sha ni 8shi tshig de thos pa dang slar pha'i thad du mchis nas pha la 'di skad du deng yidage ba spyod pa'i mi zhig sems rtse gcig tu dkon mchog gsum mchod tī de/ nor gyis phongs (nyepa'i slad du yab la gsol ba 'debs so zhes bgyis pa dang / phas yikhyod myur du song la nyin gcig du )bzhin du de la kācho pa ṇa brgya tībargya byin cig ces mchi bar 'gyur te sngags 'don pas de lta bu'i mtshan ma mthong bar gyur tson don 'grub par 'gyur bar rig par bgyis nas gcig pu tsokhang pa gtsang ma'i nang du bdug spos bsregs te mchis nyal ba'i khri'i drung du 83—257

spos kyi sprog ma gcig ①bzhag nas rtag par nam langs ②pa'i tshe sprog ma'i nang du nor ci thob pa blta bar bgyi'o/ /rtag par nor thob pa'i tshe de nyid kyi gdugs la duspos dang me tog dang / zhal zas kyis dkon rjomachog gsum la mchod cing dbul phongs pa rnams la stsal nas bas par bgyi'o/ /bsris te gzhag ⑤par mi bgyi'o/ /sems can rnams la byams pa rjodang snying rje'i bsam pa bskyed par bgyiklu/ zhe snang dang g.yo sgyu dudang / gnod sems kyi bsam pa bskyed par mi bgyi'o/ /gal te zhe snang skyes par gyur na/ dngos grub kyi mthu stor bar 'gyur bas khyartag par sems bsrungs te zhe snang bskyed par mi bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang sngags 'dzin pas rtag par lha'i rgyal po rnam ⑩thos bdag dang / bu dang ske/ bu mo dang / 'khor rnams rjes su dran par bgyis te bsngags pa brjod na 7rtag par dge ba bcu po dag gis 8bstangs te/ lha de dag bsod nams kyi mthu 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / dge ba mang po kun du 'phel nas ⑫byang chub mngon par rtogs par 'gyur bar bgyid na/ lha mang po de dag gis dngos po de lta bu mthong ba dang / thams cad rab tu dga' bas lhan cig tu nye bar mchis te/ sngags 'don pa'i gang zag de la yongs su bsrung 8bar bgyi'o0/ /gzhan yang sngags 'dzin pa de 0tshe ring zhing lo tshad ma mchis pa ⑩snyed du gnas par 'gyur/ ngan song gsum dang rtag tu bral 8zhing rtag par gnod pa ma mchis par 'gyurayi/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang gter rnams 'thob ḍa rtepar 'gyur/ mngon par shes pa dang / dbang phyug dang /smon pa thams cad mngon par 'grub par 'gyur/ gal te blon thabs 'tshal na yang 27yid bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur/ gcan gzan thams cad kyi skad kyang 83—258

'tshal bar 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te sngags 'don pa'i tshe bdag gi ①lus mngon du ston par ②mthong bar ③'tshal na tshes brgyad dam/bcwa dulnga'i gdugs la ras dkar po la sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs shig sbyin dang tshon ⑤sna tshogs kyis brgyan ⑥pa bri bar bgyi'o/ /sku gzugs 'dri ba'i ri mo mkhan de ④yang bslab pa'i gnas brgyad yang dag par blang bar bgyi'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi ⑧g.yon phyogs su dpal gyi lha mo'i gzugs 0bri bar bgyi'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi g.yas phyogs su rgyal po rnam thos bdag dang / bu dang / bu mo dang / 'khor rnams kyi gzugs 0bris nas/ mchis pa'i stan legs par bshams te me tog sna tshogs bkram nas spos mchog dam pa bsregs te gdugs mtshan rgyun chad pa ma mchis par mar me sbar bar bgyi'o/ /bza' yib dang btung ba 8mchog dam pa 8sna tshogs kyis 8gus pa'i sems bskyed de dus gsum du byamachod pa ⑩bgyis nas sngags gdon par bgyi'o/ /brnyas pa'i sems bskyed par mi bgyi'o/ /bdag g.yar 'dren pa'i tshe sngags 'di gdon par bgyi'o/ /na maḥshrī ku ⑩ya/ bud dhā ya.a/ na mo bai shra ba yiṇa ya/ yak+ṣa rā dzā zhu ya/ma hā rā dzā ya/ a ti durā dzā ya/ na maḥshrī dum hā de bi ye'u/ tabya thā/ ta ra ta ra/ tu ru tu ru/ ba ra ba ra/ su shusgo su shu ci/ ha na ha na/ ma ṇi tsoka na ka / badz+ra be+e ḍūr+ya/ musti kā lo kṛ ta/ sha rī rā ya/ sarba sa tā ṭ+wāṃ hi ta kā ma/ be+e shra ba ṇa/ shri ya de bī pra bhā ya/ e hi e nyi/ mā bi lasbra/ guṇ+ḍa guṇ+ḍa/ pa ra su/ pa ra su/ da dā nyi ma ma a mu ka nā ma su/ dar+sha na kā ma su dar+sha rna/pu nye ma ma ma na/ pra la ha dā sonaya swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis phyisngags 'don pa'i mi de dang / gzhan yang de lta bu'i ⑥mchod pa rgyas par 89—259

bgyis ①mthong bar gyur na byams shing sdug pa dang / rab tu dga' ba'i sems bskyed nas bdag byis pa gzhon nu'i gzugs sam/ rgan po'am/ dge slong gi gzugs su phyilus bsgyur nas sug pa na yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang gser gyi snod thogs te③/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs te lus kyis dugus pa bstan te/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan nas brjod de sngags 'don pa de la khyod kyis bsam 0pa bzhin du smon pa rnams 'grub par bya'o zhes mchi bar du'agyur lags so / /nags tshal gyi nang du mi snang bar 'tshal lam/ rin po che mngon par 'grub par ⑦bgyid pa dang / skye bo mang po kun gyi snying du sdug cing bkur bar 'tshal lam/ gser dang dngul la sogs pa'i nor rnams yongs su gnyer bar 'tshal melam/ sngags kyi dngos grub 'grub par 'tshal lam/ mngon par shes pa dang / tshe shin tu ring ba dang / longs spyod mchog dam pa yongs su gnyer bar 'tshal na yang bsam pa bzhin du mi 'grub pa gang yang ma mchis par 'gyur lags so/ /deng bdag gis re zhig ⑨dngos po 'di tsam zhig bstan pa lags te / gal te yang gzhan dag yongs su gnyer bar bgyid na yang thams cad ji ltar smon pa bzhin du mngon par 'grub cing rin po che'i gter bas pa ma mchis pa dang / yon tan mthar thug pa ma mchis pa yang mngon par 'grub par 'gyur bolags so/ /gal te nyi ma dang zla ba dog sa la nyung ⑩bar 'gyur yang srid / sa chen po res 'ga' gzhan du 'gyur yang srid kyi bdag gi bden pa'i tshig 'di ni nam yang 7chab 'tshal bar mi 'gyur bas rtag par yid bzhin gyi bde ba rka/nye'athob par 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das gang la la zhig gis mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di len pa dang / /'dzin pa dang / klog pa dang / kha don ski89—260

du 'don pa des sngags 'di 'don par bgyid na/ ngal ba ma mchis par cho ga rnams myur du 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das deng bdag gis dbul phongs ①pa dang / sdug bsngal gyi ②gnod par 'gyur ba'i ①sems can de dag gi ched du sngags 'di bstan pas 0phan yon chen po thob nas thams cad phyug cing skyid pa dang rang dbang dang ldan zhing gnod pa ma mchis pa 'thob ⑤par 'gyur lags so/ /bdag gis nam 'tsho'i dubar du gang zag de'i rjes su 'brangs nas yongs su bsrungs te⑦/ gnod pa rnams yongs su sel bar bgyid do/ /gzhan yang gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di yongs su bzung nas spel bar bgyid pa dang / sngags 'don pa'i gang zag de la gom pa brgya tshun chad du 'od kyis kun du gsal bar bgyid lags so/ /bdag gis gnod sbyin brgya stong ji snyed ⑧mchis pa yang rtag par rim gro bgyid cing ji ltar mos ⑨pa bzhin du g.yog bgyis ⑩pas yid bzhin du mi 'grub pa gang yang ma mchis lags so/ /bdag gis bden tshig smra ba la mi mad ⑩pa ma mchis par ni bcom ldan 'das nyag gcig dbang du gyur cing mkhyen par gyur pa lags so/ /de'i tshe lha'i rgyal po rnam thos kyis sngags 'di smras pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po khyod kyis sems can thams cad kyi 8dbul phongs (/3pa'i sdug bsngal gyi dra ba dral rdzinas bde ba 'thob ⑫par bya ba dang / mdo sde 'di 'jig 8rten du rgya cher spel ba'i phyir rig sngags 'di bshad pa legs so legs so/ /de nas rgyal po chen po bzhi po cig car stan tshulas langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig la gzar nas bcom ldan 'das kyi (shezhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas /3te/ pus ri — )mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la 89—261

btsugs nas gus pas thal mo sbyar te/ tshigs su bcad ①pa gya rnam pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi yon tan la mngon par bstod pa/ bcom ldan zhal ni zla gtsang nya 'dra zhing / /nyi ma stong gis ②'od zer bkye dang ①mtshungs/ /spyan ni dag yangs pad+ma sngon po 'dra/ /tshems dkar gtams pa dper na dung dang mtshungs / /bcom ldan yon tan mtha' med rgya mtsho 'dra/ /rin chen gya rnam tshad med bden pa dubasags/ /mkhyen pa'i yon tan chab kyis rtag rgyas shing ⑤/ /ting 'dzin dam pa brgya stong rab tu gang / /zhabs mthil du'akhor lo'i ⑦mtshan ni thams cad mdzes/ /lte ba mu khyud rtsibs stong kun rab mnyam/ /phyag dang zhabs kyi dra bas nikun brgyan pasal/ /ngang pa'i rgyal bzhin mtshan ⑩ni phun sum tshogs/ /bcom ldan sku 'od gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /rnam dag khyad 'phags dpe zla yod ma mchis/ /ri rab bzhin du yon tan kun rgyas ⑩pas/ /bcom ldan ri rgyal khyod la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /mtshan dang dpe byad mkha' ⑫bzhin dpag mi rig /zla ba stong bas lhag par 'od zer bkye/ /smig rgyu sgyu ⑫ltar bsam gyis ④mi khyab pas/ /thugs zhen mi mnga' khyod la bdag phyag 'tshal / /de'i tshe rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa / gser 'od dam pa'i mdo sde mchog 'di ni/ /bla med stobs bcu dag gis rab tu gsungs/ /khyed cag rgyal po bzhi yis rab bsrungs 7la/ /rab dga' nur ba med pa'i 7sems skyed cigatu tsho /mdo sde'i 8rin chen gya rnam zab mo 'di/ /sems can thams cad bde ba sbyin par byed/ /sems can de dag bde bar gyur pa'i phyir/ /rtag tu 'dzam gling rab tu spel bar 'gyur/ /stong 89—262

chen 'jig rten khams ni 'di dag tu/ /sems can rnam pa thams cad ji snyed pa/ /yi dgas ①dud 'gro ②sems can dmyal ba yi③/ /sdug bsngal 'gro ba de kun sel bar byed/ /'dzam gling 'di na gnas pa'i 0rgyal po dang / /gzhan yang sems can rnam pa thams cad kun/ /mdo sde'i ⑤mthu yis rtag tu rab ⑦dga' zhing / /nad mang ④sdug bsngal bsal bas chom rkun ⑧med/ /yul der mdo sde rgya cher spel ba'i phyir/ /rab bde lo legs mi mthun gnod pa med/ /gang zhig mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di mnyan nas/ /cho rigs btsun zhing don 0ni gnyer ba dang / /yul na lo legs rtsod pa med 'dod na/ /sems la bsams bzhin thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /pha rol dgra rnams phyir ni zlog 0byed cing / /rang gi yul khams rtag tu bde bar 'gyur/ /mdo sde'i rgyal po dam pa 'di yi mthus/ /sdug bsngal mang spong 0mya ngan 'jigs pa med/ /rin chen shing rgyal khyim na gang gnas pa/ /bde ba'i yo byad thams cad skyed pa ltar/ /⑫mdo sde'i rgyal po dam pa'ang de bzhin te/ / mi rgyal 8dag la yon tan mchog sbyin byed/ /dper na rab dang chu ni grang mo yis/ /skom pa'i gdung ba rnams ni sel ba ltar/ /mdo sde'i rgyal po dam pa'ang de bzhin te/ /bsod nams mos pa'i sems ni yongs rdzogs byed/ /mi zhig gya rnam rin chen gzab bdog ④na/ longs spyod sems la bsams bzhin 'byor pa ltar/ /mdo sde'i rgyal po dam pa 'ang de bzhin te/ /bsod nams bsams 8bzhin 'grub pas rgud pa med/ / lha yi ⑩bdag po khyed yidang lha tshogs kyis/ /mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di la mchod pa hunyegyis/ /gal te bstan bzhin mdo sde 'dzin byed na/ /shes rab gzi byin thams cad phun tshogs ⑩'gyur/ /da ltar phyogs bcur sgo )bzhugs 89—263

pa'i sangs rgyas kun/ /mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di ni gsung ①dgongs pasal/ /klog 'don 'dzin pa dag ni gzigs gyur na/ /legs so ngo mtshar che zhes bsngags par 'gyur/ /gang zhig mdo sde 'di ni nyan byed na/ /lus dang sems ni dga' rangs mgu ②ba skye/ /rtag par gnod dusbyin brgya phrag mang po yis /gang du gnas pa der ni de ⑤sung byed/ /'jig rten khams 'di'i lha ni mang po rnams / /de yi grangs ni tshad med bsam mi khyab/ /thams cad mdo sde'i dbang po 'di nyan ①pas/ /rab dga' srung ⑦byed nur ba ci yang med/ /gang zhig mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di mnyan na/ /mthu che rab dpa' nirtag par dbang dang ldan/ /mi yi 'khor mang thams cad phan 'dogs pas/ /gnod pa rab spong snang ba 'phel bar byed/ /de nas rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag gis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag thos nas/ dga' mgu rangs par gyur pas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis ni sngon chad nam yang mdo sde zab mo shin tu gya nom pa 'di lta bu ma thos so zhes rab tu dga' ba'i shugs kyis mchi ma blags te ngus nas lus kyi yan lag 'dar zhing g.yo bar gyur te/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i dngos po bsam gyis mi khyab pa mngon du gyur pas lha'i yo)me tog man dā ⑩ra ba dang / man dā ra hu)ba chen po dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par gtor te/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i mchod pa byas nas yang bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi la so so nas gnod sbyin gyi 'khor lnga brgya lnga brgya mchis pas rtag par gnas de dang de dag tu mdo sde 'di dang /chos smra ba de dag la lhonyayongs su bsrung 7zhing yongs su skyob par byed pas ye shes 89—264

kyi snang bas yongs su skyob par bgyid do①/ /gal te mdo sde 'di'i tshig dang /don bskyud pa zhig mchis na ②yang bdag cag gis de dag rjes su dran zhing mi bskyud par bgyi ba'i ②slad du gzungs kyi sgo shin tu khyad par du 'phags pa stsal nas yongs su rdzogs dupar bgyid do/ /gzhan yang mdo sde'i rgyal po mchog dam pa 'di gang du gnas pa der ②sems can rnams la rgya cher spel ༷zhing myur du nub par mi 'gyur bar bgyid lags so/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor mang po'i nang du chos 'di bstan pa na sems can tshad med pa snyed shes rab chen po'i spobs pa thob nas bsod nams kyi phung po tshad med pa snyed yongs gsu bsdus te mya ngan gyi gnod pa dang bral nas rab tu dga' ba'i sems thob par gyur pas bstan bcos sna tshogs la rab tu mkhas pa dang / nges par 'byung ba'i lam thob nas phyir mi ldog par gyur pas myur du byang chub mngon par rtogs par gyur to/ /gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba mdo sde'i rgyal po las rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag gis yul bsrung ⑧ba'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba mdo sde'i rgyal po0/ bam po bdun pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa shā 0ri'i bu la bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu chos kyi rnam grangs mngon par zhen pa med pa'i gzungs zhes bya ba yod de/ de ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mngon par bsgrub par bya ba'i chos7/ 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis yongs su bzung 8ba/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mar gyur pa yin no/ /zhes 83—265

bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gzungs zhes bgyi ba gang gi tshig dang don gang ①zhig lags/ bcom ldan 'das gzungs zhes bgyi ba ni phyogs dang gnas ma lags pa/ phyogs dang gnas ma lags pa yang ma lags so zhes de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu khyod theg pa chen po la yang dag par gzhol zhing /theg pa chen po la mngon par yid ches nas/ theg pa chen po la bla mar byas ②pa legs so legs so/ /khyod kyis ji skad smras pa bzhin du gzungs zhes bya ba ni phyogs dang gnas yod pa yang ma yin/ phyogs dang gnas med pa yang ma yin / chos kyang ma yin/ chos ma yin pa yang ma yin/ 'das pa yang ma yin/ma 'ongs pa yang ma yin/ da ltar byung ba yang ma yin/ dngos po yang ma yin/dngos po ma yin pa yang ma yin/ rkyen yang ma yin/ rkyen ma yin pa yang ma yin / 'du byed kyang stim yin/ 'du byed ma yin pa yang ma yin/ chos skye bar 'gyur ba yang med/ chos 'gag par 'gyur ba yang med mod kyi/ 'on kyang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phan ④gdags pa'i phyir de skad du bstan pa yin te gzungs 'di'i yon tan gyi nus pa dang yang dag pa'i ⑤lam gyi tshul dang mthu stobs rnam par gzhag pa gang yin pa de ni sangs rgyas rnams kyi yon tan dang / sangs rgyas rnams kyi tshul khrims dang / sangs rgyas rnams kyi bslab pa dang / sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsang ba'i dgongs pa dang / sangs rgyas rnams kyi skye ba'i 'byung gnas yin pa'i phyir mngon par zhen pa med pa'i gzungs mchog tu (61gya rnam pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs zhes (3)bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal 89—266

pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bde bar gshegs pas bdag la gzungs 'di'i cho ga gang lags pa bkas bshad du gsol/ gal te byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis 'di la gnas par gyur na bla na ma mchis pa'i byang chub las ldog par mi 'gyur zhing yang dag pa'i smon lam yongs su rdzogs nas gnas ①ma mchis pa dang / rang bzhin gyi 0spobs pa 'thob ②par 'gyur ba dang / ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i dngos po thob nas 'phags pa'i lam la gnas par 'gyur ba 'di dag thams cad kyang gzungs 'di thob par 'gyur ba'i slad du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu legs so ④legs so/ /de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ khyod kyis ji skad smras pa bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' gang ⑤la la zhig gis gzungs 'di thob par gyur na/ gang zag de ni sangs rgyas dang tha dad pa med par rig par bya'o/ /gang la la zhig gis byang chub sems dpa' de la mchod cing bkur ste byed pa dang / bla mar byed cing yo byad sbyin par byed na de ni sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa byas pa yin par rig par bya'o/ /shā ri'i bu gang zag gzhan dugang la la zhig gzungs 'di thos nas len pa dang /'dzin pa dang / klog pa dang / kha ton du 'don pa dang / mngon par yid ches par gyur ⑦pa de la 'di ltar sangs rgyas dang tha dad pa nimed par bkur sti byas nas mchod cing rim gro byas na ①rgyu dang rkyen des bla na med pa'i 'bras bu thob ⑩par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gzungs sngags bka' stsal pa/ tabya thā/ san dhā ra ṇi/ uta dhā ra ṇi/ su saṃ pra tiṣ+ṭha te/ su nā ma/ su pra tikhri te/ bi dza ya ba la/ sargyu pra ti tshwa/ su ā ro ha/ tshwa na pra ti/89—267

u'i da ni/ a ba nā ba ni/ a bhi ṣiñca ni/ a sgyi ba ya hā ra/ shu bha ba ti/su ni shri ta/ ba hu sum̐ bha/ a bhi ba dā ①gu hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu mngon par zhen pa med pa'i gzungs kyi tshig 'di la byang chub sems dpa' gang la la zhig rab tu gnas nas yang dag par 'dzin par byed na/ gang zag de ni bskal pa gcig gam/ bskal pa brgya'am/ bskal pa stong ngam/ bskal pa brgya stong gi bar du yang dag pa'i smon lam bskyed pa mthar thug pa med cing ral gri dang / dbyug ②pa dang / dug dang / chu dang / me dang / gcan gzan ma rungs pa rnams kyis de'i lus la gnod par ①byed mi nus par rig par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shā ri'i bu mngon par zhen pa med pa'i gzungs 'di ni 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi yum dang ske/ ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi yum dang /du da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi yum yin pas so/ /shā ri'i bu gang la la zhig gis grangs med pa bcu'i stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi ⑤khams rin po che yisna bdun gyis ⑦yongs su bkang ste de bzhin gshegs pa ⑧la phul nas bskal pa grangs med pa'i bar du na bza' dang / zhal zas mchog dam pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyi ⑨mchod pa byas ⑩pa bas/ gang la la zhig gis gzungs 'di ni 7tha na tshig gcig tsam yang dag par bzung ba 8las byung ba'i bsod nams gang yin pa de ches rab tu (nyamang ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shā ri'i bu mngon par zhen pa med pa'i gzungs shin tu zab pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi yum yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang / 'khor mang po rnams la 0de skad ces bka' stsal pa thos nas thams 89—268

cad rab tu dga' bar gyur pas thams cad kyis yongs su 'dzin par mos par ①gyur to/ /gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba mdo sde'i rgyal po las mngon par zhen pa med pa'i gzungs kyi le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ②'khor mang po'i nang du tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ khyod kyis 'di ltar shes par bya ste/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che zhes bya ba'i gzungs gnod pa thams cad ring du spong ba 'brug dang glog ma rungs pa thams cad 'gog cing 'jil bar byed pa yod de/de ni 'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs pa yin pas/ ngas kyang deng mdo sde 'di lha ③dang mi rnams la phan pa dang / 'jig rten la brtse ba dang / thams cad yongs su bsrungs nas bde ba 'thob rjopar bya ba'i phyir 'khor mang po khyed la yang dag par bstan par bya'o/ /de nas 'khor mang po dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos (gebacom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces dubaka' stsal pa thos pa dang / so so nas sems rtse gcig tu bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal du bltas ⑦nas rig sngags mnyan par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyed cag legs par nyon cig /'di nas shar phyogs na glog 'od snang ba'i rgyal po a ga ta ⑧zhes bya ba dang / lho phyogs na glog 'od snang ba'i rgyal po sha te ru zhes bya ba dang / nub phyogs na glog 'od snang ba'i rgyal po tsu te kwang zhes bya ba dang /byang phyogs na glog 'od snang ba'i rgyal po su ta ma 0ni zhes bya ba so so na ⑩yod de/rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis 7glog gi rgyal po 'di dag gi 89—269

ming thos shing phyogs shes par gyur na/ gang zag de 'jigs shing skrag pa'i dngos po thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur zhing glo ①bur gyi gnod pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te gang du gnas pa'i gnas der phyogs bzhi'i glog gi rgyal po 'di dag gi ming yi ger bris par gyur na gang du gnas pa'i gnas de dag tu 'brug dang glog gis 'jigs pa med cing gdon bgegs dang gnod pa'i sgrib pa ②med par 'gyur/ dus ma yin par glo ③bur du 'chi ba thams cad thag ring du spong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gzungs sngags bka' stsal pa/ tabya thā/ ni mi ni mi ni mirnya ri yin dre ste 0lo ka /lo ka ni/ shi ri sho la ba til/ ha rak+ṣa ha rak+ṣa/ bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba'i gnas 'dir 'jigs shing skrag pa thams cad dang / sdug bsngal thams cad kyis (phyina'atshe ba dang / 'brug dang / glog dang / thog 'bab pa dang /glo ⑦bur du nywa'achi bar 'gyur ba ji snyed pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig swā hā / de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang phyug 'khor mang po'i nang du 'dug pa'i ⑨snyan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig la gzar nas gus pas 7thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag (1kyang deng lha dang mi rnams la sman par bgyi ba dang / 'jig rten la brtse ba dang / thams cad yongs su bsrungs nas bde ba 'thob par bgyi ba dang / mthu chen po'i stobs dang ldan zhing lho smon pa rnams yid bzhin du 'grub par bgyi ba'i slad (/—)du bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i gzungs gang lags pa mdo tsam zhig bstan par bgyi'o/ /de nas gzungs sngags smras pa/ tabya thā/83—270

ka ṭi/ bi ka ṭi/ ni ka ṭi/ pra kyarji ke /pra t+ya mi tre①/ shurnye mustel/ bi ma le/ pra bhā swa re/ aṇ+ḍa re/ paṇ+ḍa re/ shwe te/ paṇ+ḍa ra bā si ni/ ha ri kuṇ+ḍa ri/ piṅga la/ a k+ṣi da dhi mu khi ②rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i gnas 'dir 'jigs shing skrag pa thams cad dang / sdug bsngal gyis rjo'atshe ba nas glo 2bur du 'chi ba'i bar thams cad 0bral bar gyur cig /bdag gis sdig pa'i dngos po ngan pa thams cad mi mthong stizhing rtag par byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi thugs rje chen po'i ⑧byin gyis brlabs ②kyis dgongs shing yongs su bsrung 4) bar gyur cig swā hā/de nas byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje gsang ba'i bdag po stan las langs te gus pas thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag yikyang deng lha dang mi rnams la sman pa cher bgyi ba dang / 'jig rten la 8brtse ba dang / thams cad yongs su bsrungs nas gzi byin chen po'i mthu dang ldan pa dang / smon pa rnams yid bzhin du 8'grub bar bgyi ba'i ched ④du mi pham 8pa zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs bshad par bgyi'o/ /de nas tsogazungs sngags smras pa/ tar+ya thā/ mu ni mu ni/ mu ni na dha ri/ mu ni ⑩ma ti ma ti/ su ma ti/ ma hā 8ma ti/ hā hā hā hā ma bha yarnyi ti pā pañca༄/badz+ra pā ṇi ā ha drwa bi ḍa zho nyes hā/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis gzungs sngags 'di ni mi pham par srung pyo steb zhes bgyi ste/ skyes pa'am bud med gang la la zhig sems rtse gcig tu yang dag par bzung ri sheste yi ger 'dri ba dang / klog pa dang /'don pa dang / mi bskyud cing rjes su dran par bgyid na bdag gdugs mtshan du de la yongs su bsrung zhu bar bgyid pas 'jigs shing skrag pa thams cad nas 83—271

glo ①bur du 'chi ba ②thams cad thag ring du spong bar 'gyur lags so/ /de nas mi mjed nikyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bdag po tshangs pa chen po stan las langs te/ gus pas thal mo sbyar nas 0bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la yang shin tu gya rnam pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs kyi gzungs 0lha dang mi rnams la rgya cher phan 'dogs pa/ 'jig rten la rab tu 'tshe ⑥ba thams cad yongs su srung ⑦bar bgyid pani/ gzi byin chen po'i mthu dang ldan pa/ smon pa rnams ⑨yid bzhin du 'grub par bgyid pa mchis te/ gzungs sngags de bshad par bgyi'o⑩/ /tabya thā/ nyi li mi li/tsi ⑩li swā hā/ brah+ma gu re swā hā/ brah+ma swa re swā hā/ brah+ma gi su gas/ put+pa saṃ sta 8re swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi 8gzungs 8'di ni tshangs pa'i chad pas bcad pa zhes bgyi ste gzungs 'di 'dzin pa dag la yongs su bsrung bar ⑫bgyid pas mya ngan gyis ⑩gnod pa dang / sdig pa'i las rnams 0thag ring du spong zhing / glo 8bur du 'chi ba'i bar yithams cad kyang yongs su spong bar ⑦bgyid do/ /de nas brgya byin lha'i dbang po stan las langs te gus pas thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces dugasol rtodu/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la yang badz+ra sha ni zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs rig sngags chen mo ( nye'ajigs shing skrag pa dang / gdon bgegs thams cad rab tu sel bshuste/ glo ⑫bur du 'chi ba'i bar ḍo 9thams cad thag ring du spong ba sdug bsngal las drangs zhu tenas bde ba stsol ba lha ( — dang mi rnams la sman par bgyid pa mchis te gzungs de bshad par bgyi'otsho 7/ /tabya thā/ ni ba rā ṇi/ brnya mā darnyi ma ti ti ti ti/gi rī garnya ri/ tsaṇ+ḍa li/ mā taṅgi / puk+ka si/ pa ra ṇa le hi na ma rgya ma dha ri 89—272

ṇi/ ma la ni/ da la ma da de/ tsa drwa bā khri/ sha ba ri sha ba ri dhiswā hā/ de nas lha'i rgyal po rnam thos dang / lha'i rgyal po yul 'khor srung ②dang / lha'i rgyal po 'phags skyes po dang / lha'i ②rgyal po mig mi bzang cig ④car stan las langs te gus pas thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to//bcom ldan 'das bdag dul yang sems can thams cad la mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs sdug bsngal gyis nyon mongs pa las rtag par yongs su bskyabs nas bde ba thob par bgyid pa tshe 'phel bar bgyid cing nad kyi sdug bsngal ma mchis par bgyid pa glo zhubur du 'chi ba'i bar tshuthams cad thag ring du spong bar bgyid pa dumachis te gzungs sngags de brjod par bgyi'o⑨/ /tabya thā/ saspre/ su puspe/ dhu ma ⑩pa ri hā 7re/ ār+ya pra sha ste shārnyi/ nirmu lte/me ga l+ya/ hi ra rgya gar+bhe stu te/ sta bi te 8swā hā/ de nas yang klu'i rgyal po chen po mang po 'di lta ste/ klu'i rgyal po nā ga 0si dang / klu'i rgyal po glog 'od dang / klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa dang / klu'i rgyal po glog 8rtse dang / klu'i rgyal po gya rnam 'od la sogs pa stan las langs te gus pas thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la yang yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs glog ma rungs pa 'gog par bgyid pa/ 'jigs 8shing skrag pa rnams rab tu sel ba/ lha dang mi rnams la rgya cher phan 'dogs pa/ 'jig rten la snying brtse ba thams cad yongs su skyob pa/ gzi byin chen po'i mthu dang ldan pa/ smon pa rnams yid bzhin du 'grub pa/ glo 7bur du ༅'chi ba'i bar 8thams cad thag ring du spong ba/dug thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyid pa/ byad stems /7dang / sngags dang /83—273

bkra mi shis pa'i dngos po thams cad yongs su sel bar bgyid pa mchis te/bdag cag gzungs sngags 'di bcom ldan 'das la 'bul na thugs rjes ①thugs brtse bar dgongs te/ bdag cag klu'i 'gro ba 'di dang bral nas ser sna'i 'dod pa gtan du spang ba'i slad du bzhes su gsol/ de ci'i phyir ②zhe na/ser sna'i 'dod pa 'di'i dbang gis 'khor ba na sdug bsngal mang po myong bar 'gyur ①bar/ bdag cag ser sna'i 'dod pa'i byas bon yongs su gcod ⑤par 'tshal lags so/ /de nas gzungs sngags smras pa/ tabya thā/ a tsa le/ a ma re/ a mṛ yite/ ak+ṣa ye/ a rnyi ye/ pu sbyi pa r+ya ba te⑦/ sarba pā paṃ pra sha mā ⑧ni ye swā hā/ ād+ma pu rgya so bā ki ⑨yi swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo ⑩la la zhig 7rig sngags 'di g.yar kha nas brjod par bgyid dam/ yi ger bris te glegs bam du bgyis nas 'chang zhing 'dzin par bgyid dam/ klog 8cing 'don par bgyid dam/ gus pas 'amachod par bgyid nang/ 'brug dang glog dang thog 8mi 'bab cing skrag pa dang 'jigs pa dang sdug bsngal gyis nyon mongs pa dang / mya ngan dang nad dang glo bur du 'chi ba'i bar tshethams cad thag ring du spong bar 'gyur/ dug dang byad stems ⑩dang mi la gnod pa lho)bgyid pa'i stag dang / seng ge dang / spyang ki dang /sbrul gdug pa rnams dang / sbrang ma dang / sbrang bu ⑩mchu rings 9 nyal sogs pas kyang gnod pa bgyid par mi 'gyur lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ḍa lha'akhor mang po rnams la bka' stsal pa legs so legs so/ /gzungs sngags 'di dag thams cad mthu chen po dang ldan pas sems can gyi mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du sems la bsam shu pa'i dngos po rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed/89—274

rgya cher phan 'dogs par byed do/ /sems rtse gcig tu ma byas pa ni ma gtogs sonyu/ /khyed cag the tsom ②ma za shigazhu /de nas 'khor mang po rnams bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa thos pa dang / rab tu dga' bas mngon par yid ches par gyur nas bka' yang dag par bzung dubar gyur to/ /gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba mdo sde'i rgyal po las yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i gzungs kyi le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //de nas lha mo spobs pa chen mo ⑤'khor mang po'i nang nas dustan las langs te bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag byas nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol tog/ /bcom ldan 'das chos dusmra ba'i mkhan po gang la la zhig gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di yang dag par ston par bgyid na/ bdag gis shes rab 'phel bar bgyis nas rgyan dang ldan pa'i tshig gis po)spobs pa phun sum 0tshogs par bgyid do/ /gal te chos smra ba'i mkhan po de mdo sde 'di'i ⑩tshig 'bru dang / yi ge dang / tshig gi don bskyud pa zhig tsomachis na yang thams cad rjes su 0dran zhing tsolegs par khong du chud par bgyis nas gzungs kyi kun 'dzin thogs pa ma mchis pa stsal bar bgyi'os/ /gzhan yang gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di sems can gang dag sangs rgyas brgya stong du ma las dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed nas yongs su 'dzin par bgyid pa de dag gis 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir rgya cher spel nas myur du nub par mi 'gyur zhing sems can tshad ma mchis pa snyed mdo sde 'di thos pa'i dbang gis thams cad shin tu myur ba'i spobs pa dang /83—275

bsam ①pa ma mchis pa'i shes rab chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa thos ②nas bstan bcos sna tshogs dang ⑧/ sgyu rtsal rnams la rab tu mkhas pa dang /'khor ba las myur du nges par byung nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bgyid do/ /tshe 'di nyid la yang tshe 'phel zhing 'tsho ba'i yo byad rnams phun sum tshogs par bgyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis mdo sde 'dzin pa'i chos kyi mkhan po de dag dang sems can gzhan gang byamado sde 'di mnyan par mos pa de dag gi ched du sman la ⑤sngags kyis btab nas khrus bgyi ba'i cho ga bshad par 'tshal te/ des de dag la gza' ma rungs pa ltas ngan ston pa ci mchis pa dang / dang po btsas pa'i gza' skar ⑥dang / phan tshun mi mthun par gyur pa dang / nad kyi sdug bsngal dang / 'thab pa dang / rtsod pa dang / g.yul 'gyed pa dang / mi lam ngan pa dang / gdon ⑦bgegs dang / byad stems dudang / dug dang /ngan du bgyis pa dang / sngags dang / ro langs dang / 'di lta bu la sogs pa'i sdig pa rnams kyi sgrib pa dang bgegs bgyid pa thams cad yongs su bsal ⑨nas rab tu zhi bar bgyid pas blo dang ldan pa rnams kyis khrus kyi cho ga 'di ltar bgyis te7/ des sman spos kyi ro dang ldan pa sum cu 7rtsa gnyis po 'di lta ste/shu dag gi'u wang 7dang ni spri ka spos/ /gla rtsi ba 8bla dag dang shi ④ri sha /yin dra hasta 6sha ma ka sha mi/ /thang chu dang ni shing tsha 7gla sgang dang / /a ga ⑦ru dang tsan+dan ta ka ra/ /sa la ki dang gur kum aha la sa7/ /na tra smig bcud su ki ma le ne rtedang / /thang shing pa tra dang ni on sha 8〉la/ /sa la ke rgyadang spra ba gu (stegul dang / /yungs kur 8stego snyod nā ga ge sa ra/ /sardza snyir sa ru rta 0cha mnyam 89—276

bgyi / /skar ma rgyal la gcig tu btags nas ni/ /spos kyi phye ma de dag rab blangs te/ /sngags 'dis lan brgya rtsa brgyad gdab par bgyi/ /sngags ni 'di lta ste/ tabya thā/ su te/ kṛ te/ ka ma ta li/ na le dza na kur te/ haṅka ra te/ in+d+ra dza li ni/ shaṃ ka ra dri/ pa shad dre/ a bsta ka /si ke na ku tra ku ka /kha ke ba bīḥ/ bi la ①ka bi la ma ti/ shī la ma ti/ shrī la ma ti/sarnyi dhu dhu ma ba ti / pa pang ku/ pardzi le/ shi ri sha ri/ sa6 sbri ti ②swā hā/gal te chos bzhin khrus ni bgyid 'tshal na/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi khru brgyad pa bgyis nas/ /rab tu dben zhing bde ba'i gnas dag tu/ /don gang sgrub pa sems la dran par bgyi/ /ba lang rtsi bas dkyil 'khor byugs nas ni/ /steng du me tog kun tu dgram dupar bgyig/ /gser dngul snod ni shin tu gtsang ma dag /ro mchog 'o ma sprang rtsis dgang bar ⑥bgyi/ /dkyil 'khor de yi sgo bzhi dag tu yang / /skyes bu bzhi zhig chos bzhin bsrung ⑦du stsal/ /gzhon nu bzhi zhig lus ni rab brgyan ninas/ /so sor grwa rer ⑨chab kyi bum pa thogs/ /der ni rtag par gu gul bsregs nas ni/ /dbyangs lnga'i rol mo rgyun mi 'chad ⑩par bgyi/ /dkyil 'khor de yi ngos bzhi dag tu yang / /ba dan gdugs dang lda ldis 7mdzes par bgyi/ /dkyil 'khor nang du me long gsal ba dang / /ral gri rnon po mda' bzhi gzhag /dzo nyapar bgyi/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su gzhong khung cher 0stsal nas/ /'dzeg pa'i shing leb de 8de yi steng du bzhag /snga ma'i phyi sam chab dang sbyar nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor de yi tsonang du gzhag ⑩par bgyi/ /de ltar bkram zhing 8rnam par bzhag 9/chenas ni/ /de nas sngags bzlas dkyil 'khor mtshams bcad 0 bgyi/ /mtshams bcad pa yi (383—277

sngags ni 'di lta ste/ / r+sābya the dan/ a ka ra ke /na ya ne/ nyi le mi le gi ①le / khi khi le swā hā/ de ltar mtshams ni rab bcad nas/ /dkyil 'khor nang du zhugs nas ni/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig chab bsngags ②te/ /phyogs bzhi dag tu gtor bar bgyi/ /de nas spos chab dag la ni/ /brgya rtsa brgyad tshang sngags btab ste༅/ /ngos bzhir yol bas bskor nas ni/ /de 'og lus ni bkru dubar bgyi / /chab dang spos chab la gdab pa'i sngags ni 'di lta ste/ /tabya thā/ sa ga ḍi bi ga ḍi/ bi ga ta ba ti ⑤su hā/ khrus bgyis lags nas khrus bgyis pa'i chab dang / dkyil 'khor gyi nang du mchod par phyobagyis pa'i bza' ba dang /btung ba ci mchis pa gtsang ༅po'am/ rdzing ⑧ga nang du dor bar bgyi zhing gzhan ni bsdu bar bgyi'o/ /de ltar khrus bgyis lags nas gos gtsang ma bgos te / dkyil 'khor nas phyir byung nas khang pa gtsang ma'i nang du zhugs te/sngags mkhan gyis de dag yi dam rgya chen po slad 6)du stsal nas sdig pa sna tshogs gtan du bcad cing dge ba sna tshogs rtag par spyad nas sems can rnams la snying rje chen po bskyed par bgyi ste/ rgyu dang rkyen des na yid bzhin gyi bsod nams kyi rnam par smin pa tshad ma mchis pa snyed thob par 'gyur lags so/ /yang tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ sems can gang zhig nad kyi sdug bsngal nyen / /sman spyad sna tshogs gsos 7kyang ma sos pa/ /khrus kyi cho ga 'di bzhin khrus bgyis te/ /gzhan yang mdo sde 'di ni klog bton nas/ /gdugs mtshan rtag par sems ni mi g.yeng bar/ /rtse gcig gus pas dang sems bskyed bgyid hustenas / /nad kyi sdug bsngal bas par zhi bar 'gyur/ /dbul phongs thar nas ⑫nor dang ldan par 'gyur/ /phyogs bzhi yi zhustegaza' skar nyi zla yi ④lha/ /mthu 89—278

yis rab bsrungs tshe ni ①ring bar 'gyur/ /bkra shis rab bde bsod nams yongs su 'phel②/ /ltas ngan gnod pa ①thams cad sel bar bgyidaX//de'i 'og tu lus bsrung ba'i ⑤sngags lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzla bar bgyi'o/ /sngags ni 'di lta ste/ tabya thā/ sa me/ bi sa me swā hā/ sa ga khe/ bi ga ḍi duswā hā/ ⑦sna ga ra saṃ bud dhā ༷ya swā hā/ skan dha mā 0tā ya ṭ+wā hā/ nī la /ce ⑩ya swā hā/ a pa rā dzi ta 0bir+sā 8ya swā hā/ nyi 0ma brnya saṃ bhu tā 8ya swā hā/a ni bi la ba'i tsoya swā hā/ na mo bha ga ba te/ brah+ma ṇi 8swā hā/ na maḥ0sa ra swa s+t+ya ma hā de bi ye 87 hā/ si skyo man+t+ra pa dā yiswā hā/ dha ra to/ bi tsi ta/braṅgā nu ma n+ya tu zhug hā/ de nas lha mo spobs pa chen mo 0khrus kyi cho ga dang /dkyil 'khor gyi sngags bshad nas dubacom ldan 'das kyi 0zhabs la phyag byas te bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong ngam④/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang la la zhig mdo sde'i rgyal po dam pa 'di len pa dang / 'dzin pa dang / klog pa dang /tsokha ton du 'don pa dang / yi ger bris nas spel ba dang / ji skad bstan pa bzhin du spyod par bgyid na/ grong khyer ram/ grong rdal lam/ 'brog dgon pa'am/ ri 'am/ nags tshal lam/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'i gnas gang yang rung ba dag tu gnas kyang rung ste/ bdag de'i ched du 'khor rnams dang lhan cig lha'i 'khor tsomo bgyis nas de'i thad du mchis te/ yongs su skyob pa dang bsrung ba 0bgyis nas nad kyi sdug bsngal dang / skar mda' ltung ba dang / ltas ngan dang / rims nad dang / 'thab cing rtsod pa rnams sel bar bgyid/ rgyal po'i khrims kyis gzung dub dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang /83—279

'dre srin ma rungs pas gnod par bgyid ①pa dang / byad stems ②thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyis nas/ mdo sde 'dzin pa'i gang zag dge slong la sogs pa'i 'khor dang / nyan pa'i 'khor rnams myur du 'khor ba'i ③rgya mtsho chen po las yongs su bzlas nas dubyang chub las ldog 0par mi 'gyur bar phan 'dogs par bgyid do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces yigasol pa gsan pa dang / lha mo spobs pa chen mo la/ lha mo khyod kyis sems can tshad med cing mtha' med pa dag la phan pa dang / bde bar ④bya ba'i ①ched du rig sngags de dag dang / spos chus khrus bya ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa yang dag par bshad pa legs so legs so zhes bsngags ⑨pa brjod nas khyod kyis mdo sde'i rgyal po mchog dam pa 'di bsrungs nas myur du nub par mi 'gyur zhing rtag par rgya cher gnas par 'gyur bar byos shig /de nas lha mo spobs pa chen mos bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos ⑩phyag byas nas rang gi stan la 'dug par gyur to/ /de nas bram ze koṇ+ḍi rgyas lho/chos kyi slob dpon gyis lung bstan pa bcom ldan 'das kyi byin gyis brlabs lho kyi mthus 'khor mang po'i mdun du lha mo spobs pa chen mo la mngon par bstod 7pa/ shes rab gsal tsodapa' spobs pa'i lha mo khyod/ /lha mi'i mchod pa dag gis mchod par 'os/ /grags pas 'jig rten kun du rgyas pas na/ /sems can thams cad re ba rdzogs par byed/ /ri rtse mthon po'i ⑫gnas mchog dag tu ni/ /rtswa 7bsdus khyim byas de na rab tu gnas/ /rgyun du rtswa bo'ajam mdun 3stenas gos byas te/ /rtag par rkang pa ya gcig bkug (1ste 'greng lha/ /lha 'khor mang po thams cad 'dus nas lhags(sto/ /thams cad rtse 89—280

gcig sems kyis khyod la bsngags/ /shes rab spobs pa ldan pa'i lha mo khyod/ /tshig snyan gya ①rnam thams cad sbyin par gyis②/ /de nas lha mo spobs pa chen mo des gsol ba btab pa mnyan nas gzungs sngags smras pa/ sār+ya the dan/ mu re tsi re/ a ba dze/ a ba dza ba til/ nyidu lebya/ midu le/ piṅga la ba ti/muṅga ṣe/ ma rī rtsu/ swa ma ti/ da sha ma ti/ a gyi ta ma gyi ta ra tsi/ ta ra tsa ba tidu/ tsi yitsi ri/ shi ri ⑦mi ri/ ma narnyi/ da ma khi/ ma rī rtsu/ ṅgā na pri ye/ lo ka dz+reṣ+ṭha/ lo ka ther+sā/ bi ra tse/ lo ka pri ya/ si pra te/gli ma mu khi/ shu tsi tsa ri/ a pra ti ha te/ a pra ti ha ta burnyi/ na mu tsi/ma hā na mu tsi/ ma hā de byi/ pra ti/ spyi hā/ na ma ska rā na ⑧bdag gi ming brjod/ ma ma bu / dra sha 7gyi burnyi/ a pra ti ha ta/ bha 0tu/ si bha me/bi shud 0tsi to/ shashā sho lo 8ka /mas bi dhi 8ka /ka pi ya dhi 8sho/ tabya thā/ma hā pra bhā be'/ hi li nyi li/ mi li mi li/ bi tsa ro⑩/ bi tsa to/ bi bu /bdag gi ming brjod/ ma ma bu / bi shurnyi/ bha ga bad traṃ/ be 0ba yaṃ/ spa ra sa t+ya/ ka ra de/ ke lca re/ ke yu ra ma ti/ ti 'ali mi li sa pa ya meyi / ma hā de bezhu/ bu sa t+ya na/ dharma sa t+ya/ saṃ gha sa s+t+ya na/ in+d+ra sa h+ye 0na/ ba ru ṇa sa h+ye dun/ ye lo kedu / sa t+ya sa h+ye ( sten/ te sha ma sa h+ye na/ sati bad tsa ni gis/ a ba liha ya zhu rtemi/ ma hā de bedu/ hi li mi li/ hi li mi li/phyo bi tsi da zhunye to/ bdag gi ming brjod/ ma ma bu du/ na mo bha ()ba ti/ ma hā de be sa ra sa t+ya si skyo (seman+t+ra pa dā ni dunaswā hā/ de nas lha mo spobs pa chen mos gzungs sngags 'di bstan nas bram ze de la 'di skad ces kye tsoskyes bu chen po sems can rnams kyi ched du spobs pa gya nom pa dang / rin po 89—281

che dang / rdzu 'phrul dang / shes rab yongs su gnyer nas thams cad la rgya cher phan btags te myur du byang chub mngon du byed par 'dod pa legs so legs so/ /de ltar shes par byas nas cho ga 'di gzung bar bya'o/ /zhes smras nas yang tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ thog ma nyukho nar gzungs 'di kha ton du/ /byang zhing nor ba ②med par bklags ②nas ni/ /byin gyis rlob cing smon pa rdzogs bya'i phyir/ /dkon mchog gsum dang lha rnams skyabs 'gro zhing / /sangs rgyas chos dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rang rgyal nyan thos tshogs la gus phyag byas0/ /de 'og tshangs dang brgya byin lha dbang ⑤dang / /'jig rten skyong dang rgyal ༷po chen po bzhisaX/ /rtag par tshangs par spyod pa thams cad la/ /rtse gcig yid kyis ⑧gas par phyag byas nas/ /dgon pa rab tu dben pa'i gnas dag tu/ /skad cher snga ma'i sngags dang cho ga gdon⑨/ /sangs rgyas sku gzugs lha klu'i ⑩mdun dag tu/ /ji tsam 'byor bas mchod pa bsgrub par bya/ /sems can rnam pa de dag thams cad la/ /byams dang snying rjes brtse ba'i sems kyang bskyed/ /bcom ldan gser sku shin tu gya rnam mtshan/ /g.yeng ba med sems rtse gcig dran par bya/ /bcom ldan yang dag chos ston tīdagongs mdzad pas/ /dbang po ji bzhin ting 'dzin sgom la 'god/ /de yi tshig gi don ni legs soms la/ /stong pa nyid brten borab tu bsgom 8par gyisatso/ /bcom ldan sku gzugs dag gi spyan sngar ni/ /rtse gcig yang dag dran pas gnas byed na/ /gya rnam ye shes ting nge 'dzin dag dang / /gzungs mchog dam pa dag kyang 'thob par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan gser zhal yang dag chos bstan nas/ /gya nom dbyangs kyis lha mi 'dul bar mdzad/ /ljags 89—282

mtshan rkyen bzhin ngo mtshar rab ston pas/ /yangs ring ⑦stong gsum 'jig rten khyab par mdzad/ /bcom ldan gsung dbyangs gya rnam de 'dra ba/ /rtse gcig dran na sems la 'jigs med 'thob/ /bcom ldan smon lam rgya chen btab pa'i dbang / /ljags ②mtshan bsam gyis mi khyab 'di brnyes ③nas/ /chos rnams yod pa ma yin gsung dumadzad pas/ /dper na nam mkha' chags pa med pa 'dra/ /bcom ldan gsung dbyangs dag dang ljags mtshan rnams/ /dran pa nye gzhag gzhal byed ⑤smon rdzogs 'gyur/ /gal te lha mo spobs chen mchod dumathong ngam/ /slob mas slob dpon rjes slob mthong nas ni/ /gsang ba'i cho ga 'di blangs sgom byed dam/ /bla mar byed na sems la bsam ⑦pa 'grub/ /gang zhig ye shes dam pa mchog 'dod na/ /rtse gcig sems kyis chos 'di gzung bar bya/ /bsod nams ye shes yon tan 'phel byed pas/ /nges par 'grub 'gyur the tsom duyongs ma bskyed⑨/ /nor tshol dag ni nor mang rnyed ⑩par 'gyur/ /grags pa gnyer ba grags chen thob par 'gyur/ /nges 'byung tshol ba rnam par grol 'gyur bas/ /nges par 'grub 'gyur the tsom ⑪yongs ma bskyed8/ /yon tan tshad med mtha' las 'ji snyed pa/ /sems la bsams bzhin yongs su sdud par byed/ /gal te de ltar chos bzhin spyod nus na/ /nges par 'grub 'gyur the tsom ④yongs ma bskyed8/ /gtsang ma'i gnas su gos sar ⑩bgos nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor che chung ci 7tsam nus par bya/ /bum pa gtsang ma bzhir ni ro zhim bkang 43/ /me tog pog spos ci 'byor mchod par bya/ /lda ldi ba dan dag dang gdugs bres yite/ /byug spos phye ma kun du khyab brgyan du nas/ /sangs rgyas lha mo spobs chen mchod ( nyebyed na/ /lha lus 89—283

mthong bar 'dod na'ang 0smon bzhin 'grub/ /lha mo spobs chen mdun du snga ma'i sngags/ /zhag ni nyi shu rtsa gcig gdon ②par bya/ /gal te lha de mthong bar ma gyur na/ /rtse gcig sems kyis zhag dgu ②dran par byedaX/ /nam gyi cha smad ⑤'on kyang ma mthong na/ /gnas gtsang dam pa gzhan dag btsal nas ni/ /lha mo spobs chen gzugs ni rab bris te/ /mchod gnas bzlas brjod sems kyis mi btang zhing / / gnyid dang le lo dusems ni mi bskyed ⑦na/ /bdag dang gzhan la phan 'dogs mthar thug med/ /rnam smin gang thob skye dgu smin byed na/ /smon pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ /gal te yid bzhin ma grub zla ba gsum/ /yang na drug dang dgu dang lo gcig par/ /rab brtson gsol 'debs sems ni mi g.yo na/ /lha yi mig dang gzhan sems shes thob 'gyur/ /de nas bram ze kauṇ+ḍi ⑧rgyas de skad ces bstan pa thos pa dang /dga' mgu ⑨rangs shing ngo mtshar du gyur pas 0'khor mang po rnams ⑩'di skad ces kye tsunyekhyed cag lha dang mi'i (nye'akhor mang po thams cad shes par byos la/sems rtse gcig tu deng bdag gis kun rdzob kyi bden pa'i chos la brten nas lha mo spobs pa mchog dam pa de dag la bsngags 0pa brjod pa nyon cig /ces smras nas tshigs su bcad 8de smras pa/ 'jig rten dag na ⑩dbang phyug thob 'gyur babo/ /lha mo mthu chen thob la gus phyag 'tshal/ /deng bdag gtso mo de la bsngags pa yang / sngon gyi drang srong ji skad bstan pa bzhin/ /bkra shes yongs rdzogs sems ni bde bar gnas/ /sems gsal ngo tsha khrel yod 8grags dang ldan/ /ma ma byas te 'jig rten rab tu bskyed/ /rab dpa' rtag par brtson 'grus chen po spyod/ /thab 17mo'i g.yul du rtag par rgyun du rgyal/ /rab 89—284

dul byams sems bzod pa gsol bar byed/ /da ①ltar gshin rje'i sring mo chen mor gyur/ /gos su rtag par dar tshon sngon po gyon/ /sdug dang mi sdug byad bzhin kun dang ldan/ /mig ni mthong ba thams cad rab tu dngang ②/ /spyod mchog dam pa tshad med 'jig rten 'das/ /phyogs shing mngon dang mi kun yongs su sdud/ /res 'ga' ri brag zab mo dag na gnas/ /res 'ga' brag phug gtsang ③po'i 'gram na gnas/ /res 'ga' ljon shing nags tshal chen por gnas/ /lha mo phal cher de dudag kun du gnas/ /ri dang nags tshal mi rgod ji snyed pa/ /rtag par lha mo la ni mchod par byed/ /rma bya'i sgros ni rgyal mtshan ba dan byed/ /dus so cog ⑤tu rtag par 'jig rten skyong / /stag rjodang seng ge spyang kyis ④rgyun du bskor/ /gnag lug bya la sogs pas rten yang 'cha'/ /dril chen bsgrags nas sgra ni phyung bas na/ / bin dha'i duri la sgra ni kun du gragasasti/ /res 'ga' rtse gsum tri shul ⑩thogs byed cing / /g.yas g.yon rgyun du nyi zla ru mtshon 'dzin/ /zla ba nag po'i tshes yidagu bcu gcig la//de yi dus su rtag par mchod par bya/ / res 'ga' 8ba su lha chen sring mor ston/ /g.yul 'gyed mthong na rtag par snying yang brtse/ /sems can thams cad rnam par lta ba la/ /lha mo mchog tu gyur pas bdas 8pa med/ /res 'ga' ba rdzi'i ④bu mo dga' mor ston/ /lha dang 'thab tshe rtag par rgyal ba 'thob / /'jig rten dag na yun ring 8gnas par byed/ /rab dul bzod dang khro gtum ston par byed/ /bram ze chen po rig pa'i chos bzhi dang / /sgyu 'phrul sngags sogs thams cad rab tu rtogs/ /drang srong nang na rang dbang dag dang ldan/ /sa bon dang ni sa chen byed par nus/ /lha mo tsobu mo la 83—285

sogs 'dus pa'i tshe/ /rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar nges par der yang 'du/ /klu dang gnod sbyin mang po'i tshogs kun gyi/ /gtso bor gyur pas rab tu dul bar byed / /bud med nang na tshangs spyod mchog dang ldan/ /tshig byung dper na 'jig rten bdag po 'dra/ /rgyal po'i ①gnas na pad+ma dag dang ②mtshungs/ /chu bo'i 'gram na duganas tshe gru zab ④bzhin/ /byad bzhin sdug mdzes zla ba nya ba 'dra/ /mang thos phun tshogs gnas dang rten ⑤yang byed/ /spobs pa mchog byung ri rtse mthon po 'dra/ /dran pa thams cad kun gyi gling yang byed/ /lha ma yin la sogs te lha tshogs rnams/ /thams cad 'di yi yon tan bsngags par byed/ /mig 0stong brgya byin lha yi ⑦dbang pos kyang / /gus pa'i sems kyis lta zhing rab tu rtog /sems can gang zhig re zhing tshol ba yod/ /de dag thams cad myur du 'grub par byed/ /yid myur spobs dang chos 'dzin ldan byed pas/ /sa chen steng na mchog tu gyur pa yin/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams ni 'di dag tu/ /mar me che ltar rtag par kun gsal byed/ /tha na lha 'dre gcan gzan dag la yang / /de dag ⑧bsams bzhin thams cad rdzogs byed 'gyur/ /bud med rnams kyi nang na ri rtse 'dra/ /sngon gyi drang srong ji bzhin yun ring gnas/ /lha mo gzhon nu ji bzhin 'dod chags spangasal/ /'jig rten bdag po ji ⑩bzhin bden tshig smra/ /'jig rten kun 7gyi khyad par rgyan ⑩rnams dang / /'dod khams lha yi khang pa kun bltas nati/ /lha mo 'ba' zhig chagatso mor grags pas 7na/ /sems can mchog tu gyur pa yongs ⑩mi snang //gal te g.yul 'gyed 'jigs pa'i ho)gnas dag dang / /me dong lhung tu)ba bdag tunyeni mthong bar gyurang nya/ /chu bo nyam nga chom rkun 'jigs pa'i tshe/ /'jigs pa 89—286

de dag thams cad sel bar nus/ /gal te rgyal po'i khrims kyis bcings bsgrogs ①sam/ /gal te sha chags gsod ②par byed pa'i tshe/ /sems ni rtse gcig mi g.yo gnas gyur na/ /nges par mya ngan sdug bsngal kun las thar /dge sdig mi kun yongs su skyob pas dun/ /byams dang snying rje'i dubartse ba rtag mngon ⑤snang / /de phyir bdag ni bsam pa rtse gcig tu/ /lha mo che la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ /de nas bram ze des sngags dang / bsngags pa brjod pa'i tshig gis lha mo de la mngon par bstod pa/ 'jig rten gtso la phyag 'tshal dugus phyag 'tshal/ /mi ⑦rnams nang na kun gyi mchog gyur pas/ /'jig rten gsum po thams cad khyod la mchod/ /byad bzhin rab mdzes kun gyis blta ⑧bar mos/ /yon tan rnam ⑨pa sna tshogs lus rab brgyan⑩/ /mig yangs ⑪pad+ma sngon po'i 'dab 8ma 'dra/ /bsod nams ye shes snang ba'i grags pas rgyas/ /dper na rin thang med pa'i nor bu mtshungs/ /deng bdag dam pa khyod la bsngags pas na8/ /sems la bsam ④pa thams cad 'grub ⑩par 'gyur/ /yang dag yon tan bkra shis gya rnam pa/ /pad+ma lta bur shin tu rnam par dag /lus mdog rab mdzes kun gyis blta tsobar mos/ /mtshan mang 0ngo mtshar bsam gyis yang 8mi khyabatso/ /dri med ye shes 'od zer rab 'gyed pas/ /dran pas ⑥ kun gyi nang na mchog tu gyur/ /ji ltar seng ge gcan gzan mchog gyur ltar/ /rtag par lag pa brgyad kyis bdag nyid brgyan 0/ /so sor mda' gzhu ral gri sta re dang / /tho rings du gelcags kyi soge'akhor lo zhags pa thogs/ /rab mdzes lha mo zla ba nya ba 'dra/ /tshig la thogs med dbyangs snyan 'byin par byed/ /sems can gang zhig sems la smon yod na/ /skyes bu dam pas 89—287

bsams bzhin rdzogs par byed/ /brgya byin lha mang kun gyis khyod mchod nas/ /thams cad bsngags brjod skyabs su 'gro bar byed/ /bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan skyed ①byed pas/ /dus rnams rtag ②tu gus pa skyed ②par byed swā hā/ /gal te spobs chen lha mo gsol 'dod na/ /bsngags dubastod tshig ni 'di las 'byung ba bzhin⑤/ /nang par rnam dag sems kyis rtse gcig gdonaX/ /bsam pa'i dngos po thams cad bsams bzhin 'grub/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bram ze de mel khyod kyis sems can rnams la phan gdags ⑧shing bde ba sbyin pa'i ched du/ lha mo de la bsngags ⑨pa brjod pas ⑩byin gyis rlob par gsol ba btab nas7/ bsod nams dpag tu med pa 'thob ⑩par 'gyur ba legs so legs so /3zhes bka' stsal to// //gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba ④mdo sde'i rgyal potshu/ bam po brgyad pa/ de nas bram ze kauṇ+ḍi ⑩rgyas gong du bstan pa de ⑩lta bu'i mngon par bstod pa'i tshig dang / sngags kyi tshig gis lha mo spobs pa chen mo la mngon par bstod nas 'khor mang po rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyed cag lha mo spobs pa chen mo la gsol ba btab nas snying brtse bas 'byin gyis brlabs nas tshe 'di nyid la thogs pa med pa'i sems myur ba dang / ye shes chen po dang /tshig la shin tu mkhas pa dang / shes pa rgya chen po 'thob rka/)pa dang / 'bel ba'i gtam gyis 3)phan tshun lan 'debs pa dang / tshig 'bru'i rgyan yid bzhin du grub nas thogs pa med par 'dod na sems rtse gcig tu gus pas 'di ltar gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs 89—288
