dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / nyan thos dang / 'phags pa thams cad dang /'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas yang dag pa'i bden tshig mngon par grub pa dang ①/ dbang po ji lta ba bzhin du yang dag pa'i bden tshig gsung ba/ mi slu ba'i ④tshig gsung ba/ bskal pa chen po bye ba tshad med pa snyed du rtag par yang dag pa'i bden tshig gsung zhing / yang dag pa'i bden tshig dang ldan ①pa thams cad la rjes su yi rangs dunas phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi bden pa'i tshig mi gsung ba'i ⑤phyir yangs shing ring ba'i ljags phyung nas ༷nyid kyi zhal dang / 'dzam bu'i gling dang gling bzhi pa medang stong dang stong gnyis pa nidang / stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams dang / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams bsam gyis mi khyab pa thams cad 0kun tu khyab par g.yogs nas nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba thams cad rab tu sel bar mdzad pa la 0gus par ⑩phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas ljags kyi mtshan de lta bu dang ldan pa thams cad la gus par phyag byas tsonas bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba shin tu gya rnam pa'i spobs pa thams cad (snyedang ldan par smon nas sems rtse gcig tu srog phrogs 8so/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi spobs pa dam pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i spobs pa dam 8pa dang / /rang rgyal 'phags pa'i spobs pa dam pa yidang / /zhugs bzhi ⑩'bras bzhi'i spobs pa dam pa dang / /'phags pa'i bden 8pa'i tshig gi 0spobs zhu mchog pu rnyedang / /drang srong lha yi ( )spobs pa dam pa dang / /tshangs 'khor drang srong spobs pa dam pa ( shedang / /lha chen u (stema'i spobs pa dam pa dang / / skal ldan lha yi so spobs pa dam pa dang / /rgyal po ma na si yi (9spobs ⑦mchog dang / /yid bzhin lha mo'i (nyaspobs pa dam pa dang / /rgyal 83—289

chen bzhi yi 0spobs pa dam pa dang / /rab gnas lha yi bu yi zhuspobs mchog ⑧dang / /rdo rje dugasang ba'i bdag po'i spobs ⑤mchog dang / /khyab 'jug lha yi duspobs pa dam pa dang / /lha mo bi ⑦ma'i spobs pa dam pa dang / / birgyu'i lha mo'i 0spobs pa dam pa dang / lha mo bzang mo'i spobs pa dam pa dang / /shi ri ma ta'i 0spobs pa dam pa dang / /ha ri tshig gi spobs pa dam pa dang / /ma dang ma chen spobs pa dam pa dang / /ha ri ta ma'i 0spobs pa yidam pa dang / /gnod sbyin rnams kyi spobs pa dam pa 8dang / /phyogs bcu'i rgyal po'i tispobs la 0gus phyag 'tshal/ /las mchog ci mnga' thams cad bdag bstangs 8nas/ /spobs mchog dam pa mtha' med 'thob ⑩par shog /bslu ⑩ba med la gus phyag 'tshal/ /rnam par grol la gus phyag 'tshal/ /'dod chags spangs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /'ching sgrib spangs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /rnam dag sems la gus phyag 'tshal / /'od dang ldan la gus phyag 'tshal/ /bden tshig smra la gus phyag 'tshal / /rdul chags 8med la gus phyag 'tshal/ /don mchog gnas la gus phyag 'tshal/ /'khor mang dag yil gus phyag 'tshal/ /spobs pa'i lha la gus phyag 'tshal/ /bdag gi 0tshig la thogs med shog /bdag gis smon cing gnyer ba'i dngos/ /thams cad myur du grub par shog /nad med rtag tu rab bde zhing / /tshe ring lo nur 'thob par shog /rig 0sngags kun la rab mkhas shing | /nan tan byang chub lam bsgoms zhunas/ /skye dgu rgya cher phan btags te/ /bsam pa myur du grub snyipar smon/ /bdag gis bden tshig smras pa dang / /bdag gis bslu 59med smras pa yisas/ /lha mo'i spobs pa gang yin pa/ /bdag la grub par mdzad du gsol/ /lha mo khyod ni 'dir gshegs te/ /tshig ⑩thogs 89—290

ma mchis bgyi slad du/ /bdag lus khar ni myur zhugs nas/ /yid myur spobs dang ldan par mdzod/ /bdag gi lalce yi dbang po yis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i spobs thob nas②/ /tshig de'i mthu stobs dbang gis ni/ /sems can rnams ni 'dul bar shog /bdag ni tshig dag smras pa'i tshe/ /don ni ji ①bzhin grub gyur cig /thos pa dag ni gus bskyed ④nas/ /byas pa chud gson ⑤ma gyur cig /bdag gis spobs pa gnyer ba yidu/ /dngos po gal te ma grub na/ /lha mo'i bden tshig gang yin pa/ /thams cad brdzun ⑦pa nyid du 'gyur/ /gang dugis mtshams med sdig byas pa/ /sangs rgyas gsung khyagis 'dul bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin dgra bcom gang yin dang / /drin gzo'i ⑩tshig ni ji snyed dang / /shā 7ri'i bu dang mod gal 8bu/ /bcom ldan 'khor mang mchog gyur pa/ /'di la sogs pa'i bden tshig rnams/ /thams cad bdag la grub par mdzod8/ /deng bdag sangs rgyas nyan thos 'khor/ /thams cad 'dir ni spyan 'dren na/ /thams cad myur du 'dir gshegs te/ /bdag gi smon pa rdzogs mdzad smon/ /yang dag bden tshig gang gnyer ba/ /thams cad bslu ba ma mchis smon8/ /gong du 'og min lha man chad/ /gnas gtsang ris ⑫kyi lha dag yidang / /tshangs chen tshangs lha nye phan dang / /tshangs pa'i rgyal po'i ⑩'khor rnams dang / /stong gsum 'jig rten kun khyab dang / /mi mjed 'jig rten bdag po dang / /'khor ni mang po thams cad kun/ /deng bdag thams cad spyan 'dren na/ /byams dang thugs rje rab bskyed de/ /thams cad brtse bas gzung du gsol/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed lha rnams dang / /'phrul dga'i lha ni de dag dang / /dga' ldan pa yi lha tshogs dang / /byams pa 89—291

mngon par rdzogs 'gyur dang / /'thab bral ba yi lha rnams dang / /sum cu ①rtsa gsum lha dag dang / /rgyal chen ris bzhi'i ②lha tshogs dang / /lha mang 'khor ni thams cad dang / /sa chu me rlung lha rnams dang / /ri rab brten ③nas gnas pa dang / /mtsho bdun ri yi lha tshogs rnams/ /'khor ni mang por rjobacas pa dang / /nor rgyas dang ni mgo lnga dang / /nyi zla gza' skar lha dag dang / /'di la (shesogs pa'i ⑦lha mang po/ /'jig rten bde bar byed pas na/ /'di la ⑦sogs pa'i lha mang po/ /sdig pa'i las ni mi byed ⑧mes/ /sangs rgyas gus pa 'phrog ma dang / /de yi bu sdug tha chungs khyadang / /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / /dri za dang ni lha ma yin/ /mi 'am ci yi ⑩'khor rnams dang / /lto 'phye 7chen po la sogs pa/ /bdag ni bcom ldan mthu stobs kyis/ /de dag thams cad spyan 'dren na/ /byams dang snying rje'i sems bskyed nas/ /bdag la thogs med spobs pa 455/ /lha dang mi yi 8'khor rnams las/ /gzhan gyi sems ni rig gyur pa/ /thams cad byin gyis brlabs nas 7ni/ /bdag la spobs ④pa dam pa stsol/ /nam mkha'i khams ni mthar thug dang / /chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa na/ /sems can rnam pa ji snyed pas/ /bdag la spobs pa dam pa stsol/ /de nas lha mo spobs pa chen mos de skad ces chagasol ba btab pa thos pa dang bram ze de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye skyes bu chen po legs so/ /skyes pa'am/ bud med gang ⑩la la zhig sngags de dang / sngags kyi mngon 1 tshopar bstod pa de dag la brten nas sngar gong du bstan pa bzhin du cho ga 1 yang dag par blangs te/ dkon mchog gsum la gus pas skyabs su 'gro zhing sems rtse gcig tu dran pa nye bar 'jog par byed na ci dang ci bsgrubs pa 89—292

thams cad chud za bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang gser 'od dam pa ①shin tu gya nom pa'i mdo sde 'di yang dag par bzung ste/ klog cing 'don par byed na smon pa thams cad 'bras bu dang ldan par 'gyur zhing myur du mngon par 'grub par 'gyur te/ sems rtse gcig tu ma byas pa ni ②ma gtogs so/ /de'i tshe bram ze de shin tu dang ba'i sems kyis rab tu dga' bar gyur pas thal mo sbyar nas ④spyi bos yang dag par blangs par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha mo spobs pa chen mo la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi lha mo khyod kyis mdo sde'i rgyal po dam pa 'di rgya cher spel nas mdo sde yang dag par 'dzin pa dag la yongs su skyob pa dang / yongs su bsrung ba dubyas pa dang / sems can thams cad la phan gdags shing bde ba thob ⑤par bya ba'i ched du chos de lta bu bstan nas yibasam gyis mi khyab pa'i spobs pa byin te/ bsod nams tshad med pa thob par gyur pa dang / sems bskyed pa rnams 0myur du byang chub la dugazhol bar byas pa legs so legs so/ /gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba ⑨mdo sde'i rgyal po las lha mo spobs pa chen mo'i le'u ste bcwa (3 lnga pa'o// //de nas dpal gyi lha mo chen mo tunyestan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag byas nas gus pas thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'amadzo dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang tunyel la zhig gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di len pa dang / 'dzin pa dang /klog pa dang / 'don pa dang / gzhan dag la yang dag par ston par bgyid 83—293

pa zhig mthong bar gyur na bdag gis ①sems rtse gcig tu gus pas bkur sti dang mchod pa ②bgyid do/ /chos smra ba de nil 'di lta ste/ bza' ba dang /btung ba dang / gos dang / mal cha dang / gsos sman dang / yo byad ci 'tshal ba thams cad phun sum tshogs par sbyar te brel cing duphongs pa ma mchis par bgyid do/ /gdugs mtshan du mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di'i tshig gi don ji snyed pa dag la so sor brtags te/ yid la bsams shing yongs su btsal rgyanas bde bar gnas pa dang / mdo sde 'di 'dzam bu'i gling du rgya cher spel ba'i slad du sems can gang la la dag sangs rgyas ⑥brgya stong tshad ma mchis pa snyed ⑦las dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed ⑧pa de dag rtag 7tu thos par 'gyur zhing / myur du nub par mi 'gyur bar bgyid na bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong tshad ma mchis pa snyed du lha dang mi'i longs spyod mchog ⑩rnam pa sna tshogs myong bar 'gyur lags sol/ /rtag par lo legs shing mu ge'i rgud pa gtan du sel bar 'gyur bas ⑩skye bo rnams gtan du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang mjal 8bar 'gyur/ slad ma'i dus kyi tshe myur du byang chub chen po'i 'bras bu 'thob par 'gyur bas ngan 'gro gsum dang / 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi bgegs gtan du gcod par 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag mngon par 'dran lags te/ 'das pa'i dus kyi tshe de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas be+e ḍūr+ya tsodang gser gyi ri bo rin po che'i me tog snang ba dpal gyi yon tan rgya mtsho zhes bgyi ba mtshan rnam pa bcu dang ldan pa zhig byung ste bdag de las dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun 7te/ de bzhin gshegs pa des byams pa dang thugs rje'i byin gyis brlabs ⑩kyi mthus brtse bar 89—294

dgongs par gyur pa'i slad du deng bdag gang du bsams pa'i gnas de dang /gang du bltas ①pa'i phyogs de dang gang du mchis pa'i yul de dang de dag tu sems can bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong tshad ma mchis pa snyed shin tu bde ba'i longs spyod myong zhing gos dang / bza' ba dang / btung ba dang / 'tsho ba'i yo byad dang / gser dang / dngul dang / bai ḍūr+ya ②dang / spug dang /rdo'i snying po dang / byi ①ru dang / 'gron ④bu dang / mu tig la sogs pa rin po che ci 'tshal ba thams cad phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba ⑤lags so/ /gang la la zhig sems rtse gcig tu gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di klog cing 0'don pa des gdugs gcig ⑦bzhin du spos sna tshogs bsregs nas me tog dam pa rnams kyis bdag gi ched du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas be+e ḍūr+ya dudang /gser gyi ri bam̐ rin po che'i me tog snang ba dpal gyi yon tan rgya mtsho de la mchod pa ⑨bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang gdugs gcig ⑩bzhin du dus gsum du bdag gi ming nas brjod cing rjes su dran par bgyis nas logs shig tu spos dang / me tog dang / zas mchog rnams kyis bdag la thumachod cing rtag par mdo sde'i rgyal po dam pa 8'di nyan 8par bgyid na bsod nams 'di lta bu dag 'thob par 'gyur lags so/ /de nas tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ 'di ltar mdo sde 'di ni 'dzin pa'i slad/ /bdag dang 'khor rnams gnod pa kun dang 'bralas/ /gos zas ci 'tshal phongs (gepa ma mchis 'gyur/ /gzi byin ldan zhing tshe yang dpag par dka'/ / sa yi tiro yang rtag par ⑩'phel bar 'gyur/ /lha rnams dus bzhin char ni rab tu 'bebs/ /lha 'khor de dag rab tu dga' 83—295

bar 'gyur/ /skyed ①mos tshal dang 'bru yi lha rnams kyis/ /nags tshal ljon shing 'bras bu rab 'phel zhing / /'bru rnams thams cad yongs su smin par bgyid / /rin chen nor tshol bsam pa rdzogs 'gyur zhing / /ci dang ci smon bsams ②bzhin 'grub par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dpal gyi lha mo la bka' stsal pa/ khyod kyis 'di ltar sngon ③gyi rgyud rjes su dran nas drin rjes su bsab 0pa'i phyir mchod pa byas pa dang / mtha' yas pa'i dusems can rnams la phan gdags shing bde bar bya ba'i ched du mdo sde 'di yongs su spel nas yon tan zad mi shes par byas pa legs so legs so/ /gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba mdo sde'i rgyal po las dpal gyi lha mo chen mo'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das la dpal gyi lha mo chen mos yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang phyogs na lha'i rgyal po rnam thos kyi bu'i grong khyer nor ldan zhes bgyi ba mchis te/ grong khyer de las mi ring ba na me tog dam pa'i bsod nams kyi 'od ces bgyi ba'i kun dga' ra ba mchis pa de na gzhal med khang mchog dam pa rin po che sna bdun las mngon par grub pa zhig mchis te/bcom ldan 'das bdag ni rtag par de na gnas lags pas gang la la zhig 'bru rnam pa lnga gdugs gcig bzhin du 'phel ba dang / bang mdzod ༅rnams rgyas shing gang bar 97'tshal bas gus pas dang ba'i sems bskyed de khang pa gcig gtsang mar byas 9nyanas ba lang gi lci bas dog sa la zhal zhal bgyis te/ bdag gi gzugs rgyan rnam pa sna tshogs kyis rab tu brgyan pa ri mor bris nas lus ⑨89—296

legs par bkrus te/ gos gtsang ma bgos nas byug ①pa dam pas labyugs te khang pa gtsang ma'i nang du zhugs te①/ bdag gi ched du gdugs re zhing rjodus gsum du sangs rgyas de'i mtshan dang / mdo sde ⑤'di'i mtshan nas dubarjod par sems bskyed de de bzhin gshegs pa be+e ḍūr+ya ⑦dang gser gyi ri bo rin po che'i ⑧me tog snang ba dpal gyi ⑨yon tan rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod nas me tog dang spos rnams thogs te/ zhal zas bda' 0ba sna tshogs sems rtse gcig tu dbul bar bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang spos dang me tog dang bza' ba dang btung ba rnams kyis bdag gi gzugs brnyan tshul mchod par bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang bza' ba dang btung ba dag thogs te/ phyogs gzhan du gtor nas 'dre srin rnams la stsal bar bgyi'o⑩/ /yang dag pa'i hubaden tshig gis dpal gyi lha mo chen mo la gsol ba btab nas ci dang ci gnyer ba'i smon lam gdab par bgyi'o/ /gal te ji skad smras pa bzhin du brdzun pa ma lags na gsol ba btab pa don dang ldan par mdzad du gsol zhes brjod par bgyi'o/ /de'i tshe dpal gyi lha mos dngos po de (sterig nas brtse ba'i sems ⑩skye bar 'gyur bas de'i khyim du nor dang 'bru rnams rab tu 'phel bar bgyid do/ /de nas sngags bzlas nas bdag g.yar drang bar bgyis te/ sngar sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang byang chub sems dpa'i ming nas brjod de sems rtse gcig tu gus pas phyag bgyi'o/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug phud 0la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dri ma med pa'i 'od zer rin po che'i tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gser tog 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gser brgya'i 'od kyi snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /89—297

sangs rgyas gser gdugs 4①rin po che brtsegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo sangs rgyas gser gyi me tog 'od zer rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas sgron ma chen po'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rin po che chen po'i tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar phyogs kyi sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal pho lho phyogs kyi sangs rgyas rin chen tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub phyogs kyi sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang phyogs kyi sangs rgyas lha'i rnga sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mdzes pa'i tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gser 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gser mdzod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ②bshums la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' shin tu bde bar gnas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar sangs rgyas dang ①byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gus par ༅phyag bgyis nas de'i rjes la sngags bzlas te/ dpal gyi lha mo chen mo bdag g.yar 'dren par bgyid na ⑤sngags 'di'i mthus yongs su gnyer ba'i dngos po rnams thams cad mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ro༅/ /dpal gyi lha mo chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngags ni 'di lta ste/ sār+ya the dan/ pra ti pur+ṇa tsa re/ sa man+ta dar+sha ṇi/ ma hā bi hā ra ga ti/ sa man+ta/ bi mā na ga ti/ ma hā kār+ya/ pra ti mā ba ṇi/ satā arba sa ma tā nu pra pū re/ a yā na/ dharma tā/ ma hā bho gi ni/ ma hā mi tri/ u pa saṃ nyi te/ hi te ṣi/ sa gro tī te/ sa mār+sha a nu pā li ne (peswā hā/ bcom ldan 'das gang la la zhig gzungs sngags 'di 'don 2cing yongs su bzung bas (rtenobadag g.yar 'dren par bgyid na/ bdag gis 7g.yar 'dren pa thos nas 89—298

de'i thad du mchis te smon pa rnams 'grub par bgyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ni dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'i tshig /ting nge 'dzin mngon par 'grub ①pa'i tshig /yang dag pa'i tshig / slu ba ②ma mchis pa'i tshig /yang dag pa'i spyod pa sems can rnams kyi yang dag pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba lags pas/ gang la la zhig sngags 'di yang dag par 'dzin cing klog pa dang / 'don pa des gdugs mtshan bdun gyi bar du yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i sdom pa yang dag par blangs nas snga dro'i dus kyi tshe sngar so shing bcas te dag par bkrus nas ③snga dro'i dus kyi tshe spos dang / me tog ④gis sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod pa bgyis te / bdag nyid kyis ⑤dngos sdig bshags nas bdag dang sems can rnams smon pa myur du 'grub par bgyi ba'i slad du yongs su bsngo zhing smon lam gdab par bgyi'o4)/ /khang pa gcig rtso)gtsang mar bgyis pa'am/ yang na dben pa'i gnas sam/ dgon pa'i gnas kyang rung ste/ ba lang gi rtsi nibs dkyil 'khor bgyis nas tsan+dan bsregs te mchod par bgyi'o/ /stan mchog gcig bting ste ba dan dang gdugs kyis brgyan par ⑨bgyi'o/ /me tog dam pa rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi nang bkram ste ⑩sems rtse gcig tu sngags yibazlas nas bdag der mchi bar re bar bgyi'o/ /bdag de'i tshe de la rjes su sems shing lta bar bgyid tu)pas de'i khang par zhugs te stan la mchis nas de'i mchod pa len par bgyid do8/ /de slan 8chad mi des g.yar lam na 'badag mthong bar 'gyur bas ci dang ci smon pa'i dngos po rnams yang dag pa'i tshig gis bsgo tsonas go bar bgyid do/ /grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ 'brog dgon pa'am/ dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang yang rung ste/ ci dang ci smon pa thams cad yongs su 89—299

rdzogs par bgyid pas gser dang / dngul dang / nor dang / rin po che dang ske/ ba lang ①dang / lug dang / 'bru rnams dang / bza' ba dang /btung ba dang / gos rnams yid bzhin du 'thob par 'gyur zhing / bde ba dang ②longs spyod mchog la yongs su longs spyod par 'gyur lags so/ /de ltar 'bras bu rnam par smin pa mchog dam pa thob nas kyang skal ③ba mchog gang lags pa des dkon mchog gsum la mchod cing bdag la yang stsal bar bgyi'o/ /chos kyi 'dus pa rgya cher bshams nas bza' ba dang btung ba rnams sbyar te/spos dang me tog gcal rjodu bkram nas mchod par bgyi'o/ /mchod pa ⑤bgyis nas mchod par bgyis pa'i zas lhag ma ci mchis pa btsongs ①te/ rin blangs nas yang mchod par bgyid ⑦na bdag nam 'tsho'i bar du rtag tu de na duganas nas gang zag de la bsrung zhing bskyab ⑨pa dang / phongs shing brel ba ma mchis pa dang smon pa rnams yid bzhin du 'grub par bgyid do/ /dus dus su dbul phongs ⑩pa rnams la yang stsal bar bgyi zhing bdag gcig pu'i ched du ser snas phangs par mi 7bgyi'o/ /rtag par mdo sde 'di bklags bonas rgyun 'chad 8pa ma mchis par mchod par ④bgyi ste/ bsod nams ci mchis pa de yang thams cad la gtong 8zhing byang chub tu yongs su bsngos nas 'khor ba las tshunges par 'byung zhing myur du rnam par grol ba thob ⑩par 'gyur bar smon par bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 8dpal gyi lha mo la (7khyod kyis de ltar mdo sde 'di rgya cher spel nas bdag dang gzhan gnyis ka rka nyal phan pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa byas pa legs so legs so zhes bsngags pa brjod par gyur to/ /gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba rdzu nyamado sde'i rgyal po las dpal gyi lha mo chen ( ste89—300

mos nor 'phel bar byed pa'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o// //de nas sa'i lha mo brtan ①ma 'khor mang po'i nang nas stan las langs te gus pas thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba ②mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di da ③ltar ram/ slad ma'i dus kyi tshe gal te grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/grong rdal lam/ rgyal po'i pho brang ngam/ dgon pa'i gnas sam/ ri 'am/phug gam/ nags tshal dag na yang rung ste mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di spel bar bgyid na/ bcom ldan 'das bdag der mchis nas mchod pa dang / bkur ste dang yongs su bsrung dub dang / yongs su bskyab pa ⑤bgyis te rgya cher spel bar bgyid do/ /sa phyogs gang yang rung ba dag tu chos smra ba'i mkhan po'i ched du khri mthon po btsugs te mdo sde 'di 'chad par bgyid yin/ bdag rdzu 'phrul gyi mthus lus mi gda' ⑦bar bgyis nas der mchis te/ de'i rkang pa nas spyi bos 'degs par bgyid do/ /bdag chos thos par gyur nas kyang shin tu dang ba'i bsam pas rab tu dga' bar bgyid do/ /chos kyi ro thob pa'i dbang gis gzi byin 'phel bar 'gyur bas mgu ba tshad ma mchis pa thob par 'gyur te/bdag nyid nide lta bu'i phan yon thob pa nyid kyis sa chen po 'di yang dpag tshad stong laphrag ⑩brgyad cu hu)rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la thug pa tshun chad sa'i bcud thams cad rab tu 'phel bar bgyid do/ /rgya mtsho bzhi tshun chad kyis chen po ji snyed pa de 8dag sa'i bcud rgyas shing rab tu gshin pas sngon bas 4)kyang lhag pa dang / ches 8khyad par du 'phags par bgyid do/ /'dzam bu'i gling 'di na chu 89—301

bo dang / rdzing dang / rdzing bu dang / ljon shing dang / sman dang / nags tshal dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / rtsa ba dang / sdong bu dang /yal ga dang / lo ma dang / 'bru rnam pa sna tshogs ci mchis pa de dag kyang dbyibs mdzes shing yid du mchi ba dang / mang po kun gyis blta ①bar mos pa dang ske/ kha dog dang / dri phun sum tshogs pa dang longs spyod du rung bar bgyid do⑤/ /sems can gang gis bza' ba dang / btung ba mchog de lta bu ④dag la longs spyod pa rnams kyang tshe ring zhing kha dog dang stobs dang ldan pa dang ④/ dbang po rnams bde zhing gzi byin 'phel ba dang / bro ⑤nad rnams ma ⑥mchis pa dang / sems kyi shes rab dpa' zhing ci yang rtsol mengo thogs ⑧par 'gyur lags so/ /gzhan yang sa ṇichen po 'di las ji tsam du yongs su spyad par bgyi ba'i dngos po brgya stong ji snyed pa thams cad kyang phun sum tshogs par bgyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das rgyu dang rkyen des na ⑩'dzam bu'i gling rnams su hunyerab tu bde zhing lo legs pa dang / mi rnams dar zhing rgyas pa dang /gnod pa rnams ma mchis pas sems can ji snyed mchis pa de dag thams cad bde ba myong bar 'gyur lags so/ /de ltar lus dang sems kyis tsobade ba myong bar gyur nas kyang mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di la shin tu gus pa bskyed 8nas gang du gnas kyang rung ste/ thams cad kyis yongs su bzung ba dang / mchod pa dang ske/ bkur sti dang / bla mar bgyis shing bsngags pa chabarjod par 7smon par bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang chos 'chad pa'i mkhan po chen po de dag gang du chos 'chad pa'i gnas der yang mchis te/ sems can rnams kyi ched du mdo sde'i rgyal po dam pa 'di tsha'achad par gsol ba gdab par bgyi'o1nye/ /de ci'i slad du 89—302

zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das mdo sde 'di bshad pa'i dbang gis bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la sman par 'gyur zhing 'od dang / kha dog dang /mthu stobs dang / dpa' zhing gzi byin dang ldan pa dang / byad bzhin shin tu sdug cing sngon bas ches khyad par du 'phags par 'gyur bas so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag sa'i lha mo brtan ma yang chos kyi ros tshim par gyur pa'i dbang gis 'dzam bu'i gling dpag tshad bdun stong tshun chad sa thams cad bcud dang ldan pa dang / snga ma ①bzhin du sems can ji snyed pa thams cad kyang ②bde ba myong bar bgyid lags so/ /de lta bas na bcom ldan 'das de'i tshe sems can de dag gis kyang chabadag gi drin bsab ④pa'i slad du bdag cag gdon mi 'tshal ⑤bar mdo sde 'di mnyan nas bkur sti dang / rim gro dang / mchod pa dang /bla mar bgyis nas bsngags ⑥pa brjod par bgyi'o snyam du bsam par bgyi'o/ /de ltar bsams nas kyang gnas nas byung ste grong dang / grong khyer dang /grong rdal dang / khang khyim dang / dgon pa'i gnas gang du chos bshad pa'i 'dus pa der mchis nas gachos bshad pa'i mkhan po la spyi bos btud de phyag bgyis nas mdo sde 'di mnyan par bgyi'o/ /mdo sde 'di (kyemanyan nas kyang so so nas rang gi gnas su mchis te rab tu dga' ba'i sems bskyed de/ 'di skad du bdag cag deng shin tu zab cing bla na ma mchis pa'i chos gya rnam pa thos pas ⑨'di ni bsod nams kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa snyed yongs su bsdus par gyur to/ /mdo sde'i mthu stobs kyi dbang gis bdag cag sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong tshad ma mchis shing mtha' ma mchis pa masnyed la mchod cing rim gro bgyis pas ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal nyu)mi bzad pa mdang bral bar 83—303

gyur to/ /ma 'ongs pa'i tshe rabs brgya stong gi bar du yang rtag par mtho ris dang mi'i nang du skyes nas bde ba mchog myong bar 'gyur ro zhes brjod par 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe mi mang po de dag so so nas slar rang rang ①gi gnas su mchis nas kyang ②skye bo mang po rnams la mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di las gsungs pa'i dpe gcig ①tsam mamadu/ le'u gcig ༷tsam mamayi/ sngon gyi gtam ༅rgyud gcig tsam mamadu/ de bzhin gshegs pa gcig gi ⑨mtshan tsam mamatshu/ byang chub sems dpa' gcig 0gi ming tsam mam8/ tshig bzhi pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam mam8/ yang ④tshig gcig 8tsam zhig sems can rnams la yang dag par ston par bgyid dam/ tha na mdo sde 'di'i mtshan tsam zhig brjod par bgyid na/ bcom ldan 'das sems can de dag gang na gnas pa'i sa phyogs de dag thams cad bcud dang ldan zhing gzhan bas lhag par 'gyur ⑩ba dang / sa chen po las skye bar 'gyur ba'i dngos po thams cad kyang rgya cher rab tu 'phel zhing rab tu ⑩rgyas par 'gyur bas sems can rnams shin tu bde ba'i longs spyod myong bar 'gyur ro/ /rin po che dang nor mang bar 'gyur/ sbyin pa legs par gtong bar 'gyur/ rtag par sems brtan zhing dkon mchog gsum la shin tu mngon par yid ches par 'gyur lags so/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sa'i 8lha mo brtan ma la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sems can gang la la zhig gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di las tha na tshig gcig tsam zhig thos par gyur na yang tshe 'phos pa'i 'og tu sum cu 7rtsa gsum dang / lha'i gnas gzhan dag tu skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can gang la la zhig mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di mchod 89—304

par 'dod pa'i phyir ①khang khyim dag rab tu brgyan nas ③bla re gcig bre ①bar byed dam/ ba dan gcig tsam dpyangs par dubyed na rgyu ⑤dang rkyen des lha'i ris drug po dag tu ji ltar bsams pa bzhin du skye bar 'gyur bas rin po che sna bdun gyi gzhal med khang mchog dam pa dag la yid bzhin du longs spyod par 'gyur/ so so nas lha'i bu mo bdun stong dang phan tshun lhan cig rtse zhing nyin mtshan rtag par khyad par du 'phags pa'i bde ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag la longs spyod par 'gyur ro/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das la sa'i lha mo brtan mas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rgyu dang rkyen des na 'khor bzhi po las gang la la zhig chos kyi stan la mchis nas chos 'di yang dag par ston pa na/ bdag gdugs mtshan du gang zag de la yongs su srung zhing yongs su 0skyob ⑦par bgyid nadu/ rang gi lus mi gda' bar bgyis nas chos kyi stan gyi 6)drung du mchis te de'i rkang pa la ⑩'degs par bgyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das mdo sde 'di lta bu 'di ni sems can de dag gis sangs rgyas brgya stong du ma las dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun tunyepas na 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir rgya cher 'phel zhing nub par mi 'gyur ba lags so//sems can gang gis mdo sde 'di mnyan 8par bgyid pa de dag ni 0slad ma'i dus kyi 8tshe bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong tshad ma mchis pa snyed kyi bar du lha dang mi'i nang du rtag par bde ba mchog mel longs spyod par 'gyur/ sangs rgyas mang po dang mjal (nyanas myur du bla na med par 'o 1yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur/ ngan song gsum dang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal myong bar mi 'gyur lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 83—305

la sa'i lha mo brtan mas yang ①'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la sngags kyi snying po lha dang mi rnams la phan 'dogs shing thams cad la bde bar bgyid pa mchis te/ skyes pa dang / bud med dang / 'khor bzhi po dag las gang la la zhig bdag gi rgyalus yang dag pa ②mngon sum du mthong bar 'tshal ba des sems rtse gcig tu gzungs ④'di yongs su 'dzin par bgyid dun/ji ltar smon pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par bgyid do/ / 'di lta ste/rjonor dang rin po che'i gter dang / mngon par shes pa dang / tshe ring ba'i sman dam pa gnyer ba dang / sems can gyi nad mang po gso ba dang / phyir rgol ba'i dgra pham par bgyi ba dang tha dad par smra ba rnams tshar gcod ⑦par 'tshal na khang pa gtsang mar bgyis te ⑧dkyil 'khor bgyi'o/ /lus bkrus te gos sar pa gtsang ma bgos nas rtswa'i stan gyi ⑨steng du mchis/ te ring bsrel dang sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar ram/ yang na ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten gyi drung du bdug pa bsregs 7te/ me tog gtor nas bza' ba dang / btung ba dag gis mchod pa bgyis te/ zla ba yar gyi ngo tshes brgyad la skar ma rgyal rdzogs pa na g.yar 'dren pa'i sngags 'di bzla bar bgyi'o/ /tabya thā/ tsi li tsi litha/tsu ru tsu ru/ ku ru ku ru/ ku ṭu ku ṭu/ to ṭu to ṭu/ ba ha ba ha/ ba ri sha ba ri sha nyarnyeswā hā/ bcom ldan 'das rig 1)sngags 'di 'khor bzhi po las gang la la zhig gis lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas bdag g.yar 'dren par bgyid ④na bdag gis de'i ched du g.yar 'dren pa der mchi bar 'gyur lags so/ /gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das sems can gang la la zhig bdag nyanadangos po mngon sum du mngon par 'amathong zhing lhan cig gtam bgyid par 3)'tshal na yang snga ma 89wa 306

bzhin du cho ga bshams nas gzungs 'di bzlas par bgyi'o/ /tabya thā/ añca ni/ kya li k+ṣa ni/ shi shi dha ril/ ha ha hi hi/ ku ru ba ②re swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das gang la la zhig sngags 'di 'don pa na lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas sngags snga ma yang 'don par bgyid na bdag gdon mi 'tshal bar lus mngon du bstan nas des ji ltar smon pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyid pas nam yang ②chab mi du'atshal bar ⑤bgyid do/ /gal te sngags 'di 'don par 'tshal na sngar lus bsrung 0ba'i sngags 'di 'don ⑦par bgyi'o/ /tabya dushā/ shi ri shi ri/ bā sha ka ti/ ta ti kurtsi/ pu ta/ pū de ri/ gu de ri/ ṭi ṭi ba ṭi/ku ku ṭi/ ka ba tsi li ⑨snya hā/ bcom ldan 'das sngags 'di 'don pa'i tshe tshon sna lnga'i skud pa blangs nas sngags lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas te⑩/ mdud pa nyi shu rtsa gcig bgyis nas/yo dpung pa g.yon pa la bcings na 8slan chad lus bsrung ba 8bgyis pas 'jigs pa ma mchis par 'gyur ro/ /gang la la zhig sems rtse gcig tu sngags 'di zlos 8par bgyid lin/ bsam ⑩pa rnams yid bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur te/ bdag sho be mi mchi ste/ bdag gi dbang du sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun dkon mchog gsum bzhugs pas mad pa 7nyid du rab tu mkhyen par 'gyur lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sa'i lha mo brtan ma /snyel bka' stsal pa/ khyod yang dag pa'i bden tshig gi sngags kyis btab pa'i mdo sde'i rtso )rgyal po 'di dang / chos smra ba dag la yongs su bsrung ( )bar byas pa legs so legs so/ /rgyu dang rkyen 'dis khyod bsod nams kyi rnam par smin pa tshad med pa snyed 'thob zhu)par 'gyur ro/ /gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba ru mdo sde'i rgyal po las sa'i lha mo 89—307

brtan ma'i le'u ste bcwa ①brgyad pa'o// //de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po yang dag shes zhes bya ba gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon ②nyi shu rtsa brgyad po dag chadang lhan cig tu 'khor mang po'i nang nas stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig la gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha ④nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba dumado sde'i rgyal po 'di da ltar ram/ slad ma'i dus kyi tshe grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ grong rdal lam/ ljongs sam/ri'am / dgon pa'am/ nags tshal lam/ rgyal po'i pho brang ngam/ dge 'dun gnas pa'i gnas dag tu yang rung ste/ yang dag par bstan nas rgya cher spel bar bgyid na/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po yang dag shes gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon yinyi shu rtsa brgyad dang lhan cig tu der mchis nas so so nas rang gi lus mi gda' bar bgyis te/ ci rigs par chos smra ba'i mkhan po de dang / chos nyan pa'i 'khor de dag ⑦yongs su bsrungs nas gnod pa rnams spangs te brtag par bde ba myong bar bgyid do/ /skyes pa'am / bud med dam/ khye'u 'amasti/ bu mo gang la la zhig mdo sde 'di las tha na tshig bzhi pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam yang dag par 'dzin par phonyebagyid dam/ tshig gcig tsam yang dag par 'dzin par bgyid dam/ mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di'i mtshan tsam smos par bgyid dam/ mdo sde 'di las gsungs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa gcig gi mtshan tsam mamananya/ byang chub sems dpa' 89wa 308

gcig gi ①ming tsam brjod par sems bskyed nas gus pas rim gro dang /mchod pa ②bgyid na bdag nigis yongs su bsrung ④zhing byin gyis brlabs nas gnod pa ma mchis par bgyis te sdug bsngal spangs nas bde ba 'thob ⑤par 'gyur ro0/ /bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du bdag gi ming yang dag shes zhes bgyi ba'i rgyu dang rkyen gang lags pa de ni bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis mngon sum du mkhyen pa lags te/ bdag gis ④chos rnams nirig pa dang / bdag gis ⑨chos thams cad kyi ji snyed pa dang / chos thams cad kyi ji lta ba dang / chos thams cad kyi ⑩rnam pa dang / ngo bo nyid dang / bye brag ji snyed pa thams cad gsal bar rtogs pa lags so0/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar chos rnams bdag gis khong du chud par gyur pas 8bdag dpag par dka' ba'i ye shes kyi snang ba dang ldan pa dang / bdag dpag par dka' ba'i ye shes kyi sgron ma dang ldan pa dang / bdag dpag par dka' ba'i ye shes kyi spyod pa dang ldan pa dang /bdag dpag par dka' ba'i ye shes kyi phung po dang ldan pa dang / bdag dpag par dka' ba'i ye shes kyi 8spyod yul rnams mngon par rtogs 8par gyur pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis 'di ltar chos thams cad yang dag par rig /yang dag par gsal bar rtogs / yang dag par khong du chud/yang dag par so sor rtogs hu9par bgyid pas bcom ldan 'das rgyu dang rkyen de'i slad du gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po yang dag shes zhes bgyi ba lags te/don de'i slad du bdag gis mchos smra ba'i mkhan po de'i tshig gi aspobs pa gsal zhing rgyan dang ldan pa dang / gzi byin dang mdangs ba hu)spu'i bu ga kun nas 'jug pa dang / lus kyi mthu stobs dang ldan pa dang / gzi byin dang 83—309

ldan zhing dpa' ba dang / dpag par dka' ba'i ye shes kyi snang ba thams cad phun sum tshogs pa dang / yang dag pa'i ༅dran pa thob nas spa gong ba ②ma mchis pa dang / de'i lus la phan 'dogs shing nyams pa ma mchis pa dang /dbang po rnams bde zhing rtag par dga' ba bskyed par bgyi'o / /rgyu dang rkyen de'i slad du sems can gang dag sangs rgyas brgya stong du ma las dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed nas bsod nams kyi las mngon par sgrub pa dag gi ched du 'dzam bu'i gling dag tu rgya cher spel nas myur du nub par mi 'gyur bar bgyid pas sems can de dag gis mdo sde 'di thos nas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba chen po dang / bsod nams kyi phung po tshad ma mchis pa 'thob 0par 'gyur zhing slad ma'i dus kyi tshe yang bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig tshad ma mchis pa'i bar du bsam gyis ⑤mi khyab pa'i lha dang / mi'i bde ba myong ba dang / rtag par sangs rgyas mang po dang mjal menas myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par ⑦'tshang rgya bar 'gyur bas gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang / ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal shin tu mi bzad dupa dag kyang myong bar mi 'gyur lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po yang dag shes kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la gzungs mchis te/ sems can rnams la sman par bgyi zhing brtse ba'i slad du deng bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bdag nyid kyis bshad par bgyi'o / /de nas sngags smras pa(7/ na mo bun+ta 7ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥyisi bhā ya/ na mo pra t+pā ya/ na ma in+d+ra ya/ na ma: tur ṇ+ḍaṃ ma mahā rā dzā ṭ+wāṃ/tabya thā/ hi li nyi li/ mi li mi li/ go ri ma hā go ri/ garnya 7ri/ ma hā 89—310

garnya ri/ dri mi ḍi/ ma hā dri mi ḍi/ daṇ+ḍa khu khun tirdzi/ ha ha ha ha ha/ hi hi hi hi nyi/ hu hu hu hu hul/ ha lo dha me/ gu me / tsa tsa tsa tsa dzi tsi tsi tsi/ tsu tsu tsu tsu/ tsaṇ+ḍi shwa ra/ shi kha ra shi kha ra/ u tiṣ+ṭha he/ bha ga bān saṃ bid tsā duya swā hā/ gang la la zhig rig sngags 'di 'dzin par bgyid na bdag gis 'tsho ba'i yo byad sman dang / bza' ba dang / btung ba dang /gos dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / rin po che ngo mtshar che ⑤ba dag gis ⑥rim gro bgyid do/ /gal te skyes pa dang / bud med dang / khye'u dang /bu mo dang / gser dang / dngul dang / rin po che dang / rgyan phreng gi rnam pa rnams yongs su gnyer bar bgyid na yang bdag gis ④thams cad sbyar nas ji ltar smon pa bzhin ⑧rgyad cing longs pa ma mchis par bgyid do/ /rig ⑨sngags 'di mthu chen po dang ldan pas sngags 'don pa'i tshe/ bdag myur du de'i thad du ⑩mchis nas thogs pa ma mchis par yid bzhin du 'grub par bgyid do/ /sngags 'di 'don pa'i tshe cho ga ci rigs ⑩par bgyis nas thog ma kho nar gnod sbyin yang dag shes kyi gzugs 'phang du chag bzhi lnga tsam mchis pa sug pa na tunyedagra sta thogs pa ri mor bri bar bgyi'o/9nye/ /gzugs brnyan de'i mdun du dkyil 'khor gru bzhir ④bgyis nas bum pa bzhi sbrang rtsi'i chab bam/ bu ram gyi chab kyis tsobakang ste bzhag nas byug maspos dang / phye ma dang / bdug spos dang /me tog dang / phreng ba rnams kyang bkram par bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du thab gcig bgyis te/ de'i nang du sol ba'i zhugs stsal nas mar dang yungs kur chabasregs te/ snga ma'i sngags de lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas/ sngags lan re zhing lan cig hu bsregs na/ bdag gnod sbyin gyi sde 89—311

dpon chen po rang nyid drung du ①mchis nas lus mngon du bstan te/ sngags 'don ②pa'i mi de la khyod ci dang ci dgos pa dang / yid la ci 'dod pa'i dngos po gang yin pa de dusmos shig ces 'dri bar bgyid do/ /bdag gis ji skad mchi ba bzhin yongs su gnyer ba'i dngos po rnam pa thams cad phun sum tshogs par bgyid do/ /gal te gser dang / dngul dang / gter 'tshal bar gyur tam/ yang na lha'i drang srong du gyur nas dunam mkha' la mchi bar 'tshal lam/ lha'i mig gi ⑤mngon par shes pa dang / gzhan gyi sems 'tshal ba dang / sems can thams cad la yid bzhin du rang dbang thob nas nyon mongs pa bcad de myur du rnam par grol ba thob pa la dgod ⑥par 'tshal na yang thams cad phun sum tshogs par bgyid do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po yang dag shes la bka' stsal pa/ khyod kyis 'di ltar sems can thams cad la phan gdags pa'i phyir rig sngags 'di bshad de/yang dag pa'i chos yongs su bsrungs nas ⑦bsod nams kyis mtha' yas pa rnams la phan btags pa legs so legs so/ /gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba mdo sde'i rgyal po las/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po yang dag shes kyi le'u ste bcu dgu pa'o// //de nas sa'i lha mo chen mo brtan ⑧ma zhes bya ba 'khor mang po'i nang nas stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag byas nas gus pas nywathal mo sbyar te / bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /(nyebacom ldan 'das yul rnams su mi'i rgyal po bgyid pa la gal te yang dag pa'i 89—312

chos ma mchis par gyur na/ yul skyong zhing skye bo mang po rnams kyang gso ba'i rngo mi thogs ①la bdag nyid kyang yun ring du khyad par du 'phags pa'i rgyal thabs ②la gnas par mi 'gyur na/ bcom ldan 'das byams pa dang / thugs rjes thugs brtse bar dgongs te/ bdag la rgyal po'i chos lugs ①yang dag pa'i bstan bcos yul skyong bar bgyid pa'i don gang lags pa bkas bshad du gsol / des na dumi'i rgyal po rnams chos 'di thos pa'i dbang gis ji skad bstan pa bzhin du mngon par sgrub cing yang dag par 'jig rten 'dul ba dang /khyad par du ⑤'phags pa'i rgyal thabs gtan du bde zhing zhi ba dang / yul na gnas pa'i skye bo thams cad la yang sman par 'gyur lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor mang po'i nang du sa'i lha mo brtan ma la bka' stsal pa/khyod legs par nyon cig /sngon 'das pa'i dus kyi tshe rgyal po stobs kyi gtso bo'i tog ces bya ba byung ngo / /rgyal po de'i yibu mdzes pa'i tog ces bya ba zhig yod de/ spyi bo nas dbang bskur nas ring po ma lon par de nas rgyal po yab kyis mdzes pa'i tog la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rgyal po'i chos lugs yang dag pa'i bstan bcos lha'i bdag po'i man ⑦ngag ces bya ba yod de/ nga ⑤sngon spyi bo nas dbang bskur nas yul gyi bdag po byas pa'i tshe nga'i yab shes pa'i stobs kyi ⑨gtso bo'i tog ces bya bas nga la rgyal po'i chos lugs yang dag pa'i bstan bcos 'di bstan pas/ ngas bstan bcos 'di la brten nas lo nyi khri'i bar du yul legs par bskyangs te/ ngas skad cig gcig tsam gyi bar du yang chos ma yin pa spyad par bya'o snyam pa'i bsam pa byung ma myong ngo / /deng khyod kyang de bzhin du chos ma yin pas yul skyong bar ma byed cig /ci'i phyir rgyal po'i chos 89—313

lugs yang dag pa'i bstan bcos zhes bya zhe na/ khyod deng ①legs par nyon cig dang khyod la ②bstan par bya'o/ /de nas de'i tshe rgyal po stobs kyi gtso bo'i tog ②gis rgyal bu de la tshigs su bcad pa gya rnam pa dag gis yang dag par rjobastan bcos mngon par bstan pa/ ngas ni sems can bde bya dang / /'jig rten the tsom bcad ⑤pa dang / /nyes dmigs mang po bsal ba'i phyir/ /rgyal khrims bstan bcos bshad par bya/ /lha yi bdag po thams cad dang / /mi yi rgyal po gang yin pa/ /dga' ba'i sems ni rab skyed yil/ /thal mo sbyar nas ngas bshad nyon/ /sngon byung lha 'khor mang po rnams/ /rdo rje'i ⑦ji la 'dus pa na/ /rgyal bzhi (8)stan las langs nas ni/ /tshangs chen la ni 'di skad zhus/ /tshangs bdag mchog tu gtsor ⑨gyur cing / /lha yi nang na dbang phyug che/ /bdag cag la ni brtser dgongs nas/ /the tsom ⑩rnams ni gcad ⑩du gsol/ /ji ltar mi yi 'jig rten skyes/ /rgyal po zhes ni bgyi bar 'gyur/ /gzhan yang rgyu rkyen gang gi slad/ /lha yi bu zhes bgyi bar 'gyur(ste/ /ji ltar mir ni skyes pa la / /gcig pu mi yi bdag po 'thob/ /ji ltar mtho ris gnas dag tu/ /lha yi rgyal po 7bgyid par 'gyur/ /8de ltar 'jig rten skyong dag gis/ /tshangs rgyal de la zhus pa dang / /de tshe tshangs pa'i bdag po yis/ /de dag la ni ⑫'di skad smras/ /'jig rten skyong khyod 0shes par byos/ /sems can la ni phan bya'i phyir/ /nga bol yul skyong chos dris pas/ /ngas bshad khyod kyis legs par nyon/ /sngon gyi las kyi mthu yis ni/ /lhar skyes rgyal por gyur pa yin / /gal te mi nang gnas gyur nas/ /dbang sdud mi yi bdag po byed/ /lha rnams lhan cig byin brlabs 1)nas/ /de 'og ma yi mngal du 'jug /ma yi 89—314

mngal na gnas pa na/ /lha rnams kyis ni srung bar byed/ /mi yi 'jig rten skyes gyur kyang / /gtso mchog gyur phyir lha zhes bya/ /lha rnams kyis ni bsrungs pas na①/ /lha yi bu zhes brjod pa yin/ /sum cu ②rtsa gsum bdag po yis/ /stobs bshes mi rgyal stongs par ③byed/ /lha ni mang po thams cad kyis/ /rang dbang stobs ni rab bstangs nas/ /chos min kun ni rab bsal te/ /sdig pa'i las ni skyed ④mi byed/ /sems can dge ba sgrub bskul nas/ /mtho ris gnas su skye bar byed/ /mi dang lha min 'khor dag dang / /dri za dang ni ⑤srin po dang / /gdol pa la sogs thams cad kyis/ /stobs kyi phyed ni stor bar dubyed/ /pha mas stobs phyed bstangs nas ni/ /sdig spong dge ba sgrub la 'dzudaX/ /lha rnams lhan cig rab bsrungs nas/ /dge sdig rnam smin ston par byed/ /dge sdig las ni byas gyur nardzi// /da 7ltar tshe 'di nyid la ni/ /lha rnams lhan cig rab bsrungs nas/ /dge sdig rnam smin ston par byed/ /yul mis sdig pa'i las byas la/ /rgyal spangs 0nan tur rka/nyemi byed na/ /'di ni yang dag rigs pa min/ /chos bzhin chad pas gcad 8par bya/ /gal te nyes mthong mi 'gog na/ /chos min rab tu 'phel 'gyur bas/ /rgyal po de yi yul khams su/ /g.yo sgyu mang du 'phel bar 'gyur/ /rgyal pos nyes byed mthong ba ⑫la/ /gal te zlog cipar mi byed na/ /sum cu 8rtsa gsum lha 'khor rnams/ /thams cad khong khro'i 7sems skye 'gyur/ /rgyu des rgyal khrims nyams 'gyur zhing / /g.yo sgyu 'jig rten 'phel 'gyur bas/ /pha rol dgra 'khor dag gis ni / /yul de bcom nas 'jig 7par byed/ /gnas pa'i khyim dang yo byad dang ske/ nor bsags thams cad stor bar 'gyur/ /g.yo sgyu sna tshogs skyes pas tso89—315

na/ /phan tshun gcig la gcig ①kyang 'phrog /yang dag chos kyis rgyal thob kyang / /chos bzhin du ni mi spyod pas/ /yul mi thams cad 'thor ②'gyur te / /glang pos pad+ma'i rdzing brdzis ①'dra/ /rlung drag ldang la dus kyang med/ /mi 'phrod char ni dus min 'bab/ /rgyu 0skar ltas ngan mang po ston/ /nyi zla gcan zin 'od kyang med/ /rgyal pos yang dag chos spangs ⑤pas/ /'bru rnams me tog 'bras bu dang / lo tog 0thams cad mi smin cing / /yul na mu ge 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rgyal pos ②yang dag chos spangs nas/ /sdig chos mi ni ston byed na/ /gzhal med khang gnas lha rnams kyis/ /mthong nas mya ngan skye bar 'gyur/ /lha rgyal 'khor bcas de dag gis/ /'di skad du ni smra bar 'gyur/ /rgyal 'dis chos min rab spyad nas/ /sdig pa'i grogs po bsten pas na / /rgyal srid yun ring brtan mi 'gyur/ /lha rnams thams cad rab mi dga'/ /de dag khros par gyur pa'i phyir/ /yul de 'jig par 'gyur zhes zer / /chos min mi ni rab brten pasani/ / yul khams 'phel bar 'gyur bas na/ /rki'athab rtsod g.yo sgyu mang por 'gyur/ /rims nad sdug bsngal mang po skye/ /lha yi bdag po srung mi byed/ /lha gzhan thams cad spong bar byed/ /de yi yul ni rang zhig nas/ /rgyal po sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur/ / pha ma ⑩chung ma bu rnams dang / /phu nu dang ni sring mo rnams/ / cig car yisdug dang bral 'gyur zhing / /tha mar bdag kyang 'chi bar 'gyur/ /ltas ngan skar mda' dag kyang lhung 7/ /nyi ma gnyis ni cig car lhonya'achar/ /pha rol dgra ni nyer 'ongs pas / /yul mi 'chi bar me'akhrug phrad 'gyur/ /yul bkur 7blon po chen po rnams/ /nyes med glo 7bur 'chi bar 'gyur/ /glang po rta sogs 89—316

gces pa rnams/ /thams cad 'thor zhing stongs par ①'gyur/ /yul yul kun du dgra yod pas②/ /mi ni phal ②cher dus min 'chi/ /'dre srin mang po duyul zhugs pas/ /rims nad kun du 'phel bar 'gyur/ /yul mi ①blon po chen po dang / /nye phan mang po 0thams cad kyang ⑦/ /sems ni g.yo sgyu ⑧bcas pas na/ /thams cad chos min spyod par 'gyur/ /chos min spyod pa ⑨mthong gyur ⑩na/ /snying du sdug cing bkur bar byed/ /dge chos spyod pa'i mi dag la/ /sdug bsngal nyon mongs chad pas gcod/ /ma rungs byams shing bkur ba dang / /dge ba chad pas 0bcad pa'i phyir/ /gza' skar rlung dang char pa rnams/ /thams cad dus su rgyu mi 'gyur/ /nyes dmigs rnam gsum skye bar 'gyuratso/ /yang dag chos ni nub 'gyur zhing / /sems can kha dog 'od mi ldan/ / sa yi 8bcud ni thur du 'bab/ /sdig bkur dge la brnyas ⑫pas na/ /gzhan yang nyes dmigs rnam gsum 'byung / /dus min sad dang ser ba 'bab/ /mu ge'i sdug bsngal kun du khyab/ /lo tog 8'bras bu mang po rnams/ /thams cad ro zhim nyams par 'gyur/ /de dag gi ni yul khams na/ /sems can phal cher na bar 'gyuratso/ /de yi yul na sngon shing rnams/ /sngon chad 'bras bu zhim chags pa/ / de yi ⑩dbang gis nyams 'gyur bsatso/ /kha rtsub ro mchog med par 'gyur/ /sngon gyi kun dga' nags tshal mchog /snying du sdug cing rtse yiba'i gnas/ /thams cad skams shing rnyings gu 'gyur bas0/ /mthong ba kun gyis mya ngan skye/ /sā ( shelu nas dang lo rtog rnams/ /ro zhim khad kyis med gyur pasang nye/ /bza' (stetshe sems kyang mi dga' na/ /'byung chen 'phel byed ga la nus/ /sems can kha dog 'od nyams shing / /mthu stobs 89—317

zad cing nyams par 'gyur/ /kha zas mang po ①thos kyang ni/ /'grangs ②pa nyid du yong ②mi 'gyur/ /yul khams de na yod pa yi/ /sems can rnam pa duji snyed pa/ /stobs chung dpa' bshor ⑤med pas na/ /bya ba dag ni byed mi nus / /yul mi phal cher nad thebs ⑥pas/ /sdug bsngal sna tshogs lus gzir ⑦'gyur / /'dre srin kun du khyab pas na/ /thams cad kun du srin por skye/ /rgyal pos ①chos min rab spyad nasal/ /mi dge'i grogs po bsten ⑩pas na/ /'jig rten rnam pa gsum po kun/ / des na yiganod pa sna tshogs myong / /de 'dra'i nyes dmigs mtha' med pa8/ /yul nas 'byung bar 'gyur ba yang / /sdig can mi ni mthong 'gyur yang ⑫/ /yal 8bor ma bskrad pa las gyur/ /lha rnams kun gyis byin brlabs 0nas/ /yul gyi rgyal po byas gyur kyang / /yang dag dam pa'i chos dag gis/ /yul khams yongs su srung 0mi byed/ /gang zhig dge spyod sgrub 7byed na/ /rtag tu mtho ris gnas su skye/ /gal te sdig pa'i las byas pa/ /tshe 'phos nges par ngan 'gror snyi/ltung / /gal te rgyal pos yul mi rnams/ /thal rangs nyes pa byed 'jug na/ /sum cu yirtsa gsum lha tshogs rnamasal/ /thams cad rab gdungs sems skye 'gyur/ /lha rnams dang ni pha ma yi/ /bstan dag bzhin du mi byed pa/ /'di ni chos min mi yin pas/ /rgyal po sno7 sri zhu'i bu ma yin/ /gal te rang gi yul khams su/ /chos min spyod pa mthong ba'i tshe/ /chos bzhin chad pas gcod byed cing / /yal dor 0sems ni mi bskyed ḍo rten/ /de phyir lha tshogs mang po kun/ /rgyal po de la skyob par byed/ /byang chub spyod pa bsgrub tsha pa'i phyir/ /sdig pa'i chos rnams zhi byed na/ /rgyal po tshe 'di nyid la ni/ /mthong ba'i rnam smin nges par ‘ 0myong / /dge dang mi 89—318

dge'i ①las dag la/ /spyod spong sems can bskul nas ni/ /dge sdig rnam smin bstan ②pas na/ /de phyir mi rgyal thob nas kyang / /lha rnams lhan cig byin brlabs ①nas/ /thams cad yi rang ④'gyur ba yin/ /bdag dang gzhan la phan gdags phyir/ /yang dag chos kyis yul bskyang bya/ /g.yo sgyu byed pa mthong gyur na/ /chos bzhin chad pas gcad ⑤par bya/ /gal te rgyal thabs stor ⑥ba dang / /srog 'bab rkyen zhig byung na yang / / nams kyang sdig chos ⑦mi spyod cing / /sdig pa mthong na spang bar bya/ /gnod pa'i nang na mchog lci bsadu/ /rgyal srid stor stilas lhag pa med/ /'di kun g.yo sgyu mi las gyur/ /des ⑩na chad pas gcad ⑩par bya/ /g.yo sgyu byed pa yod gyur na/ /rgyal srid dag kyang stor 8'gyur zhing / /rgyal srid tsodag kyang nyams 'gyur bas/ /glang chen me tog tshal zhugs 'dra/ /de yis mi rgyal byas kyang ni/ /chos kyis 0yul ni ma bskyangs pas/ /lha dbang thams cad mi dga' zhing / /lha ma yin yang de bzhin no/ /de lta bas na chos bzhin du/ /sdig pa byed pa chad pas gcad8/ /dge bas sems can gdul bya zhing / /chos min rjes su 'brang ⑩mi bya/ /lus dang srog ni spang sla 0yi/ /mi dge grogs rjes 'brang mi bya/ /nye ba dang ni nye min 8pa/ /thams cad mnyam pa nyid du blta/ /yang dag chos kyis yirgyal byed na/ /yul du)mi mi drang ⑥med pa'i phyir/ /chos rgyal grags dang ldan 'gyur h+phubs/ /khams gsum kun du grags par 'gyur/ /sum cu ( ༄rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams/ /dga' nas 'di skad smra bar du ste'agyur/ /'dzam gling chos rgyal tsogang yin pa/ /de ni bdag gi bu yin te/ /dge bas sems can 'dul byed cing / /yang dag chos kyis yul bskyangs nasashuste/ /yang dag chos spyod bskul 89wa 319

bas na/ /bdag cag gnas su skye 'gyur zer/ /lha dang mi ①yi bu rnams dang //lha ma yin gyi 'khor rnams kyang / /rgyal pos ②yang dag chos 'dul rgyus/ /rtag tu sems ni dga' bar 'gyur/ /lha tshogs thams cad rab dga' nas/ /mi rgyal de la srung ③bar byed/ /gza' duskar rang gi lam rgyu zhing / /nyi zla tshad las 'da' mi byed/ /rlung ni 0rtag par dus bzhin ldang / /bdud rtsi'i 0char ni dus bzhin 'bab/ /lo tog thams cad smin legs pas/ /mi rnams mu ge med par 'gyur/ /lha tshogs mang po thams cad kun/ /rang gi pho brang gang 'gyur bas/ /de phyir mi rje khyod kyis ni/ /lus spangs yang dag chos spel byos//rin chen chos la bkur byed na/ /des na mang po ⑦bde 'gyur bas/ /rtag par yang dag chos bsten ninas/ /yon tan bdag nyid brgyan par bya/ /'khor rnams rtag par rab dga' zhing / /sdig pa rnams ni spong bar byed/ /chos kyis sems can 'dul byed pas/ /rgyun du bde ba 'thob par 'gyur/ /mi rnams de dag thams cad kun/ /dge ba bcu 0ni spyod byed na⑩/ /yul khams rtag par lo legs shing / /yul ni zhi ba nyid du 'gyurayi/ /rgyal po chos kyis mi 'dul zhing / /dge bas sdig spyod 'dul byed na/ /snyan pa'i grags pa 'thob 8'gyur zhing / /sems can rnams ni bde bar byed/ /de nas de'i tshe sa chen po la gnas pa'i mi'i rgyal po thams cad dang 'khor mang po rnams bcom ldan 'das kyis sngon gyi mi'i 8rgyal pos yul skyong ba'i 0chos kyi 7don bkas bshad pa thos pas 7thams cad ngo mtshar rmad du gyur pa yonyadang / rab tu dga' ba thob par gyur pas shin tu dang ba'i mngon par yid ches pa dag gis bka' yang dag par blangs te spyod par gyur to/ /gser 'od dam pa mchog 89—320

tu rnam par rgyal ba mdo sde'i rgyal po las rgyal po'i chos lugs yang dag pa'i bstan bcos bstan pa'i le'u ste nyi shu pa'o// //gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba ①mdo sde'i rgyal po②/ bam po dgu pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor mang po rnams la rgyal po'i chos lugs yang dag pa'i bstan bcos bkas bshad nas yang 'khor mang po rnams la bka' stsal pa/ khyed dul sogs pa legs par nyon cig dang / ngas deng khyod rjol sngon chos yang dag par spyod pa'i rgyu dang rkyen bshad par bya'o/ /de nas de'i tshe tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ ngas ⑤sngon 'khor los sgyur 0rgyal byas pa na/ /sa chen 'di dang rgya mtshor bcas pa btang ⑦/ /gling bzhi rin chen gyis ni rab bkang ba/ /thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la mchod/ /ngas sngon bskal pa dag ni tshad med snyed/ /rnam dag yang dag nichos sku gnyer ba'i phyir/ /phangs ⑨pa'i nor dang rang gi 0lus srog kyang / /ser sna med pa'i sems kyis yongs su btang / /gzhan yang 'das pa'i bskal pa bsam dka' ⑫na/ /yang dag mkhyen pa rin chen gtsug phud 8byung / /de bzhin gshegs de ⑫mya ngan 'das pa'i 'og /rgyal po legs skyes zhes bya 'jig rten byung / /'khor mos sgyur 8rgyal byas nas gling bzhi btul/ /rgya mtsho'i 8mthar thug tshun chad skyabs su dong / /grong khyer ming ni gya rnam sgra zhes bya/ /de tshe 'khor spos sgyur ⑩rgyal de na gnas/ /mi lam sangs rgyas bsod nams ye shes thos/ /chos smra rin chen brtsegs /shepa zhes bya ba/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar mdzes stan 'dug nas/ /gser 'od dam pa'i nyunyemado sde 'chad pa'ang mthong / /de yitshe 83—321

rgyal de ①mi lam sad pa dang / /rab tu dga' ba skyes nas lus kun khyab/ /nam langs rgyal po'i pho brang phyir byung nas/ /dge slong dge 'dun rnams kyi thad du song / /'phags pa'i tshogs la gus pas ②rab mchod nas/ /tshogs chen mang po de la 'di skad dris/ /chos smra rin chen brtsegs ②pa zhes bgyi bdu//yon tan phun tshogs sems can 'dul mchis sam/ /de ①tshe chos smra chen po rin chen brtsegs0/ /gnas khang gcig pur meyang dag gnas nas ni/ /dran pa nyer gzhag dumado sde 'di bton ⑨pas/ /drang 'dug mi g.yo lus dang sems kyang bde/ /de tshe dge slong zhig gis rgyal khrid nas/ /rin chen brtsegs pa ⑩de yi gnas su phyin/ /gnas khang nang du 7lus ni drang bsrang ste/ /'od dang mtshan tsomachog lus kun khyab par tsomathong / /rgyal po de la 'di ni rin chen brtsegs8/ /mdo sde'i rgyal po ⑩mchog gyur 'di lta ste/ /gser 'od dam pa shin tu gya rnam mchog /sangs rgyas spyod yul zab mo 'dzin ⑩ces smras/ /rgyal pos rin chen brtsegs ⑩la phyag byas nas/ /gus pas thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad smrasam/ /zla ba nya ltar zhal mdog mdzes gyur pa/ /gser 'od dam pa'i chos 'di bshad du gsol/ /rin chen brtsegs shwe/kyis rgyal po'i tshig mnyan nas//gser 'od dam pa 'di ni bshad gnang bsadu bye/ /stong gsum 'jig rten khams 'di 0kun khyab pa'i/ /lha mi thams cad rab tu dga' bar 'gyur(nya/ /rgyal pos 2rnyes phyogs yangs shing gtsang ma'i 9 steganas/ /rin chen gya nom mchog gis rab brgyan 2gete/ /spos chu dam pa dag 8nyagis chag chag btab/ /me tog sna tshogs dag ni gcal 8 7du bkram/ /gnas mchog der ni stan mtho rab bting ste / /ba dan bla re bres nas mdzes par byas/ /phye ma byug gi spos rnam pa sna 89—322

tshogs kyis/ /bdug pa dag ni ①kun du khyab par byas/ /lha klu lha ma yin dang mi 'am ci/ /sto 'phye chen po dang ni gnod sbyin dang / /lha rnams man dā ra ba'i ②char phab nas/ /thams cad nyer 'ongs stan ②mchog de la mchod/ /gzhan yang lha ni 'bum phrag brgya dustong rnams/ /dam chos nyan mos thams cad der ni ⑤'dus/ /chos smra dang po stan las langs pa'i tshe/ /thams cad lha yi me tog dag gis mchod/ /de tshe chos smra chen po rin chen brtsegasadu/ /shin tu lus bkrus gos gtsang rab bgos te/ /tshogs chen chos stan de drung ⑦song nas ni / /thal sbyar rtse gcig sems kyis gus phyag byas/ /lha dbang lha tshogs lha yi ⑧bu mo rnams/ /thams cad me tog man dā ⑨ra yang gtor/ / lha yi 0rol mo brgya stong bsam mi khyab/ /mkha' la gnas nas sgra dbyangs snyan par 0phyung / /de tshe chos smra chen po rin chen brtsegs8/ /stan la 'dug ste skyil mo krung ⑫bcas nas④/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing na bzhugs pa'i byams chen gtso/ /bye ba brgya stong de dag yid la bsams/ /sdug bsngal sems can thams cad ji snyed pa/ /thams cad byams sems mnyam pa nyer gzhag 8nas/ /gsol 'debs bdag po rgyal po legs pa'i 8phyir/ /gser 'od dam pa'i mdo sde ⑩rab tu bshad/ /rgyal pos de 'dra'i chos ni thos gyur nas/ /thal sbyar rtse gcig rjes su yi rang smras/ /ya mtshan chos thos mchi ma blags hunyete ngus/ /lus dang sems ni dga' chen kun khyab gyur/ /de tshe yul bdag rgyal po legs skyes kyis//mdo sde 'di ni mchod par 'dod pa'i phyir/ /lag na yid bzhin nor bu thogs nas ni/ /sems can kun phyir smon lam 'di skad btab/ /'dzam gling 'di ni kun du khyab par yang / /rin chen rgyan phreng char ni rab hu)phab nas/ /nor 83—323

dang yo byad rgyad phongs ji snyed pa/ /thams cad yid bzhin bde ba ⑦myong bar shog /de nas rin chen sna bdun char phab nas/ /gling bzhi kun du chog cing tshim byas pas/ /lus kyi rgyan phreng gos dang zas skom dang / /ci dang ci 'dod phongs pa med par gyur/ /de tshe yul bdag rgyal po legs skyes kyis/ /gling bzhi rin chen char bab ②mthong ba dang / / thams cad lasangs rgyas rin chen rjogatsug phud kyi/ /bstan la zhugs ⑤pa'i dge slong dge 'dun mchod/ /'das pa'i rgyal po legs skyes gang yin pa/ /shākya thub pa nga yin shes par byos/ /sngon yang sa chen mang po rab btang 0ste/ /rin chen dag gis gling bzhi yongs su bkang / /sngon tshe chos mkhan chen po rin chen brtsegs④/ /legs skyes de la gya rnam chos bshad de/ /mdo sde'i rgyal po de dag ⑧bshad pa'i phyir/ /shar phyogs sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs grub pa yin/ /ngas ni mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di mnyan nas/ /thal sbyar rtse gcig yi rang brjod pa dang / /rin chen sna bdun btang ba'i bsod nams kyis/ /rdo rje sku mchog 'di ni brnyes pa yin/ /gser 'od bsod nams brgya yi mtshan brgyan ⑨pas/ /mthong ba thams cad kun ni rab dga' zhing / /sems can thams cad kun gyi snying du sdug /lha tshogs mang po bye ba kun de bzhin/ /'das tshe bskal pa bye ba dgu bcu dgu/ /'khor los sgyur 7ba'i rgyal po dag kyang byas/ /yul khams chung ngur mi yi rgyal po byas/ /gzhan yang bskal pa brgya stong tshad med snyed/ /brgya byin lha yi ⑩dbang po dag kyang byas/ /tshangs pa'i rgyal po chen po dag byas te/ /phyogs bcu'i byams chen gtso la mchod pa yi/ /de yi grangs tshad shin tu mthar thug dka' / /ngas sngon mdo thos rjes su yi rang dge/ /bsod nams phung po ci 89—324

yod tshad shes dka'/ /bsod nams de dbang byang chub mngon rtogs nas/ /chos sku yang dag ye shes dam pa brnyes/ /de nas 'khor mang po rnams de skad ces bka' stsal pa thos pas ①ngo mtshar rmad du gyur nas thams cad kyis mdo sde gser 'od dam pa spel zhing rgyun mi 'chad par spyad par mos par gyur to/ /gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba mdo sde'i rgyal po las rgyal po legs skyes kyi ②le'u ste nyi shu gcig pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dpal gyi lha mo chen mo ③la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /shin tu dang ba'i sems rjodad pa dang ldan pa'i rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis ⑤'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / yangs shing rgya che ba dag gis mchod par byed par 'dod pa dang / dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul zab mo shes shing rtogs par 'dod pa gang yin pa des gdon mi za bar sems rtse gcig tu mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di grong khyer ram/ grong rdal lam/ ri 'am/ nags tshal gang yang rung ste/gnas de dang de dag tu sems can rnams la rgya cher yang dag par bstan nas yongs su spel bar bya'o/ /chos nyan pa gang yin pa de yang rnam par g.yeng ba'i ( sa'adu shes spangs nas rna (peblags (shete sems rtse gcig tu gzhag par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha mo de dang 'khor mang po rnams la tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ gang zhig sangs rgyas mang po la/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mchod pa dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /spyod yul zab mo shes 83—325

'dod na/ /gal te gser 'od ①dam pa 'di/ /yang dag phye bshad mthong gyur na/ /de yi phyogs su nyer song nas/ /de yi drung du 'gro bar bya/ /mdo 'di bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /yon tan mang po spyod ②byed cing / /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho mtha' med las③/ /sems can rnams ni thar bar byed/ /nga yi rjomado 'di rnam bltas na/ /thog ma bar dang tha mar ⑤dge/ /shin tu zab pas dpag par dka'/ /dpe dag gis ni zla byar med/ /gang gā'i 0bye ma sa chen rdul / /rgya mtsho'i tshuchu dang nam mkha' dang / /ri brag thams cad gang gis kyang ske/ /cha shas tsam yang dper dubyar med/ /chos dbyings zab mor ⑨'jug 'dod na/ /mdo 'di ⑩sngar ni mnyan par bya0/ /chos nyid mchod rten gang na bar/ /zab mo shin tu bde bar gnas/ /mchod rten 'di yi nang dag tu/ /shākya thub pa nga yis ni/ /yid 'ong sgra dbyangs dam pa yis/ /mdo sde 'di bshad ⑩mthong bar 8'gyur/ / des na 8grangs tshad bsam dka' skeba'i/ /bskal pa bye ba snyed du ni/ /lha dang mi yi nang skyes nas/ /rtag tu bde ba mchog myong 'gyur/ /mdo sde 'di ni mnyan ⑩pa yis/ /bdag ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /bsod nams phung po 'thob 'gyur zhes/ /de snyam du ni bsam par bya/ /gal te me chen phung po dag /dpag tshad brgya ni gang gyur 0kyang / /mdo sde'i lhonyergyal po 'di mnyan 7phyir/ /dka' ba med par 'gro bar bya/ /de yi so )gnas su phyin nas ni/ /'di 'dra'i mdo 'di thos gyur na/ /sdig pa'i las rnams 'byang 'gyur zhing / /rmi lam ngan pa sel bar 'gyur/ /gza' skar ma rungs ltas ngan dang / /byad stems log pa'i gdon la sogs/ /mdo sde 'di ni thos pa'i tshe/ /sdig pa mang po spong bar byed/ /stan mtho mchog ni rab 89—326

brgyan ①nas/ /rab gtsang pad+ma 'dra ba la/ /chos smra steng du phyin nas ni/ /klu chen lta bur 'dug par bya/ /de la bde bar 'dug nas ni/ /zab mo'i mdo 'di bshad par bya/ /yi ger bris nas klog 'dzin dang / /de yi don ni bshad par bya/ /chos smra ①stan ni spangs nas ni/ /phyogs gzhan dag tu song gyur kyang / /khri stan mthon po de las ni/ /cho 'phrul mtshan ma mang 'byung bdu/ /res 'ga' chos smra mkhan po'i gzugs/ /stan mtho ④steng na 'dug par mthong | /res 'ga' sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang mthong / /res 'ga' kun du bzang po'i gzugs/ /res 'ga' 'jam dpal lta bu dang / /res 'ga' byams pa gtso bo'i gzugs/ /stan mtho'i ⑤steng na 'dug par mthong / /res 'ga' ya mtshan mtshan ma dang / /lha ni mang po rnams kyi gzugs/ /yud tsam du ni mthong gyur kyang / /de ma thag tu mi snang 'gyur/ /bkra shis mang po rdzogs byed pas/ /byas pa thams cad yid bzhin 'grub/ /yon tan rnams ni yongs rdzogs par/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad gsungs/ /mchog tu rnam rgyal grags dang ldan⑥/ /nyon mongs mang po zhi bar byed/ /pha rol dgra rnams rab tu sel/ /g.yul 'gyed tshe na rtag par rgyal/ /rmi lam ngan pa thams cad med/ /dug dang gnod pa mang po zhi/ /las gagasum sdig pa ci byas pa(kye/ /mdo sde'i mthu yis byang 6)bar byed/ /'dzam bu'i gling ni 'di dag kun0/ /grags pa kun du rgyas par 'gyur/ /'khon hunye'adzin dgra ni ji snyed pa/ /phan tshun 'khon 8ni gtong bar 'gyur / /gal te dgra ni phyin gyur kyang / /ming thos tsam gyis ldog 'gyur bas//mtshon cha g.yo ba 8mi ltos pasayi/ /dgra gnyis shedaga' ba skye bar tso'agyur/ /83—327

tshangs rgyal ①dang ni brgya byin dbang / /'jig rten skyong dang rgyal chen rgyabazhi/ /lag na rdo rje gnod sbyin dang / /sde dpon chen po yang dag shes/ /klu yi rgyal po ma dros dang / /klu yi rgyal po rgya mtsho dang / /mi 'am ci dang rol mo'i lha/ /lha ma yin dang gser 'dab ①bdag /lha mo spobs pa chen mo rjodang / /dpal gyi lha mo chen mo dang / /'di la sogs pa lha yi gtso/ /so sor lha tshogs khrid nas ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams la mchod par dubyed/ /dkon mchog chos ni bsam mi khyab/ /rtag par dga' ba'i sems kyis ni/ /mdo sde la ni bkur ste byed / /'di la sogs pa'i dulha mang po/ /thams cad lhan cig 'grogs nas ni / /bsod nams sgrub pa rnam ⑦bltas nas/ /lhan cig 'di skad smra bar byed / /sems can 'di dag rab tu ltos/ /bsod nams yon tan che ldan zhing / /dge rtsa brtson 'grus stobs kyis ni/ /bdag cag lha gnas skye 'gyur zeraX / /mdo sde zab mo mnyan pa'i phyir/ /gus pa'i sems kyis der 'ongs nas / /yang dag chos ni bkur ba'i phyir/ /chos kyi mchod rten mchod par ⑨byed/ /sems can kun la snying brtse bas/ /phan pa chen po byed pas na/ /mdo sde zab mo 'di dag gi/ /chos kyi rin chen snod kyang byed/ /chos kyi sgo 'dir gang zhugs ⑩pa/ /chos nyid la ni 'jug 'gyur bas/ /mdo sde gser 'od dam pa 'di/ /rtse gcig sems kyis mnyan par bya/ /sangs rgyas brgya stong tshad med la/ /gang zag de dag mchod pas na/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba de dbang gis/ /mdo sde 'di ni thos pa yin/ /'di ltar lha yi bdag po dang / /lha mo spobs pa chen mo 9/nyadang / /dpal gyi lha mo de dang ni/ /rgyal chen ris 8bzhi'i lha rnams dang / /gnod sbyin 'khor ni grangs med pa/ /dpa' zhing rdzu 'phrul 83—328

ldan pa rnams/ /so sor phyogs bzhi dag nas ni/ /rtag tu 'ongs nas skyob par byed/ /nyi zla brgya byin lha dbang dang / /rlung dang chu dang me yi lha/ /khyab 'jug dang ni phrag chen dang / /gshin rje spobs pa ②lha mo dang / /'jig rten mgon po la sogs pa/ /rab dpal ②gzi ldan thams cad kun/ /mdo sde 'dzin pa dusrung byed pasaX/ /nyin mtshan rtag par yong ⑤mi 'bral/ /gnod sbyin rgyal po stobs po che/ /mthu chen dang ni dbang phyug dang / /gtso bo yang dag shes la sogs/ /gnod sbyin nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / /gzhan yang gnod sbyin brgya stong rnams/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs chen duldan pa dag /rtag par 'jigs pa'i gnas rnams su/ /nyer 'ongs ⑦gang zag de srung labyed/ /lag na rdo rje gnod sbyin rgyal/ /'khor ni lnga brgya ⑨bcas pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i tshogs/ /rtag par nyer 'ongs de srung 0byed/ /rin chen rgyal po gnod sbyin dbang / /de bzhin rdzogs bzang rgyal 7po dang / /'brog gnas ⑩dang ni ku be tsor/ /zas sbyin kha dog ser po dang / /'di la sogs pa'i gnod sbyin rgyal④/ /so sor g.yog 8'khor lnga brgyar ⑩bcas thams cad nyer 'ong srung ⑩bar byed/ /sna tshogs sde dang dri za dang / /'dam bu rgyal po rtag tu 8rgyal/ /nor bu gtsug tunyedang ne gan dang gu / /char pa'i dbang po de dag dang / /mchog 0tu rgyal ba nag po che/ /su bar+ṇa dang ke dusha dang / /partsi duka dang ra rkang dang / /de bzhin skal ⑥ba chen po dang / /pra ma li chung tsochos skyong dang / /spre'u rnams kyi ni rgyal po dang / /khab spu zhunyedang ni nyi ma'i gnyen/ /rin chen gtsug phud 'i 〉srung bar byed/ /pra ni 0li chen na ku phyal/ /bdun pa dang ni 'dod mchog dang / /mthu bo che dang gangs ri dang / /bde 83—329

ba'i ri yang de bzhin te/ /thams cad rdzu 'phrul che ldan zhing / /rab dpa' mthu stobs ldan pa yang / /mdo sde 'di 'dzin mthong gyur ①na/ /thams cad 'ongs nas srung ②bar byed/ /ma dros klu yi rgyal po dang / klu yi ①rgyal po rgya mtsho dang / btang bzung dang ni e la'i 'dabadu/ /dga' bo dang ni nye dga' bo / /klu ni brgya stong mang po'i nang / /rdzu 'phrul dang ni gzi byin ldan/ /mdo sde 'dzin pa srung dubyed pas/ /nyin mtshan rtag par yong dumi 'bral/ /ba li ⑦dang ni sgra gcan dang / / thags zangs ⑤ris dang sdom ⑨pa pa bong bu dpung ⑩dang phrag chen dang / /de bzhin du ni rab dga' dang / /lha min rgyal ⑪po gzhan rnams dang / /lha yi tshogs ni grangs med pa/ /stobs chen tsorab tu dpa' ba rnams/ /thams cad 'ongs nas de srung 'byed/ /'phrog ma 'byung po rnams kyi ma/ /gnod sbyin 'khor ni lnga brgya rnams/ /mi de gnyid log sad kyang rung / /rtag par 'ongs nas srung 8bar byed/ /ma rungs pa dang gdug ⑫pa dang / /gnod sbyin lag na dbyug thogs dang / /dung 0chen dang ni so brtsegs ma/ /sems can kun gyi mdangs 'phrog pa/ /de 'dra'i lha tshogs mang po rnams/ /mthu chen rdzu 'phrul ldan pa kun/ /mdo sde 'dzin pa rtag bsrungs pasabo / /nyin mtshan rtag par yong mi 'bral/ /gtso 1nyemo spobs pa chen mo dang ske/ /lha yi bu mo tshad med dang / /dpal gyi lha mo gtso mo dang / /de yi 'khor ni mang po dang / /sa chen 'di yi lha mo dang / /lo tog kun dga' nags tshal lha/ /shing gi lha dang chu rlung lha()/ /mchod rten lha la sogs pa dang rka/ /de la sogs pa'i 3)lha mang po/ /dga' chen sems ni rab bskyed nas/ /mdo sde 'di ni 'dzin zhunyapa la/ /thams cad 'ongs nas srung 'bar byed/ /mdo 89—330

sde 'dzin pa mthong gyur na/ /tshe dang kha dog stobs 'phel byed/ /gzi byin dang ni yon tan dang / /mtshan mchog gis ni brgyan par 'gyur①/ /gza' skar ltas ngan ston pa dang / /de la nyam thag byur byung dang / /mi lam ltas ngan mthong ba yang / /thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed/ /sa chen 'di yi lha mo yang ③/ rab brtan gzi byin mthu stobs ldan③/ /mdo sde 'di yi mthu yis ni//chos kyi ro yis rtag tshim pasaX/ /sa bcud thur 0du song ba yang du/ /dpag tshad brgya ni yan chad du/ /sa bcud gyen du 'phags byas nas/ /sa chen 'di ni snum par byed/ /sa yi rngams ⑦bu dpag tshad ni/ /'bum phrag drug cu nirtsa brgyad nas/ /rdo rje'i ⑨gzhi la thug pa'i bar/ /sa bcud thams cad gyen du 'phags/ /mdo sde'i 0rgyal po 'di thos dbang / /bsod nams phung po che thob yipas/ /lha yi 'khor ni mang po rnams/ /thams cad phan yon thob par 'gyur/ /gzhan yang lha tshogs mang po rnams/ /mthu stobs 'od dang ldan 'gyur zhing / /rab dga' rtag tu bde byed pas/ /nyams 8pa'i mtshan ma spong bar 'gyur/ /'dzam 0bu'i gling ni 'di nang gi/ /nags tshal 'bras bu lo tog lhayi/ /mdo sde 'di yi byin brlabs kyis 8/ /sems ni rtag tu dga' thob pa / /lo tog thams cad legs 'gyur zhing / /kun du me tog dam pa dang / /'bru rnams thams cad 'phel 'gyur bas0/ /sa chen kun du rgyas par 'gyur/ /'bras bu'i ljon shing mang po dang / /3nyethams cad lo tog mchog skyes nas/ /dri zhim rtag par /pokun du 'thul/ /rtswa ( )mang ljon shing rnams las kyang / /me tog dam pa skye 'gyur zhing / /'bras bu zhim po skye 'gyur bas/ /thams cad kun du gang bar 'gyur/ /'dzam 2nyebu'i gling ni 'di dag tu/ /klu yi bu mo tshad med snyed/ /83—331

rab tu dga' ba'i sems bskyed nas/ /thams cad kun du zhugs nas ni/ /me tog rnam ①pa du ma ②dang / /de bzhin pad+ma dkar po dang / /pad+ma sngon po dmar ③po gnyis/ /bskyed dunas rdzing kun gang bar 'gyur/ /mdo sde 'di yi ⑤byin brlabs 0kyis/ /nam mkha' gtsang zhing sgrib ⑦pa med/ /sprin dang khug rna yongs su sel/ /mun nag thams cad snang bar 'gyur/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer stong 'gyed pas/ /dri med 'od ni rnam par dag /mdo sde'i nirgyal po 'di yi ⑨mthus/ /gling bzhi yongs bskor gsal bar byed/ /mdo sde 'di yi byin brlabs ⑩kyis/ /lha yi bu rnams bstangs pas na/ /thams cad 'dzam bu'i gser dag gis/ /gzhal med khang ni byed par 'gyur/ /nyi zla dang po 'char ⑪ba'i tshe/ /gling 'di mthong na rab dga' bas/ /rtag par snang ba chen po yis//thams cad kun du gsal bar byed/ /sa chen 'di la yod pa yi/ /pad+ma'i ⑫rdzing ni ji snyed pa/ /nyi mas dus bzhin gsal byed pas/ /kha ni mi 'byed gang yang med/ /'dzam bu'i gling ni 'di dag tu/ /lo 0tog 'bras bu sman rnams kun/ /thams cad legs shing smin 'gyur bas/ /sa chen kun du gang bar 'gyur/ /mdo sde 'di yi byin brlabs ④kyis/ /nyi zla snang bar byed pa'i gnas / /rgyu skar tshad las mi 'da' zhing / /rlung char dus bzhin ldang 'bab ⑫pas/ /'dzam gling 'di dag kun du yang / /yul rnams lo legs skyid par 'gyur/ /gang na mdo sde 'di bzhugs pa/ /phyogs gzhan dag las ⑩khyad par 'phags/ /gser 'od dam pa'i mdo sde 'di/ /gang du spel zhing 'don pa dang ske/ /rnam phye 'chad par 7byed pa'i gnas/ /bsod nams gong ma 8thob par 'gyur/ /de nas 9/cadapal gyi lha mo chen mo dang / lha la sogs pa mang po de 89—332

dag bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa thos nas/ de thams ①cad rab du dga' bas mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di dag ②yongs su 'dzin par byed pa de dag la/ sems rtse gcig tu yongs su bsrungs ③nas mya ngan gyi duganod pa med cing rtag tu bde ba thob ⑤par 'gyur bas dumos par gyur tol/ /gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba ⑧mdo sde'i rgyal po las lha dang gnod sbyin rnams kyis ⑨yongs su bsrung 0zhing 'dzin par byed pa'i le'u ste nyi shu gnyis pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pas 'khor mang po'i nang du rgya cher yang dag par chos ⑩bshad nas byang chub sems dpa' mdzes pa'i tog dang / de'i 8bu gnyis po dngul gyi tog dang / dngul gyi tso'od ces bya ba gnyis po bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan par bzhed par gyur pa dang /de'i tshe lha'i bu stong phrag bcu mchog tu rgyal ba'i bu'od ces bya ba gtso bor gyur pa dang lhan cig tu sum cu 0rtsa gsum lha'i gnas nas babs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar lhags nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑩bkas bshad pa'i chos nyan ⑩par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' mdzes pa'i tog la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /khyod ma 'ongs pa'i dus bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag brgya stong tshad med grangs med pa snyed 'das pa na gser 'od ces bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams su bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur bas/ de bzhin gshegs 89—333

pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang / zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa①/ bla na med pa'i skyes bu kha lo sgyur ba/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gser dang rin po che'i ri bo'i rgyal po zhes bya bar gyur nas 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu bstan pa'i chos rnams nub par gyur pa dang / de'i tshe 'di'i bu chen po dngul gyi tog ②ces bya ba 'jig rten gyi khams de nyid du de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyal tshab tu gyur te/ de'i tshe de'i ming bsgyur nas rnam dag tog ces bya bar 'gyur zhing mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur bas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ bla na med pa'i skyes bu kha lo sgyur ba/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gser tog 'od ces bya bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa de yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu bstan pa'i chos rnams nub par gyur pa dang /'di'i bu chung ngu dngul gyi 'od de bzhin gshegs pa de'i nirgyal tshab tu 'gyur bas 'jig rten gyi khams de nyid du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/bla na med pa'i skyes bu kha lo sgyur ba/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gser 'od ces bya bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan to/ /de nas de'i tshe lha'i bu stong phrag bcu po de dag gis skyes bu chen po gsum po de 89—334

dag gis ①lung bstan pa yang thos/ 'di ltar mdo sde'i rgyal po mchog ②dam pa 'di yang thos pas sems rab tu dga' ba skyes dunas rnam par dag cing dri ma med par gyur pas dper na nam mkha' lta bur gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pas lha'i bu stong phrag bcu po de dag dge ba'i rtsa ba ④yongs su smin par thugs kyis ⑤mkhyen pas byang chub chen por lung bstan nas/ 'di skad du lha'i bu khyed cag ma 'ongs pa'i bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag brgya stong tshad med grangs med pa snyed 'das pa na/ 'jig rten gyi khams dbang po'i tog mngon par 'phags pa zhes bya bar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur te/ rus rigs kyang mthun/ming yang ⑥mthun par 'gyur bas thams cad zhal dang spyan rnam par dag cing /ut+pa la'i ④gri'i ri mo ⑧zhes bya ba mtshan rnam pa bcu phun sum tshogs par 'gyur te/ 'di ltar rim ⑨bzhin du sangs rgyas stong phrag bcu 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub kyi shing gi lha mos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das lha'i bu stong phrag bcu po 'di dag ni sum cu 0rtsa gsum lha'i gnas nas chos mnyan /napa'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar mchis pa lags na/ ci'i tunyeslad du de bzhin gshegs pas mngon par rdzogs par 8'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan par mdzad lags/ bdag gis ④ni lha'i bu 'di dag pha rol tu phyin pa drug phun sum tshogs par bsgoms nas dka' 7ba spyad de/ lag pa dang / rkang pa dang / mgo dang / mig dang / rkang dang / klad 7rgyas dang / g.yog 'khor dang / bu dang / 'chis 'brang 9/tshedang / glang po che dang / rta dang /83—335

shing rta dang / bran pho ①dang / bran mo dang / mngag gzhug bgyid pa dang / khang khyim dang /② kun dga' ra ba dang / nags tshal dang / gser dang /dngul dang / be+e ḍūr+ya dudang / spug dang / rdo'i snying po dang / byi duru dang /man shel dang / dung dang / bza' ba dang / btung ba dang / gos dang /mal cha dang / gsos sman dag sbyin pa yongs su gtong bar yang ⑤ma thos te/byang chub sems dpa' brgya stong tshad ma mchis pa gzhan dag ni mchod pa'i yo byad mang pos 'das pa'i sangs rgyas 'bum phrag khrag khrig brgya stong grangs ma mchis pa snyed la mchod pa bgyis nas/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' de dag so so nas bskal pa tshad ma mchis shing mtha' ma mchis pa snyed lon nas gdod de'i rjes la byang chub tu lung bstan pa 'thob par 'gyur ba yilags na/ bcom ldan 'das lha'i bu 'di dag rgyu charkyen ni gang / spyod pa mchog ni ji lta bu zhig ⑧mngon par bsgrubs/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ni ji lta bu zhig bskrun ⑨na lha'i gnas de nas 'dir mchis te/ yud tsam zhig chos thos pa 'di 0nyid kyis lung bstan pa thob 17par gyur bilags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 8bdag la bkas ④bshad de the com 0gyi dra ba gcad ⑩du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis shing gi lha mo la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi lha mo khyod kyis ji skad smras pa bzhin te/ 'di dag thams cad ni dge ba'i rtsa ba mchog dam pa'i rgyu dang rkyen dang nan tan brtson 'grus kyis dka' ba bsgrubs 7nas gdod lung bstan pa thob pa yin pas lha'i bu mang po 'di dag lha'i gzhal med khang mchog dam pa nas 'dod pa lnga'i bde ba lho spangs te/ ched du gser 'od dam pa'i mdo sde 'di mnyan tu)du 'ongs pa yin pas chos thos par gyur nas kyang mdo sde 'di la sems kyis (nyegus pa 83—336

bskyed de/ be+e ḍūr+ya ①yongs su dag pa ltar skyon gyi dri ma med par gyur pa dang /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gsum po 'di ③lung bstan pa'i dngos po yang thos pa dang / gzhan yang 'das pa'i dus kyi tshe yun ring por yang dag pa'i ①spyod pa bsgrubs nas yi dam chen po blangs pa'i rgyu dang rkyen de'i phyir/ ngas dum 'ongs pa'i dus na bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par ⑤'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa yin no/ /de dag 0shing gi lha mo des bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa thos nas༅/ rab tu dga' bas mngon par yid ches par gyur to/ /gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba mdo sde'i rgyal po las lung bstan pa'i le'u ste nyi shu gsum pa'o// — //bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub kyi shing gi lha mo la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi lha mo legs par nyon la shin tu yid la zung ⑧shig dang / lha'i bu stong phrag bcu po 'di dag gi sngon gyi smon lam gyi rgyu dang rkyen gang yin pa deng khyod la bshad par bya'o/ /rigs kyi lha mo sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus kyi bskal pa grangs med pa/ tshad med cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa de'i tshe de'i dus na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ bla na med pa'i skyes bu kha lo sgyur po)ba/ lha dang mi ⑩rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rin chen gtsug phud phonyeces bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/rigs kyi lha mo de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das de yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og 89—337

tu yang dag pa'i chos nub par gyur nas gzugs brnyan gyi chos kyi tshe rgyal po lha'i dbang phyug gi ②'od ces bya ba zhig yod de/ rtag par yang dag pa'i chos kyis pha ma bzhin du mi ②rnams la rjes su ston ②par byed do/ /rgyal po de'i yul na tshong dpon chu 'dzin ces bya ba sman gyi rig pa ④la shin tu mkhas pa/ shes pa'i yan lag brgyad legs par khong du chud pa/ sems can gyi nad kyi sdug bsngal 'byung ba chen po bzhi mi mthun pa las gyur pa thams cad yongs su skyob cing gso bar byed pa zhig yod de②/ rigs kyi lha mo de'i tshe tshong dpon chu 'dzin de la bu chu 'bebs zhes bya ba byad ⑥bzhin sdug cing mdzes pa/ mang po kun gyis ⑦blta bar mos pa/ rang bzhin gyis 0sems myur ba/ gtsug lag rnams legs par rtogs pa⑨/ yi ge dang / ri mo dang / rtsis dang / grangs rnams mngon par mi rtogs ⑩pa gang yang med pa zhig yod par gyur to/pa/de'i tshe rgyal po de'i yul khams na sems can brgya stong tshad med pa snyed nad kyi sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis rab tu gzir bar gyur pas tha na dga' bar gyur pa'i thonyesems cung zad tsam yang med par gyur to/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu chu 'bebs sems can brgya stong tshad med pa de dag nad kyi sdug bsngal myong bar gyur pa tsomathong ba dang / snying rje chen po'i sems bskyed nas 'di 7snyam du sems can tshad med pa 'di snyed 8sdug bsngal mi bzad snyipas nyon mongs par gyur te/ bdag gi pha tshong dpon sman dpyad tshil shin tu mkhas shing shes pa'i yan lag brgyad legs par khong du chud de/ 'byung ba chen po bzhi 'phel zhing 'grib pa las byung ba'i nad sna tshogs gso bar nus kyang rgas 'khogs pas lus kyi nyam chung zhing dma' 11ba dang / 'khar lho ba la brten nas gdod 'gro bas 89—338
