yin no/ /rigs kyi bu gser 'od dam pa ①mdo sde'i dbang po 'di'i phan yon rnam pa sna tshogs 'byung bar 'gyur te/ byang chub kyi dge ba'i chos rnams ②yongs su rgyas par 'gyur ba dang / las kyi sgrib pa'i rgyun thams cad gcod par 'gyur ro/ /yang zhudage slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/dge bsnyen ma gang ④la la zhig gis gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i ⑤dbang po 'di 'chad cing ston pa'i gnas dang / yul 'khor der phan yon rnam pa 'di bzhi 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ yul de'i rgyal po nad med cing gnod pa thams cad dang bral tsu)bar 'gyur ba dang / tshe ring zhing bar chad mi 'byung ba dang / dgra dang pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyis 'joms par mi 'gyur ba dang / bde bar (75longs spyod cing dam pa'i chos yongs su rgyas par byed pa de ni/ mi'i rgyal po de la narabargya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi dang / gnod sbyin gyi bdag po la sogs pas yongs su bsrungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i 'khor de dag la rigs kyi bu dag/de de lta yin nam zhes bka' stsal pa dang / de nas brgya byin dang / tshangs pa la sogs pa tshad med pa'i 'khor de dag gis 59)so so nas tshig 'di skad ces gsol to/ /de de lta lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das yul 'khor gang du mdo sde'i dbang po 'di klog cing 'don pa dang / ston pa de'i rgyal po dang / yul 'khor der mchis te/ de la bdag cag gis rtag tu bsrung dzab dang / lhan cig gnas par bgyis te/ rgyal po de'i phas kyi dgra dang / gnod pa dang /bar chad dang / nad dang / mya ngan la sogs pa thams cad ma mchis par bgyi'oX/ /tshe ring ba dang / bde ba dang / bkra 17shis su ldan zhing bsam nyu pa 89wa 545

thams cad 'grub pas/ rtag par ①sems dga' bar ②yang bgyi'o/ /rgyal po'i 'khor de'i dmag rnams kyang dpa' zhing rtul niphod par bgyi'odu/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis legs so zhes bka' stsal te⑤/legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu dag ji skad smras pa de bzhin du sgrubs ⑥shig dang ske/ rgyal po de chos bzhin du spyod pas/ de'i 'bangs rnams kyang rgyal po bzhin chos bzhin spyod par 'gyur ro/ /de la khyed kyi ⑦mthu dang kha dog phun sum tshogs pas bstang ⑤zhing phan pa dam pas gnas 6)dang / 'khor la sogs pa 'od can du gyis ⑩shig /de nas brgya byin dang / tshangs pa la sogs pas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis ji skad bka' stsal pa bzhin du bgyi'o zhes gsol to/ /de nas yang 17bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang mdo sde'i dbang po 'di ston tshapa dang / rgyas par byed pa'i gnas dang / yul der rgyal po'i blon po rnams la phan yon rnam pa 'di 7bzhi 'byung bar 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/gcig la gcig gus shing / mdza' ba'i sems su 'gyur ba dang / rtag tu rgyal pos gnang zhing / dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / rgyal phran la sogs pas btsun par 'dzin pa dang / dam pa'i chos don du gnyer zhing khe dang grags pa mi tshol bas grags pa chen po phyogs su rgyas shing kun gyis bstod pa dang ske/ tshe ring zhing bde bar longs spyod pa ste/ bzhi po de dag go/ /gzhan yang dam pa'i chos 'di ston pa'i yul de'i dge sbyong dang / bram ze rnams la phan yon 'di bzhi 'byung ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / mal cha dang / sman la sogs pas phongs par mi 'gyur ba dang / de dag kun kyang klog pa dang / 'don pa'i bsam pas sems bde bar 'gyur ba 89—546

dang / ri dang nags tshal la sogs par gnas pas ①bde bar gnas par 'gyur ba dang / gang brnag par bya ba'i bsam pa de yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba dang bzhi po de dag go/ /gzhan yang mdo 'di 'don pa'i yul de'i skye bo de dag nad med cing bde ba 'phel ba dang / nor dang yo byad dang / rin po che la sogs pa bsgrub ②pa myur du 'grub cing / bsod nams 'phel ba la sogs te/ phan yon rnam pa de dag dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de nas brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi la sogs pa'i 'khor de dag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das don zab mo ②ston pa'i mdo sde 'di ji byasrid 'jig rten na gnas kyi bar du byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyi chos rnams kyang gnas par 'gyur ro/ /mdo sde 'di nam mi bzhugs par gyur pa'i dus der/ dam pa'i chos rnams kyang med par 'gyur ro zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de de lta'o/ /rigs kyi bu dag ⑤de lta bas na khyod 0kyis gser 'od dam pa'i mdo 'di las tha na tshig gcig gam/ tshigs su bcad pa gcig gam/ le'u gcig gam/ sde tshang bar yang rung ste/ yang dag par gdon par bya/ gzung ⑦bar bya/bsam par bya/ yongs su bsgrub par bya'o/ /sems can mang po'i yun dugyi don dang / phan pa dang / bde ba'i phyir kun la ston cing rgyas par byed na/de bsod nams kyi phung po tshad med pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las/ las kyi sgrib pa rgyun gcod pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //83—547

gros mi zad pa stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs (2)te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de ①logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la rin po che sna tshogs kyi me tog gi gdugs dang / me tog gi phur mas mchod nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi sems byang chub kyi sems zhes bgyi ba/ bcom ldan 'das ji tsam gyis na/ byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi sems gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub la ni sems sam/ byang chub (47sems dpa' ma 95)dmigs/ mi dmigs (6skadamigs par yang mi 'gyur ro/ /byang chub las gud na yang byang chub kyi sems mi dmigs te/byang chub ni brjod du ma mchis/ sems ni gzugs ma mchis/ bstan du ma mchis / thogs pa ma mchis/ rnam par rig pa ma mchis shing / sems dpa' 7yang mi dmigs na/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar tshon chos 'di dag gi don rtogs par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu 'di la byang chub 99)ni brda'am / gdags pa'am/ tha snyad du mi 11dmigs shing /byang chub las gud na/ byang chub kyi sems kyang mi dmigs la/ byang chub ni brjod du med/ sems ni gzugs med/ bstan du med/ thogs pa med1 /rnam par rig pa med de1lha/ sems dpa' yang mi dmigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / byang chub ni brjod du med pa ste/ byang chub ji lta bar sems kyang de 83—548

bzhin no/ /sems ji lta bar byang chub kyang de bzhin no/ /byang chub dang sems ji lta bar sems dpa' rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /sems dpa' rnams ji lta bar 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i chos thams cad kyang ①de bzhin no/ /rigs kyi bu de ②ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byang chub sems dpa'i ming 'thob ②bo/ /chos thams cad kyi rjes su song ba'i sems de ni/ byang chub kyi sems zhes bya'o/ /byang chub ni 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba yang ma yin te/ sems kyang de bzhin no/ /chos thams cad mi dmigs pa'i phyir 'di la ci yang rnyed pa med deli / byang chub kyang med/ byang chub tu gdags pa yang ⑤med/ sems can yang med/ sems can du gdags pa yang med/ nyan thos kyang med/ nyan thos su gdags pa yang med/ rang sangs rgyas kyang med/ rang sangs rgyas su gdags pa yang med/ byang chub sems dpa' yang med/ byang chub sems dpar (spagadags pa yang med/ sangs rgyas kyang med/ sangs rgyas su gdags pa yang med/ 'dus byas kyang med/ 'dus byas su gdags pa yang med/'dus ma byas kyang med/ 'dus ma byas su gdags pa yang mi dmigs (ledamigs par mi 'gyur ba'ori ci/ /rigs kyi bu 'on kyang dper na ri rab kyi tshul du dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyis yang dag par 'phags pa'i sems dang po skyes te(9/ske/ de la rgyu ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /sems bskyed pa gnyis pa ni chos thams cad kyi bya ba'i gnas kyi tshul gyis sa lta bur blta ste de la rgyu ni tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /sems bskyed pa gsum pa ni 'jigs pa med pa dang / bag tsha ba med pa dang / skrag pa med pa'i tshul gyis/ ri dgas kyi 83—549

rgyal po seng ge ral pa can gyi rtsal lta bur blta ①ste/ de la rgyu ni bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /sems bskyed pa bzhi pa ni phyir mi ldog ②pa'i ②tshul gyis/sred med kyi bu'i mthu dang / stobs dang / drag shul ④dang / brtson 'grus dang ske/ brtul (9ba lta bur blta duste/ de la rgyu ni brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /sems bskyed pa lnga pa ni bsod nams kyis chog mi shes pa'i tshul gyis / dge ba sna tshogs kyis yang dag par 'phags pa lta bur blta ste/ de la rgyu ni bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /sems bskyed pa drug pa ni mun pa mun nag chen po sel ba'i tshul gyis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od gsal ba lta bur blta ste/ /de la rgyu ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /sems bskyed pa bdun pa ni ded dpon mdzod chen pos phyug pa lta bur 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon pa las sgrol ba'i tshul gyis/ bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pas de la tsho legs par brgyan pa lta bur 'a)blta ste/ de la rgyu ni thabs (skyemakhas pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /sems bskyed pa brgyad pa ni zla ba nya ba'i ⑩dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa'i dpe'i tshul gyis sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag pa 37yongs su rdzogs par byed pa lta bur 7blta ste/ de la rgyu ni smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /sems bskyed pa dgu pa ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa'i yon tan gyi rgyan bkod pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor gyi tshul gyis/bsam pa thams cad 7yongs su rdzogs par byed pa lta bur thubalta ste/ de la rgyu ni stobs kyi pha tsharol tu phyin pa'o/ /sems bskyed pa bcu pa ni/ yon tan dang ske/ ye shes dang / chos thams cad la dbang sgyur 7bar dbang bskur ba thob pas 'khor los sgyur 1 ba'i mtshan gyi dpe'i tshul gyis/ nam mkha' dang 89—550

mtshungs pa lta bur 0)blta ste/ de la rgyu ni ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin ②pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems bskyed pa ni bcu po 'di dag yin te/ 'di dag dang ldan pas byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya'o/ /don dam par na 'di la byang chub kyang med/ byang chub sems dpa' yang medanub/ byang chub kyi sems kyang med do/ /rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngon du 'gro ba'i chos rnam pa bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ dad pa'i dbang po sngon du 'gro ba dang / bsam pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / lhag pa'i bsam pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / pha rol tu phyin pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / byams pa chen po sngon du 'gro ba dang / snying rje chen po sngon du 'gro ba dang / sems can gyi rten sngon du 'gro ba dang / bsdu ba'i dngos po sngon du 'gro ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos 'dod pa sngon du 'gro ba dang /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'dod pa sngon du 'gro ba ste/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'di'i sngon du 'gro ba'i canachos rnam pa gebacu'o/ /rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi/tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i/ sngon du 'gro ba'i chos rnam pa bcu ste/bcu gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ lus kyi las yongs su dag pa sngon du 'gro ba dang /ngag gi las yongs su dag pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / yid kyi las yongs su dag pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / rnam par mi 'tshe ba tsho sngon du 'gro ba dang / ngan song thams cad rnam par spong ba sngon du 'gro ba dang / mi khom pa brgyad rnam par spong ba sngon du 'gro ba dang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa las 'das pa 7)sngon du 'gro ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi yon tan la dgod (8)pa sngon du 'gro ba 89—551

dang ske/ bsam pa yongs su rdzogs pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / smon lam yongs su rdzogs pa sngon du 'gro ba ste/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngon du 'gro ba'i chos rnam pa 'di bcu'o/ /rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngon du 'gro ba'i chos rnam pa bcu ste/ bcu ①gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rjes su 'chags ri pa spong ba sngon du 'gro ba dang / khong khro ba spong ba sngon du 'gro ba dang —/ lus la mi lta smyo ba sngon du 'gro ba dang / srog la yid mi rten pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / mos pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / sems can yongs su smin par bya ba sngon du 'gro ba dang / byams pa'i stobs sngon du 'gro ba dang / zab mo'i chos la bzod pa sngon du 'gro stib dang / rgya chen po la mos pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / mi shes pa bsal (51ba sngon du 'gro ba ste/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'di'i 57sngon du 'gro ba'i chos rnam pa bcu'o/ /rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi (pebartson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngon du 'gro ba'i chos rnam pa bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ sems can thams cad kyi bya ba ci yod snyam pa sngon du 'gro ba dang /dge ba'i lus dang / ngag dang yid mngon par bsgrub (8)pa la rjes su yi rang ba 9sngon du 'gro ba dang / zhum pa med pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la tshabasdu ba thob par bya ba sngon du 'gro ba dang / yang dag pa'i rtsol 1nyab sngon du 'gro ba dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / nyon mongs pa'i dgra 'dul 1 ba sngon du 'gro ba dang / chos thams cad kyis dben pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / sems can yongs su smin par bya ba sngon du 'gro ba 89—552

dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yang dag par sgrub pa sngon du 'gro ba ste/rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di'i stisdon du 'gro ba'i chos rnam pa bcu'o/ /rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngon du 'gro ba'i chos rnam pa bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dge ba'i chos la gnas pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / ting nge 'dzin sngon du 'gro ba dang / snyoms par 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub sngon du 'gro ba dang / bsam gtan dang rnam par thar pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po sngon du 'gro ba dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs sngon du 'gro ba dang ske/ sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa spong ba (misngon du 'gro ba dang /ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po yongs su rdzogs par byed pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / dam pa'i chos yongs su bsrung ②ba sngon du 'gro ba ste/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di'i ④ston du 'gro ba'i chos rnam pa bcu'o/ /rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngon du 'gro ba'i chos rnam pa 'di (debacu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ phung po la mkhas pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / khams la mkhas pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / skye mched la mkhas pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba la mkhas pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / bden pa la mkhas pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / lta bar gyur pa thams cad bsal ba sngon du 'gro ba dang / shes rab kyi dbang po sngon du 'gro ba dang / mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bya ba sngon du 'gro 83—553

ba dang / sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes mthong ba sngon du 'gro ba ste/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di'i 51)sngon du 'gro ba'i chos rnam pa bcu'o/ /rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thabs la mkhas pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngon du 'gro ba'i chos rnam pa bcu ste/bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sems can gyi bsam pa dang spyod pa la 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / sems can gyi rten sngon du 'gro ba dang / byams pa dang snying rje chen po sngon du 'gro ba dang / sems can yongs su smin par bya ba la mi skyo ba sngon du 'gro ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / khyad par can nagyi ye shes mthong ba khong du chud pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su byang bar bya ba (5)yongs su smin par bya ba ④sngon du 'gro ba dang / dngos po ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su rtog 5)pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / sems kyi stobs nye bar bsgrub (6pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i sa yongs su thob par byed pa sngon du 'gro ba ste/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thabs mkhas pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'di'i (7sngon du 'gro ba'i chos rnam pa bcu'o/ /rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngon du 'gro ba'i chos rnam pa bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi naspyod pa (9)thibs po nye bar rgyu ba shes pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa'i thibs po nye bar rgyu ba shes pa sngon skadu 'gro ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi dbang po thibs po nye bar rgyu ba shes pa sngon du 'gro ba dang /sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa dang mos pa thibs po nye bar rgyu ba shes pa 89—554

sngon du 'gro ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa dang / lhag pa'i bsam pa dang / mos pa thibs po nye bar rgyu ba shes pa sngon du 'gro ba dang /'jig rten gyi khams tha dad pa dang / khams gsum gyi hu)thibs po nye bar rgyu ba shes pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa dang / bag la nyal gyi gethibs po nye bar rgyu ba shes pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi 'chi 'pho dang / skye ba thibs po nye bar rgyu ba shes pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi phung po gsum du rnam par gzhag ④pa thibs po nye na bar rgyu ba shes pa sngon rdogedu 'gro ba dang / dbang po mi skyo ba'i sems can yongs su smin par bya ba shes pa sngon du 'gro ba ste/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi smon lam gyi pha rol tu 5tshephyin pa 'di'i nasngon du 'gro ba'i chos rnam pa bcu'o/ /rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngon du 'gro ba'i chos rnam pa bcu stenyu)/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ chos thams cad gzod 57ma nas 'byung /thob med pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / chos thams cad gzod / ma nas mtshan nyid med pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / chos thams cad gzod tu ma nas skye ba med pa sngon du 'gro ba dang /chos thams cad gzod 7ma nas yod pa ma yin pa masngon du 'gro ba dang / chos thams cad gzod skom nas chags pa med pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / chos thams cad 'jug pa med pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / chos thams cad ldog pa med pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / chos thams cad dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid sngon du 'gro ba dang ske/ chos thams cad kyi thog ma dang bar ma dang tha ma mnyam pa nyid sngon du 'gro ba dang / chos thams cad ’ de bzhin nyid la 'jug pa'i ri shertog pa dang /83—555

rnam par rtog pa med pa sngon du 'gro ba ste/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di'i sngon du 'gro ba'i chos rnam pa bcu'o/ /rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ①sngon du 'gro ba'i chos rnam pa bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ chos thams cad rnam par dbye ba la shin tu rnam par brtags pa sngon du 'gro ba dang /dkar po'i chos shin tu yongs su rdzogs pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / byang chub kyi tshogs bsags pa dpag tu med pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs chen po yongs su bzung ba sngon du 'gro ba dang / snying rje chen po yangs pa khong du chud par bya ba sngon du 'gro ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par dbye ba'i rim pa shes pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / sems can gyi khams dang /nyon mongs pa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul la 'jug cing rjes su 'gro ba shes pa yid la byed pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa la lhag par dmigs shing kun shes par bya ba sngon du 'gro ba dang ②/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la dbang bskur ba'i sa thob pa sngon du 'gro ba ste/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di'i 9bsngon du 'gro ba'i chos rnam pa bcu'o/ /de la pha rol tu phyin pa'i don gang zhe na/ spyod pa'i khyad par yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i don ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i don no/ /ye shes zab cing rgya che ba yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i don ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i don no/ /'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas la chags pa med pa'i don ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i don 83—556

nol/ /'khor ba'i nyes pa ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs pa'i don ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i don no/ /skye bo mi mkhas pa rnams khong du chud par byed pa'i don ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i don no/ /chos kyi mdzod zad mi shes pa yang dag par ston pa'i don ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i don no/ /sgrib pa med pa'i rnam par thar pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i don ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i don no/ /sems can gyi khams rab tu shes par bya ba'i don ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i don no/ /sbyin pa mnyam pa nyid rjes su rtogs pa'i don ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i don no/ /tshul khrims mnyam pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i don ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i don no/ /bzod pa mnyam pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i don ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i don no/ /brtson 'grus mnyam pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i don ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i don no/ /bsam gtan mnyam pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i don ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i don no/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la shes par ①mkhas pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i don ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i don no/ /chos thams cad rab tu shes par bya ba'i ④don ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i don no/ /mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i don ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i don no/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i sa yang dag par thob (bapar byed pa'i don ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i don no/ /lisangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyang ba'i don ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i don no/ /sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba'i ⑤don ni/pha rol tu phyin pa'i don no/ /byang chub kyi snying po la sangs rgyas kyi ye shes yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i don ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i don no/ /bdud 83—557

thams cad gdul bar bya ba'i don ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i don no/ /'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa 0)gnyis su med par ston cing sgrol ②ba'i don ni/pha rol tu phyin pa'i don no/ /yon tan thams cad kyi pha rol tu 'gro ba'i don ni / pha rol tu phyin pa'i don no/ /phas kyi rgol ba thams cad tshar gcod pa'i don ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i don no/ /stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa kyibargyad yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i 4don ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i don no/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i don ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i don no/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 57mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par byed pa'i don ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i don no/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rnam pa bcu gnyis su bskor ba'i don ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i don no/ /rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang po'i snga ltas ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams gter bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gis yongs su gang bar mthong ngo / /rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i byang chub sems dpa'i sa gnyis pa'i snga ltas ni/gang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams lag mthil lta bur gyur pa la rin po che bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas legs par brgyan 6)par mthong ngo / /rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i byang chub sems dpa'i sa gsum pa'i snga ltas ni/ bdag nyid dpa' 7zhing lag cha dang go cha sra ba thogs nas phas kyi rgol ba thams cad 'dul bar mthong ngo / /rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i byang chub sems dpa'i sa bzhi 89—558

pa'i snga ltas ni/ phyogs bzhi nas rlung gi dkyil 'khor bzhis thams cad dang ldan pa'i sa'i dkyil 'khor chen po la me tog sna tshogs kyis mngon du 'thor ①bar mthong ngo / /rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i byang chub sems dpa'i sa lnga pa'i snga ltas ni/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i bud med kyis mgo la me tog tsam pa ku'i phreng ba 'dogs par mthong ngo / /rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i byang chub sems dpa'i sa drug pa'i snga ltas ni/ rdzing them skas bzhi (kyedang ldan pa gser gyi bye ma bdal ba rtog pa med cing dang dkyil yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chus yongs su gang ba me tog ut+pa la dang / ku mu da dang / pad+ma dkar pos brgyan ④pa'i chu mthong ste/ de la bdag nyid rtse dga' zhing (lde)yongs su spyod par mthong ngo / /rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i byang chub sems dpa'i sa bdun pa'i snga ltas ni/ phyogs g.yas g.yon gnyis na/ sems can dmyal ba'i g.yang sa mthong ste/ de nas bdag nyid ma rmas (6)ma nyams par slar ldog pa mthong ngo / /rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i byang chub sems dpa'i sa 57brgyad pa'i snga ltas ni/ phrag pa gnyis na ②ri dgas kyi rgyal po seng ge ral pa can cod pan thogs pa/ gcan gzan phra mo thams cad skrag par byed cing 'dug par mthong ngo / /rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems 9)dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i byang chub sems dpa'i sa dgu pa'i snga dzaltas ni/ 'khor los sgyur 17ba'i rgyal por rtso mthong ste skye bo bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du mas yongs su /2bskor cing mdun gyis bltas la mgo'i /stesteng na nyugerin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i gdugs dkar po 'dzin pa tshemathong ngo / /89wa 559

rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu pa'i snga ltas ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mthong ste/ kha dog gser lta bu'i 'od 'dom gang ba tshangs pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor cing ①mdun gyis bltas nas chos ston par lamathong ste/ rigs kyi bu bcu po 'di dag ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi / byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu po'i ①snga ltas ④yin no/ /de la rigs kyi bu de 2ci'i phyir sa dang po la rab tu dga' ba ⑥zhes bya zhe na/ de ni thog mar 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sems sngon ma thob pa de mngon du gyur te/ don chen po'i bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa'i phyir/ rab tu dga' ba chen po skye bas sa dang po la ⑦rab tu dga' ba zhes bya'o/ /ltung ba phra mo'i dri ma dang / tshul khrims kyi nyes pa thams cad rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ sa sa/nyis pa ni dri ma med pa zhes bya'o/ /tshad med pa'i ye shes dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi ye shes la'od snang ba de bskyod par mi nus shing gang gis kyang zil gyis mi non ⑨pa dang /thos pa 'dzin pa'i gzungs la gnas pa'i phyir sa gsum pa ni 'od byed pa zhes bya'o / /shes rab kyi mes 97nyon mongs pa thams cad sreg cing byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos bsgoms pa'i me'i 'od 'phro ba cher gyur pas sa bzhi pa la (nyeni 'od 'phro ba zhes bya'o/ /de bsgom 7pa'i thabs dang / mchog gi ye shes la dbang sgyur 12bar dka' ba dang / mthong ba dang / bsgoms pas spangs pa'i ④nyon mongs pa thul bobar dka' ba thul ba'i phyir sa lnga pa la ⑩shin tu sbyang dka' ba tu 7zhes bya'o/ /'du byed kyi chos bar chad med par rtsonyamangon du gyur te/ mtshan ma med pa yid la byed pa thams cad mngon du lto)byed pas/ sa drug pa la mngon 83—560

sum pa ①zhes bya'o/ /zag pa med pa'i chos rnams ②la bar chad med cing mtshan ma med pa yid la byed pas/ rnam par grol ba'i ting nge 'dzin la rgyun ring du bsgoms ③pas/ sa de rnam par dag cing thogs pa med pa'i phyir/ sa bdun pa ni ring du song ba zhes bya'o/ /mtshan ma med pa ④yid la byed pa bsgom ⑤pa la dbang thob ste/ nyon mongs pa rnams kyis g.yo bar mi nus pas na/ sa brgyad pa ni mi g.yo ba zhes bya'o/ /rnam pa thams cad du chos ston pa la dbang du gyur pas/ kha na ma tho ba med cing / blo gros shin tu yangs pa thogs pa med pa thob pa'i phyir/ sa dgu pa ni legs pa'i blo gros zhes ⑥bya'o/ /chos kyi sku nam mkha' lta bu la/ ye shes chen po'i sprin lta bus khyab par ⑦'gebs pa'i phyir/sa bcu pa ni chos kyi sprin ces bya'o/ /de la rigs kyi bu chos dang gang zag la/mtshan ma can du mngon par zhen pa'i rmongs pa dang / 'khor ba dang ngan song gi nyon mongs pas 'jigs pa'i rmongs pa dang / rmongs pa 'di gnyis kyis sa dang po la sgrib po/ /ltung ba phra mo'i 'khrul pa la rmongs pa dang / las dang spyod pa rnam pa lasna tshogs mngon par skyed ⑨pa'i rmongs pa dang / rmongs pa 'di gnyis kyis sa gnyis pa la sgrib po/ /ma thob pa thob par 'dod pa'i rmongs pa dang / gzungs dam pa'i mchog thob pa la rmongs pa dang / rmongs pa 'di gnyis kyis sa gsum pa la sgrib po/ /mnyam par gzhag ⑩pa'i ro'i dga' ba la sred pa'i rmongs pa dang / chos rnam par dag pa la sred 0pa'i rmongs pa dang /rmongs pa 'di gnyis kyis sa bzhi pa la sgrib po/ /'khor ba la 8shin tu skyo ba'i rmongs pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa la mngon par gzhol ba'i rmongs pa dang /rmongs pa 'di gnyis kyis sa lnga pa la sgrib po/ /'du byed kyi rgyu ba mngon du gyur 83—561

pa'i rmongs pa dang / mtshan ma sbom po mngon du gyur pa'i rmongs pa dang /rmongs pa 'di gnyis kyis sa drug pa la sgrib po/ /mtshan ma phra mo mngon du gyur pa'i rmongs pa dang / mtshan ma med pa ①yid la byed pa'i rmongs pa dang /rmongs pa 'di gnyis kyis sa bdun pa la sgrib po/ /mtshan ma med pa la ched du rtsol ba'i rmongs pa dang / mtshan mar 'dzin pa la dbang thob pa'i rmongs pa dang tre/5 rmongs pa 'di gnyis kyis sa brgyad pa la sgrib po/ /gang chos ston pa tshad med pa dang / tshig dang yi ge tshad med pa la mkhas par ma gyur pa'i rmongs pa dang / spobs pa la dbang ma thob pa'i rmongs pa dang / rmongs pa 'di gnyis kyis sa dgu pa la sgrib po/ /mngon par shes pa chen po la dbang sgyur ba ma thob pa'i rmongs pa dang / don dang / las gsang 9 ba phra mo la mkhas par ma gyur pa'i rmongs pa dang / rmongs pa 'di gnyis kyis sa bcu pa la sgrib po/ /spyod yul shin tu phra ba thams cad la/ shes bya'i sgrib pa'i rmongs pa dang /nyon mongs pa shin tu phra ba'i gnas ngan len la rmongs pa dang / rmongs pa 'di gnyis kyis sangs rgyas kyi sa la sgrib pa'o tsho/ /rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang po la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gnon to/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 5tshos gnyis pa la ni/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gnon to/ /sa gsum pa la ni bzod (6)pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gnon to/ /sa bzhi pa la ni brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 97)gnon to/ /sa lnga pa la ni bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa gnon to/ /sa drug pa la ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gnon to/ /sa bdun pa la ni thabs mkhas pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gnon to/ /sa brgyad pa la ni smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa 89—562

gnon to/ /sa dgu pa la ni stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gnon to/ /sa bcu pa la ni ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gnon to/ /rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems bskyed pa dang po ni/ rin po che yang dag par 'phags pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis yongs su bzung ste skye'o/ /sems bskyed pa gnyis pa ni gnas pa med pa'i ting nge 0)'dzin gyis yongs su bzung ste skye'o/ /sems bskyed pa gsum pa ni rab tu mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis yongs su bzung ste skye'o/ /sems bskyed pa bzhi pa ni phyir mi ldog pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis yongs su bzung ste skye'o/ /sems bskyed pa lnga pa ni rin po che'i me tog gi ting nge 'dzin gyis yongs su bzung ste skye'o/ /sems bskyed pa ( drug pa ni nyi ma'i 'od kyi gzi brjid kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis yongs su bzung (2)ste skye'o/ /sems bskyed pa bdun pa ni don thams cad grub pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis yongs su bzung ste skye'o/ /sems bskyed pa brgyad pa ni da ltar gyi sangs rgyas mngon sum du bzhugs /depa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis yongs su bzung ste skye'o/ /sems bskyed pa dgu pa ni ye shes sgron ma'i ting nge 'dzin gyis yongs su bzung ste skye'o/ /sems bskyed pa bcu pa ni dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis yongs su bzung nas skye ste/ rigs kyi bu 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi (5)sems bskyed pa bcu'o(phyin/ /rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang po la ri75khyad par gyis byin gyis brlabs pa rin/zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'di 59)skye ste gzungs la/ tabya thā/ pur+ṇa rigem no ra the/’/ du hu du hu du hu/ yā bta 51 srur+ya a ba bhā sa tā/ yā bta /natsan+d+ra do dasto/ dā bā da rak+ṣa mān/ daṇ+ḍa pa ri hā blaram ku ru swā hā/ rigs kyi 89wa 563

bu gzungs 'di ni gang gā'i ②klung gcig gi ②bye ma snyed las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ①rnams kyis sa dang po'i byang chub sems dpa' bsrung ④ba'i phyir gsungs te/ su zhig gzungs sngags 'di 'don cing 'dzin na/'jigs pa thams cad las grol bar 'gyur ba ⑤ni/ 'di lta ste/ stag dang seng ge la sogs pa gcan gzan ma rungs pa'i rigs dang / yi dgas thams cad dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa 4)la sogs te/ dgra dang / rkun po dang —/ gza' dang / nyon mongs pa rnams dang / sgrib pa rnam pa lnga las rnam par ⑦grol te/ sa dang po rjes su dran par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa gnyis pa la gzhan gyis mi thub pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'di me)skye'o/ /gzungs la/ tabya thā/ usto li/ tsi ri tsi ri/usto rān)/ to ra ṇi/ shārnyo shārto8/ asto 6nyali/ hu lu hu 7lu swā hā/ rigs kyi bu gzungs 'di ni 3nyagang gā'i 7klung gnyis kyi bye ma snyed las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis sa gnyis pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bsrung 7ba'i phyir gsungs so/ /gang la la zhig gzungs sngags ⑩'di klog cing 'dzin na/'jigs pa thams cad las rnam par grol te/ de gcan gzan ma rungs pa dang ske/ yi dgas ma rungs pa dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa la sogs pas gtse ba dang /7 pa rol gyi dgra dang / gza' lto dang / nyon mongs pa dang /sdug bsngal ba dang / sgrib pa rnam pa lnga las rnam par grol te/ sa gnyis pa 17rjes su dran par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu sa gsum pa ( — )la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la merab tu gnas pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'di skye'o / /gzungs la/ tabya thā/ daci ni ge/ bzhi ( gege/ ka ra khris / kau ra 89wa 564

khril/ kai yu ②re darnyi li swā hā/ rigs kyi bu gzungs 'di ni gang gā'i ③klung gsum gyi bye ma snyed las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis/sa gsum pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bsrung ④ba'i phyir gsungs te/ su gzungs sngags ⑤'di 'chang ba dang / 'don pa de 'jigs pa thams cad dang / gcan gzan ma rungs pa dang / gdon ma rungs pa dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad dul sogs pas gtse ba gdang / gza' dang / pha rol gyi dgra dang / sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs dang / sgrib pa rnam pa lnga las rnam par grol te/ sa gsum pa ⑤rjes su dran par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu sa bzhi pa ⑨la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la ⑩gdul dka' ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'di skye'o/ /gzungs la/ tabya thā/ shi ri shi ri7/ di mi di mi ⑩ni/ da ri da ri ṇi0/ shi ri shi ri ṇiñca/ bi shā lā/ bi shī lā/ pa sha pa sha 8ni/ brnya ni ye swā hā/ rigs kyi bu gzungs 'di ni gang gā'i 7klung bzhi'i bye ma snyed las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis tsos bzhi pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bsrung /tsho nyeba'i phyir gsungs te/ sus gzungs sngags 4)'di 'don pa dang / 'chang ba de 'jigs pa thams cad dang / gcan gzan khro bo dang / yi dgas ma rungs pa dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa la sogs te/ pha rol gyi dgra dang / sdug bsngal mang pos gtse ba nu byedang / gza' ri nyedang /sgrib pa rnam pa lnga las kyang rnam par grol te/ sa bzhi pa rdunyerjes su dran par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu sa lnga pa la gnas pa'i byang sachub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la zhusteyon tan sna tshogs kyis ( nyebakod pa ces bya ba'i gzungs 'di skye'o/ /gzungs la/ tabya thā/ ha ri ha rdo zheri ṇizhu / tsi ru ri tsi ri ṇiñca/ ka ri 83—565

mā ṇi3)/ sang ka ri mā ṇi4kyi/ sa las ni/ dzam+bha ṣ+yo/ni/ stam+bha ni/ mo ha ni/swa ya suk+ki tshig hā/ rigs kyi bu gzungs 'di ni gang gā'i nyaklung lnga'i bye ⑦ma snyed las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis sa lnga pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bsrung (8)ba'i phyir gsungs te/ sus gzungs sngags (9)'di 'don cing 'chang na/ 'jigs pa thams cad dang / gcan gzan khro bo dang ske/ yi dgas ma rungs pa dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa la sogs te/ pha rol gyi bodagra dang / sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs kyis gtse ba nyarnyedang / gza' dang ske/ sgrib pa rnam pa lnga las rnam par grol te/ sa lnga pa rjes su dran par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu sa drug pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la skoyi shes kyi dkyil 'khor sgron ma zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'di skye'o//gzungs la/ tabya thā/ bi to ri/ bi to ri/ ma ri ṇi/snye/ ka li ka li/ bi dho han tik+ṣa/ lu lu lu lu/ tsu lu tsu lu/ to lu ba to lu tshogeb/ sha sha /shats+tsha /ba ri sha swa 7ste/ sarba satā māṃ/ sid rgyas mā ma/ man+t+ra bā dā nya ni swā hā/rigs kyi bu gzungs 'di ni gang gā'i 37klung drug gi bye ma snyed las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis sa drug pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bsrung 3 ba'i phyir gsungs te/ sus gzungs sngags 27'di 'don cing 'chang na/ 'jigs pa thams cad dang / gcan gzan khro bo dang / yi dgas ma rungs pa dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa la sogs te/ pha rol gyi dgra dang ske/ sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs kyis gtse ba tsho 2dang / gza' dang / sgrib pa rnam pa lnga las kyang rnam par grol te/ sa drug pa rjes su dran par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu sa bdun pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen 89wa 566

po la 0)khyad par du 'phags pa ②zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'di skye'o/ /gzungs la/tabya thā/ dza ha dza ha ru/ dza ①ha dza ha dza ha stiru/ bai lu ke/ be+e lu kephyi/a mṛ ta gha ṇi/ pa ru sha ṇi/ be+e (6)ru ti ke/ ba ru bsto/ bi dhi hi stike/bin+da bi li ni/ a mṛ lu (geti kepo// lha dzu yu/0 lha hunyadzu yu swā hā/ rigs kyi bu gzungs 'di ni gang gā'i 7klung bdun gyi bye ma snyed las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis sa bdun pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bsrung 'o ba'i phyir gsungs te/ sus gzungs sngags 8'di 'don macing 'chang na/ 'jigs pa thams cad dang / gcan gzan khro bo dang / yi dgas ma rungs pa dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa la sogs te/ pha rol gyi dgra dang ske/ sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs kyis gtse ba tshedang / gza' dang / sgrib pa rnam pa lnga las kyang rnam par grol te/ sa bdun pa rjes su dran par 'gyur rol/ /rigs kyi bu sa brgyad pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la marnyog pa med pa'i rtog pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'di skye'o/ /gzungs la/ tabya thā/ shi ri shi ri/ shi ri ṇi/she/ mi te mi te/ ka ri ka ri37ske/ he ru he ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ brnya 2 rini swā hā/ rigs kyi bu gzungs 'di ni gang gā'i 7klung brgyad kyi bye ma snyed rigelas 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis sa brgyad pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bsrung — ba'i phyir gsungs te/ sus gzungs sngags 2 'di 'don cing 'chang na/ 'jigs pa thams cad dang / gcan gzan khro bo dang / yi dgas ma rungs pa dang /mi dang mi snyem yin pa la gsogs te / pha rol gyi dgra dang / sdug bsngal 8rnam pa sna tshogs kyis gtse ba ri dang / gza' dang / sgrib pa rnam pa lnga las 83—567

kyang rnam par grol te/ sa brgyad pa rjes su dran par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu sa dgu pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la tshisgo mtha' yas pa'i rgyun ces 9 bya ba'i gzungs 'di skye'o/ /gzungs la/tabya thā/ ha ri tsaṇ+ḍa ri0li ke/ ku la mā bha te④/ to ra shi pa ta pa ta si/ shi ri shi riX5 / ga shi ri/ ga 6)bi shi ri/ swa sti sarba satā ṭ+wāṃ gsu hā/ rigs kyi bu gzungs 'di ni gang gā'i (8)klung dgu'i bye ma snyed las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis sa dgu pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bsrung 9ba'i phyir gsungs te/ sus gzungs sngags ⑩'di 'don cing 'chang na/'jigs pa thams cad dang / gcan gzan khro bo dang / yi dgas ma rungs pa dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa la 9/—1sogs te/ pha rol gyi dgra dang /sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs kyis gtse ba chadang / gza' dang / sgrib pa rnam pa lnga las kyang rnam par grol te/ sa dgu pa rjes su dran par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu sa bcu pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la mizad mi shes pa'i za ma tog ces bya ba'i gzungs 'di skye stemi/ gzungs la/tabya thā/ sidhe su si 7/ mo tsa ni/ mo k+ṣa ni/ multe'i/ bi multe / a ma le / bi ma le/ da ma le/ māṅga le/ hi ra rgya garnye/ rat+na ga nyu / sa man+ta bha drenirto/ sarba aṅgā/ sā dha ni/ ma na si ‘ )ma hā ma na si/ a te/ a t+ya 1te/ a ra dze/ bi ra dze/ u tsu te/ a mṛ te/ a ra dze/ bi ra dze/bra d+me bra h+ma/ sā 22re pū ra ṇi tsho steg ra ṇa )/ ma no ra the swā hā/ rigs kyi bu gzungs 'di ni bkra shis pa dang spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba ste gang gā'i sa klung bcu'i 2 bye ma snyed las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis sa 89wa 568

bcu pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ①bsrung ②ba'i phyir gsungs te/sus gzungs sngags ①'di 'don cing 'chang na/ 'jigs pa thams cad dang /gcan gzan khro bo dang / yi dgas ma rungs pa dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa la ④sogs te/ pha rol gyi dgra dang / sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs kyis gtse ba ⑤dang / gza' dang / gdug pa can ⑥thams cad dang / sgrib pa rnam pa lnga la sogs pa las rnam par grol te/ sa bcu pa rjes su dran par 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po seng ge'i tog gi ⑦'od zer snang ba thogs pa med pa zhes bya bas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gzungs 'di dag bshad pa thos nas stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar dunas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs shenate/ thal mo sbyar ba btud nas zhabs la phyag 'tshal 7te tshigs su bcad pa 'dis bstod do/ /zab mo mtshan nyid med chos la/ /skye bo shes pa nyams pa rnams/ /bcom ldan nyag gcig sgrol mdzad pa9/ste/ /dpe med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i shes rab spyan/ /chos kyi mtshan nyid gcig mi gzigs/ /yang dag chos kyi spyan gyis ni/ /kun du gsal ba bsam mi khyab/ /chos 'ga'ang ⑩skye ba med pa ste/ /'gog par yang ni mi 'gyur ro/ /de ltar mnyam par gzigs pas /tshonan/ /bla med gnas su bzhugs mapar 'gyuratshe/ /'khor ba dag kyang mi 'jig la'i/ /mya ngan 'das la'ang mi bzhugs /mashing / /mtha' gnyis la ni mi gnas te/ /de'i / phyir mya ngan /smu'ada' ba brnyes/ /dag dang ma dag phyogs la yang / /rnam par dbye ba med pa'i phyir/ /bcom ldan ro gcig sau )mkhyen pas na/ /rnam par dag pa'i mchog sasmubarnyes so/ /bcom ldan 'das ( gekyi tshad med skus/ /83wa 569

tshig gcig ston pa med par yang / /'khor mang 0)'di dag thams cad la/ /chos kyi char gyis tshim par (khumadzad/ /sems can 'di dag thams cad kyi/ /mtshan nyid rnam par gzigs med kyang / /nyon mongs sdug bsngal thams cad las / /bcom ldan rtag tu skyob par tshon)mdzad/ /bde dang sdug bsngal rtag mi rtag /bdag dang bdag med la sogs dang / /gcig dang tha dad ma yin dang ske/ /skye ba med dang 'gog med pa'i/ /de 'dra'i don gyi rnam pa la/ /rnam par dbye zhing ston par rinamadzad/ /dper na brag ca rige)stong par ni/ /de don sangs rgyas rnams kyis mkhyen/ /chos kyi dbyings ni dbyer med pas/ /theg pa mi mthun gzhan med de/ /sems can rnams ni bsgral ba'i phyir/ /gsum du rnam par dbye ba mdzad/ /de nas tshangs pa'i rgyal po dbang phyug chen po stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos 3phyag 'tshal (77te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i 8rgyal po 'di shin tu dkon zhing /dpag par dka' ba/ thog mar yang dge ba/ bar du yang dge ba/ tha mar yang dge ba/ don bzang po/99 tshig 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa yongs su rdzogs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad phun sum tshogs par mdzad pa 'di gang zhig 'chang ba dang / 'dzin pa de/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi 7mdzad pa gzo 11ba lags so/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu ji skad smras pa de bzhin te/ rigs kyi bu gang mdo sde 12'di nyan par byed pa ni/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs 89—570

pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'dis ni/ sa las phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba mchog tu smin par byed pa dang / chos kyi phyag rgya dam pa yin pa dang /mdo sde kun gyi rgyal por gyur pa ste/ de'i phyir mnyan pa dang / gzung ba dang /bklag ①pa dang / gdon chopar bya'o/ /de yang rigs kyi bu dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskyed pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su ma smin pa dang / sangs rgyas mang po la bsnyen bkur ma byas pa'i sems can de budag gis ④ni dam pa'i chos 'di mnyan par mi nus so/ /rigs kyi bu chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos pa tsam gyis/rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dag lhag pa'i bsam pa yongs su dag cing sangs rgyas mthong ba dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur ro/ /dam pa'i chos nyan 9depa dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur(5)/ dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur(be/ rgya mtsho'i phyag rgya mi zad 9shepa mngon par bsgrub (khapa'i gzungs dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur/ sems can gyi bsam pa dang / spyod pa dang / sgra la 'jug pa'i gzungs dang mi 'bral bar 'gyura'i/ nyi ma'i tog snang ba'i gzungs dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur511/ zla ba'i tog snang ba'i gzungs dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur/ kun nas ldang ba thams cad rnam par gnon pa bsgrub ri 5pa'i gzungs dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur512/ rdo rje ltar sra zhing brtan pa'i ri r+sharnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur/ brjod du med pa'i don bstan pa la yang dag par gzhol ba'i gzungs dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur/tshig dang spyod pa dang / sgra thams cad la 'jug pa'i gzungs dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor 12dri ma med pa bsgrub pa'i phyag rgyas 83—571

btab pa'i gzungs dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur/ sangs rgyas kyi sku mtha' yas pa yongs su rdzogs pa bsgrub ①pa'i gzungs dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i bu gzungs 'di dag thob ②pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams su sangs rgyas kyi sku ①mngon par sprul nas chos ston to/ /chos nyid las kyang mi g.yo la/ 'gro ba yang med/ 'ong ba yang med do/ /sems can rnams yongs su smin par byed kyang ④/ sems can du dmigs pa yang med do/ /chos ston kyang yi ge mnyam pa nyid las g.yo ba med do/ / 'chi 'pho ba ⑤dang skye ba ston kyang 'pho ba yang med/ skye ba yang med do/ /chos thams cad la rnam par rtog ⑥pa med pa'i phyir/ 'du byed rnams gang du yang ⑦'gro bar mi 'gyur/ gang nas kyang bya'ong bar yang mi 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' sum stong gis/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' tshad med pa rnams kyis ni/ byang chub kyi sems las 7phyir mi ldog par gyur to/ /dge slong dang /dge slong ma tshad 7med pa rnams kyis ni/ chos la chos kyi mig rnam par dag pa thob bo/ /sems can tshad med pa rnams kyis ni/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par gyur pa dang / de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs so/ /'khor ba'i rgyun gcod dam chos 'di37/ /zab cing phra la blta dka' ste/ /'dod pas bsgribs ⑫pa'i dmus long 1 dag /de ma mthong bas sdug cibasngal len/ /de nas 'khor 'dus pa de dag stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal tshanas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gser 'od dam 89—572

pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di klog cing 'don pa dang / ston cing gnas pa der bdag cag thams cad mchis nas/ chos ston pa'i 'khor du bgyis ①te/ de la phan pa dang / bde ba stsal cing lus dang sems bde bar bgyi'o/ /bdag cag gis sems rtse gcig tu gyur pas ②mchod par bgyi'o/ /nyan pa'i 'khor rnams kyang bde bas tshim par bgyi'o/ /rgyal po'i yul der yang pha rol gyi dgra'i 'jigs pa dang / 'tshe ba dang / mu ge'i ③ya nga bas sdug bsngal ba ma mchis pa dang / skye bo mang pos rgyas shing yongs su dar bar bgyi'o④/ /chos 'di bshad pa'i gnas kyi dkyil 'khor 'di lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin la sogs pa thams cad dang / sems can thams cad kyis mi brdzi phyizhing gtsang mar bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ chos rtsibashad pa'i gnas 'di ni mchod rten lags pa'i slad du/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / me tog dang / bdug (7pa dang / lhab lhub kyis yongs su mchod par bgyi'o/ /bdag cag gis kyang rtag tu bsrung 'unyezhing bskyabs te nyams pa ma mchis par bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor 'dus pa de dag la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu khyed 6)kyis mdo sde dam pa 'di bsgrub 7pa la brtson nyunyepar gyis tsheshig dang / dam pa'i chos 'di 'jig rten 'dir yun ring du gnas par 'gyur rol/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i hunyergyal po las/ sa rnam par sbyong ba 0zhes bya ba'i le'u zhes bya nyunyeste drug pa'o// // bam po lnga pa/te de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ rigs kyi lha mo byang chub yang dag par bsdus pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi lha mo 83—573

de'i tshe de'i dus na/ rgyal po gser gyi lag pa'i dbang po zhes bya ba des/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bstod pa/ pad+mo'i ①'byung gnas 'dis ②'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa chadang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la mngon par bstod do/ /rgyal ba gang dag sngar 'gyur ligang byung dang ge/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten dag na yigang 'tsho ba/ /rgyal ba de dag rnams la phyag bgyi'o/ /rgyal ba de dag kun la bdag gis bstod/ /thub dbang zhi zhing rab zhi rnam par dag /sku ni gser gyi mdog tu rab tu gda'/ /dbyangs tsho rnams kun pas tsho skusangs rgyas gsung snyan te/ /tshangs pa'i sgra ⑨dbyangs rab tu bsgrags pa'i gsung / /bung ba rma bya ut+pal sngon po'i dbu/ /mthon mthing bolcang lo bya ni tsa sha 'dra/ /kha ba dung ltar rab tu dkar ba'i tshems / /rtag tu gser ltar rnam par mdzes par gda'/ /spyan ni ring zhing mthon mthing nya1dri ma med/ /ut+pal sngon po rab tu rgyas pa 'dra/ /ljags ni che zhing legs pa nya pad+ma'i mdog /pad+ma 'drar snang pad+ma'i ze ba 'dra/ /zhal gyi mdzod spu pad rtsa dung dang 'dra/ /be+e ḍūr+ya yi nyanyamadog 'dra g.yas su 'khyil/ /thub pa'i sku ni zla ba phra mi'adra zhing / /zla ba zad mi'adra spyan bkrag bung ba bzhin//zhal tshamatho shangs ni nya rtag tu lhang nge ste/ /'jam zhing sa yi gser ltar kha dog bzang ske/ /rtag par rgyun du rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /ro mchog 'jam zhing dam pa'i ’ mchog rab 'phags/ /spu yi bu ga nas ni re re skyes/ /spu rnams skyes pa g.yas su 'khyil pa ste/ /mthon mthing 19'dra bar 'tsher zhing lcang lo can/ /rma bya'i mgrin sdug 'dra bar sngo la mdzes/ /bltams 3lham thag tu sku yis snang bar bgyis / /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten dag ni thams cad gang / /'jig rten 89wa 574

gsum na sdug bsngal mtha' yas zhi/ /bde ba kun gyis sems can rnams kyang tshim / /sems dmyal 'gro dang ①dud 'gror 'gro ba dang / /yi dgas lha gnas mi yi 'gro ②rnams su/ /sems can de dag thams cad bde bas tshim/ /ngan song 'gro ba rnams ni thams cad zhi/ /kha dog bzang ba dugaser dang 'dra ba'i 'od/ / btso ma'i ④gser ltar rab tu snang ba'i sku/ /bde tshigashegs zla ba rab tu dri med zhal/ /'dzum zhing rnam mdzes shin tu dri med zhal/ /gzhon nu btsas 'drar sku lus yan lag 'jam/ /seng ge 'dra ⑥bar rtsal gyis gnon pa'i mchog /phyag ring phyag ni rab tu ring ba ste/ /sā gala'i lhug ma rlung gis bskyod pa bzhin/ /'dom phunagang 'od 'bar 'od zer rab tu gtong / /nyi ma stong (9)ltar rab tu lhang 8nge'o/ /thub pa'i dbang po'i nyunyestu mchog dri ma med/ /zhing rnams mtha' yas thams cad rab tu snang / /sangs rgyas 'od ni rnam par lhang nge bas(1rte/ /zhing rnams mtha' yas brgya stong rnams su yang / /mtshan byad ⑫zla ba nyi ma mang po dag /de dag thams cad 'od ni med par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma 'jig rten sgron ma ste/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma brgya phrag stong rnams ni/ /zhing rnams mtha' yas stong phrag brgya 7dag na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 8nyi ma sems can mthong / /bsod nams stong phrag brgya dang ldan pa'i sku/ /yon tan kun gyis rab tu brgyan 7pa'i sku/ /glang chen dbang po'i sna 'dra rgyal ba'i phyag /phyag dang zhabs 'od rab mdzes dri ma med/ /sa yi steng gi rdul dang mtshungs 'dra snyed1 / /phra ba'i rdul snyed sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /gang dag phra ba'i rdul snyed byung 17ba dang / /gang dag phra ba'i rdul snyed bzhugs pa yitsho no / /rgyal ba de dag la ni rab dang gleba'i/ /ngag yid lus kyis me tog 83—575

dbul ①ba dang / /spos rnams dbul ②dang bsngags pa brgya dag dang / /dge ba'i sems kyis kyang ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan gang dag dge gyur pa/ /snying po mchog rab sna tshogs du ma ste/ /bdag gis bskal pa stong du lce brgya yis/ /sangs rgyas yon tan brjod par mi nus so/ /rgyal ba gcig gi yon tan rnams kyang ni/ /lce stong gis kyang cung zad brjod mi nus/ /bdag gis rgyal ba dag ni thams cad kyi/ /yon tan gcig rgyas brjod par ga la nus//lhar bcas 'jig rten thams cad mtshor gyur te/ /srid pa'i rtse mo man chad ①chus gang ba/ / skra yi ④ce mos dpag par nus srid kyis⑤/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi yon tan gcig 96)la min/ /lus dang ngag dang yid rab dang ⑦ba yis / /rgyal ba kun la bdag gis bsngags bstod pas92)/ /bdag gis po)bsod nams bo'abras bu mchog bsags gang / /des ni sems can rgyal ba reg gyur cig /de ltar rgyal pos sangs rgyas rnams bstod nas/ /rgyal po 'di ltar smon lam 'debs pa ni/ /ma 'ongs bskal pa mtha' yas rnams su yang / /gang dang gang du bdag ni skye ba na/ /rmi lam du ni 'di 'dra'i nyusternga mthong zhing / /der ni bshags pa 'di sko'adra thos par shog /rgyal bstod pad+ma 'byung rgyal 'di 'dra ba/ /tshe rabs de dang der ni rnyed gyur cig /sangs rgyas yon tan mtha' yas mtshungs med dang yi / /gang yang bskal pa stong du rnyed dka' ba/ /de dag rmi lam na yang thos par shog /nyin gyur tshe yang de dag ston gyur cig /sems can sdug bsngal mtsho las thar byed shog /pha rol phyin pa drug po rdzogs bgyis nas/ / phyin chad bla med byang chub 3stethob par shog /bdag gis tunyezhing ni 'gran zla med gyur cig /rnga phul rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu dang / /89—576

rgyal ba thams cad la yang bstod pa'i rgyus/ /shākya thub dbang mngon du mthong bar shog /der ni bdag gis lung bstan thob gyur cig /gser gyi lag pa'i dbang dang gser gyi 'od/ /bdag gi khye'u ni ①gang yin 'di gnyis kyang / /der ni bu pho de dag gnyi ga yang ②/ /byang chub bla med lung bstan thob par shog /sems can gang dag gnas med rten med cing / /skyabs dang bral nas phongs par gyur pa dag① /de dag la yang ma 'ongs dus rnams na/ /skyob ④dang dpung gnyen skyabs dang rten gyur shog /sdug bsngal kun 'byung zad par byed gyur cig /bde ba kun gyi 'byung gnas gyur par shog /sngon mtha' 'das pa de dag ji srid pa/ /ma 'ongs bskal par byang chub spyod gyur cig /gser 'od dam pa yi (lde)ni bshags pa yis/ /bdag gi sdig pa'i rgya mtsho skems ⑥par shog /bdag gi dzolas kyi rgya mtsho zad gyur cig /bdag gi nyon mongs rgya mtsho chad par shog /bdag gi bsod nams rgya mtsho rdzogs gyur cig /ye shes dri med snang ba dam pa yis/ /bdag gi ye shes rgya mtsho rnam dag shog /yon tan kun gyi rgya mtshor 'gyur bar 2shog /byang chub yon tan yon tan rin chen rdzogs / /gser 'od dam pa'i bshags pa'i stobs kyis ni/ /bdag gi bsod nams rab tu snang bar shog /bdag gi byang chub snang ba rnam dag gyur/ /ye shes dri med snang ba dam pa yis〈pe/ /bdag gi lus kyi 'od ni snang bar shog /bsod nams snang ba lhang 7nger bya ba'i phyir/ /'jig rten gsum na khyad par 'phags gyur cig /bsod nams stobs dang rtag tu ldan par shog /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las ni sgrol ba dang / /bde ba kun gyi shu rgya mtsho 'dra ba yis/ /ma 'ongs bskal par byang chub spyod tshepar bgyi/ /'jig rten gsum na sngon /ge83—577

mthar ji snyed gshegs/ /de dag zhing ni rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /yon tan mtha' yas khyad 'phags ci 'dra ba/ /yon tan mtha' yas rnams kyis bdag gi zhing ske/ /ma 'ongs dus na de 'drar 'gyur bar shog /mdzes pa'i tog gis shes par byos/ /rgyal po gser gyi lag dbang gis/ /sngon tshe ༅smon lam 'di btab ste/ /de nyid da ltar khyod yin no/ /sngon gyi dus kyi bu gnyis ni/ /gser gyi lag dang gser gyi 'od/ /de nyid dngul tog dngul 'od ces/ /ngas ni de tshe lung bstan to/ /'khor mang de dag 'di thos nas/ /kun gyis byang chub sems bskyed pa/ /da ltar ma 'ongs dus dag tu/ /rtag par bshags pa 'di byed shog /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing tsho thams cad la bstod pa'i le'u zhes bya ste bdun pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor de'i nang na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bde bar gnas pa (4ril 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu gser can zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'di gang (5)rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo gang la las 6'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar gyi sangs rgyas thams cad mngon du mchod 7cing bkur ste byed (kye'adod pas gzungs 'di bcang 99zhing gzung 7bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gzungs 'di 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi yum yin pa'i phyir/ gzungs 'di 'dzin pa ni 3stobasod nams kyi tshogs rgya nyinacher 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 89—578

'das dpag tu med pa dag la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa rnams kyis 'dzin cing 'chang bar 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag pa ma nyams shing skyon med pa rnams kyis/ chos kyi rnam grangs shin tu zab mo 'di la 'jug nus par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gzungs sngags bsgrub ①pa'i cho ga ni/ sngar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang / byang chub sems dpa'i mtshan 'di dag brjod cing / sems rtse gcig pas phyag 'tshol la (kyede nas sngags 'di gdon ③par bya'o/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la phyag 'tshal lo / /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang / 'phags pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar phyogs kyi sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs 4)pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho phyogs kyi sangs rgyas rin po che'i tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub phyogs kyi sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang phyogs kyi sangs rgyas rnga sgra'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /steng gi phyogs kyi sangs rgyas yangs (5)pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'og gi phyogs kyi sangs rgyas snang ba dam pa'i 56)dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rin chen snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun tu 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun tu snang ba sal phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas spos mchog brtsegs pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas mnyam par (8)gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor can 5)la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rin chen bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rin chen 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dri med 'od 83—579

snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas spobs pas ①bkod par dgongs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas zla 'od rnam dag grags pa'i tog gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas me tog 'od bkod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'od snang rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dge 'od dri ma med par grags pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas spyan ras gzigs dbang mi 'jigs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'jigs med grags pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /sangs rgyas rab mchog rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros mi zad pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mthu chen thob pa (kyel phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po legs pa'i blo gros la phyag 'tshal lo /de dag la phyag 'tshal 957nas gzungs 'di 0)gdon tshanapar bya'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ tabya thā/ ku ṭi ku ṭi ni/ i mi ri to/ ko ṣa 'i(6)/ i mi ri 'i(pe/i rī 31swā hā/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 99)byang chub sems dpa' bde bar gnas pa 7la bka' stsal pa/ gzungs 11'di ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas 89wa 580

rnams kyi yum yin pa'i phyir/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis gzungs 'di 'chang zhing 'dzin na/ bsod nams kyi tshogs tshad med dpag tu med pa ①'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /grangs med pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la bkur ste dang / mchod pa dang / rim gro dang / bsngags par byas par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas de rnams kyis kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu ②de la lung ston par 'gyur ro/ /bde bar gnas pa gang zhig gzungs sngags ②'di 'chang ba des gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / rin po che dang / mang du thos shing byamakhas pa dang / nad med cing tshe ring ba la sogs pa yid bzhin du 'thob ste/ bsod nams shin tu mang du 'phel lo /ci dang ci 'dod pa de dang de dag ⑤thams cad 'grub ⑥par 'gyur ro/ /bde bar gnas nas ⑦sngags 'di 'chang zhing 'dzin na/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ma thob kyi ⑤bar du/ rtag par byang chub sems dpa' gser gyi grong khyer ri bo dang / byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal dang / byang chub sems dpa' ping ga la chen po la sogs pa dang lhan cig tu gnas te/byang chub sems dpa' de ⑨rnams kyis srung bar byed do/ /bde bar gnas pas gzungs ⑩'di sgrub pa'i cho ga ni 'di yin par shes par 7bya'o/ /thog mar bzlas brjod khri rtsa brgyad tshang bar bzlas pas bsnyen par 8bya'o/ /de nas khang pa dben pa'i nang du/ dkyil 'khor byas te/ tshes bcu drug gi nyin par khrus byas zhunyagos sar pa gyon te/ bdug 57pa dang / me tog dang / zhal zas sna 83—581

mang po la sogs pas/ mchod pa ①bya zhing dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs nas/thog mar sngar smos pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mtshan nas brjod de/ gus par phyag 'tshal zhing sdig pa bshags nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga (mis la btsugs te/ sngags de stong rtsa brgyad tshang bar bzlas so(mi / /de nas lus bsrang ste (pe'adug nas ci 'dod pa de bsam par ⑤bya'o/ /de nas nyi ma ma (6)shar bar dkyil 'khor gyi nang du kha zas gtsang ma za gcig tu bza'o0la/ /de nas zhag bcwa (kyelnga lon pa dang / gzod (9)dkyil 'khor de nas byung bar 0byas te/ mi de ni bsod nams dang gzi brjid kyi mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan zhing / bsam pa thams cad rtsonyayongs su rdzogs par 'gyur rol/ /gal te bsam 8pa ma grub na yang dkyil 'khor der zhugs nan / bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur bas / de phyin cad 8kyang rtag tu 8rjes su dran par bya'o⑩/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rmo rgyal po las gser can zhes bya ba'i gzungs 17te le'u bsdod pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gzungs de gsungs nas/ /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang dzo / lha dang mi la sogs pa'i 'khor 'dus pa de dag la phan pa dang / bde ba'i phyir don dam pa'i bden pa stong pa'i mtshan nyid de bstan pa'i phyir de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag tsho spegasungs so / /bsam gyis mi khyab mdo 2 rnams gzhan dag tu/ /stong pa'i chos rnams rab tu rgyas bshad de/ /de lta bas na mdo mchog dam pa 'dir/ /stong pa'i chos rnams na mdo tsam bshad par bya / /sems can blo chung rnam par mi shes 89wa 582

pas/ /chos rnams thams cad shes par mi nus te/ /de lta bas na mdo mchog dam pa 'dir/ /stong pa'i chos rnams mdo tsam rab tu bshad/ /sems can kun gyis ci nas shes 'gyur dang / /sems can 'byung bya'i ①phyir ni snying rje'i dbang ske/ /thabs dang tshul dang rgyu gzhan rnams kyis ni/ /mdo mchog dam pa dbang po 'di bshad do/ /lus 'di grong khyim stong pa ji bzhin te/ /dbang po rnams ni dmag dang chom rkun 'dra/ /de dag thams cad grong gcig gnas mod kyi/ /de dag phan tshun rnam par mi shes so/ /mig gi dbang po gzugs gyur rnams la rgyug /rna ba'i dbang po sgra la rnam par dpyod/ /sna yi dbang po sna tshogs dri rnams 'phrog /lce yi dbang po rtag tu ro la rgyug /lus kyi dbang po reg pa dag la rgyug /yid kyi dbang po chos rnams rnam par dpyod/ /dbang po drug po 'di dag phan tshun du/ /rang rang yul la rab tu 'jug par byed/ /sems ni sgyu ma lta bur migayo ba yin/ /dbang po drug ni yul la rnam dpyod de/ /ji ltar mi zhig grong stong rgyug pa dang / /dmag dang chom rkun dag dang gnas pa bzhin / /ji ltar bya zhig rin/yul drug gnas bcas shing / /dbang po'i spyod yul dag kyang rab shes pa/ /de ltar sems ni yul 'jug geganas bcas te/ /dbang po'i spyod yul rnams kyang rab tu shes/ /gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin dri rnams dang / /ro dang reg bya de bzhin spyod yul chos/ /sems ni dbang po drug po thams cad la/ /dbang por zhugs par (5)bya bzhin g.yo bar gyurari // /dbang po gang dang gang du gnas bcas pa/ /dbang po de ni shes pa bdag nyid byed kyi / /lus ni g.yo na ba med cing byed pa med/ /snying po med cing rkyen las byung ba yin/ /yang dag ma yin yongs su rtog las byung / /grong stong las kyi 9)89wa 583

'khrul 'khor 'dra bar gnas/ /sa dang me dang chu dang rlung rnams ni/ /grong gzhan gnas te ༅phyogs dang phyogs na gnas/ /dper na sbrul gdug gnas gcig ji bzhin te/ /rtag tu phan tshun mthun pa ma yin bzhin/ /khams kyi sbrul rnams bzhi po de dag kyang / /gnyis ni steng 'gro gnyis ni thur ⑧du 'gro/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su gnyis gnyis te/ /khams sbrul de dag thams cad 'jig ②par 'gyur/ /sa yi sbrul dang chu yi sbrul dag dang / /'di gnyis 'og tu zad par 'gyur ba yin/ /me yi sbrul dang rlung gi sbrul dag dang / /'di gnyis steng gi nam mkhar 'gro ba yin/ /ji ltar sngon chad byas pa'i las rnams kyisasti/ /sems dang rnam shes kun tu gnas nas dong / /lha dang mi dang ngan song gsum dag tu/ /ji ltar byas pa'i las kyis srid par skye/ /bad kun rlung dang mkhris pa ༷zad gyur na/ /lus ni (nyagacin dang ngan skyugs rnams kyis gang / /mngon par mi dga' srin bu'i phung por gyur/ /dur khrod dag na 'thor ba shing bzhin gyur/ /lha mo khyod ni chos 'di rnams la ltos/ /'di la sems can gang zag gang zhig yod/ /chos rnams 'di dag thams cad stong pa ste/ /ma rig pa yi rkyen las byung ba yin/ / 'byung ba chen po 'di dag che 'byung min/ /ma byung ba las byung zhing mi 'byung ste/ /gang gi phyir ni 'byung ba mi 'byung ba/ /de phyir 'byung ba che zhes ngas brjod do/ /yod pa min zhing nam yang yod min la/ /ma rig pa yi rkyen las 'byung ba yin/ /⑦ma rig 'di ni yod pa ma yin te/ /de bas ngas ni ma rig 'di bshad do(she/ /'du byed (she)rnam shes ming dang gzugs bcas dang / /skye mched drug dang reg dang tshor ba dang ske/ /sred dang len dang de bzhin srid pa dang / /skye dang rga shi mya ngan 89—584

gnod pa rnams/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /'khor ba'i 'khor lo ji ltar gnas pa dag /ma byung ba las byung dang mi 'byung dang / /tshul bzhin ma yin sems kyis rnam dpyad dang / /bdag gi lta bar gyur pa gcad ①par bgyis②/ /ye shes ral gris nyon mongs rgya mo droladu/ /phung po'i gnas la stong par gyur par ltos/ /byang chub yon tan rgya chen reg par gyis/ /ngas ni bdud rtsi ④grong khyer sgo yang phye/ /bdud rtsi'i ②khu ba'i snod kyang kun tu bstan/ /ngas ⑥ni bdud rtsi'i grong khyer gnas der 'jug /ngas ⑦ni bdud rtsi'i khu bas bdag tshim byasadu/ /ngas ni chos kyi rnga chen dam pa brdungs/ /ngas ni chos kyi dung gi mchog kyang bus/ /ngas ni chos kyi sgron ma mchog 'bar byas / /ngas ni chos kyi char pa dam pa phab/ /ngas dhini nyon mongs dgra tshogs ⑩rnams las rgyal/ /ngas ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan dam pa bsgreng ⑪/ /srid pa'i mtsho las sems can rab tu bsgral/ /ngas ni ngan song gsum gyi lam rnams bkag /sems can nyon mongs me yis gdungs gyur pa/ /rten med gyur cing dpung gnyen med pa dag /srog chags nyon mongs mes gdungs zhi byas nas/ /bdud rtsi 'ikhu ba bsil bas tshim par byas/ /gang phyir bskal pa du mar sngon chad ngas/ /'dren pa bsam gyis mi khyab mchod pa byas/ /chos kyi sku de yongs su tshol ba na/ /brtul zhugs brtan pas byang chub phyir spyad de/ /lag pa dang ni mig dang rkang pa dang / /yan lag mchog dang bu sdug bu mo dang / /nor dbyig nor bu mu tig rgyan dang gser/ /bai ḍūr+ya 97dang rin chen sna tshogs btang / /stong gsum shing ljon thams cad dang / /rtswa dang rtswa lirnams thams cad dang / /nags tshal dag dang sa las ni/ /'khrungs pa thams cad gcad 889—585

gtubs te/ /de dag thams cad phyer brlags ①nas/ /rab tu phra ba'i rdul 'drar byas/ /nam mkha'i (2)dkyil 'khor ji ( )tsam par/ /phye ma'i phung po spungs nas ni/ /'di la cha gsum dbye bar nus/ /sa la rdul ni yod pa rnams/ /stong gsum dag ni thams cad kyi/ /rdul khams bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /sems can kun gyis du )shes pa gang / /de ni sems can gcig gir ⑤gyur/ /shes pa de yis rdul rnams kyi/ /phye ma bgrang (5)bar byed na ni/ /sems can kun las rab 'phags pa/ /ye shes rab ldan ( mi rnams kyis/ /thams cad bgrang bar nus srid kyi/ /rgyal ba'i mkhyen pa mi nus so/ /thub pa chen po'i ye shes gang 37/ /skad cig gcig (shekyil 'jug pa yang / /bskal pa bye ba du mar ni//gang du'ang bgrang bar mi nus so/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las/ stong pa nyid kyi le'u zhes bya ste dgu pa'o// //de nas lha mo rin chen 'od 'phros 7chos bstan pa shin tu zab mo de thos nas/dga' ba dang rangs pa skyes te/ 'khor 'dus pa de'i nang nas stan las langs te / bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas11/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/bstan pa zab mo 'di la ji ltar rnal 'byor du bya ba nya zhu ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ rgyal ba rkang gnyis gtso lags te/ /'jig rten kun tu snang mdzad pa/ /byang chub spyod pa yang dag tshul/ /bdag la thugs rjes 1 bshad du gsol/ /rigs kyi lha mimo la bka' stsal pa/ khyod la the tshom 7ci yod pa/ /'dri tshaba'i don de zhus shig dang / /rnam par phye ste 89wa 586

bstan ①par bya/ /de nas yang rigs kyi lha mos bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba/bdag dang gzhan la phan gdags phyir/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ②ni / /'khor dang mya ngan 'das bral ba'i/ /byang chub spyod pa ji ltar spyad/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rigs kyi lha mo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lha mo chos kyi dbyings la gnas te/ byang chub kyi spyod pa spyad pas na(mi/ mnyam pa nyid la nan tan du bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / rigs kyi lha mos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ / btsun pa libacom ldan 'das ji ltar na chos kyi dbyings la gnas te/ byang chub kyi spyad pa spyod cing mnyam pa nyid la nan tan du bgyi ba lags/ bka' stsal pa/(de lha mo de ni phung po lnga la chos kyi dbyings su 'dogs te/ chos kyi dbyings ni phung po lnga nyid do / /phung po lnga yang brjod du med pa/ phung po lnga ma yin pa yang brjod du med pa ste/ de la chos kyi dbyings de nyid phung po lnga yin na ni chad par 'gyur rol/ /gal te phung po lnga las gzhan par 'dod na ni rtag par 'gyur te/mtshan ma gnyis dang bral brdo no/ mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa/ bltar med pa/blta bar bya ba las 'das pa/ ming dang mtshan ma med pa de ni chos kyi dbyings zhes (7)brjod do/ /rigs kyi (9lha mo phung po lnga la (9)chos kyi dbyings su ji ltar gdags zhe na/ phung po lnga de ni rgyu dang rkyen gyis ma bskyed pa de'i/ de yang gal te rgyu dang rkyen las skye ba zhig yin na ni/ skyes zin pa skye'am/ mi skye ba skye zhes bya/ gal te skyes zin pa skye na ni/ rgyu dang rkyen kyang mi dgos pa'i rigs so/ /gal te ma skyes pa skye na ni/ skye ba dmigs su med pa'i phyir 517ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gang ma skyes pa'i chos rnams ni yod pa ma yin pa nyid pas 89—587

ming med pa mtshan ma ①med pa/ gzhal ba ②dang / dpag pa dang / dper bya bas ⑧mi brjod pa ste/ rgyu dang rkyen gyis bskyed ④par bya ba ma yin no/ /rigs kyi lha mo dper na/ rnga'i ⑤sgra ni shing dang / ko ba dang / lag pa la brten te sgra 'byung mod kyi/ rnga'i sgra de ni 'das pa yang stong / ma 'ongs pa yang stong / da ltar gnas pa yang (yestong ste/ rnga'i sgra de ni shing las ⑦ma byung / ko ba dang lag pa las kyang ma byung / dus gsum gyis ma bskyed pas mi skye ba ste/ gang mi skye ba de ni mi 'gog pa'o/ /gang mi 'gog pa de ni gang nas kyang ma 'ongs pa'o/ /gang nas kyang ma (ge'ongs pa de ni gang du yang mi 'gro ba'o(shetsho / /gang du yang mi 'gro ba de ni rtag pa dang chad pa ma yin pas gcig pa yang ma yin/ tha dad pa yang ma yin pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gal te gcig pa yin na/ chos kyi dbyings dang tha mi dad pas/ 'o na ni byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams kyis kyang / don dam pa'i bden pa mngon du gyur pas/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba bodam pa thob par 'gyur ba zhig na/ de lta ma yin pas de gcig pa ma yin no/ /gal te de 4)tha dad pa yin na ni/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa yang bo/ mtshan ma de nyid 'dzin pa yin pas/ rnam par grol bar yang mi 'gyur zhing / nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba dang ma bral bas3nya/ de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par tsha'atshang mi rgya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'phags pa rnams ni 'du byed dang / 'du byed ma yin pa yang dag pa'i ngo bor gcig pa'i phyir tha dad pa ma yin no/ /de bas na phung po lnga po 3 de ni yod pa yang ma yin/ med pa yang ma yin/ rgyu dang rkyen gyis bskyed pa yang ma yin/ rgyu dang rkyen med 89—588

pas bskyed pa yang ma yin pa/ tshig gis thog tu mi phebs pa/ ming dang mtshan ma med pa/ rgyu dang rkyen med pa/ dpes bstan du med pa/ thog ①ma dang tha mar dben pa/ rang gi ngang gis stong pa ste/ de ni 'phags pa rnams kyis mkhyen par bya ba yin gyi/ gzhan gyi ②spyod yul du ma gyur pa'o/ /de bas na phung po lnga la chos kyi dbyings su ston to/ /gzhan yang rigs kyi lha mo gang rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang 'a la la zhig gis④/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub don dam pa dang / kun rdzob gzhan dang gzhan ma yin par 'dod pa de ni dpag par dka' ba ste/ 'phags pa dang / ma rabs kyi spyod yul ni gcig pa dang / tha dad pa'i rang bzhin ma yin te/kun rdzob kyang ma spangs/ don dam pa dang yang bral bar ma gyur pa de ni/chos kyi dbyings la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'o/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / rigs kyi lha mo de rab tu dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes nas stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas⑤/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas6)/thal mo sbyar bas (pebatud de/ spyi bos phyag 'tshal (kyenas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ji ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa de la bdag gis bslab par 'tshal lo/ /de nas mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa chen po 'khor 'dus pa de'i nang na 'dug pas/ rigs kyi lha mo rin chen 'od 'phro la 'di skad ces dris so//lha mo byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa shin tu bsgrub (9)par dka' ba 'di khyod ji ltar spyod pas de la dbang thob par 'gyur/ de nas rigs kyi lha mos tshangs pa 83—589

chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshangs pa'i rgyal po chen po ji ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i don de shin tu zab pas so so'i skye bo thams cad kyis de'i don mi shes te/ 'phags pa rnams kyi spyod yul bas/ mchog tu phra ba shes par dka' ①ba'o/ /bdag ni chos 'di la brten te / bde bar gnas pa thob bo/ /gal te tshig de bden pa lta 9kyen/ snyigs ④ma lnga'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di dag na zhe / tshad med grangs med dpag tu med pa'i sems can de dag thams cad gser gyi kha dog can du gyur te⑨/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa/ skyes pa yang ma yin/ bud med kyang ma yin pa sha stag tu gyur te/rin po che'i pad+ma la 'dug cing / bde ba tshad med pa la 97longs spyod pa dang /lha'i me tog mchog gi char 'bab cing / lha'i sil snyan dang / rol mo ma dkrol 8bar rang byung ba'i mchod pa de lta bu dang ldan par shog cig nyaces smras ma thag tu/ snyigs bom lnga'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na/ sems can ji snyed 'khod pa de dag thams cad gser gyi kha dog can/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dang ldan pa/ skyes pa yang ma yin/ bud med kyang ma yin par gyur nas / rin po che'i pad+ma la 'dug nya cing / bde ba tshad med pas longs spyod par gyur pa ni/ ji ltar gzhan 'phrul dbang byed nyurtalha'i gzhal med khang pa na/ngan 'gro thams cad med cing rin po che'i ljon shing sna tshogs bres pa/ rin po che sna bdun gyi pad+mas 1 'jig rten gyi khams khyab par byas pa/ rin po che sna bdun dang / lha'i me tog gi char 'bab 7pa/ lha'i rol mo sna tshogs kyis longs spyod par gnas pa bzhin du gyur to/ /de nas rigs kyi lha mo rin chen 'od 'phro dayang bud med kyi lus las/ tshangs pa'i lus su bsgyur cing 7'dug 89—690

gol/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen 'od 'phro la tshangs pa'i rgyal pos 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa khyod ji ltar byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod①/smras pa/ tshangs pa'i rgyal po chen po chu'i zla ba byang chub kyi spyad pa spyod pa bzhin/bdag kyang byang chub kyi spyad pa spyod do/ /rmi lam byang chub kyi spyad pa spyod pa ②bzhin / bdag kyang byang chub kyi spyad pa spyod do/ /smig rgyu ①byang chub kyi spyad pa spyod pa bzhin/ bdag kyang byang chub kyi spyad pa spyod do/ /sgra brnyan ④byang chub kyi spyad pa spyod pa bzhin/ bdag kyang byang chub kyi spyad pa spyod do/ /de skad ces bshad pa tshangs pa chen pos thos nas/ byang chub sems dpa' la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa khyod don gang la gnas te tshig de skad ces smra/lha mos ⑤smras pa/ tshangs pa'i rgyal po chos gang yang bden pa'i mtshan nyid du ma grub cing / rgyu dang rkyen la brten nas grub pa'i phyir ro/ /tshangs pa'i rgyal pos smras pa/ gal te de lta na so so'i skye bo thams cad kyang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba'i (7rigs so/ / smras pa/rtso/ skyes bu khyod ci'i phyir/ de skad ces smra/byis pa yang gzhan/ mkhas pa yang gzhan/ byang chub kyang gzhan/ byang chub ma yin pa yang gzhan/ rnam par grol ba yang gzhan/ rnam par grol ba ma yin pa yang gzhan ma yin (8༄med kyi tshangs pa chen po 5)de dag thams cad ni/chos kyi dbyings su mnyam pa nyid de ri so so ma yin pa/ yang dag par dbyer med / pa/ bar mtshams med pa/ 'phel ba dang / 'grib pa med pa la mngon par chags shing 'dzin to/ /tshangs pa'i rgyal po dper na/ sgyu ma mkhan namayin / de'i slob ma sgyu ma sprul pa la mkhas shing byang bar gyur pa zhig gis/83—591

lam gyi bzhi mdor/ sa dang / bye ma dang / shing dang / rtswa dang / lo ma la sogs pa gnas gcig tu bsdus te/ sgyu ma sprul pa 'di lta ste/ rta dang glang po che'i tshogs dang / dmag dang shing rta la sogs pa'i tshogs dang / rin po che sna bdun gyi phung po dang / bang ba dang mdzod la sogs pa rnam pa sna tshogs kun la ston to/ /de la sems can byis pa blun po ①mi shes pa'i rang bzhin can dag gis mthong na(ge/ sgyu ma sprul par ⑧mi shes te/ rta dang glang po che la sogs pa mthong ba dang / thos pa 'di dag ni yang dag par yod pa yin te/ gzhan ni brdzun 2)pa snyam du sems shing / phyis kyang de la zhib tu rtog par mi byed do/ /de la mkhas pa shes pa'i rang bzhin can rnams ni de lta ma yin te/ sgyu ma sprul pa yin par shes nas/ thos pa dang mthong ba de dag la 'di snyam du sems te/rta dang glang po che la sogs pa bdag gis mthong ba 'di dag ⑤ni yang dag pa ma yin pa/ sgyu ma sprul pas 'gro ba'i mig slu bar chu)byed pa ste/ rta dang glang po che dang / bang mdzod la sogs pa 'di dag ni der snang ba tsam du zad de/bdag gis mthong ba dang thos pa bzhin du bden pa (7ma yin par yang 'dzin la/phyis zhib tu brtags na yang brdzun 8pa slu ba'i chos su shes so/ /de lta bas na thabs shemakhas pa rnams kyis ni/ chos 'di dag thams cad ni yang dag pa ma yin pa'i rang bzhin du rtogs te/ ji ltar mthong ba dang thos pa 7yang kun rdzob tsam du de dag gi 17don mtshon pa dang tshig gi tha snyad la brten nas/ yang dag pa'i don shes par bya ba tsam du zad kyi don dam pa ni 7de lta ma yin no snyam mo / /yang tshangs pa chen po byis pa so so'i skye bo 'phags pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes rab kyi mig ma thob pa rnams kyis ni/ chos 'di dag thams 83—592

cad kyi de bzhin nyid brjod du med par yang mi shes la/ gang mthong ba dang /thos pa dang / 'du byed dang / 'du byed ma yin pa'i chos rnams ji ltar brtags pa ltar bden pa nyid du mngon par zhen te/ chos rnams kyi de bzhin nyid brjod du med pa don dam pa'i tshul de shes par mi nus so/ /de la 'phags pa rnams kyis ni gang gzigs shing gsan pa dang / 'du byed dang / 'du byed ma yin pa'i chos rnams kyis ①mthu dang / las ji lta bu yin pa de la bden pa'o zhes mngon par mi zhen te/ 'du byed kyi chos kyang mi bden pa/ 'du byed (kyem yin pa'i chos kyang mi bden pa/ yang dag pa ma yin pa'i ③rtog pas brtags ④pa tsam du 'du byed dang / 'du byed ma yin pa'i mtshan nyid kyang ming tsam du (5)zad pa/ bden pa'i rang bzhin du mi ⑨grub pa stertsi/ 'phags pa rnams kyis ((kun rdzob kyi tha snyad la brten nas/ yang dag pa'i 5tabaden pa'i don de 7ston par byed do/ /de bzhin du tshangs pa chen po gang 'phags pa rnams ni/ 'phags pa'i ye shes dang / 'phags pa'i gzigs pas chos rnams kyi de bzhin nyid brjod du med pa bzhin/ 'du byed dang / 'du byed ma yin pa'i chos kyang de bzhin du lta /steste/ kun rdzob tu ming dang mtshan ma sna tshogs la brten tsanas/ gzhan la ston par byed do/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' rin chen 'od 'phro la tshangs pa chen pos 'di skad ces smras so/ /sems can ji snyed cig gis chos zab mo 'di lta bu rtogs shing shes par nus/ smras pa / tshangs pa chen po gang sprul pa mang po'i sems dang sems las byung bas chos zab mo 'di yang dag par shes par gyur pa de /gesnyed kyis shes tsobo/ /tshangs pa'i rgyal pos smras pa/ sprul pa de dag nyid kyang rang bzhin yod pa ma 83—593
