yin na/ de dag gis 3)sems dang / sems las byung ba gang nas skye bar 'gyur / smras pa/ gang chos kyi dbyings yod pa yang ②ma yin/ med pa yang ④ma yin par yang dag par 5)shes pa de dag gis/ zab mo de'i don shes par nus so/ /de nas tshangs pa chen pos/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' rin chen 'od 'phro 'di ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa ste/ chos kyi gzhung zab mo 'di la mkhas pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa(ge/ de de bzhin te/ tshangs pa chen po de ji ltar khyod kyis smras pa de sbyo6)bzhin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen 'od 'phro 'dis khyed 2la ji skad bstan pa bzhin du nan tan du sgrubs 9kyeshig dang /mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas lha'i rgyal po tshangs pa chen po dang / gzhan yang tshangs pa'i 'khor de dag stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas99)/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te7 / thal mo sbyar bas byang chub sems dpa' rin chen 'od 'phro'i rkang pa gnyis 11la spyi bos phyag 'tshal 12te/ tshig 'di skad ces smras so/ /deng skyes bu chen po khyod dang phrad cing bdag cag gis dam pa'i chos 'di lta bu thos par gyur pa ngo mtshar che ba 1 lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshangs pa chen po la bka' stsal pa/ byang chub sems dpa' rin chen 'od 'phro 'di ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ rin po che'i 'od 77dpal gyi snying po zhes bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig tshapa dang zhabs su ldan pa / bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ bla na med pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom 89wa 594

ldan 'das su 'gyur ro zhes bka' stsal to/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa de'i tshe/byang chub sems dpa' khri phrag sum stong gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur to/ /lha'i bu khri phrag brgyad stong dang /rgyal po dang / blon po la sogs pa/ tshad med grangs med pa rnams kyis rdul med cing ①rdul dang bral ba'i chos la chos kyi mig rnam par dag par gyur to/ /de nas 'khor 'dus pa de'i nang na / dge slong khri phrag lnga bcu byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa byang chub kyi sems las phyir mi ldog par sems pa de dag kyang / byang chub sems dpa' rin chen 'od 'phros chos bstan pa 'di thos nas/ byang chub kyi sems phyir zhing brtan nyan)pa dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa bla na med pa'i smon lam yongs su rdzogs nas yang ④byang chub tu sems bskyed dunade/so so nas rang rang gi gos gyon pa (zhephud de/ byang chub sems dpa' la gsol nas / bla na med pa (namachog dam pa'i sems bskyed de smon lam 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag cag gis gshedage ba'i rtsa ba ci mchis pa de dag thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo'o zhes smon lam btab bo/ /tshangs pa chen po dge slong de dag gis/ bsod nams de la brten nas/ ji skad smras pa bzhin nan tan du bsgrubs nas/ bskal pa chen po dgu bcu 'das pa na/ 'khor ba las 9)yongs su 'das pa'i shes pa skyes par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong de dag la bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag khyed bskal pa grangs med pa sum cu 'das pa'i 'og tu/ bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur yote/ bskal pa'i ming ni rgyal bar dga' 51gleba'i 'od kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ yul gyi ming ni dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya bar dus 89wa 595

gcig ①tu kun kyang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ste/ de dag kun kyang mtshan smon lam rnam par bkod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba yon tan gyi mtshan bcu yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro / /zhes lung bstan to/ /gzhan yang tshangs pa chen po gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po gang nyan pa dang 'dzin pa de dag ni ②mthu dang /gzi brjid chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ②te/ dper na gang la la zhig gis/thabs dang mi ldan pas pha rol tu phyin pa drug /bskal pa chen po brgyad stong du spyod pa bas/ gang rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang ④la la zhig gis/gser 'od dam pa ⑤mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal yipo 'di glegs bam du bris te/zla ba phyed phyed cing sems rtse gcig tu byas te klog cing 'don na/ bsod nams kyi 97phung po 'di byal/ bsod nams kyi phung po snga ma des brgya'i char yang nye bar 0mi phod pa nas/ grangs su bgrang ⑩ba dang dper bsgrun ⑨par yang mi bzod do/ /tshangs pa chen po de lta bas na/ khyod 7kyis rtag tu yid la bya zhing / nan tan du bsgrub 8pa dang / gzung zhing gzhan la yang yang dag par rgya cher bstan par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sngon 'das pa'i dus na nga byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa 8spyod pa'i tshe/ ji ltar skyes bu dpa' bo g.yul ngor lus dang srog la mi lta ba bzhin du/ ngas kyang mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di gzung 7zhing 'dzin pa dang / klog 7cing 'don pa dang / gzhan la yang rgya cher yang dag par ston pa la thogs pa med par gyur totu sna/ /tshangs pa chen po dper na 'khor los sgyur zhu ba'i rgyal po nam 'jig rten na gnas kyi bar du tunyerin po che sna bdun yang med par gi tshomi 'gyur ro/ /gal te rgyal po mi bzhugs na/89—596

rin po che sna bdun yang mod la med par 'gyur ro/ /tshangs pa chen po de ltar de bzhin du/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di 'jig rten na gnas kyi bar du/ bla na med pa'i chos rin po che thams cad kyang nub par mi 'gyur ro/ /mdo sde'i rgyal ①po 'di nam med pa na gzhan dag kyang nub par 'gyur ro/ /de lta bas na mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di sems rtse gcig tu byas te/mnyan pa dang / gzung ba dang / klog ②pa dang / gzhan dul yang rgya cher bshad pa dang / yi ger 'drir ④'jug pa dang / lus dang srog la mi blta ⑤bas ngal ba dang / dub pa khyad du gsod cing brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yispyad par bya ste/ bsod nams kyi nang na mchog yin par nga'i 'khor rnams kyis kyang de bzhin du bslab cing nan tan du bya'o/ /de nas tshangs pa'i rgyal po chen po la sogs te/ tshangs pa'i 'khor grangs med pa dang / brgya byin lha'i dbang po dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / gzhan yang gnod sbyin gyi dbang po la ⑦sogs pa de dag thams cad stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas(kye/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag stigis kyang gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di bsrung ⑩ba dang yongs su rgyas par bgyi'o/ /chos 'di ston pa'i tshe nyunyebagegs dang bar chad kun 7bsal te/ dge bar 'gyur ba dang / kha dog dang /mthu yongs su rdzogs pa nyushedang / spobs pa thogs pa med pa dang / lus dang sems bde bar 'gyur ba dang / de'i 'khor rnams kyang bde ba nyams su myong ba dang / gang na gnas pa'i yul 'khor de yang mu ge dang dgra'i 'jigs pa 89—597

dang ske/ mi ma yin pas ①'tshe ba zhig mchis na yang bdag cag lha'i 'khor gyis yongs su bsrungs pas/ de dag bde ②zhing skyid pa dang / gnod pa rnams ma byung ②bar gyur na/ de dag kyang bdag cag lha'i mthu lags par 'tshal bar bgyi'o / /gang la la zhig mdo sde ④'di la mchod cing rim gro bgyid na/ de la bdag cag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang 'dra bar mchod cing rim gro bgyi'o⑤ / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i rgyal po tshangs pa chen po la sogs te / tshangs pa'i 'khor de dag dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / gnod sbyin gyi dbang po la ⑥sogs pa rnams ⑦la legs so zhes bka' stsal te(9/ legs so legs so/ /rigs kladakyi bu khyod kyis dam pa'i chos zab mo 'di yang thos/ mdo sde'i dbang po 'di dang 'di ti'adzin pa la bsrung 7ba dang / bskyab pa'i sems bskyed 32pa des bsod nams kyi khyad par tshad med pa dang ldan pas myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'ol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces (nyabaka' stsal nas/ tshangs pa'i rgyal po la sogs pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las stong pa nyid la brten nas bsam pa yongs su rdzogs pa zhes bya ba'i lile'u ste bcu pa'o// //de nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu dang / rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung tshadang / rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po dang / rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu bgos nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal 89—598

mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsungs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gzigs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dgongs pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad kyis yongs su bzung ba/ lha'i tshogs thams cad kyis phyag bgyis pa/ lha'i tshogs thams cad kyis mchod pa/ lha'i dbang po'i tshogs thams cad kyis mngon par bstod pa/ 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyis mchod cing bsngags te/ brjod nas 6)rab tu bkur ba/lha'i khang khyim thams cad snang bar bgyid ri pa/ sems can thams cad la mchog tu bde ba thams cad rab tu sbyin par bgyid pa/ sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal thams cad skems pa/ 'jigs pa thams cad kyi rgyun gcod pa/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad rab tu zlog tshoṭapa/ mu ge'i ya nga ba thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyid pa/ nad kyi ya nga ba thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyid pa/ gza'i gnod pa 54thams cad sel ba/ mchog tu zhi bar bgyid pa/ mya ngan dang nyon mongs pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyid pa/ gnod pa rnam pa sna tshogs rab tu zhi bar bgyid pa/ gnod pa 'bum rab tu 'joms ri par bgyid (6)lags so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di 'khor gyi nang du rgya cher yang dag par rab tu bshad na/ chos mnyan pa chos 7ribadud rtsi'i khu ba 'dis bdag cag rgyal po chen po dpung dang g.yog tu bcas pa bzhi'i lha'i lus 'di gzi byin chen pos rnam par 'phel bar 83—599

'gyur ro/ /bdag cag gi lus la brtson pa dang / stobs ①dang mthu yang bskyed 9gepar 'gyur/ gzi brjid dang / dpal dang / phun sum ①tshogs pa yang bdag cag gi lus la 'jug par 'gyur te/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po snyibazhi ni chos (pedang ldan pa/ chos smra ba chos kyi rgyal po lags te/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag ni chos kyis⑥/ lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / dri za dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'bye chen po rnams kyi rgyal po bgyi'o/ /'byung po'i tshogs mi bzad pa/ snying rje ma mchis pa/ gzhan gyi gzi byin 'phrog pa rnams bzlog par bgyi'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po gebazhi/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / gnod sbyin 'bum 'phrag pyon du ma dang lhan cig tu rtag par rgyun du lha'i mig rnam par dag pa/mi'i las 'das pas 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad la blta bar bgyi/ bsrung ⑨bar bgyi/ yongs su bskyang bar bgyi ste/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das de'i slad du/ bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi/ 'jig rten skyong 7zhes ming du chags so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gang su dag 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyis yul 'joms par 'gyur ram/ mu ge'i ya nga ba'am/nad kyi ya nga ba'am/ gnod pa sna tshogs brgya dang/ gnod pa stong dang /gnod pa 'bum dag gis gtses par 'gyur ba 31na/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhis gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 1 'di 'dzin pa'i dge slong chos smra ba de dag la bskul bar bgyi'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das nam bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhis/ rdzu 'phrul 89—600

dang ske/ byin gyis rlabs ①kyis dge slong chos smra ba ②de dag chabaskul ba na/yul gang dang ligang du mchis par snyigaser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di yul de dang shide dag tu rgya cher yang dag par ston par 'gyur te/gang dag ⑦gnod pa sna tshogs brgya dang / gnod pa sna tshogs nistong yul du 'byung ba ⑨'di lta bu 'di dag rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das mi'i ⑩rgyal po gang gi (/nyeyul du mdo sde'i dbang po 'dzin pa'i dge slong chos smra ba de dag mchi bar 'gyur ba'i yul de dag tu/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di yang bsnyen par 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das nam mi'i rgyal pos gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di mnyan te 8thos nas/ mdo sde'i dbang po 'di spege'adzin pa'i dge slong de dag phyir rgol ba thams cad las kun tu srung bar bgyidami/ yongs su bskyab pa dang ske/ yongs su 'dzin pa dang / yongs su skyong bar bgyid na/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhis/ mi'i rgyal po de'i yul thams cad na gnas pa'i sems can rnams kun tu bsrung 8bar bgyi/ yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung skob dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das mi'i rgyal pos nam/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen 51 nam/ dge bsnyen / ma mdo sde'i dbang po 'dzin pa la bde bar sbyar 519ba thams cad kyis bde bar bgyid na/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po shu )bzhis/ mi'i rgyal po de'i yul thams cad na gnas pa'i sems can rnams la/bde ba'i yo byad thams cad kyis bde ba dang yo byad thams cad phun sum tshogs 89wa 601

par bgyi'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das/ nam mi'i rgyal pos dge slong ngam/dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma mdo sde'i dbang po 'di 'dzin pa la/ bsti stang hu)bgyid/ bla mar bgyid/ rim gror (mibagyid cing mchod na/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhis/mi'i rgyal po chen po ri de la/ rgyal po thams cad pas ches bsti ④stang du bgyiphyi/ches bla mar bgyi/ ches rim gror bgyi/ ches mchod par bgyi ste/ yul thams cad du yang rab tu 6bsngags par (pebagyi'o/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las/ rgyal po chen po bzhis lha dang mi la rnam par lta ⑧ba zhes bya khyaste le'u bcu gcig pa'o// // bam po drug pa/nye tsho de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'o/rgyal po chen po bzhi la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ rgyal po chen po dag legs so legs so/ /rgyal po chen po khyed yang legs so legs so/ /'di lta ste/ khyod ⑩ni sngon gyi rgyal ba la lhag par bya ba byas pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bskyed 3 pa/ sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag mang po la bsnyen bkur byas pa/ chos dang ldan pa/ chos smra ba/ chos kyi rgyal po/ chos kyis 7lha dang mi rnams kyi rgyal po byed pa'o/ /'di lta ste/ khyod tshani yun ring por sems can thams cad la phan pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ bde ba dang byams pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ sems can thams cad la phan pa dang / bde bar bya ba'i 7lhag pa'i bsam pa la zhugs pa mi phan pa thams cad 'gog pa/ sems can thams cad la bde ba thams cad nye bar bsgrub 1 par brtson pa yin te/ rgyal po chen po khyed bzhis mi'i rgyal po gser 89—602

'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di la mchod pa dang / rim gro byed par brtson pa de dag la kun tu bsrung ba ①gyis shig /yongs su bskyab pa dang ske/ yongs su gzung ②ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar ②gyis shig / des na ④rgyal po chen po dpung dang g.yog dang ske/ gnod sbyin 'bum phrag du ma dang / bcas pa khyed bzhis/ 'das pa dang ske/ ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chos kyi tshul kun tu bsrung bar la'agyur ro/ /yongs su bskyang ba ⑥dang ske/ yongs su gzung ⑦bar yang 'gyur ro/ /des na rgyal po chen po ⑧dpung dang g.yog dang / gnod sbyin 'bum phrag du ⑨ma dang bcas pa khyed bzhis /lha dang / lha ma yin du g.yul 'gyed pa na rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /lha ma yin rnams pham par 'gyur ro/ /'di ltar gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad 'dul bar byed pa 'di'i phyir/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma mdo sde'i dbang po 'dzin pa de dag la kun tu bsrung ba gyis she shig /yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung tsheb dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar /nga gyis shig /de nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu dang / rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung lidang / rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po dang / rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu bgos nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/83—603

gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i ①rgyal po 'di grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/grong rdal lam/ ljongs sam/ yul 'khor ram/ rgyal po'i ②pha brang 'khor gang du spyod par 'gyur ba dang / mi'i rgyal po gang dang gang gi yul du spyod par 'gyur ba dang / btsun pa ②bcom ldan 'das mi'i rgyal por 'gyur ba dugang la la zhig /lha'i dbang po'i dam tshig rgyal po'i bstan bcos ⑤'dis rgyal po bgyid cing / rtag par rgyun du gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di nyan tam/ rim gro bgyid dam/ mchod pa bgyid dam/ dge slong ngam/dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ gang (zhedage bsnyen ma stimado sde'i dbang po'i rgyal shepo 'dzin pa de dag la yang bste thostang du ⑩bgyid/ btsun par bgyid / rim gro 31bgyid cing mchod de rtag par rgyun du gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po nyan na/ chos mnyan pa'i chu bo'i chus/ chos 7bdud rtsi'i khu ba 'dis bdag cag rgyal po chen po dpung dang g.yog tu bcas pa bzhi dang ske/ gnod sbyin 'bum phrag du ma'i lha'i lus 'di dag gzi byin chen po rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur1 / bdag cag la brtson 'grus dang mthu 8stobs chen por yang bgyid par ska'agyur/ bdag cag gi gzi brjid 7dang dpal dang phun sum tshogs pa yang rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi dpung dang g.yog tu bcas pa gnod sbyin 'bum phrag du ma dang lus bltar 1 tshomi gda' bar bgyis te/ da ltar dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ grong rdal lam/ yul 'khor ram/pho brang 'khor gang na gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di spyod par 'gyur ba de dag tu mchi bar bgyi'o/ /mi'i rgyal po gser 'od dam pa mdo 89wa 604

sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di nyan pa dang / rim gro ①bgyid pa dang / mchod pa bgyid pa de dag la kun tu bsrung ②bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su bskyab pa dang /yongs su gzung ①ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / chad pa spang ba dang /zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor de dag dang / yul 'khor de dag dang / yul gde dag kyang kun tu bsrung ⑤bar bgyi'o / /yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung ༅ba dang / yongs su bskyang 4 ba dang / chad pa spang ba dang / zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /yul de dag kyang 'jigs pa dang / gnod pa (kyedang / 'khrug shepa thams cad las yongs su thar bar bgyi'o/ /pha rol gyi dmag tshogs rnams kyang slar bzlog par bgyi'o/ /mi'i rgyal po gang la la gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di nyan tshepa dang / rim gro nyunyebagyid pa dang / mchod pa bgyid pa de'i dgra zla 'dab mnye ba'i rgyal po gzhan zhig mchis la/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das nam dgra zla 'dab 32nye ba de'i rgyal po de 'di snyam du bdag dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa dang lhan cig tu yul der song ste/ yul de rnam 8par gzhig go snyam du sems bskyed na/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das de'i tshe de'i dus na/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di'i gzi brjid kyi mthus dgra zla 'dab rimanye ba'i rgyal po de rgyal po gzhan dag dang g.yul 'gyed par 'gyur/ rang gi yul du phyin na yang yul 'khrug par 'gyur/ rgyal po'i 'khrug tshepa mi bzad nyu pa yang 'byung bar 'gyur/ yul du gza' ri dang /nad kyang 'byung bar 'gyur/ yul du brel ba sna tshogs brgya dag kyang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das nam dgra zla 'dab nyu nye ba'i rgyal po de 83—605

rang gi yul du phyin na/ gnod pa sna tshogs brgya dang / brel ba sna tshogs brgya 'di lta bu 'byung ngo / /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das dgra zla 'dab ①nye ba'i rgyal po de yan lag bzhi pa'i dmag bsogs te②/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs su mchi ba'i slad du/ rang gi yul nas byung ste / dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa dang lhan cig tu yul der mchi 'tshal ba dang / gang na gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di gnas pa'i yul de rnam ④par gzhig par ⑤'tshal bar gyur (6 na/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi dpung dang g.yog tu bcas pa(ge// gnod sbyin 'bum phrag du ma dang lhan cig tu lus mi gda' bar bgyis te/ der mchi bar bgyi'o/ /pha rol gyi dmag tshogs de shul du zhugs pa las kyang / de nyid nas ldog par bgyi'o/ /brel ba sna tshogs brgya dag kyang nye bar bsgrub 8)par bgyi'o/ /bgegs kyang bgyi'o/ /'di lta ste/ yul der pha rol gyi dmag tshogs de mchir sa9)yang mi nus na/ yul bo gzhig par bgyid par nyanyelta ga la 'gyur/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po bzhi po de dag la nya legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ rgyal po chen po dag legs so legs so/ /rgyal po chen po dag khyed yang legs so/ /khyed bskal pa grangs med pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du mar 12yang dag par bsgrubs pa/bla san med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'di'i phyir/ mi'i rgyal po gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di nyan pa dang / rim gro byed tsopa dang / mchod pa byed pa de dag la kun tu bsrung bar 7gyis shig /yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung 1 tshob dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang /chad pa spang ba 1 dang / zhi ba dang / bde 19legs su 'gyur bar gyis 3geshig /89wa 606

rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor de dag dang / grong khyer de dag dang / yul 'khor de dag dang / yul de dag kyang kun tu srungs shig /yongs su bskyab pa dang /yongs su gzung ①ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / chad pa spang ②ba dang /zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur bar ①gyis shig /yul de dag kyang 'jigs pa dang / gnod pa dang / 'khrug ④pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar gyis shig /pha rol gyi dmag tshogs rnams kyang zlog ⑤par gyis shig / 'dzam bu'i ⑥gling thams cad na gnas pa'i mi'i rgyal po de medag mi 'thab pa dang / mtshang dumi 'dru ⑨ba dang / mi rtsod pa dang / mi 'gyed par bya ba la spro bar gyis shig /rgyal po chen po dpung dang g.yog tu bcas pa khyed bzhis0/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir nam grong khyer brgyad khri bzhi stong de dag na/ rgyal po brgyad khri bzhi stong po de dag rang rang gi yul la mngon par dga' ba dang / rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug des mngon par dga' ba dang / rang gi nor gyi tsosang pos phan tshun rnam par mi 'tshe ba dang / phan tshun rnam par 'tshe ba mi skyed pa dang / rang gis ji ltar sngon gyi las bsags pas rgyal po thob pa'i rang gi rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug gis dga' ba dang / phan tshun du mayul 'jig hunyepar mi byed pa dang / yul gzhig pa'i phyir pha rol gyis 8mi gnod pa dang / nam 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir grong khyer brgyad khri bzhi stong chogedag na/ rgyal po brgyad khri bzhi stong de dag ༅phan tshun du byams pa'i sems su 'gyur/ byams pa'i sems dang / phan pa'i sems su 'gyur te/ phan tshun du mi 'thab/ mtshang mi 'dru/shi tsho mi rtsod mi 'gyed par rang rang gi yul dag na dga' bar 'gyur na/ de'i phyir rgyal po chen po dpung dang g.yog tu bcas pa /shekhyod bzhis57/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'di rgyas 89—607

par 'gyur/ lo legs par 'gyur/ nyams dga' bar 'gyur/ skye bo dang mi mang pos gang bar 'gyur/ sa yang byin can du 'gyur/ dus dang / zla ba dang ske/ zla ba phyed ①dang / lo khyud kor ②thams cad kyang yang dag pa'i dus dang ldan par 'gyur/ gza' dang / rgyu skar dang / zla ba dang / nyi ma yang ①nyin mtshan du legs par rgyu bar 'gyur/ char pa'i rgyun kyang sa la dus dus su 'bab par 'gyur/ 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad na gnas pa'i sems can rnams kyang / nor dang 'bru thams cad 'byor par 'gyur/ longs spyod che ba dang ske/ ser sna med par 'gyur/ gtong ba dang ldan par 'gyur/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang ldan par 'gyur/ phal cher bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du skye bar 'gyur/ lha'i khang khyim rnams kyang / lha dang lha'i bu rnams kyis gang bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po (pedag gang la la zhig mi'i rgyal por gyur tshogel/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di nyan par 'gyur (6)te / rim gro byas/ mchod pa byas/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma mdo sde'i dbang po 'dzin pa de dag la yang bste stang (7byed/ bla mar byed/ rim gror byed/ mchod par byed cing rgyal po chen po khyod na bzhi dpung dang g.yog tu bcas par stiganod sbyin 'bum phrag du ma la snying brtse ba'i phyir/ rtag par rgyun du gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal 1 po 'di nyan na/ chos mnyan pa'i chu 3)klung / chos lha bdud rtsi'i yi khu ba 'dis/ khyed cag gi milus 'di dag tshim par 'gyur ro/ /khyed kyi lha'i lus 'di dag gi gzi byin chen po yang rnam par 'phel lo/ /khyed kyi brtson 'grus dang mthu lostobs kyang skyed tshado/ /khyed kyi gzi brjid dang / dpal dang /89wa 608

phun sum tshogs pa yang rnam par 'phel ①bar 'gyur ro/ /mi'i rgyal po des de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa nga la yang mchod pa bsam gyis ②mi khyab pa rgya chen po yangs pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /mi'i rgyal po de ①'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma la yang yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ rgya che ba yangs pa thams cad kyis mchod pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /des na mi'i rgyal po ④de la bsrung ⑤ba chen po byas par 'gyur ro/ / des na ⑥mi'i rgyal po de la kun tu bsrung ⑦ba dang / yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung ⑧ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / chad pa spang ba dang / zhi ba dang ske/ bde legs su 'gyur ba ⑨byas par 'gyur ro/ /btsun mo dam pa dang /rgyal bu rnams dang / btsun mo'i 'khor thams cad dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor thams cad kyang bsrung bob chen po byas par 'gyur ro/ /yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / chad pa spang ba dang / zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur ba byas par 'gyur ro/nye/ /rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor na gnas pa'i lha thams cad kyang ches gzi brjid bidang ldan pa dang / ches nyu stobs dang ldan pa dang / bde ba dang yid bde ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par 'gyur/ dga' ba sna tshogs myong bar 'gyur/grong khyer de dag dang / yul 'khor de dag kyang kun tu bsrung tsobar 'gyur/yongs su bskyang bar 8'gyur/ gnod pa med par 'gyur/ dgra med par 'gyur/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad kyis mi brdzi (/stob dang / gnod pa med pa dang / 'khrug pa med par 'gyur ro/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang /83—609

bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu dang / rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung ①dang / rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po dang / rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang dang / de dag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das mi'i rgyal po gang la la zhig gis ②gser 'od dam pa ②mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di yang nyan 'tshal bar 'gyur④/ bdag nyid la yang bsrung 9geb chen po bgyid 'tshal bar 'gyur(6)/ btsun mo dam pa dang / rgyal bu rnams dang / rgyal po'i bu mo rnams dang / btsun mo'i 'khor gyi tshogs rnams la yang / bsrung meb chen po bgyid ⑧'tshal bar 'gyurasti/ rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor de 8thams cad la yang zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur ba chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ mchog tu khyad par du 'phags pa/ bla na med pa bgyid (7'tshal bar 'gyur32/ tshe 'di nyid hunyel bdag gi 7rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnam par 'phel bar bgyid 'tshal bar 'gyuralhonye/rgyal po nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par 'gyuras/ bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu ma mchis pa yang nyi yongs su 'dzin 'tshal bar 'gyurapo/ bdag gi yul thams cad kyang kun tu bsrung 19'tshal bar 'gyur( )/ yongs su bskyang 0'tshal bar 'gyur / rang gi yul na gnod pa ma mchis pa dang / dgra ma mchis pa dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyis mi brdzi tsho snyeb dang / nad 'go ( steb ma mchis pa dang / 'khrug pa ma mchis par bgyid 'tshal bar gyur na/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das mi'i rgyal po des g.yeng ba ma mchis pa'i sems dang /gus pa dang bcas pa'i sems dang / rim gro 2shedang bcas pas gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di/ bste tsho lhasang du bgyis te mnyan par 89—610

bgyi'o / /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di mnyan pa'i slad du/ mi'i rgyal po des/ rgyal po'i pho brang khyad par du 'phags par mchi bar bgyi'o/ /der mchis nas kyang / rgyal po'i pho brang spos chab sna tshogs kyis chag chag gdab ①cing / me tog sil ma sna tshogs dgram ②par bgyi'o/ /spos chab sna tshogs kyis chag chag btab pa der chos kyi chakhri mthon po rgyan dusna tshogs kyis legs par brgyan pa bsham par bgyi'o/ /phyogs der gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan sna tshogs kyis legs par brgyan ⑤par bgyi'o/ /mi'i rgyal po des lus bkru bar bgyi'o/ /gos dri rab tu bda' ⑥ba/ gos sar pa mdzes pa bgos ⑦nas/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan par bgyi'o/ /bdag gi ⑧ stan rab tu dma' ba gding bar bgyi ste0/ stan de la mchis nas/ rgyal po'i rgyags pas dregs par ⑩mi bgyi'o/ /der rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la chags par mi hu bgyi'o/ /rgyags pa dang / nga rgyal dang / dregs pa thams cad rnam par spangs pa'i 7sems kyis/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di mnyan par bgyi'o/ /dge slong chos smra ba de la yang ston par 'du shes bskyed par bgyi'o(/snye/ /mi'i rgyal po des de'i tshe de'i dus na/ btsun mo dam pa dang /rgyal bu rnams dang / rgyal po'i bu mo rnams dang / btsun mo'i 'khor gyi tshogs rnams la sdug pa dang / phan pas blta bar bgyi'o/ /btsun mo dam pa rnams 〉dang / rgyal bu rnams dang / rgyal po'i bu mo rnams la tshig snyan pa tshes bar bgyi'o/ /btsun mo'i 'khor gyi tshogs thams cad la yang tshig snyan pa 7smra bar bgyi'o/ /chos mnyan pa'i phyir sna mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs sbyor du stsal bar bgyi'o/ /dga' ba bsam gyis mi khyab cing mtshungs pa ma mchis pas/83—611

bdag tshim par bgyi'o/ /dga' ba dang bde ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas ①bde bar bgyi'o/ /dbang po bde bar bgyi'o/ /bdag nyid don ②chen po thob par bsam par bgyi'o/ /bdag dga' ba chen pos dga' bar bgyi'o/ /rab tu dga' ba ②chen po bskyed ④nas/ chos smra ba bsu (gebar bgyi'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po bzhi la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rgyal po chen po dag de'i tshe de'i dus na/ mi'i rgyal po des gos thams cad dkar po sar pa mdzes pa bgo stibar bya'o/ /spud pa dang /rgyan sna tshogs kyis (pebadag legs par brgyan par bya'o⑧/ /gdugs dkar po yang gzung bar bya'o⑨/ /rgyal po'i mthu chen po dang / rgyal po'i bkod pa chen pos bkra shis tha dad pa sna tshogs thogs te/ rgyal po'i pho brang de nas byung la chos smra ba de 7bsu ba'i phyir der 'gro bar bya'o/lha/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ mi'i rgyal pos der gom pa ji snyed bor ba/ de snyed kyi bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig phrag 'bum gyi 7'khor ba phyir bsnyil bar 'gyur/ de snyed kyi 'khor los sgyur hunyaba'i rgyal rigs bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag 'thob 0par 'gyur/ der gom pa ji lisnyed bor ba de snyed du tshe 'di la rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phel bar 'gyur/ bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du mar gnas yangs shing rgya che ba/ lha'i gzhal med khang rin po che sna bdun las byas pa dag 'thob tshapar 'gyur/ mi rnams kyis 1 1rgyal rigs dang / lha'i nyu rgya che zhing rgya che ba 'bum phrag du ma 'thob 19par 'gyur/ skye ba 2 snathams cad du dbang phyug chen po thob par 'gyur/ tshe ring bar 'gyur/ yun ring du 'tsho bar 'gyur/spobs pa dang ldan par 'gyur/ tshig gzung ( 1bar 'os par 'gyur/ grags pa 89wa 612

dang ldan par 'gyur/ brjod pa shin tu rgya che ①bar 'gyur/ bsngags par 'os par 'gyur/ lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten la phan par 'gyur/ lha dang mi rnams kyi bde ba rgya che zhing rgya che ba thob par 'gyur/stobs che bar 'gyur/ tshan po che chen po'i stobs kyi shugs dang ldan zhing gzugs bzang bar 'gyur/ mdzes pa dang / blta na sdug pa dang / kha dog bzang po rgyas pa mchog dang ②ldan par 'gyur/ skye ba thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa dang phrad par 'gyur/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams rnyed par 'gyur/ bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu med pa yongs su gzung nibar 'gyur te/ rgyal po chen po dag yon tan gyi phan yon 'di lta bu byadag mthong nas/mi'i rgyal po des dpag tshad ⑤tsam du chos smra ba la 0bsu bar bya/ dpag tshad brgya dang / dpag tshad stong du yang bsu bar bya/ chos smra ba de la ston par 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /yang 'di snyam du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa deng bdag gi rgyal po'i ⑦mo brang 'dir 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /deng de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/ bdag gi rgyal po'i pho brang 'dir bshos gsol bar 'gyur ro/ /deng bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i chos 'jig rten thams cad dang mi mthun pa mnyan par bya'o8༄/ /deng bdag gis 5)chos mnyan pa tso/'dis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par bya'o37/ /deng bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma mnyes par byas par 'gyur ro/ /deng bdag gis 'das pa dang / ma byon pa 83—613

dang —/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la/ mchod pa chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa yangs shing rgya che ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /deng ①bdag gis sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi ②sdug bsngal thams cad shin tu rgyun chad par 'gyur ro/ /deng bdag gis tshangs pa'i dbang po'i rgyal po nyid kyi lus bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma 'thob (9pa dag gi ④dge ba'i rtsa ba'i sa bon bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /deng bdag gis brgya byin nyid kyi lus bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma 'thob ⑤pa dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i sa bon bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /deng bdag gis 'khor los sgyur 97ba'i rgyal po nyid kyi lus bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma 'thob (7pa dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i sa bon ⑧bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /deng bdag gis bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du mar 'khor ba las yongs su thar bar byas par 'gyur ro/ /deng bdag gis yi)bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu med pa bla na med pa yangs shing rgya che ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa yongs su gzung 7bar 'gyur rol/ /deng bdag gis btsun mo'i 'khor gyi tshogs thams cad la bsrung phospreb chen po byas par 'gyur ro/ /deng bdag gis rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor 8'dir zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ mchog tu khyad par du 'phags pa bla na med pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /deng bdag gis yul 'di dag nyagethams cad kun tu bsrungs par 〉'gyur rol/ /yongs su bskyangs pa gludang /gnod pa med pa dang / dgra 3 tshomed pa dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad kyis mi brdzi 18ba dang / nad 'go ba med pa dang / 'khrug pa med par 'gyur ro snyam du sems bskyed par bya'o/ /rgyal po chen po dag dge slong ngam/89—614

dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen 6)ma gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di ②'dzin pa/ de dag la mi'i rgyal po de dam pa'i chos la gus pa de lta bus bsti stang ②byed/ bla mar byed/ rim gror byed/mchod par ⑤byed cing / rgyal po chen po khyed bzhi dpung dang g.yog tu bcas pa dang / lha'i tshogs de dag dang gnod sbyin 'bum phrag du ma dag la shas kyis (de dam pa byin na/ mi'i rgyal po de bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa dang /dge ba mngon par 'du byed pa de dang / tshe 'di'i lus kyi rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa des rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur(6)/ tshe 'di la rgyal po'i tsogazi brjid chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /dpal dang / phun sum tshogs pa dang / gzi brjid kyis kyang brgyan (kyepar 'gyur ro/ /phyir rgol ba thams cad dang / dgra thams cad chos dang mthun par 6)shin tu tshar chod par 'gyur ro/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang /bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po chen po bzhi po de tshedag gis 'di skad ces gsol to//btsun pa bcom ldanasidas gang la la zhig mi'i rgyal por gyur la/ de yistechos la gus pa de lta bus/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po nyan la/dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di kyi 'dzin pa de dag la yang bsti stang tu bgyid/ bla mar bgyid/ rim gror khabagyid/ mchod par gebagyid cing / rgyal po chen po bdag cag gi slad du/ rgyal po'i pho brang de shin tu dag par phyag dar bgyid/spos chab sna tshogs kyis chag chag legs par 'debs la/ bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / lhan cig tu mthun mong du chos mnyan pa de (1mnyan cing 89—615

bdag dang lha thams cad 0)kyi slad du dge ba'i rtsa ba'i shas ③cung zad cig sbyin par bgyid na/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das dge slong chos smra ba ③de chos kyi stan la mchis ma thag tu/ mi'i rgyal po des bdag cag rgyal po chen po ④bzhi'i don gyi slad du/ spos sna tshogs kyis bdug par ⑤bgyi'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po de la mchod pa'i slad du/ bdug pas bdugs ma thag tu spos sna tshogs rnams las/ spos dang bdug pa sna tshogs kyi 'khri ⑥shing dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de dag skad cig thang cig yud tsam de la/ rgyal po chen po bdag cag bzhi'i rang rang gi khang pa'i steng gi bar snang la/ spos dang bdug pa sna tshogs kyi 'khri gshing dag gi gdugs rnams su gnas par 'gyur rol/ /spos kyi 6)dri rgya chen po yang mnam par 'gyur/ gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i snang ba 'byung bar 'gyur ⑩zhing snang ba des bdag cag gi khang pa rnams kyang snang (meb bgyis par 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das spos dang / bdug pa sna tshogs kyi 'khri 7shing dag skad cig thang cig yud tsam de la mi mjed 7kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang / lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin dang / lha mo chen mo dbyangs can yidang / lha mo chen mo snyibartan ma dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po yang dag shes dang /⑫gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po 7nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / lha'i bu 5nyadabang phyug chen po dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde yi7dpon chen po lag na rdo rje dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nor bu bzang dang / 'phrog ma'i so bu lnga brgya 'khor dang ldan pa dang / klu'i rgyal po chen po ma dros pa dang / klu'i rgyal po chen po rgya mtsho dang / de dag tsho rang rang gi khang pa'i steng gi bar snang la byung ste/89wa 616

spos dang bdug pa sna tshogs kyi ①'khri shing gi ②gdugs rnams su gnas par 'gyural/ spos dri sna tshogs rgya chen po yang mnam ②par 'gyur/ khang pa rnams kyi nang du dugaser du snang ba ⑤'byung bar 'gyur zhing / snang ba des gnas thams cad snang ba skyobagyis par 'gyur ro/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po bzhi la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rgyal po chen po dag rgyal po chen po khyed bzhi'i rang rang ⑦gi khang pa rnams kyi steng gi bar snang la/ spos dang bdug pa sna tshogs kyi 'khri shing de dag gdugs rnams su gnas par ma zad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyal po chen po dag /mi'i rgyal po des gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di la mchod pa'i phyir/ spos sna tshogs de dag gis bdugs nim thag tu lag na 6)pog snod cig thogs pa de las/ spos dang bdug ⑩pa sna tshogs kyi (nya'akhri shing kyirnams 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de dag 8skad cig thang cig yud tsam de la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di dag tsothams cad na gang na zla ba bye ba phrag brgya dang / nyi ma bye ba phrag brgya dang / rgya mtsho chen po bye ba phrag brgya dang —/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab bye ba phrag brgya dang / ri'i rgyal po 'khor 7yug dang —/ 'khor tsolug chen po bye ba phrag brgya dang / gling chen po bzhi pa'i ⑩'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag brgya dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha bye ba phrag brgya dang sum cu rtsa gsum bye ba phrag brgya nas/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min du nye bar song ba'i bar gyi lha bye ba phrag brgya dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams de dag thams cad du sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i ris bye ba phrag brgya po thams cad naXsnye/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin 89—617

dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang ske/ lto 'phye chen po'i tshogs rnams kyi 0)rang rang gi khang pa dag gi steng gi bar snang la/ spos dang bdug pa sna tshogs kyi 'khri shing de dag gdugs rnams su gnas par 'gyur/ spos (7dri rgya chen po yang mnam par 'gyur/ lha'i ②khang pa rnams su gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i snang ba yang 'byung bar 'gyur zhing snang ba des kyang lha'i khang pa rnams snang ba (gebyas par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po dag 'di ltar stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ lha'i khang pa thams cad kyi steng gi bar snang la/ spos dang bdug pa'i 'khri (9shing de dag gdugs rnams su gnas pa de bzhin du/ gser 'od dam pa (6)mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di la mchod pa'i phyir/ mi'i rgyal po des/ spos sna tshogs de dag gis bdugs 97)ma thag tu/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di'i gzi brjid kyi mthus/ spos dang bdug pa sna tshogs kyi 'khri shing dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de dag skad cig thang cig yud tsam de la kun tu phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams du ma/ gang gā'i (7klung gi bye ma snyed dag gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag (9)rnams su de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma/ gang gā'i 7klung gi bye ma snyed kyimedag gi bar snang la/spos dang bdug pa sna tshogs kyi 'khri shing rnams su gnas par 'gyur/ de dag kyang sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma la/ spos dang bdug pa sna tshogs rgya che zhing rgya che ba mnam par 'gyur/ gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i snang ba 'byung bar 'gyur zhing /snang ba des kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma gang gā'i 1 klung gi bye ma snyed dag snang ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /89—618

rgyal 6)po chen po dag cho ②'phrul chen po de lta bu de ③dag byung ma thag tu de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma gang gā'i ⑥klung gi bye ma snyed dag (ltachos smra ba de la dgongs par 'gyur te(ye/ skyes bu dam pa legs so legs so/ /skyes bu dam pa khyod rtsigaser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po'i tshul nasa'adi lta bu zab mo'i don 'di lta bu zab mor snang ba 'di lta bu yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa 'di lta bu 'di rgya cher yang dag par rab tu 'chad par 'dod pa khyod yang legs so legs sodzi)/ /zhes bya ba sbyin ⑩par 'gyur ro/ /su tha na gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di nyan pa'i sems can de dag kyang / dge ba'i rtsa ba ngan ngon dang ldan par mi 'gyur na/ gang dag 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / 'chad pa dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / 'khor la rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston pa lta smos kyang ci dgos(1/ /de ci'i slad du 7zhe na/ skyes bu dam pa gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di thos nas sna thos ma thag tu/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de nas phyogs bcu kun du sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma gang gā'i 4steklung gi bye ma snyed dag na/de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing na bzhugs pa dag gis/ de'i tshe de'i dus na/ tshig mthun pa dang /ngag mthun pa dang / sgra skad mthun pas dge slong chos smra ba 7chos kyi khri stan la 'dug pa de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /skyes bu dam pa khyod ma 'ongs pa'i dus na byang chub kyi snying por 'gro bar 'gyur/ skyes bu dam pa khyod 89—619

byang chub kyi snying po mchog dam par song ste/ shing gi ①rgyal po'i drung du 'dug nas / 'jig rten gsum po thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa sems can thams cad las rab tu 'das pa'i brtul zhugs dang / dka' thub spyod pa'i stobs skyed ②pa'i byin gyis ②brlabs dka' ④ba spyod pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma dag ston par 'gyur/ skyes bu dam pa khyod byang chub kyi snying por ⑤legs par brgyan (5)par byed par 'gyur/ skyes bu dam pa khyod stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad yongs su skyob par 'gyur/ skyes bu dam pa khyod shing gi rgyal po'i drung du 'dug ste/ bdud kyi sde bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ gzugs rab tu 'jigs ⑦'jigs ltar 'dug pa/ mi sdug pa ston parnyi / gzugs mi sdug pa sna tshogs dag las rgyal bar 'gyur/ skyes bu dam pa khyod byang chub kyi snying po mchog dam par song ste/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub dpe med par yonyerab tu zhi ba rdul dang bral ba zab mo mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya 7bar 'gyur/ skyes bu dam pa khyod rdo rje'i gdan snying po brtan pa la 'dug ste/ chos kyi 'khor lo rgyal ba thams cad kyis mngon par bstod pa/ mchog tu zab pa/ bla na med pa rnam pa bcu gnyis rab tu bskor bar 'gyur/ skyes bu dam pa khyod chos kyi rnga chen po bla na med pa brdung bar ⑪'gyur / skyes bu dam pa khyod chos kyi dung bla na med pa 'bud par 'gyur/skyes bu dam pa khyod chos kyi rgyal mtshan chen po bsgreng kyibar 'gyur/ skyes bu dam pa khyod chos kyi sgron ma bla na med pa (nya'abar ba yibyed par 'gyur/ skyes bu dam pa khyod chos kyi char bla na med pa 'bebs 7par 'gyur/ skyes bu dam pa khyod nyon mongs pa'i dgra 'bum phrag du ma las rgyal bar 'gyur/ skyes bu dam 89—620

pa khyod sems can bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma shin tu 'jigs su rung ba/'jigs pa chen po'i rgya mtsho las sgrol bar 'gyur/ skyes bu dam pa khyod sems can bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma dag /'khor ba'i 'khor ba ①las yongs su thar bar byed par 'gyur/ skyes bu dam pa khyod sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma dag mnyes par byed par 'gyur ro②/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po chen po bzhi po de dag gis ③'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das mi'i rgyal po gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po'i yon tan tshe 'di dang / ma 'ongs pa na 'byung ba 'di lta bu 'di dag mthong ba/ sangs rgyas 'bum phrag du ma ④la dge ba'i rtsa ba skyed ⑤pa/ bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu ma mchis pa yongs su 'dzin pa ⑥mthong nas/ snying brtse ba'i slad du/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi dpung dang g.yog tu bcas pa dang / gnod sbyin 'bum phrag du ma rang rang ⑦gi khang pa na mchis pa dag /spos dang bdug pa sna tshogs kyi 'khri shing dag gi gdugs ⑤kyis bskul ma thag tu/ lus mi gda' bar bgyis te / mi'i rgyal po de'i khang pa brtsegs pa phyag dar ma mchis pa/ legs par phyag dar bgyis pa/ spos chab sna tshogs kyis 6)chag chag legs par btab pa rgyan tsosna tshogs kyis legs par brgyan pa'i rgyal po'i pho brang ga la ba der chos mnyan pa'i slad du mchis par (spebagyi'o/ /mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang /lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin dang / lha mo chen mo 7dbyangs can ()dang / lha mo chen mo yidapal dang / sa'i lha mo brtan ma dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po yang dag shes dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nyi shu rtsa brgyad 89—621

dang ske/ lha'i bu dbang phyug chen po dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nor bu bzang dang / 'phrog ma'i bu lnga brgya'i 'khor can dang / klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa dang / klu'i rgyal po rgya zhu)mtsho dang / lha bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma dag lus mi gda' bar bgyis te(ge/ mi'i rgyal po de'i pho brang rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa de ga ①la ba dang ske/ chos smra ba de'i chos kyi khri stan ④mthon po rgyan sna tshogs kyis legs par brgyan pa/ me tog bkram pa'i sa la bshams par 'gyur ba (5)ga la ba der chos mnyan pa'i slad du mchis par (6)'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi dpung dang g.yog tu bcas pa/ gnod sbyin 'bum phrag du ma de dag thams cad mthun par bgyis te/ mi'i rgyal po dge ba'i grogs bgyid pa/ dge ba thob par bgyid pa/ bla na med pa chos kyi sbyin pa chen po sbyin nga de la/ chos 97bdud rtsi'i khu ba 'dis 2tshim par gyur ma thag tu/ mi'i rgyal ngo de la kun du bsrung (9)bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung khob dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /mi'i (11rgyal po'i pho brang de dang / grong khyer de dang /yul de yang kun du bsrung 12bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung 12ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /chad pa spang bar yang bgyi'o/ /yul der yang 'jigs pa dang /gnod pa dang / nad 'go ba dang / 'khrug pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar bgyi'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gang la la zhig mi'i rgyal por gyur skite / mi'i rgyal po de'i yul du/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal 89—622

po 'di 'byung ①la/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das mi'i rgyal po de/ dge slong ngam / dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di 'dzin pa dag la bsti stang ②mi bgyid/ bla mar mi bgyid/ rim gror ②mi bgyid/ mchod par ④mi bgyid na⑤/ bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / gnod sbyin bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma la chos mnyan pa 'di (7dang chos bdud rtsi'i khu ba 'dis tshim pya par mi bgyid/rim gror (7mi bgyid/ lha'i lus 'di dag gi 6)gzi byin yang rnam par 'phel bar mi bgyid doyi/ /bdag cag gi brtson 'grus dang / mthu dang stobs kyang mi skyed/ bdag cag gi lus la gzi brjid dang / dpal dang phun sum tshogs pa yang rnam par 'phel bar mi bgyid pa lags so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag 4)cag rgyal po chen po bzhi dpung dang g.yog nyunyetu bcas pa dang /gnod sbyin bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma dag gis tunyeyul de yal bar dor bar bgyi'o / /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis yul de yal bar bor na/yul na (skyeganas pa'i lilha'i tshogs thams cad kyis kyang / yul de yal bar 'dor bar 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das lha rnams kyis 7yul de yal bar bor na/ yul der yul rnam par 'khrug pa sna tshogs 'byung bar 'gyur/rgyal po'i 'khrug pa mi bzad pa dag 'byung bar 'gyuradzin/ yul gang tunyen gnas pa'i sems can thams cad kyang 'thab pa skye ba dang / mtshang 'dru 4)ba skye ba dang —/ rtsod ripa skye bar 'gyur/ dngogs pa dang 'gyed ( stepar 'gyur ba dang /gza' dang nad rnam pa sna tshogs yul du 'byung bar 'gyur ros / /phyogs tha dad pa nas skar mda' ltung ri dbar 'gyur/ gza' dang rgyu sa skar rnams kyang 89—623

phan tshun mi mthun ①par gda' bar 'gyur/ dgung zla ②'char ba na nyi ma lta bur (gegada' bar 'gyur/ zla ba'i gza' dang / nyi ma'i gza' 'byung bar 'gyur / nyi ma dang zla ba nam mkha' la gnas pa yang rtag par rgyun du sgra gcan gyi gnod pa dang ldan par 'gyur/ dus dus su nam mkha' la 'ja'i kha dog lta bu 'khyil bar ④'gyur/ sa yang g.yo bar 'gyur/ sa la gnas pa'i khron pa yang sgra 'byin pa grag ⑤par 'gyur/ yul du rlung drag po ldang bar 'gyur/char pa drag po 'bab par 'gyur/ yul du mu ge'i ya nga ba 'byung bar ⑥'gyur/pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyis yul 'joms par 'gyur/ yul de phung bar 'gyur sems can de dag kyang nyon mongs ⑦pa mang bar 'gyur/ yul de nyams mi dga' 97bar 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po kyi)bzhi dpung dang g.yog du bcas pa dang / gnod sbyin 'bum phrag du ma dang yul na gnas pa'i lha dang klu rnams kyis yul de yal bar bor na/ yul der 'di lta bu'i gnod pa rnam pa sna tshogs brgya dang / gnod pa stong 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das/ gang la la ⑩zhig mi'i rgyal por gyur la / de bdag 17nyid la kun du bsrung 7ba chen po bgyid 'tshal bar gyur(sri/rgyal po'i bde ba sna tshogs yun ring por myong bar 'tshal bar gyur/ bde ba thams cad bstabs pa'i sems kyi 7rgyal po nyid bgyid 'tshal bar gyuratso/ yul na gnas pa'i sems can thams yicad bde bar bgyid 'tshal bar gyuradhi/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad pham par bgyid 'tshal bar gyur/ yul thams cad du nya yun ring du yongs su skyong 'tshal bar gyur(7/ chos kyi rgyal po nyid bgyid 'tshal bar gyur/ rang gi yul yang 'jigs pa dang / gnod pa dang /89—624

nad 'go ba dang / 'khrug pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar bgyid 'tshal ①bar gyur na/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das mi'i rgyal po des gdon mi 'tshal bar gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di ②mnyan par bgyi/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen namadu/ dge bsnyen ma mdo sde'i dbang po 'dzin pa de dag la yang bsti stang ④bgyi/ bla mar bgyi/ rim gror ⑤bgyi / mchod pa 4)bgyi/ bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi dpung dang g.yog tu bcas pa rnams kyang / chos mnyan pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bsags pa 'di dang /chos bdud rtsi'i ༷khu ba 'dis tshim par bgyi/ bdag cag gi ⑧lha'i lus 'di dag gi gzi byin chen po yang rnam par 'phel bar bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du ⑨zhe na / btsun pa bcom ldan 'das/ mi'i rgyal po des gdon mi 'tshal bar/gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di mnyan par bgyi ste/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das tshangs pa'i dbang pos 'jig rten pa yidang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bstan bcos rnam pa sna tshogs ji snyed pa bstan pa dag (medang /lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bstan bcos rnam pa sna tshogs ji snyed pa 8bstan pa dag dang / drang srong mngon par shes pa lnga can rnam pa sna tshogs dag gis sems can dag gi don gyi slad du/ 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bstan 7bcos rnam pa sna tshogs ji snyed bstan pa dag pas ches mchog ches khyad par du 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di ni / btsun pa bcom ldan 'das tshangs pa'i dbang po 'bum phrag 8de dag dang /brgya byin bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma dang / drang srong mngon par shes pa lnga can bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma 'othams cad pas ches mchog ches khyad par 89—625

du 'phags pa'i 1)de bzhin gshegs pas/ sems can rnams kyi don gyi slad du rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ②bshad pa lags ①so/ /ci nas kyang ④'dzam bu'i gling thams cad na gnas pa'i mi rnams kyi (5)rgyal pos rgyal po nyid bgyi ba dang /ci nas sems can thams cad bde bar 'gyur ba dang / ci nas rang gi yul kun du tsho4)bsrungs par 'gyur ba dang / yongs su bskyangs par 'gyur ba dang /ci nas yul thams cad na gnod pa dang / dgra ma mchis par 'gyur ba dang /ci nas pha rol gyi dmag tshogs rnams tshupham ste/ phyir phyogs par 'gyur ba dang / ci nas yul de dag na (8rind 'go ba ma mchis shing / 'khrug pa ma mchis par 'gyur ba dang / ci nas yul thams cad chos kyis 'khrug 6)pa ma mchis shing / mi rdzi khobar 'gyur ba dang / ci nas mi'i rgyal po de dag gis/rang rang gi yul rnams su chos kyi sgron ma chen po 'bar bar bgyis shing / snang bar bgyis par 'gyur ba dang / ci nas lha'i khang khyim thams cad lha dag dang /lha'i bu rnams kyis gang bar 'gyur ba dang / ci nas bdag cag 17rgyal po chen po tshabazhi dpung dang g.yog tu bcas pa dang / gnod sbyin 'bum phrag du ma dang / 'dzam bu'i gling na gnas pa'i (12lha'i tshogs thams cad tshim pa dang /rim gro 'bagyid par 'gyur ba dang / ci nas bdag cag gi lha'i lus 'di dag gzi byin lochen pos rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang / ci nas bdag cag ⑩gi lus la brtson 'grus dang stobs dang / mthu chen po skyed 11par 'gyur ba dang / ci nas bdag cag gi lus la gzi brjid (1 dang / dpal dang / phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'jug par 'gyur ba dang / ci nas 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad du 19lo legs shing nyams dga' la/ skye bo dang mi mang pos gang 89—626

bar 'gyur ba dang / ci nas 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad na gnas pa'i sems can rnams bde bar 'gyur ba dang / dga' ba sna tshogs myong bar 'gyur ba dang ske/ ci nas sems can thams cad bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du mar lha dang mi'i bde ba rgya che zhing ①rgya che ba dag myong bar 'gyur ba dang /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang lhan cig gnas par 'gyur ba dang /ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba de dag ②thams cad/ da lta na ①bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis tshangs pa'i dbang po bye ba khrag khrig phrag 'bum skyidag pas ches 'phags pa'i thugs rje chen po'i stobs dang ldan pa'i byin gyis brlabs rgudang /brgya byin bye ba khrag khrig phrag 'bum dag gi (6)lha'i shes pa bas/ ches 'phags pa gde bzhin gshegs pa'i mkhyen pa bla na med pa dang / drang srong mngon par shes pa lnga can rnam pa sna tshogs kyi tshogs bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma thams cad bas ches 'phags pa'i byin gyis (8)brlabs kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ sems can thams cad kyi don gyi slad 9)du/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di/'dzam bu'i gling 'dir rgya cher yang dag par rab tu bshad do/ /mi'i rgyal po'i dgos pa dang / rgyal po'i bstan bcos tshadang / rgyal po'i bgyi ba gang dag 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad na mchis pa dang / gang dag gis sems can 'di dag thams cad bde bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad/1)/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 89—627

kyis / gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di ①nye bar bstan/yongs su brjod/ yang dag par rab tu bshad do/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das rgyu de dang rkyen des mi'i rgyal po des/ gdon mi 'tshal bar/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di gus par mnyan par bgyi(gyi/ gus par rim gror bgyi/ gus par (bamachod par bgyi'o④/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang ske/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po bzhi la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to / /de'i phyir rgyal po chen po khyed bzhi dpung dang g.yog tu bcas pas/gdon mi za bar mi'i rgyal po gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di nyan pa dang / rim gro byed pa dang mchod pa byed pa de dag kun tu bsrung (9ba'i phyir spro ba rgya ①cher gyis shig /rgyal po chen po dag dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang lamado sde'i dbang po 'di (nya'adzin pa de dag kyang / sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa 'dzin du chug cig 6)dang /de dag lha dang mi 7dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'di la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa byed par 'gyur/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di rgya cher yang dag par rab tu 'chad par 'gyur te/ rgyal po chen po khyed bzhis ci nas mdo sde'i dbang po 17'dzin pa'i dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma bsrung ba medang / gnod pa med pa dang /nad med pa dang / 'khrug pa med pa dang / sems bde bar 'gyur tizhing /gser 'od dam pa 1 nyamado sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di yang dag par rab tu (steston par 'gyur bar7/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/dge bsnyen ma mdo sde'i dbang po 'dzin pa de dag yi kun du bsrung bar bya/89—628

yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung ①ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur bar bya'o/ /de nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu stan las langs te/ 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag ②la yid bzhin gyi nor bu zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs mchis pa 'di/sems can gang la la dag 'dzin cing 'chang bar mos pa de la/ bsod nams dpag tu ma mchis par 'gyur ba dang / rtag tu de la bdag gis bsrung ①zhing bskyabs pas④/ de'i sdug bsngal thams cad bsal te/ bde bar gnas par bgyi'ol/ /bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs kyang bskyed par dubagyi'o/ /gang gzungs sngags du'adi 'dzin par 'dod pas lus bsrung ⑦ba'i phyir sngags 'di sngar brjod par bya'o⑧/ /na mo be+e shra ba ṇa 6)ya/ ma hā rā dzā ya/ tar+ya thā/ra ra ra ra/ ku no ku no/ khu no khu no/ ru no ru no/ sa ba sa ba/ ka ra ka ra / ma hā bi ka ro⑩/ ma hā bi ka ro⑩/ ma hā kā kyil/ ma hā rā dza8/rak+ṣa rak+ṣa tu 'cha/ sarba satā nāñca 8swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das sngags 'di skud pa dkar po la sngags lan re bzlas shing mdud pa lan re bor te/ de ltar lan bdun byas nas/ dpung pa la btags na don de nges par 'grub par 'gyur ro / /de nas khang pa dben pa'i nang du khrus byas la gos gtsang ma gyon te/spos gu gul dang / tsan+dan dang / ga bur tsodang / du ru ska ⑩dang / a ga ru dang / spos (shedakar po la 4)sogs pa 'di dag cha mnyam par sbyar ba'i spos kyis mchod cing / sngags 'di bzlas pas ( )rgyal po chen po rusprernam thos kyi bu spyan drang bar bya'o/ /na mo be+e shra ba ṇa ya(ge/ ma hā dha na dā tsoya/ tsaṇ+ḍi shwa rā (steya/ ā kur+shason/ a pa ra dzi tsoto/ tsaṇ+ḍi ru shwa ra(she/ pa ra ma/ kā sa ru ṇi ri no89—629

ka /sarba satācha/ hi (mita tsin+ta / ma ma dha ④na bar dho/ parle shwa ra swa ⑤yam / ā /sgo ya ⑥su hā/ sngags 'di lan bdun bzlas pa'i 'og tu rtsa ba'i sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /sngags 'di 'don pa'i dus su dkon mchog gsum dang ske/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu la sngar phyag 'tshal bar bya'o/ /rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu ni sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa skong zhing nor sbyin pas sems can thams cad bde bar mdzad pa'i phyir yid bzhin gyi nor bu zhes bya ba'i sngags 'di bzlas na( —)/ sems can de dag yid bzhin du bde ba rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas lha'i rgyal po rnam thos kyi bus ⑧bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar yid bzhin gyi nor bu zhes bya 6)ba'i sngags kyi snying po 'di smres so/ /na mo rat+na 8tra yā ya/ na mo be+e shra ba ḍā ya(skye/ ma hā rā dzā 7ya/ tar+ya thā/ si mi si mi/ su mu su mu/ tsaṇ+ḍa tsaṇ+ḍa/ tsa ra tsa ra/ sa ra sa ra/ ka ra ka ra/ki li ki li/ ku ru ku ru/ mu ru mu ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ san+t+ra ya/ ād+ma māṃ/ni ta t+ya na/ an+tad+dhā 1 tu swā hā/ na mo be+e shra ba ṇa ya tsheswā hā/ dha na dā ya snyig hā / ma no ter tha pa ri pū ra ya swā hā/ sngags 'di sngar lan stong bzlas pa'i 'og tu khang pa dben pa'i nang du lci bas 1 7dkyil 'khor chung ngu zhig byas te bshos (1 ci 'byor pas mchod par 17bya'o/ /spos dam pa bsregs pa'i du ba'i rgyun mi 'chad par bya zhing nyin mtshan du sems rtse gcig pas sngags kyi snying po ci'adi bdag nyid kyis thos pa tsam du bzlas pa byas na me/ de nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu'i sras dzi sgyu nyanar sha bha zhes bya ba gzhon nu'i gzugs kyis de'i gan du mchis te nga'i yab la ci zhig gsol zhes dri bar byed do/ /de nas des ( gebadag ni dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa'i phyir/ nor zhig gsol gyis ( snyestsol 89—630

cig ces smros ①shig /de nas sras dzi ⑧nar sha bhas yab la gsol ba/ skyes bu dam pa zhig dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa'i phyir/ nor zhig gsol lo zhes gsol pa dang / yab kyis khyod myur du song la nyin gcig bzhin du kār+sā pa ṇa ①brgya brgya byin cig ces ④bka' stsal rgyato/ /de nas sngags sgrub pa des ltas de lta bu mthong nas/ don de grub par shes te/ gnas dben par bdag gcig pu spos bsregs la nyal khar sngas su dri'i za ma tog gcig dubazhag ste nyal bar bya'o / /de phyin chad ⑦nang gcig ⑧bzhin du za ma tog de'i nang nas nor ci ⑨'byung ba las nor de de'i nyin par dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa'i yo byad me tog dang / spos dang / zhal zas la sogs par kyisbyar ba dang / brel cing ⑪phongs pa rnams la yang sbyin zhing zad par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad la byams par bsam mo/ /khro ba dang 'tshe tsoba'i bsam pa bskyed na/ de nyams par 'gyur bas/ khro ba'i sems mi skye bar rtag tu bsrung (nyebar bya'osnyi/ /de nas yang sngags 'di 'dzin pa des nyin gcig bzhin du 8lha'i rgyal po rnam thos kyi bu dang / gzhan yang sras dang / sras mo'i 'khor du bcas pa la/ rtag par bsam zhing / bstod pa dang / bsngags ⑩pa bya'o/ /rtag par dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam gyis gtong 7zhing lha la sogs pa rnams kyi 5)mthu dang bsod nams mngon par 'phel bar 'gyur (7ba dang / dge ba rgyas pa dang / bla na med pa'i byang chub kyang 'thob ( )par 'gyur ro/ /lha de dag gis de ltar byed pa de mthong nas kun dga' zhing mgu rangs pas 'ong zhing de la bsrung ( geb dang /skyob par byed do/ /sngags mkhan de nyid kyang tshe lo dpag tu med par gnas shing ske/ ngan song gsum yongs su spong ba dang bgegs dang / bar chad thams 89—631

cad kyang med par 'gyur ro/ /yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'di ①dang / gter gzhan dag kyang thob par 'gyur ro/ /rdzu 'phrul la dbang sgyur zhing bsam ②pa thams cad kyang grub par 'gyur ro/ /gal te longs spyod can du 'dod na yang yid bzhin du grub pa dang / bya dang gcan gzan gyi skad thams cad kyang shes par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das sngags sgrub pa des bdag mthong bar 'tshal na/ tshes brgyad dam/ tshes bcwa ⑧lnga'i nyin par ras dkar po la bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gzugs ka ṅge ta dang khyisbyar ba'i tshon ⑤ris rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ ri mo mkhan gso sbyong gi ⑥yan lag brgyad dang ldan pas / sangs rgyas kyi g.yon phyogs su ni dpal gyi lha mo'i gzugs bri/ sangs rgyas kyi g.yas phyogs su ni rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu bdag ⑦bu smad dang 'khor du bcas pa (8)bris te/ gnas der bkram nas/ me tog sna tshogs dang /dri sna 997mang po dang / mar me dam pa dang / zhal zas bda' ba sna tshogs kyis/nyin mtshan rgyun mi 'chad par mchod par bya'o/ /sngags 'di zlos pas sems mi g.yeng bar bya zhing / rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu spyan drang ba'i ⑩sngags 'di bzlas par bya'o/ /na maḥshrī kuṇa ṭhā ya/ bud dhā 11ya/ na mo be+e shra ba ṇa ⑫ya / yak+ṣa rā dzā ya/ ma hā rā dzā ya/ a ti (rten dzā ya/ na maḥshrī/ ma hā de byimi / tabya thā/ ta ra ta 7ra/ tu ru tu ru/ ba ra ba ra/ su shurnyo su shurnyo4 / ha na ha na/ ma ṇi ka na ka /badz+ra be+e ḍūr+ya/ muka ti ka /a yaṃ kṛ ta sha rī rā ya/ sarba satā/ hi ta kā ma/ bai shra ba ṇa shrī ya de bī pra bhā yadhi/e hi e hi/ mā bi las/ ghur+ṇa byuṇa0ste/ pa ra su pa ra su/ da dā hi ma mā/dar+sha na kā ma su/ dar+sha rna67/ ma ma ma na/ pra la ha dā ( nyaya swā hā/ bcom 89—632

ldan 'das bdag gis sngags zlos pa de dang / mchod pa rgya chen po mthong nas/bdag byams pa dang / dga' ba'i bsam pa skyes nas/ bdag de'i mdun du byis pa gzhon nu'i gzugs sam/ yang na rgan ①po'am/ dge slong gi gzugs su byas te/ bdag lag na yid bzhin gyi nor bu gser gyi snod ②dang bcas pa thogs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs nas/ lus kyis ①gus pa ston cing /sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gcig tu brjod de/ sngags mkhan de la 'di skad ces smra'odu / /khyod ⑤ci dang ci slong ba de dag 0thams cad grub par byas te⑦/nags tshal dben par 'gro 'dod pa'am/ nor bu rin po che 'dod pa'am/mi mang po'i niyid du 'ong bar 'dod pa'am/ gser dang / dngul la sogs pa'i nor 'dod pa'am/ sngags gzhan sgrub pa'i dngos grub 'dod pa'am/ rdzu 'phrul dang / mngon par shes pa dang / tshe ring bar 'dod pa dang / sman bcud kyis len 'dod pa la sogs pa thams cad bsam pa bzhin du grub par bya'o / /bdag gis 5)dngos po de dag la sogs pa mdo tsam zhig smos par zad kyitshul/ de ma yin pa gzhan zhig 'dod (nyan yang thams cad bsam pa bzhin du yongs su grub par bya ste/ rin po che'i gter mi zad snyipa dang / bsod nams tshad med pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /dper na nyi zla 'di sa la lhung ()bar 'gyur ba dang / sa chen po 'di gzhan du 'gyur ba'i dus ni yod kyang srid kyi/bden pa'i tshig 'di ni nam yang 4)spu bar mi 'gyur bas rtag tu bde ba dang /yid tsobazhin du skyid pa dang 7longs spyod pa thob par 'gyur ro6)/ /gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das mdo sde'i tu rgyal po 'di gang zhig 'dzin cing 'chang ba dang /klog cing 'don pa yang rung / sngags 'di sgrub pa yang rung ste/ tshegs 4)chung 89—633

ngus myur du 'grub 6)par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis sems can dbul zhing phongs pa'i sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa'i sems can ②rnams kyi ched du sngags 'di bshad pas/ de gaphyug cing bde ba'i mchog dang phun sum tshogs pa tshe gcig tu 'byor bar 'gyur ro/ /bdag gis kyang de yongs su bsrung ④zhing bskyab pa'i phyir/ rjes su 'brang zhing gnod pa dang / 'tshe ⑤ba thams cad ma mchis par bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po de 'dzin cing rgyas par byed pa dang / sngags 'di 'chang ba'i gang zag de gom 6)pa brgya tshun chad 'od kyis ⑦snang bar byas te/ bdag gi 'khor gnod sbyin stong rnams kyis (7kyang rtag tu de'i g.yog tu bsko (9)zhing mngag gzhug kyiyid bzhin du byed du gzhug ⑩go/ /bdag gi bden pa'i tshig 'di slu 8ba med par yang bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs su gsol/ de nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi 'bus sngags de skad ces smras pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis legs so legs so tsozhes bka' stsal te7/ rgyal po chen po khyod kyis sems can thams cad sred pas gdungs pa'i sdug bsngal gyi dra ba thams cad bral yibs phyug cing bde bar bya ba'i phyir sngags 'di smras pa dang / gzhan yang mdo sde 'di 'jig rten du yongs su rgyas par bya ba'i phyir/ sngags 'di bshad pa kyi 7ni legs so legs so/ /de nas rgyal po chen po bzhi stan las langs nasakyi / bla gos phrag pa gcig tu — gzar nas37/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs 6)te/ thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ zhabs gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal khri7te/ de'i tshe mngon sum du tshul dang mthun pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis/ bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod do/ /rgyal ba zla ba dri ma med pa'i sku/ /rgyal ba 3 nyi ma 'od 89—634

zer stong gi 'od/ /rgyal ba pad+ma dri ma med pa'i spyan/ /rgyal ba me tog pad rtsa rdul med tshems/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu ste/ /rin po che ni du ma'i 'byung gnas gyur/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho ye shes chu yis gang / /ting 'dzin brgya phrag stong gis kun du gang / /rgyal ba'i zhabs ni 'khor los bris 'dra ①ste/ /khor ②yug mu khyud de bzhin rtsib nim stong / /phyag dang zhabs ni dra bas spras pa ste / /zhabs kyi dra ba ngang pa'i dbang po bzhin/ /gser gyi ri bo lta bur rab tu gda'/ /rgyal ba ④gri med gser gyi ri dbang rgyaladu/ /yon tan thams cad ri dbang 'dra ba ste/ /sangs rgyas ri dbang rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i zla ba chu zla 'dra/ /nam mkha' dang yang mtshungs shing 'dra ba ste/ /sgyu ma smig rgyu lta bur chags med pa/ /rgyal ba dri ma med la phyag 'tshal lo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po bzhi la tshigs su bcad de bka' (7stsal pa/ stobs bcu dag gis gser ⑦'od dam pa yi/ /mdo sde'i ⑧dbang po'i rgyal po rab mchog 'di/ /'jig rten skyong ba khyed cag rnams kyis po)ni / /brtson 'grus rab tu brtan pas bskyang bar bya/ /'di ltar mdo sde dkon mchog 0zab mo 'di/ /sems can kun la bde ba sbyin byed pa/ /sems can rnams la phan dang bde ba'i phyir/ /'dzam bu'i gling 'dir yun ring gnas par 'gyur/ /'di ltar stong gsum gyi ni stong chen gyi/ /'jig rten dag na ngan song sdug bsngal dang / /sems can dmyal ba'i sems can rnams kyi (nyani/ /sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar byed pa yin/ /'dzam gling 'di na 'dzam gling gnas pa yi/ /rgyal po gang dag yin pa thams cad kyis/ /rab tu dga' ba chen po bskyed nas ni/ /chos rnams kyis ni yul dag bskyang bar 7gyis/ /89—635

gang gis 'dzam bu'i gling 'di ①bde ba dang / /shin tu lo legs nyams kyang dgar ②'gyur zhing / /'dzam bu'i gling ni thams cad dag na yang / /sems can thams cad bde bar 'gyur bar gyis/ /'di na ①mi yi dbang po gang rnams ni/ /yul la dga' dang ④bdag bde dga' ba dang / /rgyal srid rnam par 'byor pa dga' ba des/ /mdo sde'i dbang po 'di ni mnyan par bya/ /mdo sde'i dbang 'di (nyamachog tu dge bar ༅byed/ /pha rol dgra ni yang dag zad par byed/ /pha rol dmag tshogs zlog ⑦byed dge ba ②byed/ /mchog tu 'jigs pas phongs pa sel bar byed/ /dper na rin chen shing ljon rab mdzes pa / /yon tan kun 'byung khyim na yod pa ltar/ /rgyal po yon tan 'dod pa rnams kyis kyang / /mdo sde'i dbang po'i mchog 'di de ltar blta/ /dper na chu 6)grang skom pa sel byed patshu/ / tsha bas 7nyam thag de ⑩ni rnyed pa 0ltar/ /yon tan dag gis skom pa'i rgyal po la/ /mdo sde'i dbang po'i mchog 'di de bzhin no/ /dper na rin chen thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /rin chen snod ni lag mthil yod pa ltar/ /mi yi dbang po ④tshogs la gser 'od mchog /mdo sde'i dbang po'i mchog 'di de bzhin no/ /'di ni lha yi tshogs kyis mngon ⑫ mchod pa/ /mdo sde'i dbang po lha dbang phyag byas pas / /'jig rten skyong ba rdzu 'phrul chen po pa/ /bzhi po dag gis kun du bsrungs pa tsoyin/ /phyogs bcu dag na sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang / /mdo sde'i dbang po 'di ni rtag tu dgongs / /mdo sde'i dbang po 'di ni bshad pa na/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis (stelegs zhes brjod pa byin/ /gnod sbyin bye ba stong phrag brgya rnams kyis/ /phyogs bcu dag tu yul yang srung bar byed/ /rab tu dga' zhing rab tu mgu 89—636

sems kyis/ /mdo sde'i dbang po 'di ni nyan par byed/ /'dzam bu'i ༅gling na gnas par gyur pa yi/ /lha yi tshogs rnams bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /lha tshogs de dag kun kyang rab dga' bas/ /mdo sde'i dbang po 'di ni nyan par byed/ /chos rnams mnyan par bya ba 'di yis ni/ /gzi brjid ②dang ni stobs dang brtson 'grus thob/ /gzi byin chen po yis ni lha yi lus/ /shin tu rgyas shing rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur/ /de nas rgyal po chen po bzhis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa 'di lta bu 'di dag thos pa dang ngo mtshar du gyur/ rmad du byung bar gyural/ dga' bar gyur te/ de dag chos kyi shugs kyis yud tsam zhig tu dungus nas mchi ma phyis te/ de dag lus 'phar yan lag ⑤'dar zhing dga' ba dang / bde ba dang /⑥ yid bde ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par gyur nas/ yang ⑦bcom ldan 'das la lha'i me tog man dā dur ba dag gis gtor⑨ske/ mngon par gtor to7/ /⑩mngon par gtor nas kyang stan rnams las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu bgos nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi rgyal po chen po re re la yang gnod sbyin lnga brgya lnga brgya dang ⑫/ chos smra ba de la bsrung tsob dang / yongs su bskyang ba'i slad du/ rtag tu dge slong chos smra ba'i slad bzhin 'brang bar bgyi'o / /gal te mdo sde 'di las tshig gi don 'ga' zhig brjed par gyur na yang / bdag cag gis de la dran pa dang / mi brjed pa'i mchog gi cigazungs chos kyi rnam grangs yongs su rdzogs par bgyi'o/ /mdo sde'i dbang po 'di dag 89—637

gang na ①bzhugs pa'i gnas de dag gi ②sems can rnams kyis yongs su rgyas par byed pas/ nam yang nub par mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor 'dus pa de dag la chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa'i tshe/ sems can de dag gis ②ye shes dang / spobs pa dang / bsod nams kyi tshogs tshad med pa thob pas/ nyon mongs pa spangs pa'i bde ba dang ldan te/ bstan bcos ④thams cad la mkhas shing 'khor ba yongs su spangs te/ bla na med ⑤pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa myur du thob par 'gyur ro/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las rgyal po chen po bzhis yul 'khor yongs su skyong ba'i le'u zhes bya 6)ste/ bcu gnyis pa'o// // bam po bdun pa/(7 de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa 98)ti'i bu la bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa 6)ti'i bu 'di lta ste/ chags pa med pa'i gzungs zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' chos thams cad la bsgoms pa rnams kyi ma dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sngon gyi spyod pa 7dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis (nyayongs su 'dzin pa yin no/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i 7bus 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gzungs ni yul na mi gnas/ phyogs na mi gnas pa lags na/ bcom ldan 'das gzungs gzungs zhes yo bgyi ba'i gzungs kyi tshig gi don de snyigang lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa sha snyir dwa ti'i bu la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sha tshar dwa ti'i bu ji ltar khyod theg pa chen 89—638

po la gnas pa dang / theg pa chen po la mos pa dang / theg pa chen po la lhag par bya ba byas pa yin na①/ sha ②ra dwa ti'i bu ji ltar khyod gzungs ni yul na mi gnas phyogs na dumi gnas shing / chos kyang ma yin/ chos ma yin pa yang ma ④yin / 'das pa yang ma yin/ ma 'ongs pa yang ma yin/ da ltar byung ba yang ma yin/ dngos po can yang ma yin/ dngos po med pa can yang ma yin/rkyen las byung ba yang ma yin/ rkyen med pa las byung ba yang ma yin/ 'gro ba las byung ba yang ma yin/ 'gro ba med pa las byung ba yang ma yin/ chos gang gi ⑤skye ba yang ma yin/ 'gog pa yang ma yin par chos 0ston mod kyi/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phan par bya ba'i phyir/ 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang / sangs rgyas kyi tshul khrims dang / sangs rgyas kyi bslab pa dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa dang / sangs rgyas 'byung ba 'di lta ste/chags pa med pa'i gzungs zhes tsobya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs sgrub pa'i lam gyi rig (kyepa dang / stobs kyi gnas ston pa po)legs so legs so/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa sha yir dwa ti'i bus hunya'adi skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ gzungs thob pas gang la (rteganas na/ byang chub sems dpa' bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba dang / yang dag par dam bcas par 'gyur ba dang / rten med pa'i chos kyi rang bzhin gyi spobs pa can gyi slob dpon dang / lam la shin tu gnas par 'gyur ba'i gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs bshad du gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa bshad tu du gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa sha yir dwa ti'i bu la 'di 89—639

skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sha ①ra dwa ti'i bu legs so legs so/ /sha ②ra dwa ti'i bu de de bzhin te gzungs thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de la sangs rgyas nyid du brjod par bya ste/ sha dur dwa ti'i bu gang la la gzungs thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la bkur ster ༷byed pa dang / bla mar byed pa dang / rim gror ⑤byed pa dang / mchod par ⑨byed pa des sangs rgyas la bkur ster ⑨byas par 'gyur ro/ /sha ⑧ra dwa ti'i bu gang la la gzungs 'di nyan par byed pa dang ske/ gang dag gzungs 'di 'chang bar byed pa dang / gang dag mos par byed pa ⑨de rnams la byang chub kyi sems ⑩dang ma bral bas/ sangs rgyas la ji ltar mchod pa de bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /sha tsor dwa ti'i bu gzungs de ni 'di yin te / tar+ya thā/ san dhā ra ṇi/ uta dhā ra ṇi/ su saṃ 8pra tiṣ+ṭha te0/ su nā matso / su pra tikhri te⑩/ bi dza ya ba la/ sat+ta 8pra ti dz+nyā/ su ā ro ha7/ dz+nyā na pra ti/ us+thā da ni8/ a ba nā ba ni/ a gi ṣiñca niyi/ a gi bya hā rabya/shu bha ba ti/ su niḥshri ta/ ba hu rgu bha/ a bhi ba dā 0swā hā/ sha dur dwa ti'i bu chags pa med pa'i gzungs kyi 6)tshig 'di byang chub sems dpa' gang gis (steshin tu gnas pa dang / legs par gzung chab byas nas/ 'chang bar byed pa de dubaskal pa'am/ bskal pa las ( nyelhag pa'am/ bskal pa stong ngam/ bskal pa brgya phrag 8stestong du yang smon lam zad par mi 'gyur la/ de'i lus la mtshon gyis tshugs par mi 'gyur te/ dug gis ma yin zhing sbrul yigyis tshugs par mi 'gyur ro/ /de 6 7ci'i phyir zhe na/ sha (mer dwa ti'i bu chags pa med pa'i gzungs 'di ni/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi yum/ ma byon so pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi yum/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi yum ste/ 'di lta ste/89—640

chags pa med pa'i gzungs zhes ①bya ba'i chos kyi rnam ②gangs yin no/ /sha ②ra dwa ti'i bu gang dag gis stong gsum gyi dustong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa ⑤phyag bcu rin po che sna bdun gyis bkang ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la yon du ⑦phul zhing sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de ⑦rnams la ⑧bskal pa grangs med par na bza' dang / zhal zas gya rnam pas ⑨bzhugs par byed pa bas/ gang dag gis chags pa med pa'i gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam ⑩grangs 'di las tshig gcig 7tsam 'dzin par byed pa'i sems can de dag de bas ches bsod nams tsomang du skyed 6)par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa 8sha tsor dwa ti'i bu 'di la chags pa med pa'i gzungs ⑩kyi chos kyi rnam ⑩gangs 'di ⑩ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum yin no/ /yigaser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las chags pa med pa'i gzungs zhes ⑥bya ba'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo khyod kyis glog (stethams cad zlog 4)pa/ so sor 'brang ba du sngon gyi yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs pasaste/ nga yang da ltar 'chad kyis zung lishig /kun dga' bo shar phyogs na 'ong ba zhes bya ba'i glog tsoyod / kun dga' bo lho phyogs na skad brgya pa zhes bya ba'i glog du yod/ kun dga' bo nub phyogs na 'od nyams pa zhes bya ba'i glog sa yod/ kun dga' bo byang phyogs na rgyun gyi ( /bdag po zhes bya ba'i glog pu )yod de(spe/ kun dga' bo gang la la glog so 'di rnams kyi ming shes pa dang / phyogs rnam par gnas pa 89—641

shes pa de la glog stigi 'jigs pa thams cad mi 'byung bar shes par bya'o/ /glog ②gi ming 'di dag yi ger bris te/ gnas gang du bzhag ①pa'i gnas de dag tu/ glog ④thams cad mi 'bab bo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe / drwa ⑤tha ḍa'i gsang sngags ⑥kyi tshig 'di dag bka' stsal to/ / tar+ya shāl/ni mi ni mi/ ni min dha ril/ 'jig rten gsum snang bar byed pa/ lag na rtse 'byegasum pas ( )phyogs 'dir glog 4)thams cad las bdag la srungs shig srungs phonyeshig swā hā/ yang de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'khor de nyid du 'dus par gyur te/ 'dug pa des bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag (nyegis kyang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la/ dā bi ḍa'i gsang ④sngags kyi tshig tsornams brjod par bgyi'o/ / tar+ya btso/ ka ṭi bi ka ṭi/ ni ka ṭi/ pra t+ya rmi ke /prat+ya mi tre/ shudhe/ multe / bi ma le/ pra bhā swa re/ aṇ+ḍa re/ paṇ+ḍa ()re/shwe te/ paṇ+ḍa ra bā si ni/ ha ri kuṇ+ḍa ri/ ka pi li/ dzi ga la/ ak+ṣi da dhi (7mu khi/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad las bdag la sungs shig srungs ( )shig /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzi brjid kyis/ bdag dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad mthong bar ma gyur cig swā hā/ de nas gsang ba dzo nyapa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das tsho bdag 3 gis kyang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la gzungs kyi tshig rnams brjod par na tshobagyi'o/ / tar+ya thā nya/ mu ni mu ni/ mu ni na dha ri mu ni(lha/ma ti ma ti/ su ma ti/ ma hā ma ti( 7/ hā hā hā hā rte/ khyod la sdig pa med 89wa 642
