kyis ①ma 'jigs shig ②ces lag na rdo rjes smras kyis drwa bi ḍa ②swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi bsrung ④ba gzhan gyis mi thub pa 'di su'i snying la 'dzin tam / yi ger bris pa de bdag ⑤gis rtag par rgyun du/ 'jigs pa thams cad las bsrung yibar bgyi'o/ /dus ma lags par 'gum pa thams cad las thar bar bgyi'o/ /de nas mi mjed ⑦kyi bdag po tshangs pas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang /sems can thams cad nikyi don dang / phan pa dang / bde ba bskyed pa'i slad du/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la/ gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi tshig rnams brjod par bgyi'o/ / tar+ya shā1)/ hi li mi li/ tsi li swā hā/ brah+ma pū tshure swā hā / brah+ma swa re swā hā/ brah+ma bhi su gar+bhe/ put+pa saṃ sta yire swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ni bdag gi bsrung 8ba tshangs pa'i 'chad pa zhes bgyi 8ste/ dus ma lags par 'gum pa thams cad las yongs su skyob pa/ sdig pa thams cad tsorab tu zhi bar bgyid pa lags so/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de⑩/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi tshig rnams brjod par bgyi'o/ / tar+ya btso/ ni ba rā ṇi4she/ brnya mā darnye ma ti 47ti/ ti ti( )/ gi rī ⑩/garnya ri/ tsaṇ+ḍa ru li/ mā taṅgi ste/ par+ṇa le/ hi na ma dh+ya ma dha ri ṇi ma la ni/da la mad de( ge/ tsakra bā shrī 22/ sha ba ri/ sha ba ri swā hā/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das 'di ni bdag gi rig )sngags rdo rje'i ( nalce 'bebs pa zhes bgyi ste/'jigs pa thams cad las thar bar bgyid pa/ dus ma lags par 'gum pa 89—643

thams cad las ①yongs su skyob pa lags so/ /de nas rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung dang / 'phags skyes po dang / mig mi bzang dang / rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bus/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis kyang / skye bo mang po la phan pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba dang —/ 'jig rten la snying brtse ba'i slad du/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la gzungs kyi gsang ②sngags kyi tshig rnams brjod par bgyi'o/ / tabya thā /puspe su lisaspre/ dhu ⑤ma pa ri hā reyi/ ār+ya pu ⑦sha ste/ shān ti/ nimuka te/maṅga l+ya/ hi ra rgya garnye stu te/ sta nibi te swā hā/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das 'di ni rgyal po chen po bzhi po bdag cag dzi)gi bsrung kyib 'jigs pa ma mchis pa zhes bgyi ste/ 'jigs pa thams cad las mi 'jigs par bgyid pa0/ tshe ⑫skyong ba dus ma lags par 'gum pa thams cad las yongs su skyob pa lags so/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho dang / klu'i rgyal po glog ()'od dang / klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa dang / klu'i rgyal po glog 0lce dang / klu'i rgyal po 'od zer brgya pas/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gi srung 8ba chen po yid bzhin gyi nor bu zhes bgyi ba/ glog 7thams cad zlog ⑩pa/ dus ma lags par 'gum pa thams cad sel ba/ dug (nyarnams mi gdug par bgyid pa / gshed 17byed dang / byad stems 9 tshodang / ro langs dang / bkra mi shis pa'i 'jigs pa zhi bar 81bgyid pa mchis na/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag klu'i skye gnas 'di nas dbyung ba dang / ser sna spang ba'i slad du thugs brtse 89—644

bar dgongs te bzhes su gsol/ de ci'i slad du ①zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag klu rnams ni ser sna can te ②sems ser snas bskor ba lags sol/ / tabya thā/ ār+ya dze a ma re a mṛ ①te/ ak+ṣa ye/ a gi ye/ purje/bar+ya ba te④/ sarba pā paṃ/ pra sha mā ni ༷ye swā hā/ ār+ya purgya so pā tī duye swā hā/btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag skyes pa'amatshu/ bud med gang la la'i (nyalce la 'don pa'am6)/ yi ger bris pa ⑩de la glog yigi 'jigs 8pa thams cad ma mchis par rig par bgyi'o8/ /rtsa ba'i dug gam/mche ba'i dug gam/ dbyig dug gam/ gang dag gzhan yang yan lag las byung ba'i dug de dag gis de 'gum pa'i dus bgyid par mi 'gyur ro/ /bdag 'jigs pa thams cad dang / gnod pa thams cad las bde legs su ④gyur cig /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang /'jig rten skyong ba dang / klu'i dbang po de dag la legs so zhes bya ba gnang ste/bzhin bzangs tsodag khyed ⑩skye bo mang po la phan pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba'i phyir zhus yite/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di rjes su yongs su bzung yiba'i phyir / drwa bi ḍa'i gsang sngags kyi tshig rnams bshad pa 0)legs so legs so/ /phyogs rnams ni salhaganyid log pa dang / myos pa zhu nyadang / rab tu myos pa rnams bsrung (stebar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas / dge slong de dag dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba de dag susnyedang / klu'i dbang ri stepo de dag zhu snyedang / lha dang / mi dang ske/ lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te ( nyabacom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la dz+nyo mngon par bstod do/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo 89wa 645

sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i gzungs kyi le'u zhes bya ①ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //de nas lha mo chen mo (snyedabyangs can gyis bla gos phrag pa gcig tu bgos te/pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol tol/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das lha mo chen mo dbyangs can bdag gis kyang /dge slong chos smra ba de'i tshig brgyan (47pa'i slad du/ spobs pa nye bar bsgrub ⑤par bgyi/ gzungs kyang stsal bar bgyi/ nges pa'i tshig gis brjod pa kun tu gzhag (po)par bgyil/ dge slong chos smra ba de la shes pa'i snang ba chen po bgyi/gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di las (0tshig 'ga'am6)/ yi ge gang yang rung ba dag gcig⑩ /yongs su nyams (nyepar gyur tam/ bskyud snyin bdag gis dge slong chos smra ba de'i nges pa'i sgra dang tshig dang / yi ge de dag (stethams cad bsgrub 〉par bgyi'o/ /ci nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'bum phrag 1snyedag la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun 67pa'i sems can de dag gi don gyi slad du/gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di 'dzam bu'i gling na yun ring du gnas shing myur du nub par mi 'gyur ba dang / sems can du ma ()dag gis gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di thos nas/ shes rab rno ba bsam gyis mi khyab par 'gyur ba dang / shes rab kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob par 'gyur ba dang / tshe 'di la tshe phun sum tshogs pa rab tu thob par 'gyur ba dang / srog la phan gdags pa dang / bsod nams kyi phung po 89—646

dpag tu ma mchis pa ①rab tu 'dzin par 'gyur ba dang / thabs sna tshogs rab tu 'tshal bar 'gyur ba dang / bstan bcos thams cad la rab tu ②mkhas par 'gyur ba dang / bzo'i bgyi ba sna tshogs phun sum tshogs pa 'thob ③par 'gyur ba dang / bskyud pa ma mchis par bgyi ba'i slad du/ de la gzungs kyang stsal bar bgyi'o/ /dge slong chos smra ba de dang / sems can chos nyan pa de dag gi ④don gyi slad du/ sngags dang / sman dang ldan pa'i khrus kyi las brjod par bgyi ste/ gza' dang / rgyu skar dang / skye ba dang / 'chi rjoba'i gnod pa dang / 'thab pa dang / rnyog pa dang / 'khrug glong 6)dang / khrag khrug dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / log 'dren gyi gnod pa thams cad dang /byad dang ro langs thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ gang gis mkhas pa dag khrus bgyid du stsal ba'i sman dang sngags ni 'di dag ④ste/ shu dag gi'u wang smṛ ⑧ka dang / /sha mya sha myi shī ri shādzi)/ /in+d+ra hasta skal ba che/ /dzha tsom shing tsha ⑩a ga ru/ /shi ri bi 8sta sra rtsi tsopog /gu gul ra sa sha la giyi/ /rdo dreg 8lo ma rgya spos dang / /tsan+dan dang ni ldong ros dang / / gi'u wang bcas dang ru rta ⑫dang / /gur gum gla sgang 7yungs kur (shedang / / dbyi mo 7sug smel na la dang ( )/ /nā ( nyag ge sar u shi ra tso/ /'di dag cha ni mnyam bgyis nas/ /skar ma rgyal la btag ( par bgyi/ /phye ma la ni sngags tshig (9'di/ /lan brgya mngon par gdab par dunabagyi/ /tar+ya thā/ su te kṛ ( /te/ ka ma ta li/ na le dza zhinan ka ra te/ haṅka ra te/ in+d+ra dza li ni/ shaṃ ka ra dri pa shad dri/ a brta ka /se ( shege na ku tra ku/ ka bi khri7la/ ka bi ri )la ma ti/ shī la ma ti/shī la ma ti/ sarnyi(nye/ dhu dhu ma ba ti(she/ shi ri shi ri/ sad t+ya sbri ti nunyes hā/89—647

lci bas dkyil 'khor bgyis nas ni/ /me tog sil ①ma dgram ②par bgyi/ /gser gyi snod dang dngul snod du/ /mngar niba'i khu ba gzhag ①par bgyi/ /skyes bu go cha bgos ⑤pa ni/ /bzhi zhig der yang gzhag ⑥par bgyi/ /rab tu brgyan ⑦pa'i bu mo bzhi/ /bum pa thogs pa gzhag ⑧par bgyi/ /rtag tu gu gul bdug par bgyi/ /sil snyan ①sna lnga bgyid du stsal/ /gdugs dang ba dan ⑩rgyal mtshan 7gyis/ /lha mo de ni legs 8par brgyanati/ /bar bar dag tu me long bzhagatso /mda' dang mdung rtse sne 0sprad bzhagatso /de nas mtshams 0kyang gcad 8par bgyi/ /de yi 'og tu dgos yipa brtsam/ /sngags kyi las ni 'di dag gis/ /mtshams gcad 69pa yang brtsam par bgyi/ / sār+ya thed yin/a ka dur ke/ na ya nes/ hi le ⑥mi le/ gi le/ khi khi le swā hā/ de nas dubacom ldan 'das kyi snam (9logs su khrus bgyis nas / sngags 'di bzlas brjod bgyis na khrus kyis ( )zhi bar sbyar ro/ /tabya thā/ sa ga ḍi0/ bi ga ḍi/bi ga ta ba ti 0swā hā/ phyogs bzhi dag na gang gnas pa'i/ /rgyu skar dag gis tshe srungs (nyeshig /btsas pa'i skar ma'i gnod pa dang / /phung po'i las dukyi 'jigs 'byung dang / /'byung po'i khams rnams 'khrugs bgyid pa/ /'jigs pa mi bzad zhi 8)gyur cig / tabya thā/(ste sa me bi chasha me swā hā/ sa ga ḍi/ bi ga ḍi swā hā/ bi ga ḍi ba te swā hā/(nya sā ga ra si bhu tā ()ya swā hā/skarnya mā tā —9ya swā hā/ nī la kuṇ+ḍa 8)ya swā hā/ a pa ra (nyadzi ta/ bir+sā (nyeya swā hā / tī ma brnya si bhu tā (steya swā hā/ i ni bi la bag tā zhesteya swā hā/ na mo bha ga ba te/ braṅgā 169/ na ma swa ra swa s+t+ya/ ma hā de be+e sirdzun tu māṃ/ man+t+ra pa dā / ta ra tu bi tsi rta/ bra d+mā nu ma n+ya tu 69swā hā/ dge slong chos smra ba de la 89—648

bsrung ①ba dang / chos mnyan pa de dag dang / yi ger 'dri ba ②de dag gi don gyi slad du/ khrus ①kyi las 'dis bdag nyid der mchis par dubagyi'o/ /lha'i tshogs thams cad dang lhan cig tu grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ grong rdal lam / gtsug lag khang der nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyi'o/ /ci nas dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma mdo sde'i dbang po 'dzin pa de dag gi srog la phan gdags par 'gyur ba dang / 'khor ba las 'byung ba duthob par 'gyur ba dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba dang / myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ⑥mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba dang —/ gza' dang / 'thab pa dang / rnyog pa dang / btsas pa'i skar ma'i gnod pa dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / log 'dren gyi gnod pa thams cad dang ske/ byad dang / ro langs thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha mo dbyangs can la/ lha mo chen mo ⑦dbyangs can khyod skye bo mang po la phan pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba'i phyir zhus ⑤te/ khyod kyi 6)sngags dang / sman dang ldan pa'i tshig ⑩'di 'dra ba bshad pa ni/ legs so legs so/ /zhes bya ba byin te/ lha mo chen mo yidabyangs can gyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 8zhabs la phyag 'tshal (nyete/ phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas slob dpon lung ston pa bram ze kau ṇ+ḍi yinas lha mo dbyangs can de bkug go/ /lha mo chen mo dbyangs can mchod 'os dka' thub che/ /'jig rten kun du rnam grangs mchog sbyin yon tan che/ /rtser gnas mdzes ma drur ba rtswa 8yis gos bskus pa/ / drur ba'i rtswa yi 'gos gyon rkang 9pa gcig gi (sheganas/ /lha rnams 89—649

thams cad lhags nas 'di skad tshig smras te/ /sems can rnams la dge ba'i tshig shod lce khrol mdzod/ /sār+ya the ①dan/ mu re/ tsi re(gyi/ a ba dze /a ba dza ba ti/ bhaṅga le/ piṅga ④le/ piṅga la ba te/ muṅga ṣe/ ma ma rī rtsu/swa ma ti/ da sha ma ti/ a sgri ta ma srirgya/ ta ra tsiyi/ ta ra tsa ba ti/ tsi tsi ⑦tsi ri/ shi ri mi ri/ ma ri rtsu/ mā na pri ye/ lo ka rdzusto/ lo ka shesto/ lo ka pre ya/ sid+dha pra te/ bhā ⑧ma mu khi/ shu tsi tsa ri/ a pra po)ti ha te/ a pra ti ha ta burnyi/ na mu tsi/ ma hā tshun mu tsi/ ma hā de byi/ pra ti spyi hā/ na ma ska rā yin/ bdag gi blo thogs pa med par gyur cig /bstan bcos dang /tshigs su bcad pa'i rgyud 'dang / sde snod dang / snyan dngags 4nyal sogs pa la / bdag gi rig sngags dngos grub tu gyur cig /tabya thā/ ma hā pra bhā be/hi li hi ⑩li/ mi li mi li/ bcom ldan 'das ma lha mo dbyangs can gyi mthus bdag rnam par rgyal 8bar gyur cig / kā ra te⑩/ ke yu re/ ke yu ra ma te⑩ / hi li mi li/ hi li mi li(ste/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang / chos kyi bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang / dbang po'i bden pa dang /chu lha'i bden pas lha mo chen mo dgug par bya'o/ /gang dag 'jig rten na bden pa smra ba de dag gi bden pa dang / bden pa'i tshig gis yo)lha mo chen mo dbyangs can 8nyadagug par bya'o( skye/ /tar+ya thā/ hi li mi li/ hi li mi li hi li mi li/ bdag rnam par rgyal so bar gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das ma lha mo chen mo ( snyedabyangs can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag la gsang sngags kyi tshig rnams grub par gyur cig swā hā/ de nas lha mo zhi tshodabyangs can gyi gsang ( stosngags kyi tshig de dag ne 7smras nas/ yang bram ze kauṇ+ḍi 3 7rgya la 'di skad ces smras so/ /89wa 650

skyes bu chen po khyod sems can thams cad la spobs pa dam pa dang / rdzu 'phrul dang ske/ mngon par shes pa dang / shes rab che ba dang / nor dang / dbyig la sogs pa sbyin pas phan 'dogs shing / myur du bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par byed pa legs so legs so/ /mdo sde 'di 'dzin pa'i cho ga bstan pa'i phyir tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /gzungs 'di dang por su 'don pas/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal ①te/ /'khrul pa med par bzlas byas na/ /dngos grub dam pa thob par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang dam chos dang / /byang chub rang rgyal nyan thos dang / /tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang / /rgyal chen bzhi la phyag 'tshal zhing / /rtag tu tshangs par spyod pa yang ②/ /rim gro gus par bsam byas te/ /zhi la dben pa'i gnas su ni/ /sgra bskyed gzungs dang bstod pa brjod/ /ji snyed sangs rgyas lha klu la/ /mchod pa rgya cher bsham zhistepar bya/ /skye bo'i rigs ni mang po la/ /snying rje'i ④sems kyang bskyed par bya/ /bcom ldan gser mdog mtshan rab can/ /rtse gcig sems kyis ⑤bsam bya zhing / /bcom ldan gsung rab dam chos kyis/ /dbang po so sor nges mdzad pa'i / /de yi tshig don yilegs bsams ri/te/ /stong nyid bsgrub la'ang (sheganas par byos/ /bcom ldan thams cad mngon sum du/ /rtse gcig sems kyis bsam byas na/ /ting nge 'dzin dang ye shes dang / gzungs dzinamachog dam pa thob par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan dpal mgur gsung chos kyis/ /dam pa'i dbyangs des ⑩'khor rnams 'dul/ /ljags kyis stong gsum khebs mdzad cing / /so sor ci rigs ya mtshan ston/ /de lta'i gsung mchog dam pa la/ /rtag par bsam zhing 'jigs pa spongs/ /bsam gyis 4)mi khyab 8ljags mtshan 89—651

'di / /smon lam rgya chen dbang gis brnyes/ /chos rnams med par ston mdzad pa / /ji ltar mkha' la ma chags bzhin/ /sangs rgyas ljags mtshan gsung sgra la / /de bsams smon lam tshad med 'grub/ /gang zhig dbyangs can mngon mchod dam/ /yang na slob mas man ngag bzhin/ /lung bzhin chos de gang sgrub pa/ / bkur sti'i ①mchog rnams thob par 'gyur/ /gang zhig ye shes mchog sgrub pa'ang / /rtse gcig sems kyis chos 'di gzung ②/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs 'phel zhing / /nges par 'grub la yid gnyis spongs/ /gang zhig nor sgrub nor dang ldan / /khe dang grags pa'ang de bzhin 'grub/ /'byung bar 'dod pa'ang rnam ④grol bar/ /nges par 'grub pas yid gnyis spongs / /yon tan mang po tshad med pa'ang (snye/ /bsam pa bzhin du kun grub ⑥pas / /'di la tshul bzhin gang gnas pa/ /nges par 'grub pas ⑦yid gnyis spongs / /dben par (nyagatsang ma'i gos gyon te/ /dkyil 'khor ci ran byas pa der⑨ske/ /bum pa rgyas pa bzhi bzhag kyiste/ /dus bzhin (spreme tog bdug pas mchod / /ba dan gdugs dang lda ldi bre/ /phye ma byug pas rgyas 8par brgyan/ /sangs rgyas dang ni dbyangs can mchod/ /lha de mthong 'dod mthong bar 'gyur//dbyangs can lha mo de mdun du/ /zhag bdun gsum du bzlas brjod de/ /gal te lha de ma mthong na/ /bsam pa brtan pas zhag dgur bzlas/ /de yi nub mo'ang ma mthong na/ /gzhan du shis pa'i gnas btsal te/ /tshul bzhin lha mo'i tsogazugs bris la/ /mchod cing bzlas brjod rgyun mi gcad8/ /bdag dang gzhan don tshad med la/ /nyin mtshan rgyun tu brtson bskyed de/ /de yi 'bras bu gzhan la stobs/ /de 7ni bsam pa 'grub yipar 'gyur/ /de ste'ang yi89—652

bsam pa ma grub na/ /zla ba gsum dang drug dang dgu/ /yang na brtson pas lor bzlas na/ /mngon shes drug la sogs pa'ang 'thob①/ /de nas bram ze kauṇ+ḍi rgyas/ de ②skad ces bshad pa thos nas dga' ba dang / rangs pa tshad ①med pa skyes te/ 'khor 'dus pa de dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha dang mi la sogs pa'i 'khor thams cad kyisadu/ sems ma g.yeng bar ⑤bdag la nyon cig dang / bdag gis kun rdzob kyi bden pa la brten te/ dbyangs can lha mo stimachog la bstod pa'i phyir/ tshigs su bcad de smra bar bgyi'o/ /phyag 'tshal lha mo mthu chen la/ /'jig rten khams 'dir dbang brnyes par/ /sngon gyi drang srong gis ⑦bshad pas/ /de phyir bdag gis khyod la bstodabya/ /dpal ldan thugs ni bde ba dang / /thos 'dzin mdzes ldan grags ldan pa/ /'jig rten 'di skyed yum yang yin/ /rtag tu dpal la brtson chen spyod/ /g.yul lagyi gnas las ṇirtag tu rgyal/ /snying rje bzod la dul bas bskyed/ /gshin rje'i sring mor lus 0ston cing / /rtag tu dar ⑩gos sngon po mnabs/ /mdzes dang mi mdzes kun ston cing / /spyan mig sus mthong dang ba skyeda'/ /spyod pa tshad med 'jig rten ci'adas/ /skyabs su su 'ongs rjes su 'dzin/ /bar 'ga' 8ri dang brag la gnas/ /bar 'ga' phug dang chu bo'i 'gram/ /yang na ljon sdong nags rnams su/ /gnas de dag ni lha mo'i rten/ /ci ⑩ltar ri brags ⑩mi rnams kyis/ /rma bya'i mdongs las (shegadugs byas shing / /rtag tu lha mo de mchod na/ /thams cad dus su 'jig rten skyob/ /stag dang seng ges 'khor byas shing / /bya dang phyugs kyang ()de la brtan( )/ /dril (nyuchen sgra dag mngon bsgrags pas/ /bin dhu'i ri la'ang grag ru par gyur/ /phyag na rtse 89—653

gsum ①thor tshugs dbul/ /yang na nyi zla'i ru mtshon bsnams/ /zla ba mar ngo ③bcu gcig ④gam/ /dgu yi dus su mchod pa ⑤bya/ /g.yul 'gyed dus su thugs brtse bas/ /'jig rten kun la gzigs pa'i phyir/ /lha mo ba su'i ⑥gzugs ston pas/ /lha mo'i mchog ste bu dpe med pa'o/ /phyugs rdzi rgan ④mo'i gzugs ston cing / /lha dag 'thab pa'ang rtag tu rgyal/ /yun ring 'jig rten bde bar gnas6)/ /bar 'ga' 7khros shing bar 'ga' zhi/ /bram zer smra zhing hu)chos bzhi dang / /rdzu tso'aphrul gsang sngags kun la mkhas/ /drang srong lha yi dbang brnyes pas/ /sa chen 'di dang sa bon byed/ /lha mo 'du ba'i dus su yang ske/ /rgya mtsho lud tshubazhin nges par 'duyi/ /gnod sbyin klu la sogs rnams kyis / /kun gyi gtso byed 'dul bar nus/ /mo rnams kun gyi tshangs spyod mchog /'jig rten gtso sbyin bdag la dgongs8/ /rgyal po'i gnas la'ang pad+mo ⑩bzhin/ /chu bo la yang gru dang gzings/ /zla ba nya bzhin zhal yang rgyas/ /mang du thos ldan rten ⑩yang byed/ /ri bo'i rtse bzhin spobs pa 'phags/ /bsams sna pas gling dang rab kyang ston/ /lha min la sogs lha rnams kyis/ /kun gyis yon tan bstod cing bsngags(rte/ /spyan stong brgya byin lha rgyal yang / /gus pa'i sems kyis zhal du ltar lha/ /sems can gang dag ci 'dod pa/ /de kun bsam pa myur du skong 2nya/ /blo myur thos pa 'dzin pa yang / /sa chen 'di gnas kun gyi mchog /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams dag tu/ /rtag tu sgron chen snang byed bzhin/ /bya dang gcan gzan ri sosnyedags kyi'ang / /kun gyi zhunyabasam pa yongs su skong / /bud med kyi mchog ri bo bzhin/ /drang srong 'jig rten ri 2 gnas bzhin/ /lha mo gzhon bzhin 'dod dang bral/ /mi mjed 89—654

bdag bzhin bden par smra/ /'jig rten mthun par gzugs ston cing / /'dod khams bar gyi lha gnas su'ang / /khyod ni lha mo'i gtso yin pas/ /de las mchog pa'i sems can med/ /gal te g.yul dang 'jigs pa'i gnas/ /me yi dong du lhung 'gyur ramatshi/ /chu bo ②g.yang sa mi rgod las/ /'jigs pa de las sgrol bar ①mdzad/ /rgyal po'i chad pas bcings pa'am④ yang na dgra yis bsad ⑤par yang / /rtse gcig sems ni ma g.yos na⑥/ /sdug bsngal dag las thar bar 'gyur/ /dge dang mi jige kun la ༷skyob/ /byams dang brtse bas ⑧mdun du 6)gnas/ /de phyir bdag ni sems btud de⑩/ /phyag 'tshal lha mo chen mo la'o/ /de nas yang slob dpon lung ston pa bram ze kauṇ+ḍi ⑨rgyas / /lha mo chen mo dbyangs can la tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams thams cad nga la nyan par gyis/ /lha dang dri za lha dbang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ /bud med dam pa lha mo mchog gi 8rab gang yin/ /lha mo dam pa mchog tu mdzes pa'i zhal la bstod(nye/ /yon tan rnam pa sna tshogs bsags pas yan lag brgyanardzi/ /dbyangs can zhes bya spyan ni yangs shing bsod nams 'bar/ /dri med ye shes yon tan rnams kyis rnam par brgyanam/ /rin chen sna tshogs tha dad lta bur tsobalta ba'i phyir/ /mchog rab ngag dhigi yon tan khyad par de bstod do/ /dam pa mchog gi dngos grub byed pa dang / /yang dag bsngags pa yon tan byed pa dang / /dri med mchog dang pad+ma 'bar ba dang / /mig mchog dang ni mig gi dam pa dang / /dge ba'i gnas dang dge ba mthong ba dang / /yon tan bsam mi khyab pas /shebargyan pa dang / /zla ba 'dra dang tsho/dri ma med 'od dang / /ye shes 'byung 89—655

gnas dran pa dam pa dang / /seng ge mchog dang mi la zhon pa dang / /lag pa brgyad rnams kyis ni brgyan pa la①/ /mda' gzhu mdung thung ②ral gri dgra sta dang ske/ /be con lcags kyi 'khor ②lo zhags pa bsnams/ /zla ba 0nya ba lta bur ⑤snang ba'i zhal/ /yid du 'ong ba'i ngag dang dbyangs snyan dang / /shes rab zab mo dang ni ldan pa dang / /dgos mchog sgrub byed sems can dam pa dang / /lha dang lha min dbang pos mchod pa dang / /lha dang lha min tshogs kun gnas brjod dang / /'byung po'i tshogs kyi gnas rtag mchod pa'i phyir/ /swā hā bdag cag lha mo ⑥'di la phyag bya'o/ /bdag la yon tan khyad par kun ⑦stsol cig /dgos pa kun tu bdag la dngos grub stsol⑧/ /dgra rnams khrod na bdag la rtag tu srungs6)/ /yi ge rdzogs shing tshig rgyas 'di dag ni/ /nang par langs nas gtsang mar brjod par bya/ /bsam pa dang ni nor 'bru thams cad rnyed/ /dngos grub dge ba rgya chen thob par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bram ze kauṇ+ḍi ⑩rgya la legs so zhes bka' stsal te/ khyod kyis sems can thams cad 'onyul phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir/ lha mo dbyangs can la bstod pa dang / dngos grub dam pa slong bas /(nyabasod nams tshad med pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro// // bam po brgyad pa/1nye de nas slob dpon lung ston pa bram ze kauṇ+ḍi ④rgyas bstod pa dang / gsang sngags kyi tshig gis/ lha mo chen mo lidabyangs can la gsol tshanas/ yang 'khor de dag la smras pa/ skyes bu khyed dhikyis lha mo dbyangs can tsho17spyan drang 17ba dang / de'i thugs rjes bskyab ( — )cing tshe 'di nyid la spobs pa thogs pa med pa dang / thos pa 'dzin cing shes rab chen po 89—656

dang ldan par 'gyur ba ①dang / gtsug ②lag thams cad la mkhas shing /tshig sbyor ba'i rgyan la gsal zhing thogs pa med pa nigrub par 'dod pas/bsam pa de rjodes shing gus pa'i sems kyis lha mo dbyangs can spyan drang ba'i dhitshig 'di brjod par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dang /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas ⑥la sogs pa⑦/ 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar bzhugs pa'i 'phags pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yang dag par bden pa'i gsung la gnas pa/ so so'i dbang po dang mthun pa(gyi/ bden pa ston pa la mi slu bar gsung ba/ bskal pa bye ba tshad med par yang dag par ⑨bden pa'i tshig rtag tu ston cing / gsung ba de dag la rjes su yi rang ngo / /bden pa gsung bas ljags yangs la ring ba bkram ste/ zhal dang ⑩'dzam bu'i gling dang /rgyal chen bzhi dang / stong gcig dang / stong gnyis dang / stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'di (spredang / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams tshad med pa thams cad rgyas par 'gengs shing / nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba thams cad sel ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad la lus btud de phyag 'tshal lo / /ljags kyi mtshan dam pa de 'dra ba dang / gaspobs pa tshad med pa dang bdag tu ldan par gyur cig /phyag 'tshal bcom ldan dbyangs can mchog /byang chub chen po dbyangs can mchog /'phags pa rang rgyal dbyangs can mchog /zung bzhi ya brgyad dbyangs can mchog /bden pa bzhi gsung dbyangs can mchog /yang dag gzigs pa yidabyangs can mchog /drang srong 89—657

tshangs 'khor dbyangs can mchog /lha mo u ①ma dbyangs can mchog /skem ②byed lha yang dbyangs can mchog /gzi can klu yang dbyangs can mchog /mtshan mo lha mo dbyangs can mchog /rgyal chen bzhi po dbyangs can mchog /bde gnas ③lha sras dbyangs can mchog /rdo rje gsang bdag dbyangs can mchog /khyab 'jug lha yang dbyangs can mchog /lha mo pe ma ④dbyangs can mchog /tshogs bdag lha yang dbyangs can mchog /dpal gyi lha mo dbyangs can mchog /dpal gyi blo gros dbyangs can mchog /hi ⑤ri tshig 'chang dbyangs can mchog /ma mo kun mchog dbyangs can mchog /'phrog ma mo yang dbyangs can mchog /gnod sbyin kun kyang dbyangs can mchog /phyogs bcu'i rgyal po dbyangs can mchog /bdag la las mchog kun gyis stobs(7/ /mtha' med dbyangs can mchog thob mdzod/ /slu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par grol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dod chags bral la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcings pa bcad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam dag sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'od snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bden tshig gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdul dang bral la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don dam gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor mang gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbyangs can lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag ni tshig la thogs med mdzod/ /bdag gi (7bsam pa ci mchis pa thams cad myur du grub par mdzod/ /nad med rtag tu bde ba dang / /tshe ring ba yang thob par shog /rig pa'i gnas smyo la mkhas pa dang / /byang chub lam la brtson pa dang / /skye bo kun la phan mang mdzod/ /re ba thams cad myur du skong 9/ /bdag gi yang dag bden tshig dang / /bdag gis mi slu tshig smras pa//89—658

dbyangs can lha mo mchog gis ni/ /bdag gi ①don de grub par mdzod/ /lha mo 'dir ni gshegs par gsol/ /bdag gi tshig la thogs med mdzod/ /lus dang ngag la lamyur zhugs shing / /yid myur spobs pa rdzogs par mdzod/ /bdag gi 2lce yi dbang po la/ /bde gshegs spobs pa ldan par mdzod/ /tshig gi gzi brjid mthu des ni/ /sems can thams cad 'dul bar mdzod/ /bdag gis tshig ni ci smras pa/ /don de thams cad grub par shog /tshig la thams cad gus skyed ④cing / /byed pa thams cad chud ma gzon/ /nam zhig bdag gi spobs 'dod pa/ /don de grub par ma gyur na/ /lha mo khyod kyi bden tshig ni/ /thams cad brdzun pa nyid du 'gyur/ /mtshams ⑤med lnga yi sdig bgyis pa/ /sangs rgyas bkas ni 'dul bar 'gyur/ /gang yang dgra bcom pa dag dang / /byas pa gzo ba'i 4)tshig rnams dang / /shā ri'i bu dang mod gal ⑦ dang ske/ /bcom ldan 'khor gyi gtso bo ste/ /de la sogs pa'i bden tshig kyang / /thams cad bdag la grub par shog /sangs rgyas nyan thos 'khor rnams dgani /bdag gis deng 59)'dir spyan drang gis7/ /bdag gi re ba bskang yinyeba'i phyir/ /thams cad myur du gshegs par mdzod/ /yang dag bden pa'i tshig gsol ba/ /thams cad slu 7ba med par shog /srid pa'i rtse mo man chad dang / /gtsang ma'i gnas ni thams cad dang / /tshangs pa tshangs chen mdun 'don dang / /tshangs pa'i rgyal 'khor thams cad dang / /stong gsum 'khor ba'i bar dag dang / /mi mjed 'jig rten gtso bo dang / /de dang de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de kun deng 'dir spyan drangs te/ /thugs rjes bdag la dgongs mdzad cing / /brtse ba kun gyis gzung bar mdzod/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed lha dag dang / /89—659

gzhan yang 'phrul dga'i 6)lha dag dang / / byams pa mngon par 'tshang rgya'i gnas / /dga' ldan gnam gyi lha rnams dang ②/ /'thab bral gyi ①ni lha rnams dang —/ /sum cu rtsa gsum lha rnams dang / /rgyal chen bzhi yi lha rnams dang / /gzhan yang lha 'khor thams cad dang / /sa chu me rlung lha dag dang / /ri rab lhun la gnas pa dang / /chu bdun ri bo lha rnams dang / /de kun 'khor dang bcas pa dang / /zur phud lnga can nor rgyas dang / /nyi zla gza' dang rgyu skar dang —/ /de la sogs pa'i dulha rnams dang / /'jig rten bde bar mdzad pa'i gnas / /de la sogs pa'i lha thams cad(snye/ /sdig pa'i las la ma stimos pa⑦/ /sangs rgyas la gus 'byung ba'i lam/ /bu rab gzhon la byams pa dang / /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin rnams/ /dri za dang ni lha ma yin/ /gzhan yang mi 'am ci dag dang / /lto 'phye che la sogs pa 6)rnams/ /kun kyang bcom ldan mthu yis ni/ /bdag gis deng 'dir spyan drangs te/ /thugs rje ⑩brtse ba'i dgongs pa yis/ /bdag la thogs med spobs pa skyed(nya/ /lha dang mi rnams thams cad kyis7/ /gzhan gyi sems rig (nyemakhyen pa rnams/ /kun gyi chamathu yis byin brlabs 7shing / /bdag la spobs pa'i mchog stsol cig /ji snyed nam mkha'i mthas ⑩gtugs shing / /chos kyi dbyings kyi mus klas 7pa'i/ /sems can de dag thams cad kyis/ /bdag la spobs pa'i mchog stsol cig /de nas dbyangs can lha mo la bram ze kauṇ+ḍi 1)rgyas de skad ces gsol pa dang / lha mos skyes bu chen po de la dge'o zhes smras te/ gang rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang nyartel la zhig gis tshigs su bcad pas bstod pa dang / gsang (lhasngags kyi tshig de dag 'chang zhing 'dzin pa dang / dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 89—660

su song ste/ sems 'dun pas rjes su dmigs shing / ci 'dod pa'i don cho ga bzhin du bsgrubs na①/ /chud za bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po shin tu phra zhing / zab pa 'di 'dzin pa dang /'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / 'don pa de bsam pa thams cad myur du 'grub par 'gyur te/ sems g.yeng bas byas pa ni ma gtogs so/ /de skad ces ②smras pa dang / bram ze kauṇ+ḍi 6)rgya rab tu dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes te/ thal mo sbyar ba byas nas rjes su 'dzin to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha mo dbyangs can la legs so zhes bka' stsal te/ lha mo khyod kyis dam pa'i chos 'di yongs su bsrung ④zhing / yongs su rgyas par bya ba dang / mdo du'adi 'dzin pa'i sems can thams cad la chos 'di lta bu bstan pas bde ba dang /bsod nams dang / spobs pa tshad med pa 'phel bar 'gyur te/ gang sems bskyed pa rnams kyang myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par byas pa legs so legs so/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las/ lha mo dbyangs can gyi le'u zhes bya ste bcwa 0lnga pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha mo chen mo dpal gyis 'di skad ces gsol to / /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das lha mo chen mo dpal bdag gis ci nas kyang /chos smra ba'i dge slong de yo byad thams cad phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba dang /brel phongs pa ( ma mchis pa 'thob 58)par 'gyur ba dang / sems brtas pa 'thob 5)par 'gyur ba dang / sems bde bar gdugs mtshan bas par 'gyur ba dang / gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di las tshig dang /89—661

yi ge rnam pa tha dad pa dag chub par 'gyur ba dang / rnam par rtog ①par 'gyur ba dang / yang dag par brjod par 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas 'bum phrag midag la/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun (gupa'i sems can de dag gi don gyi ⑤slad dul/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di 'dzam bu'i gling du yun ring du gnas par 'gyur zhing / myur du nub par mi 'gyur ba dang /sems can rnams kyang / gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di nyan par 'gyur ba dang / bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du mar lha dang /mi'i bde ba myong bar 'gyur ba dang / mu ge ma mchis par 'gyur ba dang / lo legs par 'gyur ba dang / sems can rnams kyang bde bar sbyar ba thams cad kyis bde bar 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang 'grogs par 'gyur ba dang —/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub (nyamangon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba dang / sems can dmyal ba dang ske/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal thams cad shin tu rgyun (0)chad par 'gyur ba (pe'adi lta ste/ gos dang / zas dang la/ mal cha dang / stan dang / na ba'i gsos (guman dang / sman zong dang / yo byad dang / 'tshog chas kyi bye brag gzhan 6)dag gis kyang dge slong chos smra ba de spro bar bgyi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen me tog yon tan rgya mtsho be+e ḍūr+ya ( )dang /gser gyi ri kha dog bzang po gser du snang ba'i dpal zhes bya ba de la/ lha mo chen mo dpal gyis dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed 11de/ des da ltar phyogs gang dang /gang du sems pa dang / phyogs gang dang gang du lta ba dang / phyogs gang dang /89—662

gang du 'gro ba'i phyogs de dang / der sems can bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma dag bde bar sbyar ba thams cad kyis bde bar 'gyur/ zas dang / skom dang / nor dang / 'bru dang / 'gron ①bu dang / gser dang / nor bu dang / mu tig dang / bai ḍūr+ya ②dang / dung dang / man shel dang / byi (miru dang / dngul dang / sa le sbram dang / yo byad gzhan dag gis kyang mi phongs par 'gyur/ sems can de dag yo byad thams cad 'byor bar 'gyur ro//lha mo chen mo dpal gyi mthus ④de bzhin gshegs pa de la mchod par ⑤bya/spos dang / me tog dang / bdug pa yang dbul bar bya/ lha mo chen mo dpal gyi ming nas lan gsum brjod cing / de la spos dang / bdug yis dang ske/ me tog kyang byin la/ ro sna tshogs kyang byin na/ de'i 'bru'i phung po chen po rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ sa la sa yi ⑦bcud dag rnam par 'phel/ /lha rnams rtag tu rab tu dga' bar 'gyur/ /'bras bu lo thog lasdum sdong ljon shing (9)rnams/ /lo thog 7shin tu sna tshogs rnams /stekyang skyed7/ /gser 'od dam pa tshonamado sde'i dbang 8po'i rgyal po'i ming brjod pa'i sems can de dag la lha mo chen mo dpal ni (shesems par 'gyur/de dag la dpal chen por 7byed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dpal lha mo chen mo la legs so zhes bka' stsal te/ legs so legs so/ /lha mo khyod kyis sngon byas pa rjes su dran pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa dang / sems can tshad med pa rnams la phan pa dang / bde bas phan 'dogs shing / mdo sde 'di yang yongs su rgyas par byed pa'i bsod nams zad mi shes pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i 89wa 663

rgyal po las/ lha mo dpal gyi le'u zhes bya ste bcu drug pa'o// //de nas lha mo dpal chen mos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di nas byang phyogs su mi ring ba zhig na/ lha'i rgyal po rnam thos kyi bu'i pho brang lcang lo can gyi 'khor na skyed ①mos tshal dam pa bsod nams kyi me tog 'od ces bya ba na②/ rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i khang bzangs pad+ma nidam pa gser gyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba na bdag gnas te/ mi dugang la la ⑤'bru'i phung po spel bar 'dod pa des rang gi khyim phyag dar legs par bya/khrus legs par bya/ gos dkar po gtsang ma bgo bar bya/ gos dri ⑥rab tu zhim pa ( )bgo bar bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen me tog yon tan rgya mtsho bai ḍūr+ya ⑧dang /gser gyi (7ri kha dog bzang po gser du snang ba'i dpal de la phyag 'tshal zhing mtshan nas kyang lan gsum brjod/ lha mo chen mo dpal gyi ⑩lag nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa byed/ me tog dang / bdug pa dang / spos kyang 'bul(1/ ro bro ba sna tshogs kyang 'buladhi/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po'i ming yang lan gsum brjod/ bden pa'i tshig kyang brjod/lha mo chen mo dpal la yang mchod cing / me tog dang / bdug pa yang 'bul7ske/ ro bro ba sna tshogs kyang 'bul chan/ gser 'od dam pa chamado sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di yi 7mthus/ de'i tshe lha mo chen mo dpal khyim de la sems par 'gyur/ de'i 'bru'i phung po chen po yang 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /lha mo chen mo dpal 'gugs tunyepar 'dod pa des rig pa'i gsang 8sngags 'di dag 89—664

dran par bya'o/ /'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen gtsug tor can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med par 'bar ba ①rin chen 'od zer snang ba'i rtog ②la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'dzam bu dugaser gyi rgyal mtshan gser du snang ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gser du snang ba'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma brgya'i 'od zer stisnang ba'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gser ri ⑤rin chen 'byung gnas gdugs brtsegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gser gyi me tog 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyi tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sgron dum chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog la phyag 'tshal lo//shar phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen gtog la phyag ⑧'tshal lo/ /nub phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnga sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mdzes pa'i tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gser yi)'od dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gser gyi snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags la phyag ⑩'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rab gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de dag la phyag 'tshal 89—665

nas rig pa 'di dag la ②sbyor bar bya ste/ rig sngags 'di bdag la 'byor bar gyur cig /sār+ya ②the dan/ pra ti pur+ṇa gtsa re/ sa man+ta ④dar+sha khephyi/ ma hā bi hā ra ga ti/ sa man ta/ bi mā yin ga te/ ma hā kār+yaX/ pra ti mā ba ṇi / sa tā/ arba sa ma tā nu/ pra pū reg/ a yā na dharma tāl/ ma hā bho gi ni7ske/ ma hā mi tri/ u (1pa sang hi te/ hi tai ṣi/ sang kṛ tī 8te/ sa mar thā nu pā nyurtel ne swā hāsnyi/ 'di dag ni spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i chos nyid kyi ⑫gsang sngags kyi tshig gcig tu de kho na yang dag par grub pa ⑩sbyin pa mi slu ba'i don gyi tshig ste/ sems can bar ma la spyod pa rnams dge ba'i rtsa ba kha na ma tho ba med pa 7dag gis/ lo bdun du 'don cing / 'dzin pa dag tu)yan lag brgyad pa'i bsnyen par gnas pa la bsnyen te/ bdag dang sems can kun/thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs par bya ba yongs su rdzogs par yo)bya ba'i phyir/ snga dro dang / phyi dro sangs rgyas thams cad la me tog dang /spos rnams kyis mchod nas/ des bdag gi bsam pa ru ze'adi 'byor par gyur cig /myur du 'byor par gyur cig /gtsug lag khang ngam(nya/ dgon pa'i gnas kyang rung ste/ khyim de shin tu gtsang mar so byas la/ lci bas dkyil 'khor byas te/ spos dang / bdug 2pa yang dbul bar bya/ stan gtsang ma yang gding ( bar bya'o/ /sa la me tog ( gesil ma bkram ste bsdad par bya'o/ /de nas skad cig de nyid la/ ( lhalha mo chen mo dpal ( rte'ongs nas/ der gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de phyin chad khyim mam nya/ grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ grong rdal lam/ gtsug lag khang ngam/ dgon pa'i gnas su nam yang brel cing phongs pa med par 'gyur ro/ /'gron 6bu dang / gser dang / rin po che 89—666

dang ske/ nor dang / 'bru dang / yo byad thams cad 'byor pa dang / bde bar sbyar ba thams cad kyis bde bar 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba gang dag byed pa de dag thams cad las/ lha mo chen mo dpal la shas kyi ①mchog sbyin par bya ste / des na de ci srid 'tsho ba'i ②bar du de na gnas par 'gyur/ 'phang bar ②mi 'gyur/ de dag gi bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur rol/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las/ lha mo chen mo dpal gyis nor yongs su spel ba'i le'u zhes bya ④ste bcu bdun pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das la sa'i lha mo brtan mas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di/da ltar dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ grong rdal (snyelam/ ljongs sam/ dgon pa'i phyogs sam/ ri'i sman ljongs samayi/pho brang 'khor ⑦gang du gnas par 'gyur ba'i grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/grong nirdal lam/ ljongs sam/ dgon pa'i phyogs sam/ ri'i sman ljongs sam6) / pho brang 'khor der/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das sa'i lha mo brtan ma bdag mchi bar bgyi'o/ / btsun pa 7bcom ldan 'das gang na gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di rgya cher yang dag par rab tu 'chad par 'gyur ba dang / sa phyogs gang dang gang na/ dge slong chos smra ba de'i chos kyi khri shom par 'gyur ba dang / gang dang gang du chos smra ba stan la mchis nas/gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di rgya cher yang dag par rab tu bstan (nyapar 'gyur ba der/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das sa'i lha mo brtan ma 89—667

dag ①sa phyogs de dang de dag tu mchi bar bgyi'o/ /lus mi gda' bar chos kyi khri'i 'og logs su mchis te/ yan lag gi dam pa mgos dge slong chos smra ba de'i rkang mthil nas brten ②par bgyi'o/ /bdag kyang nichos mnyan pa dang /chos bdud rtsi'i khu ba 'dis tshim par bgyiphyi/ yang dag par rim gror gebagyi/yang dag par mchod par ⑥bgyi'o/ /bdag tshim par gyuraX/ rim gro bgyi ba nibagyis par gyur6)/ rab tu dga' bar gyur nas/ sa'i phung po dpag tshad stong phrag drug cu ⑩brgyad po 'di nas/ sa'i gzhi rdo rje la thug ⑩pa'i bar du/sa'i bcud kyis rnam par 'phel bar bgyi/ yang dag par ni 8rim gro bgyi/yongs su rdzogs par bgyi'o/ /steng du yang rgya mtsho'i mtha' la thug pa'i sa'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ sa'i bcud kyi snum gyis brlan par bgyi'o/ /sa chen po 'di rab tu gzi byin dang ldan par bgyi'o/ /de nas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir rtswa dang / shing gel pa dang / sman dang / nags tshal sna tshogs rnams gzi byin dang rab tu ldan par 'khrung bar ()'gyur/ kun dga' cir ba dang /nags tshal dang / shing ljon pa thams cad dang / lo ma dang / me tog dang /'bras bu dang / lo thog 7rnam pa sna tshogs 7thams cad kyang yi/ rab tu gzi byin dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang 6nya/ dri dang rab tu ldan pa dang / snum pa 6)dang rab tu ldan pa dang / ro zhim por 'gyur( nya/ blta na rab tu sdug pa dang /rab tu che bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can de dag kyang btung ba dang / bza' ba rnam pa sna tshogs ( 1de dag 'tshal mnyanas/ tshe dang / stobs dang / kha dog dang shā/ dbang po rnams rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /gzi byin dang /stobs dang / kha dog dang / gzugs dang rab tu so ldan par gyur nas kyang /89—668

sa la mchis pa'i dgos pa rnam pa sna tshogs tha dad pa 'bum phrag du ma dag bgyid par 'gyur/ brtson par 'gyur/ 'bad par 'gyur/ stobs su bgyi ba'i ①las rnams bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /btsun ②pa bcom ldan 'das rgyu des 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ②ba dang / lo legs pa dang /rgyas pa dang / nyams dga' bar 'gyur/ skye bo dang mi mang pos gang bar 'gyur / 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can de dag ④thams cad bde bar 'gyur/dga' ba rnam pa sna tshogs myong bar 'gyur/ sems can de dag gzi byin dang /stobs dang / kha dog dang / gzugs dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di'i slad du/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am / dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma mdo sde'i dbang po 'dzin pa de dag chos kyi khri stan la mchis pa'i ⑤gan du mchi bar 'gyur/ mchis nas kyang sems rab tu dang bas sems can thams cad kyi don dang phan pa dang bde ba dang /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po ⑥'di rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ⑦bshad par bgyi ba'i slad du/ chos smra ba de dag la gsol ba 'debs par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal ( po 'di rab tu bshad pa na sa'i khyalha mo brtan ma bdag g.yog dang bcas te/ rab tu gzi byin dang ldan pa dang /rab tu stobs dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /bdag cag gi lus la stobs dang /brtson 'grus dang / mthu chen po bskyed par 'gyur/ bdag cag gi lus la gzi byin dang / dpal dang / phun sum tshogs pa yang 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das sa'i lha mo brtan ma bdag chos bdud rtsi'i khu ba 89wa 669

'dis tshim par gyurasti/ gzi byin dang / stobs dang / brtson 'grus dang /mthu dang / shugs chen po thob par gyur na/ sa chen po dpag tshad stong phrag bdun pa'i 'dzam bu'i gling 'di sa'i bcud chen pos rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur ro②ske/ /sa chen po gzi byin dang rab tu ldan par 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das sa ②la brten pa'i sems can 'di dag thams cad kyang 'phel zhing rgyas la yangs par 'gyur/ rgya rgyachen por yang 'gyur ro/ /sa la gnas pa'i sems can de dag chen por gyur nas kyang / longs spyod dang / yongs su spyod pa sna tshogs la spyod par 'gyur/ bde ba dag kyang myong bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag thams cad bza' ba dang / btung ba dang bca' ba rnam pa sna tshogs dang / gos dang / mal cha dang / stan dang / gnas dang / khang pa dang /gzhal med khang dang / skyed phyimos tshal dang / chu bo dang / rdzing dang / chu mig dang / mtshe'u dang / mtsho dang / lteng ka dang / 'di lta bu'i yo byad bde ba rnam pa sna tshogs sa 6)la gnas pa sa las 'byung ba sa la rten ⑦pa 'di dag la spyod par 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das rgyu des (kyesems can de dag thams cad kyis bdag la byas pa gzo (she)bar bgyi'o/ /gdon mi 'tshal bar bigaser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di bste yonastang du bgyis te / mnyan par bgyi/ bkur stir 7bgyi/ bla mar bgyi/ rim gror bgyi/mchod par bgyi'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gang gi tshe sems can de dag chos smra ba'i tshagan du mchi ba'i slad du/ rigs tha dad pa dang / khyim tha dad pa dag nas byung ste mchis nas/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di nyan par gyur la/ thos nas kyang rang rang gi rigs dang / khyim dang /89wa 670

grong dang / grong rdal tha dad pa dag tu zhugs nas/ rang rang gi khyim na gnas pa dag ①phan tshun du 'di skad ces bdag cag gis de ring chos mnyan pa zab mo thos so/ /de ring bdag cag gis bsod nams kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa yongs su bzung ②ngo / /bdag cag gis chos mnyan pa des/ de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma dag mnyes par byas so/ /deng ④bdag cag gis ④chos mnyan pa 'dis sems can dmyal ba las yongs su thar to⑤la/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang / yi dgas kyi yul las yongs su thar rophyi/ /deng ⑦bdag cag gis (michos mnyan pa 'dis ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ tshe rabs 'bum phrag du mar lha dang mi'i skye ba yongs su bzung bar 'gyur ro zhes gtam zer bar 'gyur ro/ /khyim tha dad pa na ⑨gnas par gyur pa ⑩de dag sems can gzhan dag la/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di las tha na dpe gcig tsam brjod dam/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di las tha na le'u gcig gam/ sngon byung ba gcig gam/ tha na byang chub sems dpa'i ming ngam/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan gcig gam/ tha na tshig bzhi pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig gam/tshig gcig cig (stesems can gzhan tshedag la thos par bgyid dam/ tha na gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i (1 rgyal po 'di'i limatshan gzhan dag la rab tu ston tam/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gang dang gang na sems can rnam pa tha dad pa de dag phyogs rnam pa tha dad pa dag tu mdo sde'i gtan tshigs marnam pa sna tshogs 'di lta bu 'di dag gcig la gcig brjod tsodam/ thos par bgyid dam / gtam rgyud brjod skon/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das sa 4)phyogs de dag 89—671

thams cad ①shin tu gzi byin dang ldan pa dang / shin tu snum par 'gyur ro/ /sa phyogs de dang de dag tu sems can de dag thams cad kyi phyir/ sa'i bcud rnam pa sna tshogs dang / yo byad thams cad rgyas par skye bar 'gyur②/ rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur/ shin tu rgyas par 'gyur③/ sems can de dag thams cad kyang bde bar 'gyur ro/ /nor che ba dang / longs spyod che ba dang /sbyin pa la mos par 'gyur/ dkon mchog gsum la mngon par dad par 'gyur ro / /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis ④sa'i lha mo brtan ma la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sa'i lha mo sems can gang la la dag /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di las tha na tshig ⑤gcig nyan na / de dag mi'i 'jig rten 'di nas shi 'phos nas sum cu rtsa gsum yilha'i ris ༅kyi nang du lha'i ris gang yang rung ba zhig tu skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sa'i lha mo sems can gang la la dag /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di dag la ༷ mchod pa'i phyir/ gnas de dag legs par brgyan ⑨par byed dam / tha na gdugs gcig gam/ ba dan kyigacig gam/ ras bcos bu gcig gis g.yogs na17/ sa'i lha mo rtag tu brgyan 7pa'i gnas de dag 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha'i ris bdun po de dag tu lha'i rin po (9che sna bdun gyi chagazhal med khang rgyan thams cad kyis legs par brgyan 7pa dag tu gnas par 'gyur rol/ /gang gi tshe sems can de dag mi'i 'jig rten 'di nas shi 'phos te/rin po che sna bdun gyi gzhal med khang de dag tu skye ba de'i tshe/ sa'i lha mo rin po che sna bdun gyi gzhal med khang re rer yang lan bdun bdun du skye bar 'gyur ro / /lha'i bde ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag kyang myong bar 'gyur ro/ /de skad 89—672

ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la sa'i lha mo brtan mas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das des na sa'i lha mo brtan ma bdag dge slong chos smra ba/ chos kyi khri stan la mchis pa de'i tshe ①chos kyi stan gyi ⑤'og logs kyi sa phyogs de dang de dag tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /ci nas kyang sangs rgyas 'bum phrag ①dag la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun ④pa'i sems can de dag gi don gyi slad du/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di 'dzam bu'i gling du yun ring du ⑤gnas shing myur du nub par mi 'gyur ba dang / sems can rnams kyang gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di nyan par 'gyur ba dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus na bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du mar lha dang / mi'i bde ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong bar 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang 'grogs par 'gyur ba dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus na bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 4)mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba dang / sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang ske/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal thams cad shin tu rgyun (7chad par 'gyur bar lus mi gda' bar bgyis te/ dge slong chos smra ba de'i rkang pa la ⑧yan lag gi dam pa mgos 6)brten par bgyi'o⑩/ /de nas sa'i lha mo brtan mas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la sngags yinyekyi snying po zhig mchis pa 'di lha dang mi thams cad la phan pa dang bde bar 'gyur ba ste/ gang ⑫skyes pa'am/ bud med dam/ 'khor bzhi po gang (snyel la zhig gis/ bdag mngon sum du mthong bar 'dod pa dang / nor dang / nor bu 8rin po che dang —/ dbyig la sogs pa 'dod pa dang / sman bzang pos tshe ring zhing nad 89—673

med par 'dod pa dang / phas kyi dgra thams cad dang / phyir rgol ba thams cad 'jil bar 'dod na/ gnas dben par dkyil 'khor byas te/ khrus byas gos sar pa bgos ①te/ rtswa ②bting ba'i steng du 'dug nas / sku gzugs ring bsrel (gecan gyi (snyemadun nam/ mchod rten ring bsrel yican gyi mdun du/me tog dang / bdug pa dang / zhal zas sna tshogs kyis mchod de/ skar ma rgyal dang sbyar ba'i tshes brgyad la sems rtse gcig gis gzungs sngags 'di bzlas pas spyan drangs par ⑦'gyur te/ sngags la/ tabya thā/ tsi li tsi li/ tsu ru tsu ru2/ ku ru ku ru/ ku ṭu ku khusti/ to ṭu to ṭu/ ba ha ba ha/ ba ri she/ba ri she miswā hā/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor bzhi po gang yil la zhig gis/bdag spyan drang ba'i phyir sngags kyi tshig 'di brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas na/ bdag de'i gan du mchi bar bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das sems can gang la la zhig bdag dang mjal zhing ⑩smra bar 'tshal na/ cho ga snga ma'i tshul du bshams te/ sngags 'di bzlas par bya'o/ /tabya thā/ añca 7ni/ kya lik+ṣa ⑩ni / shi shi dha ri/ ha ha/ hi gyisnyi/ ku ru ba re yiswā hā/ bcom ldan 'das sngags kyi tshig 'di brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ sngags snga ma bzlas pa byas na/de'i mdun du lus bstan te/ nges par bsam pa rdzogs par bgyi'o/ /gang sngags 'di zlos par 'dod pas/ sngar lus bsrung yo ba'i phyir sngags 'di brjod do/ /tar+ya thā/ shi ri nyanashi ri/ bā (17sha ka ti/ ta ti/ kurtsi/ pū ta / pū de ri/ pu de ri ṭi she )/ pa ṭi ku ku ṭi/ ka pa tsi li swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das gzungs 27sngags 'di bsgrub 9 gepa'i tshe tshon skud sna lnga la sngags lan re gdab cing mdud pa re re bcing ngo / /de 'dra ba 6 lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas sgo )89wa 674

te / dpung pa g.yon pa la btags na 'jigs pa thams cad bsal te①/lus bsrungs par ②'gyur ro/ /sems mi g.yeng bar sngags 'di bzlas na /bsam pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro④/ /bdag gi tshig 'di mi bslu dubar ni 6nyesangs rgyas dkon mchog dang / chos dkon mchog ⑦dang / dge 'dun dkon mchog rnams bdag la mngon du gzigs shing dgongs par gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sa'i lha mo brtan ma (nyal legs so zhes 5)bka' stsal te⑩ / gang khyod kyi 4nyubaden pa'i sngags kyi tshig 'dis mdo sde'i dbang po 'di dang / chos smra ba de la bsrung ba 7byas pa de ni tsolegs so legs so/ /de'i phyir khyod dhikyang bsod nams kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las/ sa'i lha mo brtan ma'i le'u zhes bya ste bcwa tsobargyad pa'o// //de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po yang dag shes/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang lhan cig tu stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu bgos tshanas/ pus tsho mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das da ltar dang /ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ grong rdal lam/ ljongs sam/ dgon pa'i phyogs sam/ ri'i sman ljongs samatshon/ pho brang 'khor gang du 'byung bar 'gyur ba 47der/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po yang dag 89—675

shes bdag gnod 0)sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nyi shu rtsa brgyad po de dag dang lhan cig tu grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ grong rdal lam/ ljongs sam/ dgon pa'i phyogs sam/ ri'i sman ljongs samacha/ pho brang 'khor der mchi bar bgyi'o/ /lus mi gda' bar bgyis te②/ dge slong chos smra ba de ④bsrung dubar bgyi'o/ /yongs su bskyab ⑥pa dang / yongs su gzung ⑦ba dang / yongs su bskyang ⑧ba dang ske/ chad pa spang ba dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /skyes pa'am/ bud med dam/ khye'u 'am/ bu mo chos nyan pa de dag thams cad dang ⑨/ gang su dag gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di las tha na tshig bzhi pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig 7nyan pa dang / tha na tshig gcig gam(nya/ tha na gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di las byang chub sems dpa'i ming gcig gam/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan gcig tsam 7thos par gyur te/ gzung yo ba dang / tha na gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i 7rgyal po 'di'i ming thos par gyur 7te/ gzung ⑩ba de dag 8thams cad kun tu bsrung (stebar bgyi'o/ /yongs su bskyab 'o)pa dang / yongs su gzung 3lhab dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang /37 zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /rigs de dag dang / khyim de dag dang / grong de dag dang / grong khyer de dag dang / grong rdal de dag dang / dgon pa de dag dang / pho brang 'khor de dag kyang kun du bsrung sgonyebar bgyi'o/ /yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung 9 nyab dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / chad pa spang ba dang / zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das rgyu gang gis 9 stobadag gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po yang dag 89—676

shes zhes ming du chags par gyur ce na/ 'di ni btsun pa bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi ①mngon sum lags te/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag gis chos thams cad 'tshal to/ /chos thams cad yongs su 'tshal to/ /chos thams cad khong du chud do/ /chos thams cad ji snyed pa dang / chos thams cad ji lta ba dang / chos thams cad ②gnas pa chagang lags pa dang / chos thams cad gang dag lags pa dang / chos thams cad kyi rigs gang dag dulags pa dang /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad bdag la mngon sum mo/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad la bdag gi ye shes ⑤snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /ye shes kyi gsal ba bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /ye shes kyi rgyu ba bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /ye shes kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad la bdag gi ye shes kyi yul 'jug pa bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das ji ltar ⑥bdag chos thams cad yang dag par 'tshal ba dang / yang dag par yongs su brtags pa dang / yang dag par ⑦yongs su 'tshal ba dang / yang dag par rnam par bltas pa nidang /yang dag par khong du chud pa'i rgyu des na/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po yang dag shes zhes ming du chags so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag gis dge slong chos smra ba de'i dzi)tshig brgyan ⑩par bgyi ba'i slad du spobs pa nye bar bsgrub /tshonapar bgyi'o/ /ci nas dge slong 4 chos smra ba de'i 6gelus mi ngal bar 'gyur ba dang / lus kyi dbang po bde bar 'gyur ba dang glu/ rab tu dga' ba skye bar 'gyur ba dang / gang gi slad du sangs rgyas 'bum phrag dzadag la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun rdzipa'i sems can rnams kyi don gyi 89—677

slad du gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di 'dzam bu'i gling du yun ring du gnas shing / myur du nub par mi 'gyur ba dang / sems can rnams kyang gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di nyan par 'gyur ba dang / ye shes kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob par 'gyur ba dang 6)/shes rab dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / bsod nams kyi phung po rab tu 'dzin par 'gyur ba dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus na bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du mar lha dang / mi'i bde ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag myong bar 'gyur ba dang ske/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang 'grogs par 'gyur ba dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu ②mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba dang / sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal thams cad rab ①tu zhi bar bgyi ba'i slad du/ de'i spu'i bu ga rnams su gzi byin stsal bar bgyi'o//de'i lus la mthu dang / stobs dang / brtson 'grus chen po bskyed par bgyi'ol/ /de'i ye shes kyi 4snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab par bgyi'o/ /de'i dran pa khong du chud par bgyi'og/ /de cher spro bar bgyi'o/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon sgyu chen po yang dag nya shes kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la gzungs (87sngags shig (9)mchis pa 'di sems can thams cad la phan pa dang snying brtse ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bdag nyid kyis sngags 'di gdon khopar bgyi'o/ /sngags la/ na mo bud+dhā tsho1ya/ na mo dharmā ya/na maḥsi bhā 12ya/ na mo braṅgā (12ya/ na ma in+d+ra r+shaya/ na ma: tur tsā/ma mihā rā dzā rnal/ tabya thā/ hi li hi li/ mi li mi li/ gi ri1 / ma hā gi 89—678

ri / garnya ①ri/ ma hā gad+dha ri/ dri mi ḍi0/ ma hā ②dri mi ḍidu/ daṇ+ḍa khu khun til/ ha ha ha hasti/ hi hi hi hiX/ hu hu hu hul/ ha lo dha me/ gu dha me / tsa tsa tsa tsa/ tsi tsi tsi tsi/ tsu tsu tsu tsu/ tsaṇ+ḍi 6)shwa ra/ shi kha ra/ shi kha ra/ u tiṣ+ṭha he ⑩bha ga bān/ saṃ bid dz+nyā ye yiswā hā/ gang la la zhig gis rig sngags 'di 'chang zhing 'dzin na tshubadag gis de la 'tsho ba'i yo byad bsod snyoms dang / gos dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / nor dang ⑫/rin po che la sogs pa thams cad stsal bar bgyi'o/ /gang la la zhig bu pho mo smos pa tsodang / bran pho dang / bran mo dang / gser dang / dngul dang /rin po che dang / rgyan la sogs pa'i yo byad 'dod na yang / bdag gis de la yid bzhin du so sor stsal bar bgyi'o/ /rig sngags 'di'i 8mthu dang / gzi brjid chen po dang ldan pa'i phyir/ gang (nyagasang sngags 'di zlos pa'i tshe/bdag myur du de'i gan du mchi ste'/ ci yang thogs pa med par 'grub par bgyi'o / /gsang sngags 'di sgrub pa'i cho ga ni/ thog mar gnod sbyin gyi bdag po chen po yang dag shes kyi 4shegazugs/ srid chag bzhi pa'am(6/ lnga pa lag na dgra sta so)thogs pa bris pa'i mdun du dkyil 'khor gru bzhir byas pa'i grwa bzhir sbrang rtsi'am/ bu ram chus gang ba'i bum pa bzhi zhig (nyal/ byug pa dang / phye ma dang / bdug pa bsreg zhu cing / me tog gi phreng bas (nyekyang mchod par bya'o( ste/ /yang dkyil 'khor de'i mdun du sbyin sreg ( gegi thab khung brkos pa la dud pa med pa'i me'i yinang du/ mar dang yungs kur du khri bsres la/ sngags lan re bzlas shing thab de'i nang du sbyin sreg ( shebya'o/ /de ltar lan brgya rtsa brgyad bsregs pa dang / bdag de la lus mngon par bstan 7te/ khyod ci 'dod 89—679

ces dri bar bya'o/ /de nas sgrub pa po ①des kyang ci 'dod pa de la smros ②shig dang —/ ci 'dod pa de dag ①sbyin par byed do/ /gang gser dngul 'dod pa dang ske/ gter tshol bar 'dod pa dang / lha'i drang srong 'dod pa yang 'grub ste / nam mkha' la 'gro'o/ /gzhan yang lha'i mig dang / pha rol gyi sems shes pa la sogs pa'i mngon par shes pa thams cad kyang thob par byed do/ /sems can thams cad la yid bzhin du dbang sgyur ④zhing nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi rgyun bcad de/ rnam par grol ba thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po yang dag shes la legs so zhes bka' stsal te (5)legs so legs so/ /gang khyod kyis sems can thams cad la phan zhing bde ba dang / dam pa'i chos 'di yongs su bsrung 6)ba'i phyir/gsang ⑦sngags kyi tshig 'di smras pas (kyebasod nams dpag tu med pa 6)'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las gnod sbyin gyi dbang po yang dag shes kyi le'u zhes bya (7ste bcu dgu pa'o// //de nas sa'i lha mo brtan 07ma zhes bya ba de 'khor mang po de'i nang na 'dug pa stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos 7phyag 'tshal (stenas / thal mo sbyar ba btud de 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang yul 'khor na mi'i rgyal po byed pas yang dag pa'i chos mi spyod na/ yul gyi srid 'dzin cing sems can mang po la bde ba dang rang gi lus rgyal thabs mthon ñca)po'i sa na yun ring por gnas par mi 'gyur bas/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje dang ldan pas rgyal po'i bstan bcos yang dag pas/ yul gyi srid ji 7ltar 89—680

'dzin pa bshad par gsol/ de thos pas mi'i rgyal po rnams chos de lta bus 'jig rten skyong zhing rgyal thabs dam pa la yun ①ring du gnas pas bde bar 'gyur ba dang / yul 'khor gyi skye bo de dag ②thams cad kyang yongs su bde bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor mang po'i tshogs kyi nang na sa'i lha mo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sa'i lha mo khyod de'i phyir shin tu legs par nyon cig /sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na rgyal po stobs kyi dbang po'i tog ①ces bya ba la ④bu mdzes pa'i tog (nyaces bya ba de⑥/ spyi bo nas dbang bskur nas ring por ⑦ma lon pa zhig na/ yab mchog gi rgyal po dbang po'i ⑧tog las blangs pa/ rgyal po'i bstan 6)bcos lha'i dbang po'i dam tshig ces bya ba zhig yod de/ ngas sngon 7rgyal po'i bstan bcos lha'i dbang po'i dam tshig des lo nyi khri'i bar du rgyal po nyid byas par (2gyur te/ tha na sems kyi skad cig gcig tsam gyi tshod 7kyang sngon chos ma yin pa'i 4 phyogs 'ga' zhig la gnas par ma shes so/ /bu rgyal po'i bstan bcos lha'i dbang po'i dam tshig ces bya ba de gang zhe na/ de nas rigs kyi lha mo de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po stobs kyi dbang po'i tog gis / bu rgyal po mdzes pa'i tog la/ rgyal po'i bstan bcos lha'i dbang po'i dam tshig ces bya ba tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis/rgya cher yang dag par rab tu bstan to/ /sems can kun la phan byed pa/ /the tshom thams cad gcod pa po/ /nyes byas thams cad 'jig 8byed pa/ /rgyal po'i bstan bcos bshad par bya/ /rgyal po thams cad so so nas/ /dga' ba'i sems su 'gyur byos la/ /lha yi dbang tsopo'i dam tshig kun/ /thal mo sbyar te mnyan 7par byos/ /rdo rje'i 'byung gnas ri dbang 'dir/ / lha yi 4she89—681

dbang po 'dus pa na/ /tshangs dbang la ni dri ba'i phyir/ /'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyang langs/ /khyod ni lha gtso tshangs pa ste/ /khyod ni lha rnams dbang phyug lags/ /khyod ni bdag cag the tshom gcod/ /bdag cag dogs pa bcad du gsol/ /mir skyes pa yi rgyal po la/ /ji lta bur na ⑦lha zhes bgyi/ /gang gi ②rgyus na rgyal po la/ /lha sras zhes ni bgyi bar 'gyur/ /gal te lha ni ②ji lta bur / /mi yi 'jig rten 'dir skye zhing ④/ /mi bdag gyur te mi rnams la/ /rgyal po nyid ni bgyid par 'gyur/ /'jig rten skyong bas tshangs dbang la/ /de skad yongs su dris pa dang / /lha yi gtso bo tshangs pa des/ /'jig rten skyong la (nya'adi skad smras/ /de ltar 'jig rten skyong rnams kyisakyi/ /de ⑦ltar bdag la dris pas (nyan/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /bstan bcos dam pa kho bos bstan/ /mi yi gnas su skyes pa ni6)/ /rgyal po rnams kyi skye ba ⑩dang ske/ /rgyu gang gis na yul rnams su/ /rgyal por gyur pa (1bshad par bya/ /lha dbang rnams kyi byin brlabs kyis7/ / ma yi (nyarum du 'jug 'gyur 7te/ /lha yis sngar ni byin brlabs yinas/ /phyi nas mngal du 'jug par 'gyur/ /mi yi 'jig rten skyes kyang ni/ /mi yi dbang por gyur pa yin/ /lha las skyes par gyur pas na/ /de ni lha yi sras zhes ⑩bya/ /khyod ni lha kun bu yin zhes/ /sum cu rtsa gsum lha dbang gis/ /rgyal po'i skal ba byin nas ni/ /mi rnams kyi ⑩ni dbang por sprul/ /nyes par byas pa rnams 'gog pa/ /chos ma yin pa gzhig pa dang / /sems can legs byed dgod pa dang / /lha yi gnas su dgye ba'i 1 phyir/ /mi yi dbang po mi shas dang / /lha yi (7shas dang dri za'i shas / /gdol pa'i shas dang srin shas kyis/ /nyes par byed pa zlog 9 gyepar 89—682

byed / /legs par bya ba ①byed rnams la/ /mi yi dbang po pha ma'i shas/ /rnam smin 'bras bu bstan pa'i phyir/ /lha yis rgyal por ②byin gyis brlabs/ /tshe 'di ①legs par byas pa dang / /nyes par dubyas pa'i las rnams kyisaX/ /rnam smin 'bras bu bstan pa'i phyir/ /lha yis rgyal por ⑤byin gyis brlabs/ /yul na nyes byed ⑦gnas pa dag /gang tshe rgyal pos yal ⑧bor zhing / /sdig pa can gyi skye bo la/ /mthun pa'i chad pas mi gcod cing / /nyes par byed pa yal bor ba/ /de tshe chos min shin tu 'phel/ /thab ṇimo dang ni g.yo rnams kyang / /yul 'khor der ni phyi phyir 'byung / /sum cu rtsa gsum khang pa na⑩/ /lha yi dbang po 'khrug par 'gyur/ /yul na nyes byed gnas pa dag /gang tshe rgyal pos yal bor ba/ /de tshe g.yo ni mi bzad pa/ /drag po rnams kyis yul ⑩'joms 'gyur/ /pha rol dmag tshogs lhags nas su/ /yul 'khor de ni rnam par 'jig /longs spyod rnams dang rigs 8kyang 'jig /gang gi nor bsags yod pa yang / /g.yo byed (shernam pa mang po yis/ /phan tshun du ni 'phrog par 'gyur/ /bya ba gang gis rgyal po nyid/ /bya ba de ni mi byed na/ /glang chen dbang pos rdzing bu bzhin/ /rang gi yul 'khor rnam par 'jig /ma rungs pa yi 7rlung ldang zhing / /ma rungs pa yi char pa 'bab/ /nyi ma dang ni zla ba dang / /gza' dang rgyu skar ma rungs 'gyur/ /rgyal pos yal bar bor na der / /sa bon lo tog me tog 'bras/ /legs par smin par mi 'gyur zhing / /mu ge dag kyang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /yul na nyes byed gnas pa dag /gang tshe rgyal pos yal bor nal/ /de tshe lha rnams khang pa na/ /yid ni dga' bar mi 'gyur ro/ /lha rgyal dbang po de dag kun/ /rgyal 'di yichos dang mi ldan te(ca/ /89—683

chos min phyogs la gnas pa'o zhes/ /phan tshun du ni smra bar 'gyur/ /rgyal 'dis ring por mi thogs par/ /lha rnams 'khrug par byed par 'gyur/ /lha rnams rab tu 'khrugs pas na①/ /de yi yul ni rnam par 'jig /yul du chos min 'byung 'gyur ②zhing / /mtshon chas kyang ni 'jig par 'gyur/ /g.yo ③rnams dang ni thab dumo dang / /nad kyang kun tu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lha dbang rnams ni rab khros khyashing / /lha rnams kyis ①kyang yal bar 'dor/ /yul 'khor de ni 'jig par 'gyur/ /rgyal po de ni mya ngan rnyed/ /spun nam yang na bu yang rung / /sdug pa rnams dang bral bar 'gyur/ /sdug pa'i chung ma dang yang bralag/ /yang na bu mo 'chi bar 'gyural/ /skar mda' ⑨dag kyang lhung ⑩bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin nyi ma 'dra ba 'byung (nya/ /pha rol gyi ni dmag tshogs dang —/ /mu ge shin tu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de yi 8glang po phangs pa dang / /blon po phangs pa 'chi bar 'gyur/ /de yi 'og tu rnga mo ni/ /phangs pa dag kyang 7'chi bar 'gyur/ /khyim dang longs spyod nor rnams kyang / /phan tshun du ni 'phrog par 'gyur/ /yul yul du ni mtshon cha yis/ /phan tshun du ni 'debs par 'gyur/ /thab bomo dag dang rtsod 'dang g.yo/ /yul rnams su ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /yul 'khor du ni gdon 'jug cing / /mi bzad 7pa yi nad kyang 'byung / /de yi 'og tu sbyin gnas kyang / /chos dang ldan pa ma yin 'gyur / /de yi 'khor dang blon po yang / /chos dang ldan pa ma yin 'gyur/ /chos dang mi ldan skye bo la/ /de yi 'og tu mchod byed 'gyur/ /chos dang ldan pa'i sems can la/ /rtag tu chad pas gcod par 'gyur/ /chos dang mi ldan skye bo bkur / /chos ldan chad pas bcad pas na/ /der ni chu dang rgyu skar 89—684

rlung glu/ /rnam gsum rnam par 'khrug par 'gyur/ /chos min skye bo bzung bas na / /dam chos ro yi snying po mdangs①/ /sems can mdangs dang sa yi bcud / /dngos po rnam ②gsum rnam ⑧par 'jig /skye bo ngan pa rab bkur cing ske/ /skye bo dam pa smad ①pas na/ /'chi dang lce 'bab mu ge dang / /rnam pa gsum ni der 'byung 'gyur/ /'bras bu lo thog dur dang mdangs/ /de yi 'og tu med par 'gyur/ /sems can nad pa mang po dag /yul rnams su ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /mngar zhing che ba'i 'bras bu dag /yul rnams na ni yod pa yang / /kha ba dang ni tsha ba dang / /chung ba dag ⑥ni nyid du 'gyur/ /rtse dang dgod ⑦dang dga' ba dang / /sngan nichad dga' ba'i dngos po dang ⑨/ /dga' ⑩ba nyams shing mi dgar ⑩'gyur/ /nyon mongs brgya yis rnam par 'khrugs / /lo thog ⑩rnams dang 'bras bu yi/ /snum dngos 6)khu ba zad pas na//lus dang khams dang dbang po la/ /de ltar tshim par mi 'gyur ro/ /sems can rnams ni mdog ngan cing / /mthu chung shin tu rid par 'gyur/ /kha zas mang po zos kyang ni/ /tshim par 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /stobs dang mthu tsodang brtson 'grus kyang / /de yi 'og tu med par 'gyur/ /sems can brtson 'grus nyams pa dag /yul rnams su ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sna tshogs nad kyis gzir ba yi/ /sems can nad mang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /srin po sna tshogs las gyur pa'i/ /gza' dang rgyu skar 'byung bar 'gyur/ /chos min phyogs la rab gnas te/ /rgyal po chos dang mi ldan pas/ /'jig rten gsum gyi dkyil 'khor na/ /khams gsum rnam par 'jig par 'gyur/ /gang tshe rgyal po phyogs gnas te/ /nyes byed yal bar tso'ador ba'i tshe/ /'di 'dra'i nyes pa 89—685

du ma dag /yul rnams su ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lha dbang rnams kyis dgos ①gang phyir/ /rgyal po'i ②byin gyis brlabs pa yig/ /rgyal po nyid ni mi byed cing ske/ /nyes byed yal bar 'dor na ni/ /legs par byas pas sems can rnams / /lha yi gnas su lhar yang skye/ /nyes par byas pas yi dgas dang / /sems can dmyal dang dud 'gror skye/ /gang tshe rgyal po ༷yul rnams na/ /nyes byed yal bar 'dor ba'i tshe/ /sum cu (migasum gyi yilha gnas nas/ /nyes pa ⑦byas pas ltung bar 'gyur/ /rgyal po nyid ni mi byed na/ /de yi nibu yang ma yin la / /lha yi rgyal po pha rnams kyi7/ /gnas la nyes dang bcas par 'gyur/ /g.yo ni shin tu mi bzad ⑩pas/ /gang tshe yul 'khor 'jig 'gyur ba/ /de phyir lha yi tunyedabang rnams kyis/ /mi'i 7gnas rgyal po byin gyis brlabs/ /nyes par byas pa zhi bya'i phyir/ /legs par byed la 'dzud skipa ste/ /tshe 'di la ni sems can la/ / yul gyi chos kyi don gyi phyir/ /8rnam smin skyed pa rgyal po yin / /legs byas dang ni nyes 8byas kyi/ /las kyi rnam par smin pa'i 'bras/ /rnam pa tha dad bstan ⑩pa'i phyir/ /byed pa gang yin rgyal por brjod/ /bdag gi don dang gzhan don dang / /yul gyi chos kyi don gyi phyir/ /lha tshogs rnams kyis 7byin gyis brlabs/ /lha rnams dag kyang rjes yi rang / /yul 'khor rnams 1nyan skye bo ni/ /sdig can g.yon (7can 'dul ba dang / /yul gyi chos kyi don gyi 9 nyaphyir/ /srog dang ( nyargyal srid rnams kyang btang / /chos ma yin pa bzod byed cing / /shes bzhin yal bar 'dor ba ni/ /yul na 'jigs pa mi bzad ( 2pa/ /de 'dra gzhan du 9 nyayod ma yin/ /ji ltar g.yo rnams byung (9ba la / /g.yo byed chad pas ‘ sum bcad na/ /yul du shin tu mi bzad pa'i na/ /89—686

g.yo ①rnams phyir ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /glang chen rnams kyis rdzing chen bzhin//yul 'khor der ②ni rnam par 'jig /lha dbang rnams kyang 'khrug ①par 'gyur / /lha yi gnas ni rnam par 'jig /yul du dngos po thams cad ni/ /ma rungs par yang 'gyur bas na/ /de phyir sdig pa byed pa rnams/ /nyes pa'i rim dubazhin gdul bar bya/ /chos kyis ⑤yul 'khor bskyang bar ⑥bya/ /chos ma yin pa spyad mi bya/ /srog kyang yongs su gtang ④bya zhing / / nyes mgon bya ⑧bar mi bya'o/ /skye bo gnyen dang skye bo gzhan/ /yul 'khor skye bo thams cad la / /rgyal pos phyogs kyang gcig bya yi5ste/ /phyogs su lhung bar gyur ⑩ta re/ /rgyal po (nyachos dang ldan pa yi/ /grags pa 'jig rten gsum gang ste/ /sum cu ⑫gsum gyi tsoganas rnams na/ /lha yi dbang po dgar gyur te/ /'dzam bu'i gling na nged kyi bu/ /'di ltar chos ldan rgyal po yin/ /chos kyi yul 'khor der bstan tsonas/ /legs par byung 7la skye bo bkod/ /rgyal po de ni legs byed pas / /skye bo dag ni 'dir 'gyed ⑩de/ /lha dang lha yi bu rnams kyis/ /lha gnas gang bar byed snyam mo/ /chos kyi yul 'khor der bstan nas / /rgyal po rnams ni rab tu dga'/ /lha dbang rab tu dad gyur pas0)/ /mi yi rgyal po de la srung / /nyi zla dang ni de bzhin du/ /rgyu skar legs par rgyu bar 'gyur/ /rlung yang dus su ldang 'gyur zhing / /char pa'ang yinyedus su 'bab par 'gyur/ /lha gnas rnams dang de bzhin du/ /yul 'khor rnams su lo legs byed/ /lha dang lha yi bu rnams kyis/ /lha yi gnas rnams gang bar byed/ /de lta bas na rgyal po yis/ /bdag gi phangs pa'i srog btang gis( )/ /gang gis 'jig rten bder rtena'agyur ba/ /dkon mchog chos ni mi btang ( geste/ /yon tan rnams 89—687

kyis ①gang brgyan ②pa/ /chos dang ldan pa ③bsten par bya/ /rang gi skye bos rtag dga' ba/ /rtag par sdig pa rnam par spongs/ /chos kyis duyul 'khor bskyang bar bya/ /chos kyang yang dag bstan par bya/ /legs par byed la sems can dgodadu/ /nyes byed las ni bzlog ⑥par bya/ /gang tshe sdig pa byed pa rnams/ /tshul bzhin gdul bar byed pa'i tshe/ /yul 'khor du ni lo legs shing ske/ /rgyal po gzi brjid ldan par 'gyur/ /rgyal po grags dang ldan 'gyur zhing ske/ /skye dgu rnams kyang bde bar skyong / /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las rgyal po'i bstan ⑦bcos lha'i dbang po'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i le'u ste nyi shu pa'o// // bam po dgu pa/⑧ de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis nyatshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /gang tshe 'khor los sgyur ⑩ba'i rgyal por gyur7ske/ /de tshe rgya mtshor bcas pa'i sa rnams dang ⑫/ /gling bzhi 0rin chen gang bar bcas pa yang / /sngon gyi rgyal ba dag la ngas phul lo/ /chos kyi sku de ⑫yongs su btsal ba'i phyir/ /gang sngon yid du 'ong zhing phangs pa yi/ /dngos po de dag ngas ni ma (7btang med/ /bskal pa du mar phangs pa'i srog kyang btang —/ /ji ltar sngon gyi bskal pa bsam yas na/ /rin chen gtsug tor can gyi bde bar gshegs/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i bde bar gshegs de yi / /bstan la legs byung zhes bya'i rgyal po byung / /de ni gling bzhi'i yidabang phyug 'khor los sgyur(she/ /rgya mtshor thug pa'i sa la rab tu ston/ /rgyal dbang gsung phyir rgyal po'i pho brang na/ /de tshe rgyal po dam pa gnyid kyis log /rmi lam du ni 89—688

sangs rgyas yon tan thos/ /chos smra rin chen sogs kyi rmi lam ①na/ /rnam par lhang nger ②mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di/ /rab tu 'chad cing 'dug pa mthong bar gyur / /rgyal po de ni gnyid kyis log las sad/ /de yi lus kun dga' bas khyab ④par gyur/ /mgu nas rgyal po'i ⑤khab nas mngon ⑥byung ste/ /nyan thos dge 'dun mchog gi gnas su song / /rgyal ba'i gnyan thos rnams la mchod byed cing / /'phags pa'i dge 'dun 'di ni nirin chen sogs/ /yon tan ldan pa'i dge slong gang yod ces/ /chos smra rin chen sogs pa kun tu dris//de yi tshe na rin chen sogs pa ni/ /phug gzhan zhig gi nang na 'dug gyur te/ /mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di ni rnam sems la/ /kha ton 6)byed cing bde bar ⑩rab tu 'dug /dge slong chos smra rin chen sogs pa de/ /phun sum gzi brjid dpal gyis rab 'bar zhing / /phug gzhan zhig hunyen 'dug par 'gyur pa des(she/ /de yi tshe na rgyal po de la bstan/ /'di na yichos smra rin chen sogs pa 'di'/ /rgyal po'i spyod yul zab mo 'dzin pa ste/ /gser 'od dam pa zhes ni bya ba yi/ /mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po rtag tu ston/ /rin chen sogs pa'i rkang la phyag 'tshal 7te/ /rgyal po legs par byung bas 'di skad smras/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i 8rgyal/ /zla ba nya ba'i zhal 'dra bshad du gsol/ /rgyal po legs par byung ba de nyid la/ /rin chen sogs pas khas ni blangs pas na/ /stong gsum pa yi 'jig rten thams cad du/ /lha rnams thams cad rab tu dga' bar gyur/ /de tshe mi yi dbang pos /shes phyogs gzhi(smu/ /gtsang zhing mchog tu khyad par 'phags pa der/ /rin chen chu dang spos chus chag chag btab / /me tog sil ma bkram ste khri bshams nas/ /rgyal pos khri de gdugs 89—689

dang rgyal mtshan dang / /dar yug stong phrag du mas legs par brgyan①/ /rgyal pos khri der tsan+dan dam pa dag /rnam pa sna tshogs rnams kyang mngon par gtor / /lha dang klu dang lha min mi 'am ci/ /gnod sbyin dbang dang gnod sbyin lto 'phye ches/ /lha yi me tog man dā phyir ba'i char/ /khri de la ni mngon par rab tu phab/ /chos 'dod lha ni bye ba khrag khrig stong / /bsam gyis mi khyab gang dag lhags gyur pa/ /rin chen sogs pa mngon par byung ba na/ /sa la ①me tog dag gis mngon par 'thor/ /chos smra rin chen sogs pa de nyid kyang ske/ /shin tu lus bkrus gtsang ma'i gos bgos te/ /khri der nye bar song ba ④ byas nas ni/ /thal mo sbyar (gyeb byas te phyag kyang 'tshalayi/ /lha dbang dang ni lha dang lha mo rnams/ /bar snang 'dug ⑦nas me tog man dā (kyera'i/ /char pa 'bebs shing sil snyan brgya stong phrag /bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag rab tu sgrogs / /rin chen sogs pa dge slong chos smra des/ /phyogs bcu dag gi sangs rgyas bye ba stong / /bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag dran byas nas/ /de ni mngon par 'dzegs tsho)te 'dug par gyurakyi/ /sems can kun la snying brtse bskyed nas ni/ /snying rje'i sems kyang yang dag bskyed nyanyabyas te/ /rgyal po legs par byung ba de la ni/ /de yi tshe na mdo sde 'di bstan te/ /rgyal pos (gethal mo sbyar byas 'dug khri nas su/ /tshig gcig gis ni rjes su yi rang ste/ /chos kyi shugs kyis mig nas mchi ma byung / /de yi lus ni yidaga' bas khyab par gyur / /mdo sde 'di la mchod skapa bya ba'i phyir/ /de tshe rgyal po legs par byung ba yis/ /yid bzhinari nor bu rin chen rgyal po blangs/ /sems can rnams phyir smon lam btab pa ni/ /rin chen bdun dang ldan pa'i rgyan rnams dang / /89—690

gang yang 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir sems can rnams/ /bde bar gyur pa'i nor bu rin po che'i①/ /char pa de ring 'dzam bu'i gling du phob/ / de yi ①tshe na rin chen sna bdun dang / /dpung rgyan dang ni do shal rna cha mchog /de bzhin zas dang gos dang skom ③rnams kyang / /gling bzhi dag tu rab tu bab par ④gyur / /rgyal po phyilegs par byung bas 'dzam gling du/ /rin chen char pa 'bab ⑥pa de mthong nas/ /gling bzhi rin chen gang bar ⑦bcas pa ni/ /rin chen gtsug tor can gyi bstan la phuladu/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa nga ⑨/ /rgyal po legs par byung zhes bya ba ⑩gyur/ /gling bzhi dag ni (7rin chen gang bcas kyi/ /sa 'di de tshe nga yis yongs su btang / /gang gis rgyal po legs par byung de la/ /de tshe mdo sde 'di ni rab 8bstan pa/ /rin chen sogs pa chos smra dge slong de/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs der 'gyur to/ /ngas gang de tshe mdo sde 'di thos shing / /tshig gcig gis ni rjes su yi rangs te/ /nga ④ni dge ba'i las ni de nyid dang / /chos nyan 8pa dang rjes su yi rang bas/ /gser gyi mdog dang bsod nams brgya yi mtshan/ /blta na sdug cing mig tu mngon mdzes la/ /lha stong bye ba rab tu dga' byed pa/ /skye bos mthong na dga' lus rtag tu 'thobayi/ /bskal pa dag yinyeni bye ba brgya stong phrag /dgu bcu rtsa dgur yonye'akhor los sgyur 47rgyal gyur/ /bskal pa brgya stong du ma mang por yang / /ngas ni khams kyi rgyal po myong bar gyur( )/ /bskal pa bsam gyis mi khyab brgya byin gyur/ /tshangs pa'i dbang po yid bzhin de bzhin ( speno/ /gang dag tshad ni nam yang yod min pa'i/ /stobs bcu dpag med ngas ni mnyes par byas/ /ngas gang mdo thos rjes su yi rang ba/ /bsod nams phung po de 89—691

ltar tshad med mang / /bsam pa ji bzhin ngas ni byang chub thob/ /chos sku dam pa yang ni ngas thob bo/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las/legs par byung ba'i le'u zhes bya 6)ste nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o// //dpal ldan lha mo rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dad pa wang la la zhig 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa (gyidang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la/ yo byad thams cad kyis mchod pa chen po shin tu rgyas ③shing rgya che ba/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa byed par 'dod cing / 'das pa dang /ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis④/sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul zab mo yongs su shes par 'dod pa des/ gtsug lag khang ngam/ dgon pa'i phyogs kyang rung ste/ gang na gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston pa'i sa (7phyogs der / des gdon mi za bar g.yeng ba med pa'i sems kyis rna ba (7blags te/gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di mnyan par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis don 'di nyid 'khor la rgya cher (chubarjod pa'i phyir/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /gang zhig sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /bsam yas mchod pa byed 'dod cing / /sangs rgyas kun gyi spyod yul ba/ /zab mo rab tu shes 'dod pas(8/ /gtsug lag khang ngam gnas khang ngam / /gang na gser 'od dam pa yi/ /mdo sde (97dam pa 'di ston pa/ /sa phyogs der ni 'gro bar bya/ /mdo 'di bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /yon tan rgya mtsho mtha' yang yasabo/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho du ma las/ /sems can thams 89—692
